**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-043 requires no special containment, although it is recommended that SCP-043 not be used for purposes other than testing. A turntable is to be maintained in the same room for testing.

**Description:** SCP-043 appears to be a vinyl copy of "The White Album" by the Beatles; however, upon closer inspection, the record has no grooves. In spite of this, the record will play from start to finish regardless of the starting position of the needle.

**对象分类:** [*https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-9336 难欧克利]

**特别收容程序:** SCP-9805事件的照片存放在[站点-19]收容锁柜中的小型塑料袋内。

**描述:** SCP-9805是一个短暂出现的实体，出现在一个无关的科学项目中。尚未记录到其他SCP-9805的出现。

证据照片卷包含在[事件]中的照片最初由美国军事人员在麻省理工学院出现异常报告后发现。随后的调查突袭揭示了一个构造的消声室，用于进行首次发现SCP-9805的实验。

[[<]]
[[include :scp-wiki:component:image-block name= http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/local--files/scp-9805/Fullteeth.jpg|caption=收集的照片卷。|width=###px]]
[[/<]]

根据研究团队的说法，在消声室内放置了一名个体，并命令其在大约3分钟内拍摄一系列12张照片，每张照片间隔均匀。据报道，在照片冲洗前没有发生任何异常事件，直到照片冲洗后才注意到该形象。尽管如此，所有参与该事件的人都报告说失去了显著的回忆连贯性，无法准确回忆该期间发生的逻辑事件。

进一步对涉及人员的访谈将确认以下细节:[脚注]直接从目击者口述中转述，尽量减少外部解释或干预。[/脚注]

* SCP-9805具有物理存在。
* SCP-9805没有明显的气味。
* SCP-9805没有明显的味道。
* SCP-9805没有尝试物理互动。
* SCP-9805产生明显的声响。
* SCP-9805发出轻微的牙齿打颤声。

所有证据将被没收，包括[原始研究中使用的消声室]。后续尝试复制该事件均未能再现。

这些照片本身没有任何可识别的超自然特性。许多观看者报告说这些图片给他们带来强烈的平静感。

**Item #:** SCP-9805

**Object Class:** [*https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-9336 Euclid]

**Special Containment Procedures:** Photos of the SCP-9805 event are held in a small plastic bag within the [[[SCP-173 |Site-19]]] containment lockers.

**Description:** SCP-9805 was an entity which briefly manifested during an unrelated scientific project. No other materializations of SCP-9805 have been recorded.

The [*https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-9607 photo reel] containing evidence of the apparition was first located by the US Military following abnormal reporting emerging from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. A subsequent investigative raid revealed a constructed anechoic chamber, used to conduct the experiments which first discovered SCP-9805.

[[<]]
[[include :scp-wiki:component:image-block name= http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/local--files/scp-9805/Fullteeth.jpg|caption=Collected photo-reel.|width=###px]]
[[/<]]

According to the research team, an individual was placed within the chamber and ordered to take a series of 12 photos over the course of approximately 3 minutes, each within an evenly spaced duration. Reportedly, no abnormal events occurred until the photos were developed, at which point the figure was first noticed.  Despite this, all participating in the event reported a loss of notable retrospective coherency, rendering them unable to properly recall logical transpirations during the period.

Further interviews with the involved staff would confirm the following details:[[footnote]] Paraphrased directly from witness accounts, minimizing outside interpretation or intervention. [[/footnote]]

* SCP-9805 had a physical presence.
* SCP-9805 had no noticeable smell.
* SCP-9805 had no noticeable taste.
* SCP-9805 did not attempt physical interaction.
* SCP-9805 produced noticeable sound.
* SCP-9805 produced the faint sound of chattering teeth.

All evidence would be seized, including the [*https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-9853 chamber used] in the original study. Later attempts at replication would fail to reproduce the event.

The photographs themselves display no identifiable paranormal properties. Many viewers report the pictures bring them a strong sense of calm.

**物品编号:** SCP-037

**对象分类:** Euclid

**特别收容程序:** SCP-037 被磁性地收容在名为 Site-22 的地下设施中。对其大小、光谱特征和温度的监测既在现场进行，也从 Site-98 远程进行。

主收容室铺有导热性能强、抗辐射的 NANOPEEK GFV 聚合物瓷砖，并且已经抽空了任何大气。物体发出的热量会辐射到周围的岩石中。如果收容完整性受损，应急系统将生成低功率氩气等离子体屏蔽。这预计可以提供至少 4 小时的时间供现场工程师进行必要的修复，以防止物体突破收容。

在恒星演化提前于预期进展或收容失败不可避免的情况下，剩余的所有项目人员被授权启动 Pituaq 协议。

**描述:** SCP-037 看起来是一颗大约 5 厘米（2 英寸）直径的恒星，其亮度约为我们太阳的 1*10^-12 倍，表面温度约为 5000 K（通过 UBVRI 分析确定）。SCP-037 的起源尚不清楚，但分析表明它与典型的主序星有许多共同的特性，除了其异常小的尺寸。据推测，它可能通过北极地磁场进入地球的磁层。

该物体于 19██ 年在北冰洋上方大约北极地磁场位置处被发现。加拿大武装部队站 Alert 报告了强烈的电磁干扰，随后一个极其明亮的物体从天空下降到海洋表面。SCPS //守护者// 回应并发现该物体在水面上方约 200 米处摇摆不定。一旦制定了收容程序，它就被运送到 Site-32 进行研究。

SCP-037 的收容和运输是通过使用强大的电磁铁实现的，这些电磁铁根据物体自身的磁场对齐。迄今为止，收容的主要挑战是其强大的电磁发射，这些发射足够强烈，以至于从高地球轨道上用肉眼就能看到。目前的收容设施位于地下深处，以防止检测并促进向周围地壳的辐射冷却。实际上，整个设施和周围地壳的体积都充当了一个巨大的热汇。

附录 A: 在过去 ██ 年的研究中，这颗恒星的发射电磁辐射发生了变化，表明它正在以极高的速度进行恒星演化。如果标准恒星模型成立，这将导致其半径增加 100 到 300 倍，并伴随相应的能量辐射增加。对于这种可能性，正在研究紧急收容预案。进一步发展的恒星生命周期可能会终止于一颗恒星超新星，估计其爆炸能量为 ███████████。外推预测这将在 ███████████ 发生。正在进行研究以找到一种方法来阻止这一发展或将 SCP-037 安全地运离行星，以防其发生。

[[collapsible show="Pituaq 协议"  hide="1977年8月5日发送"]]
> **收件人:** O5 委员会
> **发件人:** Dr. Innis
> **主题:** SCP-037 紧急中和研究
>
> **正文:** 各位阁下，
>
> 我们嵌入美国国防部的特工已经成功修改了 NASA 卫星计划的要求。现在，该卫星将设计有足够的空间容纳 SCP-037 和临时收容装置，以便将其安全地运出地球。然而，我对此项目仍有一些保留意见。
>
> 当前的火箭技术并不足以满足这个项目的需要。一次错误可能导致发射失败并导致收容失效，甚至可能是灾难性的。即使成功发射，结果也不能有任何差错，否则会被观测站和仪器，甚至肉眼观测到。
>
> 有许多由基金会收容的物体可能允许我们以安全且经济的方式将 SCP-037 运送到相邻维度、宇宙或其他神秘领域。特别是 SCP-███ 可能特别方便，考虑到最近尝试探索它的结果以及中和 SCP-037 所面临的困难，这可能有助于减少或消除 SCP-███ 所带来的威胁。
>

**项目编号：**SCP-037

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-037以磁场收容于被称作Site-22的复合地下室。物体的大小、光谱特征和温度被即时于现场和从Site-98进行远程监控。

SCP-037的主收容室内衬覆盖以导热、耐辐射的纳米颗粒GFV聚合物瓦，并抽出所有气体。来自收容物的热量被辐射到周围的岩石中。如果收容室完整性受损，应急系统将产生一个低功率的氩等离子体屏蔽罩。 预计这将为现场工程师提供至少4个小时的时间，以便在异常收容失效之前进行必要的维修。

如果发生恒星演化超乎预期或者新星爆发事件迫在眉睫或者无法避免收容措施失效的情况，任何剩余的项目人员均被授权发动:“Pituaq协议”。

**描述：**SCP-037似乎是一颗直径约5厘米（2英寸）的恒星。具有太阳表面1*10^^-12^^倍的亮度，表面温度为5000K（通过UBVRI分析测定）。SCP-037的起源不明，然而，分析表明，除了其异常小的尺寸之外，它与典型的主序星有许多共同的属性。它理论上是通过地球的磁北极进入地球磁层的。

该物体发现于19██年的波佛特海的地磁北极附近。加拿大军事站点（CFS）在警报中报告有强烈的电磁干扰，随后一个极其明亮的物体从天空降向大海。驱逐舰SCPS//监护者//号予以响应，并且发现对象在水面上以循不稳定的轨道不定地摇摆。收容措施规划完毕后，对象立即被送至Site-32进行研究。

SCP-037的收容及运输可以通过强力电磁铁来完成，设备的工件会通过自身的磁场自行排列整合。目前为止收容的主要挑战一直是其強烈的电磁辐射，其强到可以在地球高空轨道上以肉眼观测。它当前的圍阻體位于地下深处以防止被目击和促使辐射逸散到周围的基岩里。事实上，整个设施及其周围的岩层就是一个巨大的散热器。

附录A：在过去██年的研究過程中，该恒星已經歷一次电磁辐射型態的变动，表明其正經歷大幅加速的恒星演化過程。如果参照标准恒星模型，这将很快導致其半径膨大100-300倍，並伴隨著辐射能量的增加。对于该可能性，正在研究紧急突发事件的控制。恒星生命周期进一步发展的结果很可能是一次新星爆炸，之後預計將生成███████████。外推法估計這可能在███████████之後发生。在此之前阻止该过程或将SCP-037运输到地球的安全距离外的研究已在進行中。

[[collapsible show="Pituaq 协议"  hide="寄于1977年8月5日"]]

> **收件人：**O5 议会
> **发件人：**Dr. Innis
> **邮件主题：**SCP-037 应急无效化研究
>
> **正文：**女士们先生们,
>
> 派往美国国防部的探员已经设法改变了NASA轨道飞行器项目的项目要求。飞行器现在的设计将有足够的空间容纳SCP-037和一个临时安全运输装置，以便把项目于运输出行星。然而，对此我仍然持保留意见。
>
> 我认为目前的火箭技术是非常不可靠的，它不能满足运输这个项目的需求。一个简单的错误就可能导致发射失败，随后使项目失去控制，其后果可能是灾难性的。即使是一次成功的发射也必须进行的非常完美，以免结果被全世界的天文台和仪器，甚至是肉眼看到。
>
> 基金会中包含了大量的收容物，这些收容物可能允许我们将SCP-037安全且经济有效地运输到邻近的维度、宇宙或着其他未知的领域。 考虑到近来对SCP-███的各种探索成果，以及对SCP-037进行无效化的困难，无效化SCP-037可能还可以用于减少或消除SCP-███带来的威胁
>
> 恳请您重新考虑到因为这些担忧而提出的Pituaq提案

[[>]]

**Item #:** SCP-037

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedure:** SCP-037 is magnetically contained in a subterranean complex known as Site-22. Object size, spectral signature, and temperature are constantly monitored both onsite and remotely from Site-98.

The primary containment chamber is lined with heat conducting, radiation-resistant NANOPEEK GFV polymer tiles and evacuated of any atmosphere. Heat from the object is radiated into the surrounding rock. Should enclosure integrity become compromised, the emergency system will generate a low power argon plasma shield. This is projected to provide a minimum of 4 hours for onsite engineers to effect necessary repairs before the object breaches containment.

In the contingency that stellar evolution proceeds ahead of projections and a nova event appears imminent, or if containment failure is otherwise unavoidable, any remaining project staff are authorized to initiate the Pituaq Protocol.

**Description:** SCP-037 appears to be a star approximately 5 cm (2 in) in diameter, with a luminosity of about 1*10^^-12^^ times that of our sun and a surface temperature of about 5000 K (determined by UBVRI analysis). The origin of SCP-037 is unknown, however, analysis suggests that it shares many properties in common with a typical main sequence star, other than its anomalously small size. It is theorized to have entered the Earth's magnetosphere via the North Magnetic Pole.

The object was discovered in 19██ above the Beaufort Sea at approximately the North Magnetic Pole. Intense electromagnetic interference was reported by Canadian Forces Station (CFS) Alert, followed by an extremely bright object descending toward the ocean from the sky. The SCPS //Guardian// responded and discovered the object wavering in an erratic trajectory about 200 m above the surface of the water. Once containment procedures were devised it was transported to Site-32 for study.

Containment and transport of SCP-037 have been achieved by the use of powerful electromagnets, to which the artifact aligns itself according to its own magnetic field. The primary challenge to containment thus far has been its powerful electromagnetic emissions, which are intense enough to be easily seen by the naked eye from high Earth orbit. Its current enclosure is located deep underground to prevent detection and to facilitate radiative cooling into the surrounding bedrock. In effect, the entire facility and the surrounding volume of the Earth's crust act as a massive heat sink.

Addendum A: Over the past ██ years of study, the star has undergone a shift in emitted EM radiation, suggesting that it is undergoing stellar evolution at a vastly accelerated rate. If standard stellar models hold up, this will soon result in an increase in radius by a factor of 100 to 300 times, and a concomitant increase in radiated energy. Emergency containment contingencies are being studied for that eventuality. Further progression of the star's life cycle will likely terminate in a stellar nova, which is estimated to have a yield of ███████████. Extrapolations predict this to occur in ███████████. Research is underway for a method to arrest this development or to transport SCP-037 a safe distance from the planet before it occurs.
[[collapsible show="Pituaq Protocol"  hide="Sent August 5, 1977"]]
> **To:** O5 Council
> **From:** Dr. Innis
> **Subject:** SCP-037 Emergency Neutralization research
>
> **Body:** Sirs and madams,
>
> The agents embedded with the US DoD have managed to alter the project requirement for the NASA orbiter program. The vehicle will now be designed with enough space to accommodate SCP-037 and a temporary containment apparatus in order to facilitate transport off-planet. However, I continue to have reservations.
>
> Modern rocket technology simply is not reliable enough for the needs of this project. A single mistake could lead to launch failure and subsequent loss of containment, possibly catastrophically. Even a successful launch would have to proceed perfectly, lest the result be visible to observatories and instruments, and possibly the naked eye, around the world.
>
> There are numerous artifacts contained by the Foundation which might allow us to transport SCP-037 safely and cost-effectively to an adjacent dimension, universe, or esoteric domain. SCP-███ in particular might prove especially convenient for this purpose, considering the outcomes of recent attempts to explore it and the difficulty of Neutralization of SCP-037 might thus serve the added purpose of reducing or removing the threat posed by that anomaly, as well.
>
> I implore you to reconsider the Pituaq proposal, submitted in light of these concerns.
> **END MESSAGE**

**描述：** SCP-8790是一个位于阿拉巴马州████████的废弃设施，建于19世纪晚期。该建筑占地约3,800平方米，包含宿舍、行政办公室、公共区域和其他用途不明的房间。在其中一个办公室的墙上钉有一块金属牌子，上面写着：

[[div style="background: url("https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/the-great-hippo/scp_trans.png") center no-repeat; float: center; border: solid 2px #000; padding: 1px 15px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.2);"]]

+++ 为了所有人的利益。
[[/div]]

没有档案中存在名为“非常异常部门”的部门。

关于该设施的原始用途仍不清楚，因为大多数文件和识别材料完全缺失。一些SCP-8790内的房间包括：

* 一个宽敞但空荡的房间，两排金属椅子面向墙上褪色的标志。房间显示出被广泛使用的迹象，地板上有明显的刮痕，且一个长期被毁坏的文件柜残骸散落其中。房间两端各有一个锈迹斑斑的观察窗。回收的物品包括一本生锈的账簿，记录着一系列名字以及标注“H2”、“H3”和“已纠正”。

* 一个几乎被烧毁的文件和损坏的文件柜填满的房间。虽然大多数文件已被大量红墨水覆盖或完全破坏，但仍有一些完整的文件提到“战后心理异常进展”和“候选人不可恢复。根据最终决议协议已解散”。

* 一个昏暗的房间，中央固定着一把椅子。从椅子到相邻墙壁的电线连接着几个损坏的设备和粗糙的机械工具。墙壁上覆盖着剥落的油漆，角落里有微弱的灰烬痕迹。椅子后面是一台投影仪。[注脚] 工具的目的尚不清楚，但它们被一种未知的干燥物质和头发覆盖。[注脚]

* 一个小型圆形房间，配备了一面破裂但功能正常的全身镜。墙壁上挂着厚重的褪色红色窗帘，阻挡了大部分光线。镜子裂缝中嵌入了一些布料和头发的残余物。

* 一个带有褪色壁画的矩形房间，壁画上描绘的是带翅膀的人物。房间左侧是一个讲台，底部刻有十字架。讲台后面是几根高度损坏的木板、鞭子和夹子。房间中心的地毯上有一些血渍。房间总是开着灯，尽管没有窗户。

* 一条由12个小牢房组成的走廊，每个牢房内都有一张床、一个非功能性的监视摄像头和一个安装在门上的喂食口。墙壁和天花板上划出的各种词语和短语，尽管大多无法辨认。

人员在SCP-8790内部停留时间过长会报告难以形成或维持个人关系。对于同性恋者来说，这种影响往往是永久性的。

* 一间巨大的空屋，有两排金属椅子面朝墙上一个褪色的标志。该房间表现出频繁使用的痕迹，墙壁上可见有磨损痕，还有一件被毁坏文件柜的残余。在房间的两端各有一个生锈的观察窗。在其中找到的物品包括一个生锈的会计簿，其内有若干名单和标记“H2”、“H3”以及“已矫正”。

* 一个黯淡的房间，其中心地板处钉有一把椅子。椅子上的电线延伸到附近墙壁上，墙上装有若干破损的设备和粗糙的机械装置。[[footnote]]这些工具的目的不明，但其上覆盖有一种不明的干燥物质和毛发。[[/footnote]]墙壁上覆盖有剥落的颜料，房间角落处可见模糊的灰烬痕迹。在椅子后方有一台投影机。[[footnote]]大部分影片无法解码，只余下一部分女人跳舞的片段。[[/footnote]]

* 一个小型的环形房间，其中有一面开裂但仍有映像的全身镜。墙壁上悬挂着厚实、褪色的红色帷幔，遮蔽了大部分光线。在镜子的裂痕中卡有少量残余的布料和头发。

* 一个方形房间，其内有若干褪色壁画，形似某种带翼形象。房间左侧有一讲台，基座处嵌有一受难像。在其后方放有若干戒尺、鞭子和钳夹，全部严重损坏。房间中心处的地毯上有血迹留存。房间内尽管无窗却始终明亮。

* 一条有12个小房间的走廊，每个房间内包含有一个小床、一个不再工作的监控探头、以及一个嵌在门上的投食槽。墙壁和天花板上有刮痕拼写成各种词语和文段，其中一个需注意的内容如下：“你不能把它从我这夺走。”

人员在长时间暴露于SCP-8790内部后，报告称在构建或维护人际关系上出现困难。此效应在同性恋人员中时常会永久持续。

**Special Containment Procedures:** The entrance to SCP-8790 has been locked and all potential entrances boarded up. A single armed guard is to be constantly patrolling SCP-8790. All access is forbidden.

**Description:** SCP-8790 is an abandoned facility located in ████████, Alabama, constructed sometime within the late 19th century. The building spans approximately 3,800 square meters and contains dormitories, administrative offices, communal areas, and other rooms with unclear purposes. Inside one of the offices, a metal placard is affixed to the wall, which reads:

[[=]]
[[div style="background: url("https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/the-great-hippo/scp_trans.png") center no-repeat; float: center; border: solid 2px #000; padding: 1px 15px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.2);"]]
++ DEPARTMENT OF ABNORMALITIES

+++ FOR THE BETTERMENT OF ALL
[[/div]]
[[/=]]
No department of this name exists within Foundation archives.

The original purpose of the facility remains unknown, as most documents and identifying materials are completely absent. Some examples of rooms within SCP-8790 include:

* A large, bare room with two rows of metal chairs facing a faded emblem on the wall. The room shows signs of extensive use, with visible scuff marks on the floor and remnants of a long-destroyed filing cabinet. Two rusted observation windows are located at either end of the room. Recovered artifacts include a rusted ledger containing lists of names alongside the notations "H2," "H3," and "Corrected."

* A room nearly filled with burnt documents and broken filing cabinets. While most papers are heavily redacted or entirely destroyed, a few intact files reference "Postwar advancements in psycho-██████ anomalies" and "Candidate irrecoverable. Decommissioned per final resolution protocol."

* A dimly lit room with a single chair bolted to the center of the floor. Wires run from the chair to an adjacent wall, where several broken devices and crude mechanical instruments are mounted.[[footnote]] The purpose of the tools are unknown, but they are covered in an unknown dried substance and hair. [[/footnote]] The walls are covered in peeling paint, and faint traces of ash are visible in the corners of the room. Behind the chair is a projector.[[footnote]] Most of the film is indecipherable, save for a clip of women dancing. [[/footnote]]

* A small, circular room featuring a cracked but functional full-length mirror. The walls are draped in thick, faded red curtains that block out most light. Small remnants of cloth and hair are lodged in the cracks of the mirror.

* A rectangular room featuring faded murals resembling winged figures. On the left side of the room is a podium with a crucifix etched onto the base. Behind it are several paddles, whips, and clamps, all highly damaged. The center of the room has stains of blood within the carpeting. The room is always lit despite the lack of windows.

* A hallway of 12 small cells, each containing a cot, a non-functional surveillance camera, and a feeding hatch built into the door. Scratch marks on the walls and ceilings spell out various words and phrases, although most are illegible.

Personnel exposed to the interior of SCP-8790 for extended periods report difficulty forming or maintaining personal relationships. This effect is often permanent among individuals attracted to the same sex.

**物品编号**: SCP-230

**对象分类**: Euclid

**特别收容程序**: SCP-230 被存放在Site-██ 的一个安全房间内。该房间必须配备受控通风系统，以确保从房间排出的空气在重新进入综合体的常规通风系统前能够被适当过滤。SCP-230 被提供他所要求的任何物品，只要不违反标准的SCP收容程序。每当门关闭时，它会自动上锁，并只能从房间外部打开。进入SCP-230房间的人员必须穿戴全套防化服并自带氧气供应。接触过SCP-230房间内的空气或与SCP-230或其体液有过身体接触的人员必须被隔离观察至少一个月。如果一个月后人员仍然表现出SCP-230的症状，则应予以终止。如果经现场工作人员确认后人员被解除隔离，他们将被转移并禁止与SCP-230接触。

由于最近发生的事件，接触过SCP-230并被解除隔离的人员需要定期进行心理检查。如果在检查中发现人员表现出文档230-4436b中列出的特征，该人员应予以终止。

**注意**: SCP-230曾多次利用接触过他的人员进行逃脱尝试。尽管这些人员通常处于受损状态，但SCP-230仍可能变得暴力以保持与他的接触。

**描述**: SCP-230是一名体型瘦削、面庞消瘦的白人男性，身高185厘米（6英尺1英寸），体重68.04公斤（150磅），年龄约为三十岁。他穿着鲜艳的衣服，偏好粉色和黄色。SCP-230是一个非常开朗的人，似乎无法产生负面情绪。

SCP-230从毛孔分泌一种类似于海洛因的化学物质，这种化学物质已被命名为化合物███。一旦从毛孔分泌出来，它会立即蒸发并在SCP-230周围污染空气。化合物███在气体形式下只需30ppm即可生效。吸入后，化合物███会导致受试者极度欣快。对SCP-230有反应的D级人员的分析显示，他们的多巴胺水平比性高潮时高出五倍以上。受试者表现出类似海洛因的效果，愿意遵从SCP-230的任何要求，前提是这些要求不涉及离开SCP-230的视线。

化合物███存在于SCP-230的所有体液中。即使通过接触SCP-230的皮肤也可能接触到这种化合物。暴露于化合物███会导致立即成瘾。戒断症状极为严重，死亡率高达30%。症状包括：食欲减退、震颤、恐慌、呕吐、腹泻、易怒、痴呆、疯狂、失明和出血，尽管症状因人而异。症状通常会在两周左右消失。症状的严重程度似乎取决于受试者暴露于化合物███的程度。摄入SCP-230的任何体液（如唾液、血液等）的受试者的戒断死亡率为100%。

SCP-230是在████████的一个公寓中被发现的，当时有二十人在充当他的仆人。SCP-230似乎在努力限制他接触的人数。在现场发现了几具被接触过的人员的尸体。当问及此事时，SCP-230回答说：“这里太拥挤了，所以我让一些人停止呼吸。”

SCP-230似乎一直在受到化合物███的影响，但他似乎并不因此而受损。试图改变SCP-230的情绪的努力都无效。使用各种已知会导致抑郁的药物只会导致SCP-230产生更多的化合物███，因此是无效的。

SCP-230是一个非常友好的个体，会与任何人员坦诚地交谈。SCP-230不清楚自己是如何开始分泌化合物███的。当被问及过去时，SCP-230表示他一直都在分泌化合物███，自他能记得的时候就开始了。

SCP-230喜欢谈论他认为“好”或“同性恋”的事物。SCP-230对“同性恋”这个词有一些心理依附。当被问及如何描述自己时，SCP-230用了“同性恋”六次，“欢乐”四次，以及一次“最同性恋的人”，表示“我就是世界上最同性恋的人”。

**Dr. ██████ 注释**: //SCP-230对“同性恋”的痴迷与性取向无关。由于完全缺乏对性的兴趣，SCP-230似乎没有性取向。这可以解释为什么无论进行何种活动，SCP-230都会体验到相同的愉悦感，使性变得没有必要。//

**附加记录230-1**: 研究员 ██████ ███ 在研究过程中意外接触到了化合物███。█████ █████ 被拘留并送往治疗直至戒断症状消失。一个月后，经过医疗人员的确认，█████ █████ 被释放。两个月后，█████ █████ 被发现试图闯入SCP-230的收容区域。█████ █████ 反应激烈，伤及多名人员后才被控制。█████ █████ 经检查后被终止，已采取措施防止再次发生此类事件；参见文档230-4436b。

**项目编号：**SCP-230

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-230被收容于██号站点的一个看守严密的房间内。房间须设有可控的通风设施，以确保从中排出的空气在重新进入站点的常规通风系统前能够被适当地过滤。在不违背SCP收容标准程序的情况下，应满足SCP-230的任何需求。门被设置为在每次关闭后自动上锁，且只能从房间外开启。进入房间的人员必须完整装备独立供氧的防护套装。暴露在SCP-230房间的空气中或与SCP-230及其体液存在身体接触的人员将被收容并受到不少于一个月的观察。一个月后仍表现出SCP-230相关症状的人员将被处决。若一个月后人员被现场员工证明无异常，则应将其调走并禁止其接触SCP-230。

鉴于近期的事件，通过观察的对象须定期接受心理检查。在检查中表现出任何文件230-4436b所述特征的人员将被处决。

**注意：**对象已利用接触SCP-230的人员数次尝试逃跑。由于人员通常都受到了损伤，这些尝试没有造成太大的威胁；然而，人员会为了留在SCP-230身边而变得暴力。

**描述：**SCP-230是一个体格精壮、面容瘦峭的男性白人。SCP-230身高185厘米（6英尺1英寸），体重68.04千克（150磅），外表为30岁出头。他衣着鲜艳，喜欢粉色和黄色。SCP-230性格非常开朗，似乎从来不会表现出负面情绪。

SCP-230的毛孔中会分泌出一种化学成分与海洛因类似的物质。这种物质被命名为化合物-███。从毛孔中被分泌出来后，它会立即蒸发，污染SCP-230周围的空气。化合物-███在气体中所占体积达到百万分之三十时即可起效。化合物-███被吸入后会引起极度的兴奋。对处于SCP-230影响下的D级人员的分析表明，此时血液中的多巴胺含量比性高潮时多巴胺预期含量的五倍还高。受试者表现出类似海洛因引发的损伤。他们将会满足SCP-230的任何要求，只要不离开SCP-230身边。

化合物-███在SCP-230的所有体液中都存在，甚至连与SCP-230进行皮肤接触都有感染的可能。接触这种化合物将立即导致成瘾，戒断症状非常激烈且有30％的致死率。症状包括：食欲减退、颤抖、心慌、呕吐、腹泻、烦躁、痴呆、精神失常、失明和严重内出血等，但个体症状有所差异。症状通常持续约两周后消退。症状似乎是由接触的化合物-███剂量多少所决定的。如果受试者摄入了SCP-230的任何体液（如唾液、血液等），戒断致死率将达到100％。

SCP-230在位于█████████的一座公寓里被发现，当时有二十人充当他的仆人。SCP-230似乎主动试图为被影响者的数量设限。现场发现了几具受影响者的尸体。当被问到时，SCP-230回答说：“越来越挤了，所以我只能叫几个人停止呼吸。”

SCP-230似乎也处于化合物-███的作用之下，但看上去他没有受到任何损害。转换其情绪的尝试均告失败。使用到的数种可引发抑郁症的药物都只能导致SCP-230分泌更多的化合物-███，因此被证明无效。

SCP-230是一个非常友好的人，愿意与任何人员坦率地交谈。SCP-230不清楚自己是怎样开始或从何时开始分泌化合物-███的。当被问及他的过去时，SCP-230回答说记忆里自己一直在分泌化合物-███。

SCP-230喜欢谈论那些他认为“好的”或“愉悦的”事物。SCP-230对“愉悦”这个词语有心理依附。当被要求对自己进行描述时，SCP-230使用了六次“愉悦的”，四次“愉悦[[footnote]] **译注：**名词[[/footnote]]”，以及在当他自称“世界上最愉悦的人”的时候使用了一次“最愉悦的”。

**██████博士注：**//SCP-230专注的“愉悦”和性取向无关。SCP-230似乎并没有什么性取向，因为他对性爱完全没有兴趣。这很容易理解，因为SCP-230无论做什么都能感受到同等的欢愉，性爱是毫无必要的。//

**附录230-1：**2级研究员██████ ███在研究时意外接触了化合物-███。██████ ███被拘押并在戒断症状持续期中接受治疗。一个月后，医务人员确认██████ ███的症状已经消除，██████ ███被释放。两个月后，██████ ███在试图闯入SCP-230的收容区域时被发现。██████ ███暴力地反抗，在被拘禁前使多名人员受伤。经检测后，██████ ███被处决。已制定预防措施以避免发生更多事故，详见文档230-4436b。

**Item #**: SCP-230

**Object Class**: Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures**: SCP-230 is kept in a secure room in Site-██. The room must have a controlled ventilation system so that air exiting the room can be properly filtered before it reenters the regular ventilation system of the complex. SCP-230 is to be given anything he requests that does not violate standard procedures for SCP containment. The door is set to automatically lock every time it closes and can only be opened from outside the room. Personnel entering SCP-230's room must wear a full HAZMAT suit with its own oxygen supply. Personnel exposed to the air in SCP-230's cell or who come in physical contact with SCP-230 or any of SCP-230's bodily fluids must be contained and held for observation for no less than one month. Personnel still exhibiting symptoms from SCP-230 after one month are to be terminated. If personnel are cleared by on-site staff after a month, they are then to be transferred and forbidden contact with SCP-230.

Due to recent events, subjects that have been exposed and cleared by staff are required to undergo regular psychological exams. If upon exam the personnel exhibits any of the traits shown in document 230-4436b, the personnel is to be terminated.

**NOTE**: Subject has made several escape attempts utilizing personnel exposed to SCP-230. This represents a low threat due to the fact that exposed personnel are usually impaired; however, personnel will become violent in order to stay in SCP-230's presence.

**Description**: SCP-230 is a male Caucasian with a lean build and gaunt appearance. SCP-230 is 185 cm (6 ft 1 in) tall, 68.04 kg (150 lbs), and appears to be in his early thirties. He wears bright clothing and prefers the colors pink and yellow. SCP-230 is a very cheerful individual who appears to be incapable of negative emotions.

SCP-230 secretes a chemical similar in composition to heroin from his pores. The chemical has been named Compound-███. Once secreted from his pores, it evaporates immediately and contaminates the air around SCP-230. Compound-███ seems to be effective in as little as thirty parts per million in gaseous form. When inhaled, Compound-███ causes extreme euphoria in subjects. Analysis on Class-D personnel under the effects of SCP-230 indicated they had dopamine levels greater than five times of what is expected during sexual climax. Subjects express impairment similar to the effects of heroin. Subjects become willing to comply with any request SCP-230 makes provided it does not involve leaving SCP-230's presence.

Compound-███ is present in all of SCP-230's bodily fluids. Exposure is possible even by contact with SCP-230's skin. Exposure to the compound will result in immediate addiction. Withdrawal symptoms are extreme and have a thirty percent mortality rate. Symptoms include: loss of appetite, tremors, panic, vomiting, diarrhea, irritability, dementia, insanity, blindness, and hemorrhaging, though symptoms vary from subject to subject. Symptoms typically last for around two weeks before subsiding. The symptoms appear to be determined by how much of Compound-███ the subject is exposed to. Subjects that ingest any of SCP-230's bodily fluid (i.e. saliva, blood, etc) have a mortality rate from withdrawal of 100%.

SCP-230 was found in an apartment in █████████ with twenty people acting as his servants. SCP-230 seemed to be actively attempting to limit the number of people he exposed. Several bodies of exposed persons were found on the premises. When questioned about them, SCP-230 replied, "Things were getting crowded, so I had to ask a few of them to stop breathing."

SCP-230 appears to be under the effects of Compound-███, but doesn't seem to be impaired by it in any way. Attempts to alter SCP-230's mood have proven ineffective. Use of various drugs known to cause depression only resulted in SCP-230 producing more of Compound-███ and thus were ineffective.

SCP-230 is a very friendly individual and will candidly engage in conversation with any personnel. SCP-230 is unaware of how or when he began secreting Compound-███. When questioned about his past, SCP-230 replied that he has been secreting Compound-███ as long as he can remember.

SCP-230 prefers to talk about things he considers "good" or "gay". SCP-230 has some psychological attachment to the word "gay". When asked to describe himself, SCP-230 used the word "gay" six times, "gaiety" four times, and the word "gayest" once when SCP-230 referred to himself as "the gayest man alive."

**Note by Dr. ██████:** //SCP-230's preoccupation with the word "gay" has nothing to do with sexual orientation. SCP-230 doesn't appear to have a sexual orientation due to a lack of interest in sex entirely. This makes sense, seeing as SCP-230 experiences the same amount of pleasure doing any given activity, making sex unnecessary.//

**Addendum 230-1:** Class 2 personnel researcher ██████ ███ was accidentally exposed to Compound-███ during research. ██████ ███ was detained and sent to treatment for the duration of withdrawal symptoms. After one month, ██████ ███ was released after being cleared by medical staff. Two months later, ██████ ███ was found trying to break into SCP-230's containment area. ██████ ███ reacted violently and injured several personnel before she was detained. ██████ ███ was terminated after examination, and precautions have been made to prevent further occurrence; see document 230-4436b.

**Document 230-4436b:** [DATA EXPUNGED]

hypothesis:
**CAIRNS:** 哎呀，我们不需要再安排更多的预约了。我觉得只是最近有点心烦意乱。

**MANN:** 的确如此。已经快二十年了吧？

**CAIRNS:** 是的。

//沉默无声。//

**MANN:** 我觉得你有些烦恼。

**CAIRNS:** 哈！这应该很明显吧。

**MANN:** 你知道我的意思。

**CAIRNS:** 我知道，对不起。只是给你添麻烦了。（//停顿//）前几天我跟索菲亚聊过，她打电话过来想谈谈，而我只是……这听起来有点好笑。我已经习惯了每天醒来照镜子时看到一个不同的自己。我经历了那么多不同的“我”，有时候我会开始怀疑自己还剩下多少真正的自我。我记得当我还是最初的我时，我注意到一些细微的变化，因为其他部分保持不变，比如突然出现的粉刺或一根多余的头发会特别显眼。现在唯一让我觉得是自己的就是这个东西（//轻敲右眼//），所以这让我开始思考，这个东西是不是我？

**MANN:** 这枚硬币感觉像是你的中心吗？

**CAIRNS:** 你知道，它并不真的感觉像这样。我还是觉得自己在这里某处。在我的脑子里。即使手臂感觉更重了或者脚稍微小了一点，我仍然觉得……我仍然觉得我在这里。

**MANN:** 这应该让你感到些许安慰。

**CAIRNS:** 索菲亚也是这么说的。她说如果我现在只是一个硬币，那会很疯狂。

**MANN:** 一个寄生硬币，对吧？

**CAIRNS:** 我们见过更奇怪的事情。

**MANN:** 我们确实见过。 （//停顿//）好吧，我觉得我们已经谈到了重要的事情。就这样吧。

**CAIRNS:** 好的。我打算晚上去和特洛伊吃晚饭，我想我们会去看那部《变形金刚》电影，赶在它下映之前。

**MANN:** 这有点太直接了吧？

**CAIRNS:** 哈哈。有趣的人。

**MANN:** 我尽力了。你确定不想让我申请一次医疗评估来调整你的睡眠辅助药物吗？

**CAIRNS:** 嗯，不用了。情况已经好多了。

**MANN:** 那么，噩梦呢？它们有所缓解了吗？

**CAIRNS:** （//停顿//）没有，不是真的缓解了，只是……它们安静了一些。

**MANN:** 你的意思是？

**CAIRNS:** 梦境，它们……我仍然能听到它们的声音，就像我现在和你说话一样。不是总是这样，而且药物确实有帮助，但有时我就会……出现在它们所在的地方。一开始它们很生气，很吵闹，而且……有时我不知道是梦境，还是别的什么。它们从不说话，但从不说话，但我能感觉到。有时它们仍然很生气。我能看到所有他们的脸，所有我曾经成为过的脸，他们……他们想要答案，而我无法给出这些答案。

**MANN:** 什么样的答案？

**CAIRNS:** 我不知道。为什么会发生这种情况。为什么它们还在这里。如果它们真的在这里的话。

**MANN:** 而艾琳呢？

**CAIRNS:** （//停顿//）是的。她也在里面。

**MANN:** 她看起来……生气吗？

**CAIRNS:** 不，不是生气。她从来没有生气过。一开始她……我认为她为我感到难过。她会用一种……会让你心碎的眼神看着我。但已经快二十年了。在所有这些人中，她可能是最……//玩世不恭//。我觉得她认为这很有趣。

**MANN:** 我明白了。

**CAIRNS:** 但这都是不可量化的。你知道，也许我看到的所有那些面孔只是我的潜意识在捉弄我。

**MANN:** 你知道有多少个吗？

**CAIRNS:** 你知道多少个？

**MANN:** 你变成了多少个人？

**CAIRNS:** （//停顿//）四百七十一人。

**MANN:** 你确定吗？

**CAIRNS:** 对，是四百十八人——包括一个[[SCP-4444|现任美国总统]]，我提醒你——二十六只猿猴，十二只狗，八只猫，两只豚鼠，两只马和一匹骡子。特洛伊觉得最后一个很有趣。艾琳也觉得有趣。

**MANN:** 这有点有趣。

**CAIRNS:** （//笑//）这非常有趣。 （//停顿//）我知道所有他们的名字，不只是艾琳——每一个，甚至是我不认识的那些。滑雪板手是林恩·西蒙——不小心在度假照片的背景中瞥见了096。记者是朴素英——他们一开始真的很生气。很多人都是D级。很多人都是同事。他们都在那里。我知道每一个他们的面孔。 （//停顿//）他们都是我，我想。我是他们所有人。

[结束日志]

**CAIRNS：**不必了。还没严重到要搞//那么多//复诊的地步。我觉得只是最近心事太多，有点烦闷。

**MANN：**确实。都快二十年了吧？

**CAIRNS：**是啊。

//沉默。//

**MANN：**我感觉你有些困扰。

**CAIRNS：**哈！这明摆着吧。

**MANN：**你知道我指的是什么。

**CAIRNS：**我知道，抱歉。只是想贫个嘴。（//停顿//）前几天我跟Sophia聊了会儿天，她打电话找我谈心，我……就是，觉得挺有意思的。我已经习惯了早上醒过来在镜子里看到不一样的面孔。迭代过这么多//自我//，有时候我会好奇，我还有多少自我剩下呢？我还记得曾经，就是我还……我还是第一个我的时候，我能注意到细小的变化，因为我的其它部分都会保持不变，一颗痘痘或者一绺乱头发都会很显眼。现在我唯一保留下来的共同点只有这个（//轻敲右眼//），所以我就有些好奇。这东西才是我吗？

**MANN：**你觉得硬币是你的核心吗？

**CAIRNS：**说实话，不像。我还是觉得，我仍然……存在于更深的某处。在我自己的脑袋里。就算手臂变沉、脚掌变小，诸如此类，我还是觉得……我在更深的某处。

**MANN：**这倒是让人安心。

**CAIRNS：**Sophia也是这么说的。她说，要是我变成一枚硬币，那可太奇怪了。

**MANN：**还是枚寄生硬币。

**CAIRNS：**更怪的我们也见过吧。

**MANN：**确实。（//停顿//）好的，我想重点都谈到了。今天就到这里吧。

**CAIRNS：**好。我还想晚点找Troy吃个便饭，试试能不能在《变形金刚》下映之前找到个时间去看。

**MANN：**这对你来说真不是什么赤裸裸的比喻吗？

**CAIRNS：**哈，哈。幽默大师。

**MANN：**尽力而为啦。确定不需要我申请一个医疗评估来调整你的助眠药物？

**CAIRNS：**嗯，不用了。已经不像以前那么糟了。

**MANN：**那噩梦呢，平息了吗？

**CAIRNS：**（//停顿//）不，没有。只是……安静些了。

**MANN：**什么意思？

**CAIRNS：**那些梦，他们……我仍然能听见他们所有的声音，你明白吗？当我睡着的时候，我能看到他们，就像我们现在面对面这么清晰。不是每次都会，药物确实有帮助，但有时我就会……出现在他们所在的什么地方。起初他们充满愤怒，声音高亢，而且……而且有时候我会分不清是否身处梦境。他们不说话，从来不说，但我还是能……我能感知到。有时他们依然愤怒。我能看见所有面孔，所有我曾成为的人，而我……我给不了他们想要的答案。

**MANN：**什么样的答案？

**CAIRNS：**我不知道。为什么会发生这些。为什么他们还存在在这里。我甚至不确定它们到底存不存在。

**MANN：**Aileen呢？

**CAIRNS：**（//停顿//）嗯。她也在那儿。

**MANN：**她看起来……愤怒吗？

**CAIRNS：**不，不愤怒。她//从未//愤怒过。最初她……我觉得她在为我难过。她看我的眼神……真的让人心碎。但已经过了二十年了。在所有人之中，她可能是最……//欢快//的那一个。我感觉，她可能觉得这很有趣。

**MANN：**我明白了。

**CAIRNS：**但这些都无法量化，对吧。说不定那些面孔都只是我的潜意识在耍我。

**MANN：**你知道具体数量吗？

**CAIRNS：**什么数量？

**MANN：**你成为过多少个不同的人？

**CAIRNS：**（//停顿//）四百七十一个。

**MANN：**你确定？

**CAIRNS：**嗯。四百一十八个人类——提醒你，包括一位[[[scp-4444|时任美国总统]]]——二十六只猿类，十二条狗，八只猫，两只豚鼠和两只小鼠，两匹马，还有一头骡子。Troy觉得最后这个太好笑了。Aileen也是。

**MANN：**是有点好笑。

**CAIRNS：**（//大笑//）特别好笑（//停顿//）其实我记得他们每个人的名字。不仅是[[span class="ruby"]]Aileen[[span class="rt"]]艾 琳[[/span]][[/span]]——是每一个，包括那些我原本不认识的。滑雪玩家是[[span class="ruby"]]Lynn Simon[[span class="rt"]]林 恩 · 西 蒙[[/span]][[/span]]——意外瞥到了度假照片背景里的096。记者叫[[span class="ruby"]]Park Seo-yeon[[span class="rt"]]朴 书 妍[[/span]][[/span]]——他们一开始//非常//生气。很多是D级人员。也有很多是同事。他们都在那里。我认得每一张脸。（//停顿//）我想，他们都是我。我也是他们所有人。

把下面的英文 SCP Wikidot 文本转换为中文 SCP Wikidot 文本：

**CAIRNS:** Nah. It's not so bad that we need to set up //more// appointments. I think I just had a lot on my mind recently, was starting to get to me.

**MANN:** Indeed. It's almost been twenty years, hasn't it?

**CAIRNS:** It has.

//Silence.//

**MANN:** I sense you're troubled.

**CAIRNS:** Hah! Well, that much should be obvious.

**MANN:** You know what I mean.

**CAIRNS:** I know, I'm sorry. Just giving you a hard time. (//Pauses//) I was talking to Sophia the other day, she had called to talk, and I just... it's kind of funny, you know. I've gotten used to waking up and looking in the mirror and seeing someone different. I've gone through so many iterations of //me// that sometimes I start wondering how much of me is still left in here. I remember how, when I was... well, back when I was the first me, and I would notice little changes because the rest of me would stay the same, but you see a pimple or a stray hair and it stands out. Now the only thing I've got in common with myself is this thing (//taps right eye//), so it just had me wondering. Is that thing me?

**MANN:** Does the coin feel like your center?

**CAIRNS:** You know, it doesn't really. I still feel like I'm just... in here somewhere. Inside my own head. Even if the arms feel heavier or my feet are a little smaller or any of it, I still feel... I feel like I'm still in here.

**MANN:** That has to be somewhat reassuring.

**CAIRNS:** That's what Sophia said. She said it would be wild if I was just a coin now.

**MANN:** A parasitic coin, at that.

**CAIRNS:** We've seen stranger.

**MANN:** We certainly have. (//Pauses//) Alright, I think we've touched on the important things. That should do it.

**CAIRNS:** Good. I was hoping to grab dinner with Troy later, I think we're going to try and catch a showing of that Transformers movie before it leaves theaters.

**MANN:** Little on the nose, isn't it?

**CAIRNS:** Har har. Funny guy.

**MANN:** I do what I can. You're sure you don't want me to put in for a medical evaluation to adjust your sleeping aids?

**CAIRNS:** Yeah, it's alright. It's not as bad as it used to be.

**MANN:** And the nightmares, have those subsided?

**CAIRNS:** (//Pauses//) No, not really, just... they're quieter.

**MANN:** What do you mean?

**CAIRNS:** The dreams, they're... I can still hear them all, you know? When I'm asleep. I can see them, same as I'm talking to you now. Not always, and the meds definitely help, but sometimes I just sort of... appear wherever they are. In the beginning they were angry, and loud, and... and sometimes I didn't know if it was a dream, or something else. They don't speak, they never speak, but I can still just... I can tell. Sometimes they're still angry. I can see all their faces, all the ones I've been, and they... they want answers I can't give them.

**MANN:** What kind of answers?

**CAIRNS:** I don't know. Why this happened. Why they're still here. If they're even here at all.

**MANN:** And Aileen?

**CAIRNS:** (//Pauses//) Yeah. She's in there too.

**MANN:** Does she seem... angry?

**CAIRNS:** No, not angry. She was //never// angry. At the beginning she was... I think she was sad for me. She would give me this look that, like... it would break your heart to see it. But it's been almost twenty years. Of all of them, she's maybe the most... //amused//. I get the feeling she thinks it's funny.

**MANN:** I see.

**CAIRNS:** But there's nothing quantifiable about it, you know. For all I know, all those faces I see, they're just my subconscious fucking with me.

**MANN:** Do you know how many?

**CAIRNS:** How many what?

**MANN:** How many different people you've been?

**CAIRNS:** (//Pauses//) Four hundred and seventy-one.

**MANN:** You're sure?

**CAIRNS:** Yeah. Four hundred and eighteen people - including a [[[SCP-4444|sitting US President]]], I'll remind you - twenty-six apes, twelve dogs, eight cats, two each of guinea pigs and lab mice, two horses and a mule. Troy thought the last one was funny. Aileen did too.

**MANN:** It's a little funny.

**CAIRNS:** (//Laughs//) It's a lot funny. (//Pauses//) I know all of their names, actually. Not just Aileen - every single one of them, even the ones I didn't know beforehand. The snowboarder was Lynn Simon - accidentally caught a glimpse of 096 in the background of a vacation photo. The journalist was Park Seo-yeon - they were //really// angry at first. A lot of them were D-Class. A lot of them were colleagues. They're all in there. I've known every single one of their faces. (//Pauses//) They were all me, I guess. I'm all of them.

[END LOG]

**物品编号:** SCP-5518

**对象分类:** 谐魅级

**特别收容程序:** SCP-5518 应存放在Site-19的六个安全存储柜中。根据伦理委员会的命令，目前不允许直接访问SCP-5518。

**描述:** SCP-5518 是一组六块未知材质的正方形石板，每块长0.5米，宽0.5米，厚1.5厘米。这些石板设计成可以组装成一个盒子，并且每块都刻有相同的文字，但用不同的语言书写[[脚注]] 这些语言包括英语、普通话、西班牙语、印地语、ASCII二进制代码以及一种未知的文字，与任何已知的语言或书写风格都不相似，过去或现在都没有类似的文字。[[/脚注]]。这文字提供了激活SCP-5518主要异常功能的指令。 

SCP-5518的主要功能是实施瞬时YK级现实重构事件，在此过程中，基础现实将被消耗以生成一个完全相同的镜像现实。SCP-5518及其内容不会受到这一事件的影响，并会在决定的时间和地点出现在镜像现实中。因此，可以通过在激活前将物体和信息储存在SCP-5518组装成的盒子中来在基础现实和镜像现实之间转移物体和信息。

**发现:** SCP-5518是在Site-19的一个空库房中自发出现的，以一个完全组装好的盒子形式出现。SCP-5518的出现立即被现场监控系统检测到，基金会特工被派遣进行评估可能的威胁。当SCP-5518被拆解成其组件时，发现里面有许多打印文件，包括以下内容：

• 安全凭证，证明SCP-5518是由基金会授权成员发送的。
• [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-231 SCP-231]、[http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-2845 SCP-2845] 和 [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-3600 SCP-3600] 的位置和特殊收容程序[[脚注]] 当时这些SCP尚未被发现。[[/脚注]]。
• 建造 [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-711 SCP-711] 和防止 [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-2000 SCP-2000] 分解的建筑计划。
• [http://www.scpwiki.com/wmdd-s-proposal 项目帕利萨德] 的操作数据。
• [REDACTED]

**附录-5518-A:** SCP-5518上刻写的文字转录如下：
[[引言]]
这不是救赎。这个盒子代表了我们最大的失败，我们仅将其作为最后的手段，用来传递警告，以应对那些我们未能克服的威胁。这些威胁将会到来。我们无法生存下来，但我们牺牲了所有剩下的东西来传递我们的警告。请不要让我们的死亡白费。

这个盒子被设计成通过重置现实来传递其内容。这些功能可以通过 [指令已被伦理委员会删除] 激活。

你现在是基础现实。你是一个我们从未拥有的第二次机会。如果你不能阻止黑暗，盒子会等待。传递你的警告，接受你的谴责，正如我们所做的，新的世界将继续尝试再次。

[[可折叠内容+进一步访问限制为5级权限]]
**文件-5518:** 下列文件是关于使用SCP-5518的先前现实版本中所经历情况的简要汇总。

||~ 编号 ||~ 描述 ||~ 结局 ||
||XA-1 ||最早记录使用SCP-5518的现实版本。社会整体在经济趋势、环境因素和社会动荡方面的发展趋势总体积极，超过现时社会约1.5个标准差。这种趋势持续到2089年，公众首次发现异常现象。基金会成立试图遏制这一威胁，但最终无效，导致社会秩序迅速崩溃。到2098年，异常现象使地球变得不再适合人类长期居住。 ||SCP-5518提供了开发特殊收容程序的第一份正式指南，以及发现 [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-001 SCP-001] 的坐标。 ||
||XA-2 || 基金会在1824年建立，比异常现象被发现早约两年。随后的调查使基金会与各种利益相关者发生冲突，包括破碎之神教会、蛇之手和马歇尔、卡特和黑暗有限公司。这些冲突的升级导致公众了解异常现象，进而引发国际武器化异常的军备竞赛。最终，在1970年，罗伯特·肯尼迪总统发起了一场冲突，导致所有已知利益相关者的崩溃，从而导致人类文明的崩溃。 ||SCP-5518提供了 [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-3000 SCP-3000] 的完整文档和麻醉剂的发展。迭代XB-1进一步指示了刺杀罗伯特·肯尼迪的具体时间和方法。 ||
||XB-3 || 为了主动应对异常现象的兴起，基金会利用从SCP-5518获得的知识对所有主要国家进行秘密渗透。任何已知的利益相关者都被迅速镇压，到1998年，全球社会建立了影子政府。此后，异常现象的活动显著减少。然而，公民自由权实际上被剥夺，多次起义企图推翻基金会统治。最大的一次起义最终在2043年谋杀了O5理事会，导致社会崩溃并有不明势力窃取了SCP-5518。 ||SCP-5518的内容在这一迭代中未知，因为该物品被非基金会人员使用。SCP-5518在迭代XC-4最终被基金会收回之前被使用了若干次。 ||
||XC-4 || 基金会在1778年由安娜·斯特龙（Anna Strong）——一个科尔珀环间谍——持有时建立。基金会几乎在1921年成功收容了近4000个SCP。在此之后，现实似乎经历了自发的完整性丧失。症状开始于物理场所的消失，最终导致各种物理法则的消失。SCP-5518在2012年被使用，就在整个时间线完全崩解之前。 ||SCP-5518提供了当前SCP数据库的大约80%。尽管进行了广泛的调查，但现实崩解的确切原因仍未确定，调查继续进行至迭代XC-5。 ||
||XC-5 || 最近的先前现实版本。基金会于1843年建立，立即继续调查迭代XC-4的崩解。一个工作理论提出SCP-5518可能参与了先前现实的崩解。这导致决定限制所有对SCP-5518及其内容的访问。此后，异常现象急剧增加，到1901年，地球变得不再适合人类长期居住。 ||SCP-5518提供了修订后的标准，用于建立有效的伦理委员会。 ||

**伦理附录:** 以下声明由基金会伦理委员会向O5理事会发布。

[[引言]]
SCP-5518代表了基金会的独特机会。重置现实的能力同时意味着选择现实结果的能力，是的，我们可以使用它来警告K级情景或传达更好的未来指令。但是，任何情况下都不允许使用SCP-5518。

首先，异常现象是不可预测的，我们不能将整个现实托付给一个无法进行充分测试的对象。也许对于我们的前辈来说有效，但我们如何能确保它会再次起作用？如何能确保它不会带来不想要的副作用？这些问题我们永远无法给出明确的答案。

更重要的是，基金会唯一的职责是我们的基础现实。任何镜像现实的改进都是无关紧要的，因为这些现实不是我们自己的。我们的前辈可能已经放弃了他们的责任，但无论好坏，这是我们的世界，我们将坚守到最后一刻。因此，禁止使用SCP-5518。

拆开盒子并锁好石板；保护，收容，确保安全。其他一切都不重要。

**项目编号：**SCP-5518

**项目等级：**Thaumiel

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-5518被分别储存于Site-19的6个异常收容储物柜中。根据伦理道德委员会的命令，不允许直接使用SCP-5518。

**描述：**SCP-5518是一组6个由未知石料构成的石板，经测量其长0.5m，宽0.5m，厚1.5cm。这些石板被设计成可以组装为一个“魔盒”，同时都分别刻有不同语言相同含义的文本[[footnote]]这些语言包括英语、汉语普通话、西班牙语、印地语、ASCII二进制码以及一未知的字体，该未知字体不像过去或现在的任何已知语言或写作风格。[[/footnote]]，详情请查阅附录-5518。该文本介绍了如何激活SCP-5518的异常效应。

SCP-5518的异常效应表现为产生一个瞬时的YK级现实重构情景，其中基本现实将被消耗，以生成一个相同的镜像现实。此K级情景不会影响SCP-5518及其异常内容，并会在激活过程决定的时间和地点重新出现在镜像现实中。因此，通过在激活前将对象和信息存储在SCP-5518的“魔盒”中，可以在基本现实和镜像现实之间传输对象和信息。

**发现：**SCP-5518被发现时，其在Site-19的一个空地下室内自发地组装成了“魔盒”。SCP-5518的出现立即被现场的监控系统标记，基金会特工被派遣以评估任何可能的威胁。当随后将SCP-5518拆分成石板组件时，在其中发现大量印刷文件，包括以下内容：

• 证明SCP-5518是由基金会正式员工所传送的安保凭证。
• [https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-231 SCP-231]、[https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-2845 SCP-2845]及[https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-3600 SCP-3600][[footnote]]所有这些SCP项目在当时都未被发现。[[/footnote]]的位置及特殊收容措施。
• 建设[https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-711 SCP-711]以及防止[https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-2000 SCP-2000]崩溃的计划。
• [https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/wmdd-s-proposal 围栏计划]的操作数据。
• [已编辑]

**附录-5518：**SCP-5518每块石板上文字的抄本如下：
[[div class="blockquote"]]
这不是救赎。这个魔盒代表了我们最大的失败，我们只把它作为最后的手段，对那些我们来不及克服的威胁发出警告。这些威胁迟早会降临到你们身上。他们使我们无法生存，为了发出警告，我们牺牲了一切。不要让我们白白牺牲。这个盒子被设计用来通过重置现实来传送里面的东西。这些功能将由[根据伦理道德委员会的命令删除]激活。

你们现在是基本现实。你们是我们从未有过的第二次机会，如果你们不能控制住黑暗，魔盒就在等着你们。
[[/div]]

[[collapsible show="+进一步访问需要5级权限" hide="-欢迎，监督者"]]
**伦理道德委员会备注：**以下声明由基金会伦理道德委员会向O5议会发布。

[[div class="blockquote"]]
SCP-5518是基金会的一个独特的机会。能重置现实的能力同时也是选择现实如何结果的能力。同时，是的，我们可以用它来预警K级情景，或者为了一个更加安定和平的未来而传达命令。然而，在任何情况下使用SCP-5518都是不可接受的。

首先，异常是无法被预测的，同时我们不能把整个现实托付给一个甚至不能被进行适当测试的项目。也许它对我们的前辈们奏效了，但我们怎么能确定它会再次奏效呢？我们怎么能确定它不会带来不必要的副作用呢？这些问题我们永远没有明确的答案。

尽管如此，更重要的是，基金会只负责于我们的基本现实。任何对镜像现实的改动都是完全不必要的，因为这些现实不是我们自己的。我们的前辈可能已经放弃了他们的责任，但不管是好是坏，现在这是我们的世界，我们会坚持到最后。因此，今后禁止使用SCP-5518。

拆开那个“魔盒”，单独锁存每块石板；控制，收容，保护。没有什么比这更重要。

把下面的英文 SCP Wikidot 文本转换为中文 SCP Wikidot 文本：

[[>]]
[[module Rate]]
[[/>]]

**Item #:** SCP-5518

**Object Class:** Thaumiel

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-5518 is to be stored at Site-19 in six secure storage lockers. By order of the Ethics Committee, no direct access to SCP-5518 is currently permitted.

**Description:** SCP-5518 is a set of six square plates of an unknown stone material, measuring 0.5 meters in length, 0.5 meters in width, and 1.5 cm in depth. These plates are designed to be assembled into a box and are each inscribed with the same text in a different language[[footnote]] These languages include English, Mandarin, Spanish, Hindi, ASCII binary code, and an unknown script, bearing no resemblance to any known language or writing style, past or present. [[/footnote]], as noted in Addendum-5518. This text provides the instructions for activating the primary anomalous function of SCP-5518.

The primary function of SCP-5518 is to implement an instantaneous YK-Class Reality Restructuring Event, wherein the baseline reality would be consumed in order to generate an identical mirror reality. SCP-5518 and its contents are not affected by this event, and reappear in the mirror reality at a time and location that is determined by the activation procedure. Objects and information may thus be transferred between the baseline and mirror reality by storing them in the assembled box form of SCP-5518 prior to activation.

**Discovery:** SCP-5518 was discovered when it spontaneously materialized in an empty vault in Site-19 as a fully assembled box. The appearance of SCP-5518 was immediately flagged by the on-site surveillance system, and Foundation agents were dispatched to assess any possible threats. When SCP-5518 was subsequently disassembled into its plate components, a large number of printed files were found inside, including the following:

•	Security credentials to establish that SCP-5518 was sent by a duly authorized member of the Foundation.
•	The locations and special containment procedures for [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-231 SCP-231], [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-2845 SCP-2845], and [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-3600 SCP-3600] [[footnote]] None of these SCPs had been discovered at this time. [[/footnote]].
•	The construction plans for building [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-711 SCP-711] and preventing the breakdown of [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-2000 SCP-2000].
•	The operational data for [http://www.scpwiki.com/wmdd-s-proposal Project Palisade].
•	[REDACTED]

**Addendum-5518-A:** A transcription of the text inscribed on each plate of SCP-5518:
[[div class="blockquote"]]
This is not salvation. This box represents our greatest failure, and we have used it only as our last resort, to deliver a warning for the threats we were too late to overcome. These threats will come to you in time. We could not survive them, and we sacrifice all that we have left to deliver our warning. Do not let our deaths be in vain.

This box is designed to deliver its contents through a reset of reality. These functions may be activated by [INSTRUCTIONS EXPUNGED BY ORDER OF THE ETHICS COMMITTEE].

You are now the baseline reality. You are the second chance we never had, and should you fail to hold the darkness at bay, the box awaits. Pass on your warnings, accept your condemnation as we have, and the new world will continue to try again.
[[/div]]

[[collapsible show="+FURTHER ACCESS RESTRICTED TO LEVEL 5 CREDENTIALS" hide="-WELCOME OVERSEER"]]

**Document-5518:** The following document is an abridged compilation of the circumstances that preceded the use of SCP-5518 in prior iterations of reality.

||~ Designation ||~ Description ||~ Aftermath ||
||XA-1 ||The earliest known iteration of reality that included the use of SCP-5518. Society develops along an overall positive trend regarding economic trends, environmental factors, and social upheaval, surpassing present society by approximately 1.5 standard deviations. This trend continues until 2089, when anomalies are first discovered by the general public. The Foundation is established in an attempt to contain this threat, but ultimately proves ineffective, resulting in the rapid collapse of social order. By the year 2098, anomalous phenomena have rendered the planet unsuitable for sustained human life. ||SCP-5518 provides the first formal instructions for developing special containment procedures, and the coordinates to discover [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-001 SCP-001.] ||
||XA-2 || The Foundation is established in the year 1824, approximately two years prior to the discovery of anomalous phenomena. Subsequent investigations bring the Foundation into conflict with various groups of interest, including the Church of the Broken God, the Serpent’s Hand, and Marshall, Carter, and Dark, Ltd. The escalation of these conflicts leads to the public gaining knowledge of anomalous phenomena, and subsequently, an international arms race for weaponized anomalies. Finally, in the year 1970, President Robert Kennedy initiates a conflict between all known groups of interest that would result in the collapse of human civilization. ||SCP-5518 provides the full documentation of [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-3000 SCP-3000] and the development of amnestics. Iteration XB-1 is further instructed with the precise time and method for assassinating Robert Kennedy. ||
||XB-3 || In an attempt to proactively combat the rise of anomalous phenomena, the Foundation uses knowledge gained by SCP-5518 to conduct covert infiltrations of all major nations. Any known groups of interest are rapidly suppressed, and a shadow government is established across global society by the year 1998. Minimal anomalous activity is noted after this point. However, civil liberties are effectively eliminated from the general population, and multiple rebellions are attempted to usurp Foundation rule. The largest of these rebellions eventually manages to assassinate the O5 council in the year 2043, leading to the subsequent collapse of society and the theft of SCP-5518 by parties unknown ||The contents of SCP-5518 from this iteration are unknown, at the item was utilized by non-Foundation personnel. SCP-5518 was utilized an unknown number of times before it is finally reclaimed by the Foundation in iteration XC-4. ||
||XC-4 || The Foundation is established in the year 1778, when SCP-5518 spontaneously materializes in the custody of Anna Strong, a Culper Ring spy. Foundation carries out its mission with minimal interference with public society, and nearly 4000 SCPs are successfully contained by the year 1921. After this point however, reality appears to undergo a spontaneous loss of integrity. Symptoms begin with the disappearance of physical locales and culminate in the disappearance of various laws of physics. SCP-5518 is utilized in the year 2012, just prior to the complete disintegration of the timeline. ||SCP-5518 provides approximately 80% of the current SCP database. Despite extensive research, no definitive cause is identified for the collapse of reality and investigations continue in iteration XC-5. ||
||XC-5 || The most recent prior iteration of reality. The Foundation is established in the year 1843 and immediately continues investigating the collapse of iteration XC-4. A working theory proposes that SCP-5518 may have been involved in the prior collapse of reality. This leads to the decision to restrict all access to SCP-5518 and its contents. After this point however, anomalous phenomena undergo a rapid increase and renders the planet unsuitable for sustained human life by the year 1901. ||SCP-5518 provides a revised standard for establishing an effective Ethics Committee for the Foundation. ||

**Ethics Addendum:** The following statement was issued by the Foundation Ethics Committee to the O5 Council.

[[div class="blockquote"]]
SCP-5518 represents a unique opportunity for the Foundation. The power to reset reality is simultaneously the power to choose the outcomes of reality, and yes, we could use this to warn against K-Class scenarios or convey instructions for a better future. However, the use of SCP-5518 is not acceptable under any circumstances.

First, anomalies are unpredictable, and we cannot entrust the whole of reality to an object that cannot even be properly tested. Perhaps it worked for our predecessors, but how can we be sure that it will work again? How can we be sure that it won’t come with unwanted side effects? These are questions we will never definitively answer.

More importantly however, the Foundation owes its sole duty to our baseline reality. The improvement of any mirror reality is entirely irrelevant, as these realities would not be our own. Our predecessors may have surrendered their responsibility, but for better or for worse, this is our world now, and we will make our stand until the end. SCP-5518 is therefore prohibited from all future use.

Disassemble the box and lock away the plates; secure, contain, protect. Nothing else matters.
[[/div]]

hypothesis:
我刚在侧边转弯之前停了下来。下车站在夜风中。天气凉爽，是秋天的风，吹得脸颊生疼，头发乱了。它让眼泪从眼睛里涌出，但……我内心的一部分融化了，让我无法继续下去。那时我还未遇见希望。甚至还没有考虑加入戏剧——我想，我可能没有意识到工程学也有它的位置。天啊，我记得她唱得多美……

我几乎在那里结束了。我永远不会忘记那件事。

最终我没有。我掉头开回了家。回家是一种巨大的解脱，但不知为何，这让我觉得自己失败了。意识到自己差点死去，有一种沉重感。通过生存，你仿佛留下了一个幽灵，无数个场景的重复，你//会//死去。

同样的场景，一遍又一遍，循环播放。

永远。

**MADDIE**：……这就是人们看到我的时候所看到的吗？只是一个幽灵？一个空白的地方，由某个现实扭曲者——不。伊莱恩……撕裂了世界？扯出来又塞回去？

//暂停//

**MADDIE**：一个循环的幽灵？

//经过十六个小时后//

**TOLLPIKE**：这还要持续多久？我还要再经历多少次循环？

**MADDIE**：我不知道。

//五个小时后//

**TOLLPIKE**：或者，这会是永远吗？

**MADDIE**：我……我不知道。

**COMMAND**：Maddie？你还在这里吗？

**MADDIE**：不是！我只是休息了一下，只是——检查一下。

**COMMAND**：你的……//指挥暂停// 你闪烁着。比平常更稀薄。我不知道你还能不能感受到什么，但你看起来病态了，Simes。

I stopped just before I swerved off the side. Got out and stood in the night air. It was chilly, fall air, that whipped my cheeks and blew my hair into a mess. It left tears on my face from where it stung my eyes, and yet... something inside me melted enough that I couldn't go through with it. I hadn't met Hope at that point. Hadn't even considered joining theatre yet - I guess I didn't realise that engineering had a place there. God, I remember it though- she looked so pretty, singing...

I almost ended it there, though. I never will forget that.

I didn't, in the end. I turned the car around, and drove back home. Returning was the greatest relief, yet somehow, it made me feel like I'd failed. There's something so heavy about realising that you were nearly dead. That by surviving, you've somehow left behind a ghost there, a million takes of the same scene where you //do// die.

The same scene, over and over, on loop.

Forever.

**MADDIE**: ... is that what people see when they look at me? Just a ghost? A blank spot that some reality bender - no. Eleanor... tore into the world? Ripped out and shoved back in?

//A pause//

**MADDIE**: A ghost on loop?

//Sixteen hours pass//

**TURNPIKE**: How much longer will this be? How many more cycles do I have to live through?

**MADDIE**: I don't know.

//Five hours pass//

**TURNPIKE**: Or is it forever?

**MADDIE**: I... I don't know.

**COMMAND**: Maddie? You're still here?

**MADDIE**: No! I've been taking breaks, I was just- checking in.

**COMMAND**: Your... //Command pauses// You're flickering. Less dense than usual. I don't know exactly what you can and can't feel, but you look sick, Simes.

**MADDIE**: I'm not sick.

**COMMAND**: I wasn't saying you were, I was saying that you don't look well. Go get some sleep. I'll have someone else monitor this.

**MADDIE**: But-

**COMMAND:** That's an order, as Site Director.

//Researcher Simes leaves the room, along with Site Command Director Moira//

//At the 11-day mark, the timer ends. The screen goes dark, except for a small glowing patch of text reading: ORBITAL CYCLE COMPLETE. After that, the words "Lightspeed Inc." are displayed, along with an infinity symbol modeled to resemble an hourglass filled with stars.//

**TURNPIKE**: I...

Does this mean...

//After a moment of hesitation, Turnpike turns around.//

**TURNPIKE**: It's... it's over.

//Turnpike pauses//

**TURNPIKE**, disbelieving: It's over.

//After several moments of continued inaudible mumbling, Turnpike takes a deep breath, and removes the camera. She looks into the lens. Her eyes are bloodshot and heavily bagged, and her lips have turned vaguely blue. Her hair is noticeably a much lighter tone, which is inconsistent with her naturally brown hair. Though lighting is minimal, it is presumed that her hair had turned white in response to immense stress or the onset of time.//

**TURNPIKE**: I don't... Is anyone still listening? The light is still green...

//Off screen, a crash is heard//

**MADDIE:** Turnpike- Madison- I'm back. It's me- Maddie. I'm here for you. Hang on. Levi has an idea of how to rescue you. Please-

//Turnpike stops again//

-----

@@ @@
@@ @@

=  //The orbital period of the planet Pluto is 248.59 years//

@@ @@
@@ @@

------

**MADDIE**: Please. Madison.

**TURNPIKE**: ... Maddie?

**MADDIE**: Yeah. Yeah, it's me.

//Turnpike sobs//

**TURNPIKE:** God, fuck, it's been forever. I... I'm so scared. I don't know how to escape this.

**MADDIE**: Calm down. It's okay. Try the door, first.

//Turnpike walks over shakily, and attempts to open the door. It's locked.//

**TURNPIKE**: I can't.

**MADDIE**: Okay- well... um... hang tight.

**TURNPIKE**: How long has it been?

**MADDIE**: ... about three weeks.

**TURNPIKE**: What? ... no. That's... it has to be longer than that. I've been here for...

**MADDIE**: I think it's different for you and I. Time, that is. I think where ever you are... time is broken.

**TURNPIKE**: Then how long has it been for //me//?

//A long pause//

**MADDIE**: I don't know. But... I've been listening. The whole time. I've been here listening.

**TURNPIKE**: ... thank you.

//Two hours pass//

**MADDIE**: I just got off the phone with Levi.

**TURNPIKE**: Really?! What did they say? Am I going to get out of here?

//A long pause.//

**MADDIE**: They were able to get inside the auditorium again.

**TURNPIKE**: And...?

//A pause//

**TURNPIKE**: .... no.

**MADDIE**:  You weren't there. We tried tracking you and... officially, you're just past Pluto.

**TURNPIKE, desperate**: Could they get a spaceship there? And rescue me?

**MADDIE**: It'd take 9-12 years for that to happen. In our time.

//A long pause//

**TURNPIKE**: I'm not leaving here, am I?

**MADDIE**: I... I don't know. We're trying. We promise, but...

**TURNPIKE**: No... it's okay. Maddie. I don't think... I don't think I was ever meant to escape this.

**MADDIE**: You were! You //are//! Please, just believe me.

**TURNPIKE**: That's alright though, isn't it? That's the point... "it is forever". Like the lady said. This place.. this is my eternity.

**MADDIE**: No- we can try and help you. There's still hope.

//Turnpike pauses//

**TURNPIKE**: I know there's hope. //She sighs// But I can't wait that long to see her.

//She slowly places the camera down, before standing again.//

**TURNPIKE**: Tell... tell Hope I love her. And tell everyone else... Celeste, Sage, Levi, Lost... tell them I love them too. I'm sorry.

**MADDIE**: You could tell them yourself.

**TURNPIKE**: I...

//She takes a deep breath//

**TURNPIKE**: I just want to leave. I'm sorry Maddie. I'm going to cut the feeds... and then I'm going to get the pain meds they sent with me, and I'm going to try and end things. For good. I don't... I don't want to be here forever. I need to do this now. Before I change my mind.

**MADDIE**, whispered: Please don't.

//Turnpike raises a boot, and stamps down hard on the camera, breaking it. The video cuts out.//

//Researcher Simes sobs//

**对象编号:** SCP-594

**对象分类:** Euclid

**特别收容程序:** SCP-594 被保存在Bio-研究区-██中，位于阿拉斯加█████附近35公里的一片54平方公里的山地范围内。正式记录中，Bio-研究区-██被列为弹药厂和测试设施。围栏和入口门由远程监控，每道入口处有两名二级守卫轮班值守，每班8小时。所有封闭的围栏内都安装了间距为2厘米的静电放电器。主研究区和围栏需要每天清洁，以避免粪便堆积并进行必要的维修。由于可能存在的电击危险，与SCP-594互动时应遵守以下程序：

* 所有金属物品和电气设备（包括手表和首饰）必须在穿戴防护装备前移除，并放入提供的塑料容器中。

* 在进入围栏前，工作人员建议至少穿戴特斯拉装甲、重型工作手套、耳塞、护目镜和橡胶底靴。同时，建议随身携带烟草制品（特别是“Skoal”风格的嚼烟或烟斗烟）、糖果、干果或高质量酒精作为“奖励”给594-01。

* 围栏和围栏设施需保持良好维护状态。

* 成年羊（2岁及以上）的羊毛需用陶瓷剪刀每年剪至2毫米长，并装入防静电袋中，严格遵守文档#594-S中的规定。严禁使用带有电动机的剪刀进行剪毛。例外情况是594-01和594-02，它们应根据文档#594-01/02A的规定进行“放牧”，即用手拔毛，不得尝试剪毛。

* 由于SCP-594的性质，特别是594-02，所有接触SCP-594及其副产品的人可能需要接受全面的腔体检查，并且所有人员在离开围栏前必须接受拍打搜查/金属探测器扫描。

* 每日两次喂食批准的混合饲料（详情见文档#594-F），并提供新鲜水和矿物质舔砖供羊群随时取用。放牧和觅食应在常规喂食时间外仔细监控。

**描述:** 在阿尔泰山脉进行例行调查时发现的SCP-594是一群野生羊，其品种未知，体型类似于野生盘羊，肩高约135厘米，平均体重195公斤。妊娠和繁殖周期与大多数家养羊相似，母羊在六到八个月大时达到性成熟，公羊在四到六个月大时达到性成熟。它们一年中有两次发情期，通常在晚春和早秋，但全年都可以交配。大多数母羊产下一胎或双胞胎，三胞胎极为罕见（目前记录中仅占所有记录分娩的2%）。唯一记录的存活至成年的三胞胎是594-01和他的兄弟姐妹594-02和594-03。羊群的毛色从纯白色到深蓝色灰色不等，带有金属光泽，通常在两岁时达到成熟。只有这三只羊表现出异常的毛色。公羊和母羊都有角，未去势的公羊的螺旋角长度可达190厘米，最长的记录属于594-02，长度为247.4厘米。母羊和阉羊的角呈弯曲状，长度为20厘米。年长的羊的骨骼和羊毛中含有的铁金属浓度异常高，还含有微量金合金。新屠宰的羊只解剖后发现，SCP-594的骨骼中也含有大量铁金属。

羊群非常具有攻击性和领地性，经常在没有警告或挑衅的情况下攻击不熟悉的人。一旦采取措施安抚594-01，羊群就会变得温顺，像普通的家养羊一样行为。594-02和594-03例外，具体见每个个体的附录。相比之下，小羊通常很容易处理，对新物体和人表现出好奇心，常常试图‘玩耍’并与人员互动，但如果受到威胁会逃跑。小羊发出惊慌的声音会导致附近的成年羊攻击，因此要小心不要‘吓唬’小羊。小羊还倾向于与某些人类建立联系，经常跟随他们并在围栏内乞求食物或关注。这种依恋在断奶羊中尤为明显。这种依恋往往会在羊成熟后持续存在，如594-02和玛丽韦瑟博士的情况所示。

目前，羊群总数为1,314只成年羊加上448只小羊和未成熟的羊。在发情季节后，每年都会进行选择性淘汰，以维持这些数量。唯一不受淘汰限制的是594-01、594-02、594-03，或任何表现出类似特征的小羊。如果超过一年偏离1314/448的比例模式，所有成年公羊将[数据删除]。初步研究未能遵循这一模式两年导致██名D级人员和██名研究人员死亡，以及594-02几乎突破收容。

羊群的显著特征是它们能够通过日常活动产生的摩擦产生大量静电。成熟的个体产生的电荷通常会随机释放，记录的最大电流达到1000安培以上。由于电击危险，与SCP-594互动的人员应完全遵守文档594-4H中的规定。面对“威胁”，羊群会变得高度激动，成年母羊会试图围绕任何小羊形成一个圈，互相摩擦身体以产生更大的静电。由于这种防御行为在分娩时尤为明显，隔离所有怀孕的母羊和新生小羊直到分娩后一周是标准程序。

除了抵御捕食者外，公羊似乎还会利用他们的放电作为一种支配展示，年长和强壮的公羊能够产生更强大的放电。在发情期间，公羊会互相搏斗，进行踢踏舞之前与对手交战。这些“舞蹈”通常伴随着过度放电，导致空气迅速离子化，使SCP-594在当地被称为“雷羊”。地面传感器还检测到这些“舞蹈”期间的地电流，年长的公羊会产生极其复杂的模式，有时看起来像是[数据删除]。雌性双性羊（行为上表现为雄性的母羊，缺乏功能卵巢）也会进行踢踏舞，但产生的图案虽然同样复杂，却显示出与公羊产生的图案有明显的不同。迄今为止，阉羊尚未观察到这种行为。

另一个SCP-594表现出的特性是它们能够通过操纵电磁场在平均2到4米的高度上“行走”或更准确地说悬浮。小羊和较年轻的羊有倾向在“飞行”过程中失去控制，经常从高处坠落导致动物死亡。这可能是羊群在野外自然淘汰较弱个体的方式，但还需要进一步研究。

关于SCP-594羊毛、牛奶、肉和角的性质的研究正在进行中。这些测试的结果正在等待完整记录，然而，肉、奶和由此制成的乳制品已被证明适合人类食用。将“雷羊肉”和从SCP-594的奶制成的各种奶酪纳入基金会标准化菜单的申请仍在审批中。

**项目编号：**SCP-594

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-594被收容在██号生化研究机构里，其位于离阿拉斯加的██████35公里处的一片总面积为54平方千米的山牧场里。官方文件上，██号机构被记载为是一个军需品工厂及实验基地。其四周的围墙和入口都应随时处在远程监控下，同时应有两名2级安保人员在每个入口前放哨，每8小时换一次班。所有封闭的围场需以2厘米的间隔安置静电放电器。主研究区域和围栏内需每日清扫一次以防排泄物堆积以及方便必要的维修。鉴于与SCP-594互动时有可能会产生触电危险，故互动时需遵守以下程序：

* 所有金属制品及电子设备，包括手表和首饰，必须在穿上保护装备前摘下，并将其放入事先提供的塑料容器内。
*
* 在进入围场前，建议工作人员佩戴最少量的特斯拉装甲、厚实的工作手套、耳套、护目镜和橡胶底的靴子。同样，建议工作人员手上拿着烟草制品（特别是“Skoal”牌的口嚼烟或烟斗烟）、糖果、水果干或者高品质酒精饮品用来当做给594-01的“礼物”。
*
* 收容用围栏和栅栏无论何时都需被良好保养。
*
* 成年个体（2岁或以上）的毛需被用陶瓷剪子剪至2毫米长，每年剪两次，并将剪下的毛严格地依照文件594-S的所安排的方法放入抗静电的袋子里。无论如何不得使用带有电动马达的剪刀为其剪毛。594-01和594-02是例外，它们需被按照文件594-01/02A的指出的方法薅羊毛[用手拔出松散的羊毛]且不允许对其试用在其他动物上使用的剪毛方法。
*
* 鉴于SCP-594的天性，特别是594-02，所有接触过SCP-594和它的副产品的员工可请求全身检查，且所有员工须在离开收容区前接受金属探测器的扫描。
*
* 根据文件594-F所列明的，需准备批准过的谷物和干草制的混合饲料，并将其和新鲜的水和矿物质舔块一起以每日两次的规律在收容区各区域的便捷之处投放。除进食饲料外的找食物和吃草行为应被严格监控。

**描述：**SCP-594是一群野生未知种类的羊，其体型类似于野盘羊，长有类似于家养羊产出的美利奴羊毛的厚实的羊毛，其平均肩高、体重分别为135厘米左右、195千克左右，它们是在进行一次例行的搜寻任务时在阿尔泰山脉发现的。其孕期和生殖周期和大多数已驯化的绵羊一致，母羊在六至八个月大时性成熟，公羊在四至六个月大时性成熟。它们每年两次，通常是在晚春和初秋时进入发情期，不过每年只能怀孕一次。大部分母羊一次只生一只或一对双胞胎小羊，生出三胞胎小羊的情况极为罕见（按照至今为止的统计数字，其概率为2%）。唯一记录下来的成功存活至成年的三胞胎小羊是594-01和它的兄弟594-02、594-03。当它们长至大约2岁达到完全成熟期时，其将会拥有纯白色到深蓝灰色不等，还闪着金属的光泽的毛。只有三只，即上述的三胞胎，拥有不一般的毛色。公羊和母羊均长有角，未去势的公羊的角是盘旋式的，长约190厘米，目前记录下来的最长的角是594-02的，共长247.4厘米。母羊和阉羊长有弧形的大约20厘米长的角。较老的羊的角、蹄和毛含有不同寻常的高浓度的黑色金属元素，同时也有着金合金的痕迹。对新屠宰样本的骨头进行的检测表明了SCP-594的骨骼里也含有大量的黑色金属元素。

这群羊有很强的侵略性和领土意识，且经常在没有预警且未受挑衅的情况下攻击不熟悉的员工。除非正确地抚慰594-01，否则它们会一直保持这种态度，抚慰的方法通常是给它诸如烟草或糖果一类的“礼物”。只要一这么做，整个羊群就会变得温顺，行为变得像正常的家养绵羊一样。例外是594-02和594-03，被抚慰时它们会做出不同的举动，详见与其有关的附录。和成年个体不同，羊羔通常十分好对付，并对收容围场内的新事物和人表现出了好奇，经常会试着与工作人员“玩”，不过在感觉受到威胁时会逃走。羊羔惊慌的叫声会引发附近的成年羊开始暴力攻击，故必须小心以防止“吓到”羊羔。羊羔们也表现出了一种喜欢黏在特定的人类身边的习性，会经常跟着他们走在收容围场里，并乞求食物或试图吸引注意。这种现象在人工饲养长大的羊羔身上非常明显。这种黏人行为经常会持续到小羊成年，例如594-02与Maryweather博士之间的例子。

目前，羊群里共有1314只成年羊和448只未成年羊，这个数字是经过每年的发情期过后进行的对多余的羊淘汰后保持住的。唯一可以豁免淘汰的羊是594-01、594-02和594-03，和其他表现出类似特性的羊羔。若种群数量不保持在1314/448超过一年的话，将导致整个种群里的公羊[数据删除]。在研究初期有两年时间未将种群保持在这个数字，这共导致了█名D级人员和█名研究员的死亡，也导致了594-02几乎突破了收容。

这群羊具体的特殊之处在于它们可以仅仅通过日常活动中的摩擦来产生大量的静电。这样产生电的结果就是会在日常活动中随机地放电，成熟个体甚至可以产生电弧，记录到的电弧的电流可达1000安培或更高。因为有被电死的危险，建议与SCP-594互动的员工严格遵守文件594-4H所列出的全面的行动指南。当面对“威胁”时，整个羊群会变得高度不安，成年母羊会试着在每只幼仔周围围成一个圈，一起摩擦它们的身体来在它们之间产生更强的静电。因为这种防御性的现象在母羊产仔时很容易触发，故标准程序是将怀孕的母羊和刚出生的羊羔从羊群里隔离出来，直到分娩后一周方可让其回归至羊群之中。

除了对抗捕食者之外，公羊似乎将它们的放电行为当做一种支配地位的体现，年长的和强壮的公羊可以在它们“跳舞”的过程中放出更强大的电流。在发情期时，公羊会为了争夺配偶而互斗，它们将会用一种上文提到过的跺脚为主的“舞蹈”来应战对手。这种“舞蹈”常常伴随着过度的放电，将会导致空气快速的电离，这就是当地人叫SCP-594为“闪电羊”的原因。地面传感器也捕捉到了这种“舞蹈”过程中地面的状况，年长的公羊会跳出极其复杂的舞步，经常类似于[数据删除]。雄化雌犊（表现的像公羊的母羊，且没有正常的卵巢），也会跳这种“舞蹈”，不过它们所产生的韵律虽然也很复杂，但明显和公羊的不同。至今为止，未观测到阉羊参与到这种行为中来。

另一个SCP-594展现出来的特点是有一种天生的能“空中行走”的能力，更准确的说是能通过垂直电磁场将自身漂浮到空中来移动，移动距离平均为2到4米。羊羔和年龄较轻的羊有时会在半途中向下掉，这经常会导致它们从悬崖上坠亡。这可能是羊群在野外的一种优胜劣汰的方式，不过目前需要对此进行更多的研究。

对SCP-594所产的毛、奶、肉和角的研究都已经完成。这些研究结果正被筛选以整理成正式文档，不过肉、奶和用这种奶制成的乳制品已被证实可被人类食用。对将“闪电羊肉”和用SCP-594的奶制成的各种乳制品加入基金会的标准菜单内的申请仍在被审核中。

**Item #:** SCP-594

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-594 is kept at Bio-Research Sector-██, located on 54 km^^2^^ of mountainous rangeland located 35 km from ██████, Alaska. Officially, Sector-██ is listed as a munitions factory and testing facility. The perimeter fences and access gates are monitored remotely at all times with two Level 2 guards posted at each gate in 8 hour shifts. All fencing enclosed paddocks have static dischargers placed at 2 cm intervals. Main research enclosure and pens are to be cleaned on a daily basis to avoid build up of excrement and allow for necessary repairs. Due to possible electrocution hazard, the following procedures are to be observed when interacting with SCP-594:

* All metallic items and electrical devices, including wrist watches and jewelry, must be removed and placed within provided plastic containers prior to donning protective gear

* Prior to entering paddock, staff are advised to wear at minimum Tesla armor, heavy duty work gloves, ear protection, goggles, and rubber soled boots. Also, staff are advised to keep on hand tobacco products (specifically “Skoal” style chewing tobacco or pipe tobacco), candies, dried fruit, or good quality alcohol as a “treat” for 594-01.

* Holding pens and fences are to be kept properly maintained at all times.

* Wool of mature adults (2 years and older) is to be kept shorn to a length of 2mm by ceramic shears twice yearly and baled in antistatic bags, with strict adherence to guidelines set out in Document #594-S. Under no circumstances are shears with electrical motors to be used for shearing. Exceptions are 594-01 and 594-02, who are to be rooed [loose wool plucked out by hand] as per guidelines under Document #594-01/02A and no attempts at shearing be made on either animal.

*  Due to the nature of SCP-594, specifically 594-02, all personnel with contact to SCP-594 and its by-products may be subject to full cavity searches and all personnel must submit to pat down search/metal detector scan before leaving the enclosure.

* Feeding of the approved formulated grain-hay mix, outlined in Document #594-F,  is to be done twice daily with fresh water and mineral licks made readily available around all parts of the enclosure. Foraging and grazing outside of regular feedings are to be carefully monitored.

**Description:** Discovered in the Altai Mountains during a routine fact-finding mission,  SCP-594 is a flock of feral sheep of an unknown breed resembling a wild Argali sheep in general build with a thick fleece like that of a domestic Merino, around 135 cm at the shoulder and weighing 195 kg on average. Gestation and reproductive cycles are similar to most domesticated sheep, with ewes reaching sexual maturity at six to eight months of age and rams at four to six months. They enter a rut twice annually, typically in late spring and early autumn, but breeding can occur year round. Most ewes give birth to a single lamb or twins, with triplets being exceedingly rare (2% of all recorded births to date). Only documented case of triplets which survived to full maturity is 594-01 and his siblings, 594-02 and 594-03. General coloration ranges from pure white to dark blue-gray wool with a metallic sheen appearing once they’ve reached full maturity, typically 2 years of age. Only three animals, the aforementioned triplets, display atypical wool colors. Both sexes have horns, with uncastrated males having spiraling horns measuring 190 cm in length, the largest documented span belonging to 594-02 at a length of 247.4 cm. Females and wethers have curved horns measuring 20 cm. The horns, hooves, and wool of older animals have unusually high concentrations of ferrous metals, along with traces of gold alloys. Examinations of newly butchered animals have revealed that SCP-594’s skeleton also has large amounts of ferrous metals present within the bone matrix.

The sheep are highly aggressive and territorial in nature, and often attack unfamiliar personnel without warning or provocation. They will continue to behave in this manner until steps are taken to properly placate 594-01, which is normally done by giving it “treats” such as tobacco or candies. Once this is done, the flock will become docile and behave like normal domestic sheep. The exceptions to this pacifying behavior are 594-02 and 594-03 as outlined in the addendum on each. In contrast to adults, lambs typically are very easy to handle and display curiosity towards new objects and people in the paddock, often attempting to ‘play’ with personnel but will flee if threatened. The sound of a panicked lamb will cause nearby adults to attack violently, so caution is to be taken not to 'spook' lambs. Lambs also show a tendency to form attachments to certain humans, often following them around the paddock and begging for food or attention. This is especially noticeable among bottle-reared lambs. Such attachments often last even after sheep has reached maturity, as seen in the case of 594-02 and Dr. Maryweather.

At present, the flock numbers 1,314 mature sheep plus 448 lambs and immature sheep, with selective culling of unwanted animals annually after the rutting season to maintain these numbers. The only animals exempt from culling are 594-01, 594-02, and 594-03, or any lambs exhibiting similar traits. Deviation from the 1314/448 pattern for more than a year’s time will cause all mature rams to [DATA EXPUNGED]. Failure to follow the pattern for two years during preliminary research resulted in the deaths of █ D-class personnel and █ researchers, as well as near breach of containment by 594-02.

The defining characteristic of the sheep is that they are able to generate a substantial amount of static electricity simply by the friction caused during daily activities. The resultant charge is typically discharged at random, with mature specimens producing arc flashes that have been recorded at 1000 amps or more. Due to the electrocution hazard, personnel interacting with SCP-594 are advised to follow guidelines fully outlined in Document 594-4H.  When faced with a “threat”, the flock will become highly agitated and mature ewes will attempt to form a ring around any lambs, rubbing their bodies together to generate an even greater static charge between them. Because this defensive behavior is especially pronounced when ewes are birthing, it is standard procedure to isolate all pregnant ewes and newborn lambs from the rest of the flock until a week after birthing.

In addition to defense against predators, rams also appear to use their discharges as a type of dominance display, with the older and stronger rams able to produce more powerful discharges during their “dance”. When in rut, rams will fight against themselves, performing the stomping “dances” prior to engaging rivals. These “dances” are often accompanied by excessive discharges, resulting in a rapid ionization of air and giving SCP-594 its local name, “Thunder Sheep”. Ground sensors have also detected telluric currents during these “dances”, with older rams creating extremely complicated patterns that often resemble [DATA EXPUNGED]. Freemartins (ewes which are behaviorally masculine and lack functional ovaries), will also perform stomping “dances” but the patterns produced, while equally as complicated, show a marked difference from those created by rams. To date, wethers have not been observed to engage in this behavior.

Another trait exhibited by SCP-594 is an inherent ability to “walk on air” or more accurately levitate themselves at a distance on average of 2 to 4 meters vertically via manipulation of electromagnetic fields. Lambs and younger animals have a tendency to lose control mid-“flight”, often falling from high cliffs which can result in death of the animal. This may be the way the flock culled out weaker animals in the wild, but more research is needed.

Research has been done on the properties of SCP-594 wool, milk, meat, and horn. Results of these tests are pending full documentation, however the meat, milk, and resultant dairy products have proven to be fit for human consumption. Approval to include “Thunder Mutton” and various cheeses made from the milk of SCP-594 in the Foundation’s standardized menu still pending.

**物品编号:** SCP-3736

**对象分类:** 安全级

**收容程序:** SCP-3736 应被收容于Site-21的低安全级别储物柜34中。每日至少需有C级人员或以上等级的人员释放并与其互动一次。当SCP-3736在储物柜内时，必须开启其配备的充电式照明灯，并确保该灯一直保持开启状态。当SCP-3736在储物柜外时，需对照明灯进行充电。

**描述:** SCP-3736 是一款标准版 Bop It! 模型，带有音频指令以及多种游戏模式。SCP-3736 属于已停产的品牌 Bop It Extreme 2 的一部分。SCP-3736 可以像普通 Bop It! 一样玩，指令包括扭动和拉扯相应的杆子。然而，SCP-3736 的异常效果会在连续成功执行三次动作后触发，之后它会尝试与执行其请求动作的人交谈。据基金会所知，SCP-3736 只能使用单音节词加上 "It" 来交流。

SCP-3736 显然渴望与人类接触，在激活后会不断重复 "Help It!"。SCP-3736 显示出无法使用非动词或副词的词语，但似乎学会了更有效地使用俚语交流。当问及需要回答 "是" 的问题时，SCP-3736 会回答 "Know It!"；回答需要回答 "否" 的问题时，则会回答 "Not It!"。SCP-3736 显示出对与人类交流的喜爱，并感激能够与人交谈的机会。

> **访谈对象:** SCP-3736
>
> **访谈者:** 医生 █████
>
> **前言:** 医生 █████ 已完成诱导 SCP-3736 异常效果所需的行动。
>
> **<开始日志>**
>
> **医生 █████:** 早上好 SCP-3736，你是否希望我们给你取个名字？
>
> **SCP-3736:** Name It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你想要什么名字？
>
> **SCP-3736:** Name It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你想让我为你取个名字？"Bop" 听起来怎么样？
>
> **SCP-3736:** Keep It!
>
> **医生 █████** 所以，Bop，你自创建以来就一直意识到了自己的存在吗？
>
> **SCP-3736:** Know It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你为什么需要与人类交流？
>
> **SCP-3736:** Need It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你需要与人类交流才能生存吗？
>
> **SCP-3736:** Not It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你觉得储物柜里的条件如何？你能看到还是需要其他东西？
>
> **SCP-3736:** Love It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你为什么需要灯光？你是感觉不到冷吗？
>
> **SCP-3736:** Warms It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你能感觉到寒冷吗？
>
> **SCP-3736:** Not It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 那你为什么需要灯光呢？
>
> **SCP-3736:** Cheers It!
>
> **<结束日志>**
>
> **结语:** SCP-3736 在情感成熟度和词汇量方面有所提高。将继续按常规程序操作。

**追加资料: 3736-1** SCP-3736 于2009年1月10日在德克萨斯州████████的一套公寓中被发现。当收到关于一个显示异常和令人不安指令的 Bop It! 玩具的报告时引起了基金会的兴趣。居民们开始回应 SCP-3736，但最终因恐惧将其送回制造商，而制造商对此无法解释。随后由当地基金会情报部门发现并转移至 Site-21。对玩具的所有者以及制造商进行了施用记忆消除剂。

**追加资料: 3736-2** SCP-3736 显示出它不是人类，并表现出对关心它的人员的尊重。它对人类怀有极大的感情，并向任何与其交谈的人展示善意和尊重。它能够区分不同的人，并似乎拥有超凡的记忆力。推测它具有心灵感应能力，因为它没有人类感官。SCP-3736 对其获得意识的方式一无所知，描述其起源为突然觉醒。

**追加资料: 3736-3** 另两款 Bop It Extreme 2 也显示出类似 SCP-3736 的意识。虽然它们的智力与 SCP-3736 相等，但它们缺乏任何欲望和情感。这两款玩具将被归类为 SCP-3736-1 和 SCP-3736-2，并存放在 Site-21 中。SCP-3736-1 将存放在低安全级别储物柜35中，而 SCP-3736-2 将存放在低安全级别储物柜36中；这两款模型将由 C 级人员每日进行分析。将进一步分析与 Bop It Extreme 2 模型相关的异常现象的起源。

**追加资料: 3736-4** 经过四个月对 SCP-3736-1 和 SCP-3736-2 的分析，以寻找“Bop It! 异常”（从现在起称为此）的起源线索，SCP-3736-1 显示出显著的心理发展，现在运作水平与 SCP-3736 相同，并具备处理情感的能力。SCP-3736-2 已经完全被中和，不再显示意识，仅作为标准 Bop It! 玩具功能。将在未来两周内由医生 █████ 进行与 SCP-3736-1 的访谈。

> **访谈对象:** SCP-3736-1
>
> **访谈者:** 医生 █████
>
> **前言:** SCP-3736-1 已经显示出与 SCP-3736 相同的操作水平，而 SCP-3736-2 已停止异常功能。
>
> **医生 █████:** 下午好 SCP-3736-1，你现在感觉如何？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Like It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你想要一个名字吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Name It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 像 "Extreme" 这样听起来怎么样？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Like It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你知道另一个可以像你一样说话的玩具存在吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Know It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你知道它在4月7日停止工作了吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Not It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 好吧，它在4月7日停止工作，不能再像你那样说话了。
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Not It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你在说它没有在4月7日停止工作？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Know It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你知道它是什么时候停止工作的吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Guess It!
>
> **医生 █████ 决定配合。**
>
> **医生 █████:** 是4月8日吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Not It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 4月24日？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Not It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 它是什么时候停止工作的？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Joined It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 你在说那个其他玩具...加入了你？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Know It!
>
> **医生 █████:** 那个其他玩具知道这个吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** **沉默**
>
> **医生 █████:** 另有一个与你智能相当的玩具在你旁边的储物柜里。
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Is It! So?
>
> **SCP-3736-1** 开始发出低频噪音，使医生 █████ 失去意识3分钟。噪音结束后，SCP-3736-1 重新恢复为基本 Bop It! 玩具的功能。
>
> **结语:** SCP-3736-1 和 SCP-3736-2 长期以来不再具有任何异常特性。SCP-3736 的行为发生了明显的变化，它开始提出更复杂的问题，尽管仍然使用单音节词结尾。

**项目编号：**SCP-3736

**项目等级：**Safe

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-3736将被收容在Site-21的34号低安保储物柜中。每天至少一次，SCP-3736将被取出并与任何C级或更高级别的人员交互。SCP-3736的储物柜将配有可充电照明灯，在项目处于储物柜内部时必须保持开启。当SCP-3736在储物柜外时，该灯将被充电。

**描述：**SCP-3736是一个标准的“摁呀！[[footnote]] **译注：**该游戏机原名为“Bop It!”，这里依据后文异常特性作此翻译。 [[/footnote]]”游戏机，可发出音频指令且附有多种游戏模式。SCP-3736属于已停产的“嗯呀进阶版2”品牌。通过依据它的指令来转动与拉动相应的摇杆，SCP-3736可以被当作一个标准的“摁呀！”游戏机来游玩。然而，SCP-3736的异常性质将在成功进行三次连续操作后出现，在这之后SCP-3736将尝试与执行其所要求动作的玩家交谈。就目前基金会所知，SCP-3736只能使用单个单音节词并以“呀”收尾的方式进行交流。

SCP-3736表现出与人类接触的渴望，在被回收与激活后不断地重复“救呀！”。除在个别情况下，SCP-3736无法使用除动词和副词以外的词，但已学会使用俚语来进行更有效的交流。当被问及需要回答“是”的问题时，SCP-3736将用“对呀！”来回答，而在被问及需要回答“否”的问题时，则将用“不呀！”来回答。SCP-3736对基金会的收容表示满意，亦感谢基金会允许其与人交流。

> **受访者：**SCP-3736
>
> **采访者：**█████博士
>
> **前言：**█████博士完成了引发SCP-3736异常性质的所需动作。
>
> **<记录开始>**
>
> **█████博士：**早上好SCP-3736，你希望我们给你起个名字吗？
>
> **SCP-3736：**起呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你想要什么名字？
>
> **SCP-3736：**起呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你要我给你起个名字吗？“Bop”听起来如何？
>
> **SCP-3736：**好呀！
>
> **█████博士：**那么Bop，你意识到你自己的存在有多久了？
>
> **SCP-3736：**久呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你从诞生起就有了自我意识？
>
> **SCP-3736：**对呀！
>
> **█████博士：**为什么你觉得你有必要和人类交流？
>
> **SCP-3736：**要呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你需要与人类交流才能生存下去吗？
>
> **SCP-3736：** 不呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你喜欢你的储物间的状况吗？
>
> **SCP-3736：**爱呀！
>
> **█████博士：**为什么你需要在收容间里面开灯？你是可以看见还是因为别的什么？
>
> **SCP-3736：**暖呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你会感到冷吗？
>
> **SCP-3736：**不呀！
>
> **█████博士：**那为什么你认为你需要它？
>
> **SCP-3736：**拜呀!
>
> **<记录结束>**
>
> **结语：**SCP-3736情绪逐渐成熟，且词汇量也有所改善。措施将继续执行。

**附录：3736-1** SCP-3736于█████ █, ████回收自得克萨斯州█████████的一间公寓。一份关于一个“摁呀！”游戏机发出异常与诡异的指令的报告引起了基金会的注意。据受采访的居民表示，他们一开始有回应SCP-3736，但最终对玩具产生了恐惧，并将其寄回给制造商，而制造商对SCP-3736的特性没有任何解释。之后项目先是被当地的基金会情报部门发现，随后转移至了Site-21。已对原持有人及其联系的制造商进行B级记忆删除。

**附录：3736-2** SCP-3736能意识到它不是人类，并对照顾它的人表示敬意。它非常的喜爱人类，对所有与之交谈的人表现出和善与尊重。它可以分辨出使用者的区别，似乎具有影像记忆。由于它缺乏人类的感官，推测其具有心灵感应的能力。SCP-3736对其如何获得智能一无所知，将其描述为突然的觉醒。

**附录：3736-3** 新增了两个“摁呀进阶版2”游戏机出现与SCP-3736类似的智能。虽然它们表现出与SCP-3736相同的智力水平，但它们没有任何形式的欲望且不表现出任何情感。它们将被编号为SCP-3736-1与SCP-3736-2，储存于Site-21。SCP-3736-1将储存于35号低安保储物柜，SCP-3736-2将储存于36号低安保储物柜，随后C级员工将每日对其进行分析。将对“摁呀进阶版2”游戏机异常特质的起源进行进一步的分析。

**附录：3736-4** 在对SCP-3736-1和SCP-3736-2进行了█个月的分析之后，研究员将其改称为“摁呀异常版”，并对项目异常性质的起源有了少许了解。SCP-3736-1表现出极大的智力发展，现与SCP-3736的水平一致并具有处理情绪的能力。SCP-3736-2此时已无效化，不再表现出感知力，仅可作为标准的“摁呀！” 玩具使用。█████博士将在两个星期内对SCP-3736-1进行采访，时间未定。

> **受访者：**SCP-3736-1
>
> **采访者：**█████博士
>
> **前言：**由于SCP-3736-2已失去了异常属性，现SCP-3736-1拥有与SCP-3736同一水平的功能。
>
> **█████博士：**下午好，SCP-3736-1，你现在感觉如何?
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**爽呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你想要一个名字吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**起呀！
> ****
> **█████博士：**Extreme听起来怎样？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**爱呀！
> ****
> **█████博士：**你知道还有另一个可以像你一样说话的玩具吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**造呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**你知道它在4月7日停止运转了吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**不呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**好吧，它那时停止运转了，不能再像你那样说话了。
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**不呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**你是说它在4月7日没有停止运转？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**对呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**那你知道那是什么时候的事吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**猜呀!
> ****
> **█████博士决定来猜。**
> ****
> **█████博士：**是4月8日吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**不呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**4月24日？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**不呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**它什么时候停止工作的?
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**入呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**你是在说另一个玩具成为了你的一部分？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**对呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**它知道吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：沉默**
> ****
> **█████博士：**在你旁边的收容间里还有一个像你一样有智慧的玩具。
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**对呀！怎?
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1**开始发出低沉的噪音，使█████博士昏迷了3分钟。 噪音消失后，SCP-3736-1成为了普通的“摁呀！”玩具。
> ****
> **结语：**SCP-3736-1和SCP-3736-2都不再具有异常性质。 SCP-3736的行为发生了明显变化。尽管仍只能说出单音节词，但它开始问出一些更复杂的问题。 但如果不以“呀”结尾，它就无法说出任何句子。
