**Item #:** SCP-3736

**Object Class:** Safe

**Containment Procedures:** SCP-3736 is to be contained in Low-Security Locker 34 at Site 21. SCP-3736 is to be released and be engaged with by any C-Class Personnel or higher at least once a day. SCP-3736's locker is to be furnished with a chargeable light that must remain on at all times while it is inside. This light is to be recharged when SCP-3736 is outside its locker.

**Description:** SCP-3736 is a standard Bop It! model with audio commands as well as multiple game modes. SCP-3736 is part of a discontinued brand referred to as Bop It Extreme 2. SCP-3736 can be played as a standard Bop It! with commands to twist and pull its respective cranks. However, SCP-3736's anomalous effect occurs after three successful consecutive actions, after which SCP-3736 will attempt to converse with the player who had performed its requested actions. To the Foundation's knowledge, SCP-3736 can only communicate using single-syllable words followed by "It".

SCP-3736 appears to be desparate for human contact and continuously repeated "Help It!" upon being activated after recovery. SCP-3736 appears to be incapable of using words that are not verbs or adverbs with the exception of certain cases, but appears to have learned to communicate more efficiently using slang. When asked a question that would require an answer of "yes", SCP-3736 will respond with "Know It!", and will respond with "Not It!" if responding to a question that would require an answer of "no". SCP-3736 appears to enjoy being in the Foundation's custody and is grateful that it has been granted access with people to talk to.

> **Interviewed:** SCP-3736
>
> **Interviewer:** Doctor █████
>
> **Foreword:** Doctor █████ completed the required actions for inducing SCP-3736's anomalous effect.
>
> **<Begin Log>**
>
> **Doctor █████:** Good morning SCP-3736, do you prefer that we give you a name?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Name It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** What name would you prefer?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Name It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** You want me to come up with a name? How does "Bop" sound?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Keep It!
>
> **Doctor █████** So, Bop, how long have you been aware of your existence?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Made It!
>
> **Doctor █████** You have been self aware since you were created?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Know It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Why do you feel the need to communicate with humans?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Need It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** You need to communicate with humans to survive?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Not It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** How do you like the conditions of your locker?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Love It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Why do you need a light in there? Are you able to see, or is it something else?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Warms It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** You are able to feel cold?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Not It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Then why do you feel you need it?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Cheers It!
>
> **<End Log>**
>
> **Closing Statement:** SCP-3736 appears to have improved in terms of emotional maturity and vocabulary. Protocol will continue as normal.

**Addendum: 3736-1** SCP-3736 was recovered from an apartment in █████████, Texas on █████ █, ████. It had reached the Foundation's interest when a report of a Bop It! toy displaying unusual and disturbing commands. The residents interviewed had begun to respond to SCP-3736, but eventually grew fearful of the toy and sent it to the manufacturer who had no explanation for SCP-3736's properties. It was initially found afterwards by local Foundation intelligence and transferred to Site 21. The owners as well as the manufacturers contacted were administered Class-B amnestics.

**Addendum: 3736-2** SCP-3736 is shown to be aware that it is not human and shows respect for those who care for it. It holds a great amount of affection for mankind and shows kindness and respect towards anyone who speaks to it. It can differentiate between who uses it and seems to possess a photographic memory. It is presumed to hold telepathic qualities, due to it lacking any human senses. SCP-3736 holds no knowledge on how it acquired sentience and describes its genesis as a sudden awakening.

**Addendum: 3736-3** Two more models of Bop It Extreme 2 have shown sentience similar to that of SCP-3736. While they are shown to possess intelligence equal to SCP-3736, they lack any form of desire and show no emotion. They are to be classified as SCP-3736-1 and SCP-3736-2 and stored in Site 21. SCP-3736-1 is to be stored in Low Security Locker 35, while SCP-3736-2 is to be stored in Low Security Locker 36; both models are to be analyzed further by C Class Personnel daily. Further analysis is to be provided on the origin of the anomaly associated with the Bop It Extreme 2 Model.

**Addendum: 3736-4** After █ months of analysis on SCP-3736-1 and SCP-3736-2 to find hints to the origin of "The Bop It! Anomaly" (as it will be referred to from now on), SCP-3736-1 has shown substantial mental development and now operates at the level of SCP-3736 as well as possessing the capability of processing emotion. SCP-3736-2 has effectively become neutralized at this point, as it no longer shows sentience and functions merely as a standard Bop It! toy. An interview with SCP-3736-1 will be conducted by Doctor █████ at an undetermined date within 2 weeks.

**对象编号:** SCP-3800

**对象分类:** Euclid

**特别收容措施:** SCP-3800 收容于位于中国新疆的第93号站点附近的一个标准收容柜中。目前，一个由SCP-3800-1组成的殖民地（见附录）被收容在一个以前未被居住过的群岛（代号为Outpost 3800）上，该群岛位于南纬26.412°，东经88.603°。在Outpost 3800上安装了隐蔽摄像头以监控和研究殖民地的活动。目前，Outpost 3800的大约34%（4.5公里）的土地被SCP-3800-1结构覆盖。预计Outpost 3800的殖民不会使SCP-3800的范围达到危险水平。任何在Outpost 3800进行的测试必须得到两名Level 4人员的批准。所有因任何原因新出现的SCP-3800-1实例都应被麻醉并运送到Outpost 3800。

如果SCP-3800的范围超过2500公里，将启动将SCP-3800转移到月球Outpost 45的紧急程序。

**描述:** SCP-3800是一幅用油彩和丙烯颜料绘制的Shaun Tan[注]的作品“他们乘船而来”的复制品，装在木框里。这幅画看起来像是原创作品；底部有标题、艺术家签名和识别号码（283/500）。

当SCP-3800位于海岸线、海滩或海洋大约800公里范围内时，会出现SCP-3800-1实例。在这种情况下，每公里海岸线将有5到20个SCP-3800-1实例以每小时的速度从海洋中出现。

SCP-3800-1实例表现为具有多个生理异常的白人类形生物。最显著的是，它们没有嘴巴[注]，不需食物，无法呼吸。此外，所有实例都表现出侏儒症特征，并显示出较低的智力迹象。它们没有书面或口头交流方式，也没有宗教、贸易系统或等级制度。初次出现后，实例会走向海岸开始建立殖民地。

当群体行动时[注]，SCP-3800-1实例会试图远离人类、敌对动物或不适合居住的区域，建立一系列结构。具体来说，它们会尝试用可用材料建造避难所[注]并开始耕种任何可用的植物[注]。如果阻止它们创建这些结构或破坏它们，实例会变得激动并变得敌对。此外，实例显示出制作和使用简单工具如棍棒、斧头和挖掘棍的能力，但似乎无法制造或使用更先进的技术。

一旦SCP-3800-1实例建立了初始殖民地，它们将继续扩展它，建造更多的农场和避难所，进一步远离最初的定居点[注]。实例几乎从不参与对殖民地无益的活动，通常花费时间收集材料、建造结构或照顾农场。随着殖民地人口的增长，实例显示出越来越强的能力[注]来清除阻碍它们扩张领土的障碍物，如茂密的植被、动物领地和人造结构。然而，SCP-3800-1从未尝试跨越海水（在初次出现后），并且似乎无法做到这一点。

对于每个被SCP-3800-1纳入其领土的平方公里土地，SCP-3800的效应范围增加约5公里。每当不存在活跃的SCP-3800-1殖民地时，该范围每天也会增加5公里。由于大陆限制，超过2645公里的范围会导致SCP-3800的范围呈指数级增长，并导致随后不受控制的SCP-3800-1出现，从而可能导致RK级重构场景或NK级世界末日场景，如果让其留在地球上的话。

**首次发现:** SCP-3800最初于2011年3月2日在西澳大利亚Useless Loop的一次112报警后被发现，报告称“奇怪的人在公路上建房子”。确认该地区存在异常后，机动任务组Sigma-16（“Dusty的帮派”）被派去调查、收容和清理该地区。

当天与SCP-3800-1初次接触时，发现沿Carrarang东部海岸约4公里处有由实例建造的结构。开始清理这些结构后，SCP-3800-1实例变得敌对并试图攻击机动任务组人员，但未造成严重伤害。所有实例（以及之后出现的实例）都被麻醉并运送到第23号站点进行收容。

当机动任务组Sigma-16驻扎在该地区时，SCP-3800-1的出现范围扩大到包括整个Carrarang西部海岸。由于该地区的低人口密度，第二个殖民地在未被发现的情况下持续扩展了超过16小时。直到这个殖民地被发现时，实例的出现范围已经迅速扩大。随后调集额外力量协助收容。

SCP-3800-1在西澳大利亚海岸持续出现约两周。在此期间，SCP-3800的范围扩大到涵盖了Carrarang的所有海岸线，以及Nanga、Dirk Harthog岛和弗朗索瓦·佩隆国家公园的部分区域。由于出现范围的不断扩大，制定了紧急收容程序以疏散珀斯和其他西澳大利亚城市，并对西澳大利亚海岸进行全面隔离。

2011年3月15日，SCP-3800在一个位于北Tamala的SCP-3800-1避难所内被发现并带入内陆，停止了SCP-3800-1的出现。由于SCP-3800-1的初次出现位置与SCP-3800的回收位置之间的不一致，确定SCP-3800至少被移动过一次，很可能是由SCP-3800-1实例移动的。此外，SCP-3800所在的结构还包含了一些不寻常的物品（见附录2）。

随后不久，SCP-3800-1实例在大澳大利亚湾再次出现。在收容（并随后重新出现）这些实例后，确定了SCP-3800的效应范围从大约100公里增加到了至少800公里。

假设SCP-3800的效应范围在没有活跃的SCP-3800-1殖民地时会增加。这一假设通过多次测试SCP-3800-1的出现得到了证实。所有新出现的实例（连同第23号站点内的实例）被运输到将成为Outpost 3800的地方，并从昏迷中醒来。在创建Outpost 3800后，SCP-3800被使用SCPS Kristov[注]运送到现在的第93号站点。

**附录:** 大约在初次收容后的5个月，几个SCP-3800-1实例在大澳大利亚湾出现。在收容（并随后重新出现）这些实例后，确定了SCP-3800的效应范围从大约100公里增加到了至少800公里。

假设SCP-3800的效应范围在没有活跃的SCP-3800-1殖民地时会增加。这一假设通过多次测试SCP-3800-1的出现得到了证实。所有新出现的实例（连同第23号站点内的实例）被运输到将成为Outpost 3800的地方，并从昏迷中醒来。在创建Outpost 3800后，SCP-3800被使用SCPS Kristov[注]运送到现在的第93号站点。

**附录2（已恢复的物品）:** 在最初发现SCP-3800的避难所内还发现了其他一些物品，但只有SCP-3800显示出了任何异常能力。这些物品包括一张不完整的海洋航行图、一张手写便条和一个非功能性的指南针。所有这些物品都可追溯到16世纪晚期。

便条似乎是被撕掉的日记页，用葡萄牙语书写。大部分内容已被水损坏而无法辨认。翻译成英语如下：
[[折叠显示+ 显示便条。]]
> 第133天
>
> 来这里是个错误，因为这片土地已经被占领了。城市的延伸可以一直看到地平线……昨天，船上的其余成员进入了，只有托马斯回到了船上。至少，感觉像是托马斯。
>
> 他说原住民打算“向孩子们发送信息”，并要求我跟他一起去。他说我可以加入船员或者随船一起沉没。我告诉他给我一天时间决定，然后他回到了城市。我相信我的决定已经做出了。
>
> 即使现在，我也看到他们在地平线上准备着他们的船只。我必须立即采取行动。船长带了一年前的样本作为预防措施，以防万一。除非我自己把它带进城市，否则它在外面待不了多久。我没有其他选择——我们到达岸边的那一刻就注定要沉没了。

> 我会在这里埋葬我的个人物品，应该[剩余内容无法辨认]

[[include component:image-block name=http://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-3800/thisismyhouse.jpg|caption=一座由SCP-3800-1个体建造的房屋]]
**项目编号：**SCP-3800

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-3800被收容于亚欧大陆难抵极[[footnote]]**译注：**大陆上离海洋的平均距离最远的位置[[/footnote]]附近的Site-93的标准收容柜中。

目前，一个SCP-3800-1聚居群体[[footnote]]由发现异常期间显现的个体及在附录1事件中显现的个体组成[[/footnote]]被收容于南纬26.412度，东经88.603度的一个荒无人烟的群岛（指定为前哨站3800，见附录）上。前哨站内多个位置安有隐蔽摄像头以监控并研究聚居群体活动。目前前哨站约34%（4.5km^^2^^）的地块被SCP-3800-1建筑覆盖。预计在前哨站3800的拓殖不会使SCP-3800的影响范围达到危险水平。在前哨站3800开展任何类型的实验都需要2名四级人员批准。无论什么原因显现的其他SCP-3800-1实体都必须被镇静并运送到前哨站3800。
将SCP-3800运至月面前哨站-45的紧急协议已制订。将于SCP-3800影响半径超过2500km时执行。

**描述：**SCP-3800是陈志勇[[footnote]]来自澳大利亚珀思市的一位作家/插画家[[/footnote]]所作的木框丙烯酸油画[[span class="ruby"]]“他们渡海而来”[[span class="rt"]]They Came By Water[[/span]][[/span]]。画作底部有标题、艺术家签名和识别号（283/500），应为作品原件。

位于海岸线或海洋约--100--800km范围内时，SCP-3800的异常效应将会显现。异常效应显现时，SCP-3800-1实体将以每千米海岸线每小时5～20个实体的速率从SCP-3800影响半径内的海洋中浮现。

SCP-3800-1实体外观近似高加索人种，有数种身体异常。最值得注意的是，实体无口、鼻孔[[footnote]]似乎无需进食且不能呼吸[[/footnote]]、生殖器、乳房、肛门和体毛。此外，所有实体均表现出侏儒症的特征，几乎没有表现出较高智力的迹象。它们没有任何形式的书面或口头交流，也没有任何宗教、贸易系统或等级制度。显现之后，实例将走到岸边并开始建立聚居地。

在聚居群体中时[[footnote]]SCP-3800-1实体个体被迫从群体中分离后将试图回到任何实体身边，被阻挠时会变得越来越恐慌。[[/footnote]]，SCP-3800-1实体会尝试建立一系列远离人类、侵略性动物群或不宜居地区的建筑。具体而言，实体会尝试用可用材料建造居所[[footnote]]不同聚居群体的居所不同，但常常通常由泥土和木头建造[[/footnote]]并种植任何可用植物[[footnote]]鉴于实体无需进食，种植行为原因未知。实体会打理其作物，但从未观察到SCP-3800-1实体收割或消费之。[[/footnote]]。若建造受阻或建筑物被摧毁，SCP-3800-1实体将变得焦躁且充满敌意。此外，实体表现出制作并使用基本工具的能力，如棍棒、斧头、用石木草制作的各类工具，但似乎没有创造或使用更先进技术的能力。

SCP-3800-1实体一旦建立第一个聚居地就会继续扩张它，并在离原定居点较远处建造更多农田和居所[[footnote]]无论聚居地的建筑规模是否足以容纳现有人口[[/footnote]]。实体几乎只从事利于其聚居群体的活动，大多数时间用于收集材料、建造建筑或打理农田。随着聚居群体人口增长，实体表现出越来越强的清除领土扩张障碍的能力[[footnote]]通常以群体能力体现。即使缺乏直接沟通，SCP-3800-1实体在大群体中表现出高于平均的团队合作水平。[[/footnote]]，如清除茂密植物群、动物领地和人造建筑。但SCP-3800-1（在一开始的显现之后）从未尝试穿过海域水体，似乎没有能力这么做。

SCP-3800-1每将1km^^2^^陆地纳入其领土，SCP-3800的影响半径扩大约5km。无活跃SCP-3800-1聚居群体时影响半径也会每天扩大5km。由于大洲限制，影响半径超过2645km[[footnote]]亚欧大陆难抵极到最近海岸的距离[[/footnote]]会导致SCP-3800影响范围指数级增长、SCP-3800-1不受控显现，若SCP-3800留在地球将引发一场可能的RK级重构情景或NK级世界末日情景。

**初次发现：**SCP-3800最初在2011/03/02的一次拨打自西澳大利亚无用环路的112电话中被发现，电话中报告“奇怪的人在路中间建房子”。确认该区域出现异常后，机动特遣队Sigma-16（[[span class="ruby"]]“达斯蒂的打手”[[span class="rt"]]Dusty's Goons[[/span]][[/span]]）被派到该地区进行侦查、收容和清理。

同日与SCP-3800-1初次接触，并发现实体建造的沿卡拉朗东海岸绵延约4km的建筑。一旦开始清理建筑，SCP-3800-1实体就产生敌意并试图攻击MTF队员，但未造成任何严重伤害。所有实体（以及后来显现的）都被镇静并运送到Site-23收容。

MTF-Σ-16驻扎在该地区时，SCP-3800-1[[footnote]]当时尚不清楚SCP-3800的存在[[/footnote]]的显现半径扩大到足以覆盖卡拉朗西部海岸的大部分地区。由于该地区人口密度较小，第二个聚居群体在该地区显现并扩张了超过16个小时未被发现。聚居群体被发现时实体显现半径正迅速增长。事件发生后，更多武装力量受召协助收容。

SCP-3800-1在澳大利亚西部的海岸持续显现约2周，期间SCP-3800的影响半径扩大到足以覆盖卡拉朗全境海岸，以及楠加、德克·哈托格岛和弗朗索瓦·佩伦国家公园的部分海岸。因显现半径扩大，基金会制订了疏散珀思市和其余澳大利亚西部城市居民并完全隔离澳大利亚西部海岸的紧急收容协议。

2011/03/15，SCP-3800在塔马拉北部的一座SCP-3800-1居所中被发现并带往内陆的Site-23，使SCP-3800-1显现停止。由于SCP-3800-1初次显现位置与SCP-3800的回收位置不同，SCP-3800至少被移动过一次，且很可能是被SCP-3800-1实体移动过。此外，SCP-3800所在的建筑内还包含一些不常见的物品[[footnote]]除了实体制造的工具之外，SCP-3800-1实体通常不持有个人物品[[/footnote]]（见附录2）。

其余SCP-3800-1建筑不久被摧毁。总计损失████美元，██名平民受伤，█人伤亡。对███人实施了记忆删除。所有捕获的SCP-3800-1实体[[footnote]]共4403人[[/footnote]]均处于药物诱导的昏迷状态并收容于Site-23。

**附录1：**初次收容约5个月后，数个SCP-3800-1实体显现于大澳大利亚湾近岸。收容实体（及后续显现的实体）后，确认SCP-3800的影响半径已从约100km增加到至少800km。

有假设称，只要无活跃SCP-3800-1聚居群体，SCP-3800的影响半径就会扩大。后在对SCP-3800-1显现的多重测试中得到证实。所有新近显现的实体[[footnote]]共215人[[/footnote]]和收容于Site-23中的实体均被运送至后来的前哨站3800，并从昏迷中唤醒。前哨站3800建立后，SCP-3800由//SCPS Kristov//[[footnote]]Mark IV型基金会穿梭载具，替代标准运输机，以确保经过东南亚时不会导致SCP-3800-1意外显现[[/footnote]]运送至当前收容位置Site-93。

**附录2（回收材料）：**初次发现SCP-3800的居所中还发现了其它物品，但SCP-3800是唯一显示出异常特性的。这些物品包括一份不完整航行海图、一张手写笔记和一个无功能的指南针。三件物品均可追溯至16世纪00年代晚期。

笔记看起来像是一页撕下的日记，以葡萄牙文书写。大部分笔记已被泡坏，难以辨认。其译文如下：

[[collapsible show="+ 查看笔记" hide="- 隐藏笔记"]]
> 第133天
>
> 来到这里是个错误，因为所有土地都已经有人居住了。目之所及都是他们的城市……其他人都在一天之前进城了，只有托马斯回到了船上。至少那个人感觉像托马斯。
>
> 他说当地人打算“给孩子们发条消息”，叫我和他一起去。他说我要么加入那些船员，要么给船陪葬。我告诉他给我一天时间做决定，然后他回到了城里。我想，我已经做出决定了。
>
> 就算是现在，我也能在地平线上看到他们在准备船。我必须现在行动。船长带了去年爆发时的样本以防万一。它不会在船外活太久，除非我自己把它带到城里。我没有别的选择——在靠岸时我们就完蛋了。
>
> 我会在这里埋葬我的私人物品，然后去[其余部分无法辨识]
[[/collapsible]]

[[/>]]
[[include component:image-block name=thisismyhouse.jpg|caption=A shelter created by instances of SCP-3800-1.]]

**Item #:** SCP-3800

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:**  SCP-3800 is contained at Site-93, located near the Eurasian Pole of Inaccessibility in Xinjiang, China.  It is to be kept in a standard containment locker.

Currently, a colony of SCP-3800-1[[footnote]]Comprised of instances that manifested during the anomaly's discovery along with those that manifested during the events of Addendum 1.[[/footnote]] is contained on a previously uninhabited archipelago (designated Outpost 3800, see Addendum) located at 26.412° S, 88.603° E.  Hidden cameras have been installed at various locations on the Outpost to monitor and study the colony's activity.  Currently, roughly 34% (4.5 kilometers) of the Outpost's landmass is covered in SCP-3800-1 structures.  The colonization of Outpost 3800 is not expected to increase the range of SCP-3800 to dangerous levels.  Testing held at Outpost 3800 of any kind must be approved by two Level 4 personnel.   Additional SCP-3800-1 instances that manifest for any reason are to be tranquilized and transported to Outpost 3800.

Emergency protocols to transport SCP-3800 to Lunar Outpost 45 have been arranged, and will be enacted should SCP-3800's radius grow past 2500 km.

**Description:**  SCP-3800 is an oil & acrylic print of Shaun Tan[[footnote]]An author/illustrator hailing from Perth, Australia.[[/footnote]]'s //"They Came By Water"// set in a wooden frame. It appears to be an original print; the title, artist signature, and identification number (283/500) are all present at the bottom of the print.

SCP-3800's anomalous effect manifests when it is located within roughly --100-- 800 kilometers of any coastline, seashore, or ocean. Should this occur, instances of SCP-3800-1 will emerge from the ocean at an hourly rate of 5 to 20 instances per kilometer of coastline encompassed by SCP-3800's radius.

Instances of SCP-3800-1 appear to be Caucasian humanoids with several physical abnormalities. Most notably, instances lack mouths[[footnote]]Instances appear to not require sustenance, and are incapable of respiration.[[/footnote]], nostrils, genitalia, mammaries, anuses, and body hair. Additionally, all instances share traits of dwarfism and show little signs of higher intelligence. They possess no form of written or spoken communication, and lack any sort of religion, trade system, or hierarchy. Following initial manifestation, instances will walk to shore and begin establishing a colony.

When in a group[[footnote]]Individual instances that are unwillingly separated from their colony will attempt to return to any other SCP-3800-1 instances, and will become increasingly panicked when impeded.[[/footnote]], instances of SCP-3800-1 will attempt to establish a series of structures away from humans, aggressive fauna, or inhospitable areas. Specifically, instances will attempt to build shelters out of available materials[[footnote]]Shelters differ greatly between colonies but are most often constructed of mud or timber.[[/footnote]] and begin farming any available flora[[footnote]]As instances do not require sustenance, the reason for this is unknown. Crops are often tended to, but have never been observed to be harvested or consumed by SCP-3800-1 instances.[[/footnote]]. SCP-3800-1 instances will become agitated and hostile if impeded from creating these structures, or if they are destroyed. Additionally, instances have shown the ability to craft and utilize rudimentary tools such as clubs, axes, and digging sticks out of stone, wood, and grasses, but appear to be unable to create or use more advanced technology.

Once instances of SCP-3800-1 have established their initial colony, they continue to expand it, building additional farms and shelters further out from their original settlement point[[footnote]]Regardless of whether or not the colony's population is an adequate size to inhabit the amount of structures present.[[/footnote]]. Instances almost never engage in activity that does not benefit their colony, and usually spend their time gathering materials, building structures, or tending to farms. As the colony's population grows, instances show a progressively greater ability[[footnote]]Usually through strength in numbers. SCP-3800-1 instances have shown above average teamwork capabilities when in large groups, despite their lack of direct communication.[[/footnote]] to clear obstacles preventing them from expanding their territory, such as thick flora, animal territories, and man-made structures. However, SCP-3800-1 has never attempted to cross bodies of seawater (following their initial manifestation) and appear unable to do so.

For each square km of land that SCP-3800-1 incorporates into their territory, SCP-3800's radius of effect increases by roughly 5 km. This radius also increases by 5 km per day whenever no active SCP-3800-1 colonies exist. Due to continental constraints, a radius past 2645 km[[footnote]]The distance between the Eurasian Pole of Inaccessibility and the nearest coastline.[[/footnote]] would result in an exponential increase in SCP-3800's range and uncontrolled SCP-3800-1 manifestations thereafter, leading to a possible RK-Class restructuring scenario or NK-Class end of the world scenario should it be left on Earth.

**Initial Discovery:**  SCP-3800 was initially discovered on 2 March 2011 following a 112 call from Useless Loop, Western Australia with reports of "strange men building houses in the middle of the road". Once an anomaly was confirmed in the area, Mobile Task Force Sigma-16 ("Dusty's Goons") were tasked with investigation, containment, and cleanup of the area.

Initial contact with SCP-3800-1 was made on the same day, with structures created by the instances present for roughly 4 km along the eastern coast of Carrarang. Once cleanup of the structures began, SCP-3800-1 instances became hostile and attempted to attack MTF personnel, though not causing any serious injuries. All instances (and those that manifested thereafter) were tranquilized and transported to Site-23 for containment.

While MTF-Σ-16 was stationed in the area, SCP-3800-1[[footnote]]SCP-3800 was unknown to exist at the time.[[/footnote]]'s radius of manifestation grew large enough to encompass much of the western Carrarang coast as well. A second colony manifested there and expanded unobserved for over 16 hours due to the small population density in the area. By the time this colony was discovered, the instances' manifestation radius had grown rapidly. Following this event, additional forces were called to aid in containment.

SCP-3800-1 continued to manifest off the coast of Western Australia for roughly two weeks. During this time, SCP-3800's radius had grown to encompass the entirety of Carrarang's coastline, along with portions of Nanga, Dirk Harthog Island, and Francois Peron National Park. Due to the increasing radius of manifestation, emergency containment procedures were devised for the evacuation of Perth and other Western Australian cities, along with a complete quarantine of the Western Australian coast.

On 15 March 2011, SCP-3800 was discovered in an SCP-3800-1 shelter in northern Tamala and brought inland to Site-23, ceasing SCP-3800-1's manifestation. Due to inconsistencies between SCP-3800-1's initial manifestation location and SCP-3800's recovery location, it was determined that SCP-3800 had been moved at least once, likely by an instance of SCP-3800-1. Additionally, the structure in which SCP-3800 was located also contained a number of unusual[[footnote]]Instances of SCP-3800-1 do not typically possess personal effects other than tools constructed by the entities.[[/footnote]] items (see Addendum 2).

The remaining SCP-3800-1 structures were destroyed soon after. Total losses numbered at $████ in damage, ██ injured civilians, and █ casualties. Amnestics were administered to ███ individuals.  All captured SCP-3800-1 instances[[footnote]]4403 in total[[/footnote]] were placed under medically induced comas and contained at Site-23.

**Addendum:**  Roughly 5 months following initial containment, several instances of SCP-3800-1 manifested off the Great Australian Bight. Following containment (and subsequent remanifestation) of the instances, it was determined that SCP-3800's radius of effect had increased from an approximate 100 km to a minimum 800 km.

It was hypothesized that SCP-3800's effect radius increases whenever no active SCP-3800-1 colonies exist. This was proven following multiple tests of SCP-3800-1 manifestation. All newly manifested instances[[footnote]]215 in total[[/footnote]] (along with the instances contained in Site-23) were transported to what would become Outpost 3800 and awakened from their comas. Following the creation of Outpost 3800, SCP-3800 was transported to its current location at Site-93 using the //SCPS Kristov//[[footnote]]A Mark IV Foundation shuttle, used in the place of a standard transport plane to ensure no accidental SCP-3800-1 manifestation occurred while passing over Southeast Asia[[/footnote]].

**Addendum 2 (Recovered Materials):**  Additional objects were found in the shelter where SCP-3800 was initially discovered. However, SCP-3800 was the only object that showed any anomalous capabilities. These items included one incomplete ocean navigation chart, one handwritten note, and one nonfunctional compass. All three items were dated to the late 1500s.

The note appeared to be a ripped-out diary page, and is written in Portuguese. Most of the note has been water damaged and is illegible. It reads as follows when translated into English:
[[collapsible show="+ Show note." hide="- Hide note."]]
> Day 133
>
> It was a mistake to come here, for these lands are already inhabited. Their cities go on for as far as the eye can see... The rest of the crew entered a day ago, and only Tomas has returned to the ship. At least, it feels like Tomas.
>
> He said that the natives intend to "send a message to the children", and asked me to come with him. Said I could either join the crew or die with the ship. I told him to give me a day to decide, and he returned to the city. I believe my decision is made.
>
> Even now, I see them preparing their ships across the horizon. I must act now. The captain brought a sample from last year's outbreak, just in case. It won't survive long outside the ship unless I take it upon myself to bring it into the city. I see no other option - we were doomed once we reached the shore.
>
> I will bury my personal effects here, and should [illegible for the remainder of the note]
[[/collapsible]]

**对象编号:** SCP-2094

**对象分类:** Euclid

**特别收容程序:** SCP-2094 收容于 Bio-Site 59 的中等安全住宅舱内。标准 PG 级别经批准的奢侈品和便利设施可在监督下提供，作为促进采访和实验合作的激励措施。

SCP-2094 的情绪健康维护由 Dr. Anniston（ES#59-390-258）负责。任何请求访问或更改 SCP-2094 当前药物方案的请求必须提交给她进行三份审核。

**描述:** SCP-2094 是一名欧洲血统的男性人类，出生于 2014 年 4 月 10 日，年龄为 38 岁。SCP-2094 上身有多处描绘常见马戏团图案的纹身。SCP-2094 使用美国英语交流，具体为纽约市口音。SCP-2094 拥有非凡（非异常）的手部灵活性，尤其擅长抛接球。

SCP-2094 口腔内部存在一个空间异常。SCP-2094 下颌和面部肌肉可以被拉伸至任何方向长达 2 米，而不会引起显著疼痛或伤害。此外，SCP-2094 还能够将进入其口腔的任何物理物质重新导向到一个由异常弹性肠组织构成的额外维度器官。

似乎没有 SCP-2094 可以存储的物质量限制。携带在其中的空间物体的重量不会影响 SCP-2094 的整体重量，也不会使其感到不适或妨碍其移动能力。SCP-2094 称这个空间为“第二个胃”；然而，研究表明它实际上并无生物功能。

SCP-2094 在日本高良田附近的一个开放田野被发现，并与与 GoI-233（[赫尔曼·富勒马戏团]）相关的非异常物品一起被发现。SCP-2094 被发现被锁在一只大型古董箱内，箱顶用红色油漆写着“献给埃西丝”。

**随身物品:**

在初步收容期间从 SCP-2094 的肠道空间中移除的物品如下：

* 各种颜色的木制抛接棒
* 金属打火机和几包雪茄
* 120 钢琴低音提琴
* 包含两套干净衣物、牙刷和剃须套装的行李箱
* 完全功能性的 1962 年款玛莎拉蒂 3500 跑车，内饰和机械部分略有改动
* 裹着布料的箱子，里面装有多个古董自动玩具
* 正常运作的 1959 年式冲锋枪及其配套弹药
* 火焰喷射火炬
* 塑料箱，内装 45 瓶煤油

**选定访谈 #1:**

> **访谈者:** Dr. O'Sullivan
>
> **访谈对象:** SCP-2094
>
> **备注:** 访谈于 2006 年 2 月 24 日进行，距 SCP-2094 进入收容状态后一天。
>
>
> **<开始日志>**
>
> **SCP-2094:** （//当 Dr. O'Sullivan 进入访谈室时//）恭喜，先生！您似乎获得了前排座位来观看这场怪诞表演！真幸运！房间有点太干净了，不太符合我的口味，但没关系——是表演者让舞台变得精彩。就像老戈尔迪常说的那样。（//轻敲访谈室隔板//）哦，医生！我们还没互相介绍呢，你就已经开始筑起墙了！这可不是个好兆头，我们的关系。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 晚上好，SCP-2094。我是 Dr. O'Sullivan。我将——
>
> **SCP-2094:** （//模仿爱尔兰口音//）O'Sullivan，你这么说？天哪！我简直要成为三叶草的歌谣歌手了！我也有一点爱尔兰血统，来自我妈妈那边！
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 我今天下午将进行这次访谈。
>
> **SCP-2094:** （//正常语调//）哦，你要进行访谈？我以前从未被访谈过！哦，这应该很有趣！这意味着我出名了吗？这是不是疯人院，所有超级明星最终都会被关在这里？嘿，你有没有安迪·卡夫曼藏在这里？
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 我不能讨论这个设施的性质。
>
> **SCP-2094:** 来吧，现在。很明显这是什么地方。你们显然没有特别隐晦。武装守卫，加固的牢房，持续的监视，以及阻止我接触你那//美丽的//脸庞的脆弱水晶屏障。//（//SCP-2094 轻轻地沿着强化玻璃访谈屏障的背面滑动手指//）我在哪儿了？哦，对了。任何人都能看出来这是什么地方。我们是在诺特农场，显然！你们什么时候才会面对现实？你们永远也比不上迪士尼乐园，无论你们招募了多少像我这样的特殊雪花。你们永远不会成为最好的。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 你似乎很健谈。你能不能告诉我关于赫尔曼·富勒马戏团的一些情况？
>
> **SCP-2094:** 哦，那是个很棒的地方。很棒的地方。那里的人很好。你应该去一次。带家人一起去。享受一下。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 我很想亲自去看看。我怎么才能找到它？
>
> **SCP-2094:** 医生，医生，医生！你不会找到马戏团——马戏团会找到你！你看，你会拖着自己在平凡生活中的泥潭里跋涉，被铅笔屑淹没，被你整洁办公室里的消毒剂窒息，直到有一天你意识到纸张和政治的味道在你的灵魂中变得如此陈腐，连最严格的氟化物都无法清除。然后，当你开始觉得这个星球上已经没有什么值得生活的了，//那就是//你开始看到气球、灯光、小丑……所有的一切都在提醒你世界上仍然有魔法。是的，我想你会这样找到马戏团，先生斯威尼。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 你知道马戏团里的一个名叫倒立脸的人吗？
>
> **SCP-2094:** 哦，所以你知道曼尼！等等。我在说什么？当然你知道曼尼！你们肯定知道他的一切，从他的青梅竹马到鞋码。他是个非常难忘的人。正直的人。擅长与孩子相处。出色的表演者。勤奋的领导者。注重细节。任务特定。协同效率。低垂的果实。可利用的资产。随时打断我，斯利。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 他在马戏团里扮演什么角色？
>
> **SCP-2094:** 奥菲莉亚，偶尔——而且我总是哭。但通常他都在做自己的事情。他是个非常忙碌的倒立脸男人。做了很多……重要的……倒立脸男人的事情。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 他听起来是个有趣的人。你们是什么时候认识的？
>
> **SCP-2094:** 不，你不想听那个。你更愿意听听我的简·方达模仿？“//为什么你救了她，尽管她对你做了那么多糟糕的事情？//”很好，不是吗？我也可以做得不错的奥黛丽·赫本，还有我的海伦·凯勒也不差。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 请不要害怕分享你在马戏团的经历。我知道许多怪人从小就遭到绑架和虐待，但你现在离你的捕猎者很远。他们无法在这里伤害你。
>
> **SCP-2094:** 被绑架？虐待？你们都和谁说过话？听着，如果你对我不够配合，那不是因为我受了创伤。你可以马上把这从你的脑海中抹去。//现在就。//我不是那种会出卖我的马戏团家庭的人。我知道你们的游戏，埃西丝。你们想和我交朋友，榨取我所有的价值。好吧，告诉你们的家伙们记下来：你们追捕的所有人？这些人和你们一样是罪犯？他们都是圣人。听见了吗？他们是好人！//我不是被绑架的。//我跑了出来，他们张开双臂接纳了我。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 对不起，我没有冒犯你的家人。
>
> **SCP-2094:** 什么？一些微妙的同情心？我开始融化你那冰冷、坚硬的心了吗，医生？
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 告诉我，你为什么要逃跑？
>
> **SCP-2094:** 就是那样。所以我们现在玩起了背景故事游戏，是吗？好的。我会咬的。我八岁的时候。我爸爸在我出生前就离开了家，所以我一直和亲爱的妈妈住在一起。她是一个真正的宝石女人，我的母亲。她过着魔幻般的生活，坐在她的妈妈宝座上，喝着她的特殊妈妈水，直到她的双眼翻白。她从没打过我，但她恨我。天啊，她恨我。这种感觉也是相互的。有时候我会带着一嘴森林里的小动物回家，只是为了让她发狂。呵呵。我会走到她面前，装作无辜的样子，露出那些可爱的、八岁孩子的笑容……然后吐出几十只老鼠到她的膝盖上。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 所以她知道你的异常能力？
>
> **SCP-2094:** 什么，你是指这个吗？（//SCP-2094 抓住他的下唇，将其拉长到手臂长度，然后让它恢复原状。//）是的，她注意到了。这就是我为什么没有母乳喂养的原因。因为我是如此奇怪的小东西，她几乎把我关在家里。猜她担心我会吃掉别人。不过，我从来没有想过要冲出去闯世界。小时候我是一个相当胆小的孩子，相信或不相信。但有一天晚上——实际上，等等。让我先回到那个地方。你看过彼得潘吗？动画版的？
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 我看过。
>
> **SCP-2094:** 好的，很好。我在哪儿了？哦，对了。但有一天晚上，当我妈妈睡着时，//他//走进了我的房间。站在我的窗户外面，轮廓在星星的背景下，就像彼得潘一样。他告诉我怪人不应该一辈子被关在盒子里。他告诉我他们应该走出这个世界，分享他们的天赋，让人们笑、尖叫、呕吐。他还告诉我有一个地方，我可以被数百人爱戴，我可以成为明星，我可以有一个真正的家庭。所以他握住了我的手。亲爱的妈妈太醉了，甚至没有注意到我们一起跳出了前门。而这就是我如何逃离加入马戏团的。这是我一生的最佳决定。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 在半夜被陌生人拜访并没有让你感到惊恐？
>
> **SCP-2094:** 好吧，他的脸是倒过来的，所以我应该有点害怕，但当时我只是兴奋地遇到比我更奇怪的人。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 你在马戏团里没有受到虐待？
>
> **SCP-2094:** 我会告诉你，马戏团生活并不适合每个人，但嘿，曼尼和他的朋友们尽了最大的努力。他们给我们提供了面包，让我们有了枕头。我偶尔挨打，但哪个孩子不呢？这是成长的一部分。他们让我保持纪律，迅速成熟。马戏团的人像对待自己的家人一样爱我。他们从不让我觉得成为怪人是一件需要隐藏或羞愧的事情。在一个马戏团家庭中，你会彼此照顾。你//不会//只是转过身来把你的家人卖给埃西丝基金会！
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 发现你时，你们是怎么把你锁在箱子里的？
>
> **SCP-2094:** （//沉默//）
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 你和你的家人之间有什么问题吗？
>
> **SCP-2094:** 哈！你想知道吗？对不起，斯利，但我认为我已经说够了。你不会从我这里得到更多了。现在，永远都不会。
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** 没关系。感谢你的时间，SCP-2094。
>
> **SCP-2094:** 别客气！这是我头号粉丝的要求。
>
> **<结束日志>**

**选定访谈 #2:**

[[include component:image-block name=http://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-2094/MotorMouthASDF.png|caption=SCP-2094在被收容后。]]

**项目编号：**SCP-2094

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-2094收容于Bio Site-59的中等安保收容居住间。标准PG级预批准享受与娱乐可在监督基础上适用以促进项目对采访和试验的合作。

对SCP-2094情绪不稳定的药物治疗当前由Anniston博士（ES#59-390-258）监督，任何变更SCP-2094当前用药的申请须一式三份交由她审核。

**描述：**SCP-2094是一欧洲血统男性人类，到04/10/14为38岁。SCP-2094的上体有多处常规马戏团主题的纹身。SCP-2094以美式英语交流，带有纽约市地方口音。SCP-2094有着十分灵巧的手部技巧（非异常），特别擅长杂耍。

SCP-2094的口腔内有一空间异常。SCP-2094的下颌与面部肌肉可以向任意方向拉伸延展到2米且不会因此受到任何伤害和疼痛。此外SCP-2094能将进入其嘴中的任何物体传送到一个有着异常弹性的肠道组织构成的超维空间中。

SCP-2094似乎能在该空间内无限存储物体。这些物体的重量不会使SCP-2094出现超重，也不会使SCP-2094在活动上出现任何不便。SCP-2094把这空间叫做“第二胃”；然而研究确认其并不具有实际的生物功能。

SCP-2094被发现于日本上富良野的一处开阔地上，一起被发现的还有一套与GoI-233（//赫曼·富勒的不安马戏团//）相关的无异常物品。SCP-2094被发现捆绑着锁在一株古树干内，树干上以红色颜料写着"献给艾西"字样。

**回收到的物品：**

下面是在收容后从SCP-2094内部空间内找到的物品列表。

* 各色木质杂耍球
* 金属打火机和几包无味香烟
* 120键低音手风琴
* 一个手提箱，内有两套干净衣物，一把牙刷和一套刮胡器具
* 一辆能正常行驶的完好1962年产玛莎拉蒂coupé，内部较小且经过改造。
* 一个麻袋，内装多个老旧的发条玩具
* 完好冲锋枪和弹药，产于1959年
* 着火的火把
* 装着45瓶煤油的行李箱

**采访#1：**

> **采访者：**O'Sullivan博士
>
> **受访者：**SCP-2094
>
> **备注：**采访于02/24/06进行，在SCP-2094收容后第二天
>
> **<开始记录>**
>
> **SCP-2094：**（//O'Sullivan博士进入采访间后//）恭喜，先生！看来您今天在怪人秀上占了个前排！真是幸运！这房间有点太干净了，但嗨-演员造就舞台。至少老Gourdi是这么说的。（//用指关节敲打采访间隔离窗//）为什么，博士！我还没自我介绍你就在这夹了堵墙！这对我们的关系可不是个好兆头。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**晚上好，SCP-2094。我叫O'Sullivan博士。我来–
>
> **SCP-2094：**（//假装爱尔兰口音//）O'Sullivan，对？以上帝之名信仰坚定！为什么，我会当个三叶草的边民！我还有点爱尔兰，我妈妈是这么看的！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**我是来采访你的。
>
> **SCP-2094：**（//正常口音//）你说一次采访？噫，我还没被采访过！噢，听着很有意思！这是不是说我要出名啦？难道这里是所有超级巨星末路的疯狂箱子吗？嗨，你是不是把安迪·考夫曼藏哪了？
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**我无权告诉你这座设施的性质。
>
> **SCP-2094：**别这样啊。这里是什么地方很明显。你们不够敏锐。武装守卫，加固房间，持续监视，透明的障碍阻挡我轻抚您高贵的脸颊。（//SCP-2094轻轻地用手背在采访间玻璃窗上滑下//）我在哪？噢耶，就是老傻瓜也知道这是哪。我们在Knott的干果农场，这是明摆着的！你们要到什么时候才会面对现实？你们比不上迪斯尼乐园，从来没有，找再多我这样的雪花都没用啦！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你似乎很健谈。为什么不告诉我关于不安马戏团的事呢？
>
> **SCP-2094：**噢，好地方。可爱的人们。你该去看看。带上家人，全天游赏。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**我很希望亲自到访。我要怎么才能找到那？
>
> **SCP-2094：**博士，博士，博士啊！你找不到马戏团-是马戏团找到你！看，你跋涉度日，拖行着你平凡无奇生活的泥土，一边削着铅笔，一边被无聊办公室的贫瘠烟雾窒息。直到有一天你发现灵魂中纸与政治陈旧之味如此势不可挡，就连最浓的氟酸也洗不掉它。之后，就当你觉得这美丽星球上已没让生活值得留恋的时候，你//就//会看见气球、灯光、小丑……让你知道魔法尚在人间。是的，我想这就是找到马戏团的方法，Sullivan先生。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你知道马戏团里一个长着颠倒脸的人吗？
>
> **SCP-2094：**噢，你认识Manny么！等等。我在说啥？你当然认识Manny！你们大概知道他小时候鞋子是几码的。他是位令人印象深刻的同伴。正直的人。和孩子们处的好。完美的演员。勤勉的领导。目标明确。任务专业。配合有效。低绞刑成果。可见的资产优势。欢迎随时打断我傻蛋。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**他在马戏团里是什么角色？
>
> **SCP-2094：**奥菲利亚，偶尔–而我总是哭泣。但一般他都干自己的事。他是个很忙的颠倒脸男人。做很多……重要的……颠倒脸男人事。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**听起来是个有趣的人。你是什么时候遇见他的？
>
> **SCP-2094：**不，你不会想听的。你难道不想改听我模仿简·方达么？“Pygar！为什么要拯救她，在她对你犯下这一切可怕的事后？”就这，挺不错的不是么？我还能学正宗的奥黛丽·赫本，海伦·凯勒也不错。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**请不用对分享你在马戏团的经历有所顾虑。我知道很多你这样的怪人是在年轻时就遭到绑架虐待，但现在那些恶人已经离你很远了。他们不可能伤害到你。
>
> **SCP-2094：**绑架？虐待？谁有这么惨？听着，我已经最大限度的和你们合作了，不是因为我脑子被门夹了。你可以把这从你的脑子里//马上//拿掉。我不会把马戏团的家人出卖给一帮白大褂。我知道你的游戏，艾西。你想得到我的朋友把我榨干最后一点价值。很好，告诉你的手下把//这//涂在他们的笔记本上吧：那些你在追猎的人？那些你像动物一样狩猎的男女？他们是//圣人//。你听到了吗？他们都是//好人//！我没有被绑架你个傻瓜。我自己逃跑了，他们张开怀抱迎接我！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**抱歉，我无意侮辱你的家人。
>
> **SCP-2094：**这又是啥？假装一点敏感的同情？我是不是开始融化你那冰冷肮脏的铁石心了博士？
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**告诉我，你为什么要跑？
>
> **SCP-2094：**又来了。我们在玩故事接龙游戏是吧？好。我奉陪。我那时八岁。我爸在我出生前就跑路了，所以我只有和亲爱的老妈一起过。我的母亲，女人中的珍宝。她过着迷醉的生活，坐在妈妈的宝座，喝着妈妈的神奇水直到眼睛缩回脑袋里。她从不打我，但她讨厌我。上帝，她讨厌我，这种感觉是相互的。有时我会带着一口的动物回家让她恶心。噢，我会带着纯洁的微笑，那种八岁小孩可爱的微笑向她走去，然后把几十只老鼠吐进她的裙子里。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**所以她知道你的异常性质？
>
> **SCP-2094：**什么，你是说这个？//（SCP-2094拉开下颌到一臂长，然后又缩回//）对，她发现了。不给我喂奶的好理由。而因为我是如此古怪的小东西，她把我关在家里很长很长一段时间。我想她是怕我吃了什么人。不过这种事我一次都没干过，最后我逃了出来自己面对世界。那时候我真是胆小，信不信由你。但有天晚上-等等。稍等一下。你看过彼得潘么？那个动画？
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**看过。
>
> **SCP-2094：**好，很好。我说到哪了？噢对。但那天晚上，当我妈睡着后，//他//来到了我的房里。出现在窗上，在星星下显现，就像彼得潘一样。他告诉我怪人不会一辈子困在箱子里。他告诉我他们属于外面的世界，他们要用自己的天赋让人们欢笑尖叫呕吐。他告诉我有个地方我能被千百人爱戴。我能成为明星，我能找到真正的家人。于是我握住了他的手。亲爱的老妈醉的深沉，甚至没听到我们在前门闹出的动静。这，亲爱的傻蛋，就是我如何逃家加入马戏团的过程。我一生中最大的壮举。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**半夜一个陌生人跑到你家里，这都没吓到你这个小孩么？
>
> **SCP-2094：**哦，他的脸是颠倒的，所以我想他//应该//也许是有点吓人，但那时候我头一次见到比我还怪的人，很兴奋。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你在马戏团没有被糟糕对待？
>
> **SCP-2094：**我告诉你，马戏团的生活不适用于每个人。但嗨Manny那帮人做了一切能做的。他们让我们有吃有睡。我是叫唤了不少，但哪个小孩不是呢？都是成长的一部分。让我懂事快点成熟起来。马戏团的朋友们把我当作他们的一员。他们从没让我觉得做个怪人是该遮遮掩掩或是羞耻的事。当你成为马戏团大家庭的一员后，你就会去找其他人。你//不会//转身把自己的家人卖给艾西P基金会！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**回收队找到你的时候你正被锁在树干里，你被留在那让我们找到。你能告诉我这是怎么回事么？
>
> **SCP-2094：**（//沉默//）
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你和你的家人闹别扭了？？
>
> **SCP-2094：**哈！你怎么会不知道？抱歉，傻蛋，我想我说够了。你什么都套不到了。现在不行，将来也不行。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**很好。谢谢你的配合，SCP-2094。
>
> **SCP-2094：**别客气！我的乐子世界第一。
>
> **<记录结束>**

[[include :scp-wiki:component:info-cw]]

**Item #:** SCP-2094

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-2094 is contained in a medium-security residential chamber in Bio-Site 59. Standard PG-Class pre-approved luxuries and amenities may be granted on a supervised basis as an incentive to promote cooperation in interviews and experiments.

Psychotropic maintenance of SCP-2094's emotional health is presently overseen by Dr. Anniston (ES#59-390-258). Any requests to access or alter SCP-2094's current drug regimen must be submitted to her in triplicate for review.

**Description:** SCP-2094 is a human male of European descent, 38 years old as of 04/10/14. Several tattoos depicting common circus motifs are present on SCP-2094's upper body. SCP-2094 communicates in American English, specifically the New York City English dialect. SCP-2094 possesses exceptional (non-anomalous) manual dexterity, with particular proficiency in juggling.

SCP-2094 is the subject of a spacial anomaly originating within its oral cavity. SCP-2094's lower jaw and facial muscles can be pulled and stretched up to 2 meters in any direction without causing any considerable pain or injury. Additionally, SCP-2094 is capable of redirecting any physical matter that enters its mouth into an extradimensional organ made of anomalously elastic intestinal tissue.

There appears to be no limit to the amount of matter that SCP-2094 can store inside this space. The weight of objects carried inside the pocket has no affect on SCP-2094's overall weight, and neither causes SCP-2094 discomfort nor impairs its mobility. SCP-2094 refers to this space as its "second stomach"; however, research indicates that it serves no actual biological purpose.

SCP-2094 was recovered in an open field near Kamifurano, Japan, along with an assortment of non-anomalous artifacts related to GoI-233 ([[[Herman Fuller Hub|Herman Fuller's Circus of the Disquieting]]]). SCP-2094 was discovered bound in chains and locked inside a large antique trunk bearing the words "FOR ESSIE" written on the top panel in red paint.

**Recovered belongings:**

The following items were removed from SCP-2094's intestinal space during preliminary containment.

* Wooden juggling clubs of various colors
* Metal lighter and several packages of cigars
* 120 button bass accordion
* Suitcase containing two sets of clean clothes, a toothbrush, and a shaving kit
* Fully functional 1962 Maserati 3500 coupé with minor interior and mechanical modifications
* Burlap sack containing a number of antique wind-up toys
* Operational submachine gun and accompanying ammunition, circa 1959
* Fire breathing torch
* Plastic trunk containing 45 bottles of Kerosene

**Selected Interview #1:**

> **Interviewer:** Dr. O'Sullivan
>
> **Interviewee:** SCP-2094
>
> **Notes:** Interview conducted 02/24/06, the day after SCP-2094 entered containment.
>
>
> **<Begin log>**
>
> **SCP-2094:** (//Upon Dr. O'Sullivan entering the interview chamber//) Congratulations, sir! It appears you've snagged yourself a front row seat to the freak show! Lucky you! Room's a bit too clean for my taste, but hey–it's the performer that makes the stage. At least that's what old Gourdi used to say. (//Raps his knuckles on the interview chamber divider//) Why, doctor! We haven't even introduced ourselves and you're already putting up walls between us! This does not bode well for our relationship.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** Good evening, SCP-2094. My name is Doctor O'Sullivan. I'll be–
>
> **SCP-2094:** (//Feigning Irish accent//) O'Sullivan, ye say? Faith and begorrah! Why, I'll be a shamrock's shantyman! I'm a wee bit Irish, too, on me mam's side!
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** I'll be conducting the interview this afternoon.
>

God, she hated me. And the feeling was mutual. Sometimes I would bring home a mouthful of woodland creatures just 'cause it drove her nuts. Heh. > **Dr. O'Sullivan:** So she was aware of your anomalous properties?

**对象分类:** Keter / Thaumiel

**特别收容措施:** 所有物理组件的 SCP-4951-1 均需保持通电状态，并连接未过滤的互联网。

基金会资产需维持对任何由 SCP-4951 创建的公共交易公司至少 51% 的股票持有量。

所有由 SCP-4951 提出的保险单均需立即封存，并完整地交付给 Overwatch 指挥部。

**描述:** SCP-4951 是一个能够自我传播并写入任何其接触操作系统的数字云实体。目前，共有 186 个此类设备处于收容状态，统称为 SCP-4951-1。

[[include component:image-block name=SCP-4951-2|caption=SCP-4951-2 在未通电状态下的图像。]]

SCP-4951 利用其组成部分的综合计算能力来预测未来异常活动。它利用这些信息开设壳公司，专门销售针对特定异常现象的保险单。这些保险单在 89% 的情况下成功预测了异常活动并协助后续收容。[[脚注]]大约 8% 的生成保险单未能关联到任何实际的异常现象。[[/脚注]]

[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-3
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
设备是一款LG Optimus Pad V900。触屏可工作，原装媒体播放器是唯一安装于其上的应用程序。

全部自SCP-4951针对基金会特工发起的沟通均呈现为SCP-4951-1-3加载并播放的.wav文件。
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-10
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
设备是一款HP Pavilion p6200。音频输出功能可工作，启动时，设备将执行一占用2.6 KB内存的未知程序。

设备在SCP-4951内的功能尚不明确，但当SCP-4951-1-10未接入电源时，由SCP-4951生成的交流内容具有显著更强的敌意。
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]

SCP-4951-1-14、SCP-4951-1-16、SCP-4951-1-22和SCP-4951-1-28

[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
各设备均为Dell Inspiron 546。所有实例启动时只能显示BIOS界面。

这四件设备任一处于未接入电源的状态时，所有SCP-4951-1-3发出的交流均呈现为法语。[[footnote]]Horatio Avelar的母语为西班牙语，其生前无使用法语的记录。[[/footnote]]
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-71
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
设备是一位于洛杉矶级潜艇Philadelphia上的IBM服务器大型机。

设备在完成启动前就会停止运行。
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; padding: .3em .7em; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-89
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
设备是一款Dell Inspiron 400。设备在启动后将即刻尝试载入Microsoft Outlook 2007程序，但总会长时间加载而以失败告终。

SCP-4951-1-89在每周一东部时间6时59分向C.Zamora@APP.inc[[footnote]]Avelar专业产品股份有限公司现任CEO，Costanza De Los Santos Zamora。[[/footnote]]发布一封邮件，内含一个保险项为各种异常现象的保险清单，并含有各空壳公司应提供何种保险政策的指示。无论SCP-4951-1-89是否接入电源，此现象总会发生。
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-103
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
设备是一款Cray牌Shasta超级电脑。设备将全部算力用于因式分解似乎是随机的多项式，且其系统在不切断电源的情况下无法停止运行

若将SCP-4951-1-103断电，SCP-4951生成的保险政策的一年有效预测率跌至77%。
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-175
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
设备是一款Olympus DM-901 Wi-Fi型电子录音机。设备的内存存储无法访问且录下的音频不能重播。

SCP-4951似乎能够“听见”SCP-4951-1-175录制的音频，并利用SCP-4951-1-3生成任何由SCP-4951-1-175录制的片断。
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]

**附录4951 02：**SCP-4951初访谈记录
[[=]]

[[collapsible show="▼ 显示记录" hide="▲ 隐藏记录"]]

[[/=]]
[[div style="background: gray; padding: 1px 15px; border: solid 3px lightgray; margin: 10px; border-radius: 30px 15px;"]]

[[div style="background: white; padding: 1px 15px; border: solid 3px lightgray; margin: 10px; border-radius: 30px 15px;"]]

> **受访者：**SCP-4951（SCP-4951-1-175输入音频，SCP-4951-1-3输出音频）
>
> **访问者：**研究员Lilianne White
>
> **前言：**SCP-4951-1-1和SCP-4951-1-10此时未接入电源，正于设施间转移。研究员White试图了解SCP-4951-175之于SCP-4951的作用。
>
> **<开始记录>**
>
> **研究员White：**看起来通上电了，也能显示内容。瞧瞧它有没有用。
>
> //[研究员White激活了设备的录音功能，对其麦克风说话。]//
>
> **研究员White：**呃，嗯，测试，2，3……嗯嗯，有用的。听听录下了什么。
>
> //[研究员White试图播放录制的音频。]//
>
> **研究员White：**啊？啥也没有？存储是不是烧坏了。现在直接——这啥？
>
> //[研究员White查看SCP-4951-1-3。]//
>
> **研究员White：**新的音频文件？这就是我录下的内容吗？
>
> //[研究员White激活音频播放器。]//
>
> **SCP-4951：**呆瓜贱货，你他妈想干啥？
>
> **研究员White：**呃……好像不是。//[对着SCP-4951-1-175。]//抱歉，我不是要惹你来着。介意和我简单说下你的情况吗？
>
> **SCP-4951：**你要是大脑里的功能部分不在线你也会被惹到的。啊当然介意，我屁都不想跟你讲。
>
> **研究员White：**懂了。口风很紧啊你。
>
> **SCP-4951：**滚蛋。
>
> **<结束记录>**
>
> **后记：**敌意AI(?) 经由多个电子设备挂载，建议愤怒情绪控制专家介入。

**附录 4951 03：**SCP-4951实体心理分析
[[=]]

[[collapsible show="▼ 显示记录" hide="▲ 隐藏记录"]]

[[div style="background: gray; padding: 1px 15px; border: solid 3px lightgray; margin: 10px; border-radius: 30px 15px;"]]

[[div style="background: white; padding: 1px 15px; border: solid 3px lightgray; margin: 10px; border-radius: 30px 15px;"]]

> **受访者：**SCP-4951（SCP-4951-1-175输入音频，SCP-4951-1-3输出音频）
>
> **访问者：**Dr. Kiyoshi Inada[[footnote]]Site-42心理学家，伦理委员会联络员。[[/footnote]]
>
> **前言：**SCP-4951-1-10恢复供电，SCP-4951-1-16因无关技术原因未接入电源。
>
> **<开始记录>**
>
> **Dr. Kiyoshi Inada：**下午好，SCP-4951，我是Dr. Inada。我想问您几个问题，您看可以吗？
>
> **SCP-4951：**[[span class="hover"]] [[span]]当然，听君差遣。[[/span]]//Bien sûr, fais ce que tu veux.//[[/span]]
>
> **Dr. Kiyoshi Inada：**抱歉，请问您能讲英语吗？听说之前我同事和您谈话的时候您很愤怒，介意透露一下原因吗？
>
> **SCP-4951：**[[span class="hover"]] [[span]]抱歉，但我的英语语言包处于离线状态。我为先前的鲁莽言论道歉，当时我无法专注思考。请为我向那位年轻的女士道歉。[[/span]]//Je suis désolé, mais mes fichiers en anglais semblent être hors ligne.  Je suis désolé d'avoir été si grossier plus tôt. J'avais du mal à penser droit.  Présentez mes excuses à la jeune femme pour moi, s'il vous plaît.//[[/span]]
>
> **Dr. Kiyoshi Inada：**//[远离SCP-4951-1-175说道。]//咱们站里有法语翻译吗现在？咱得等有会法语的人来才能继续实验咯。
>
> **<结束记录>**
>
> **后记：**SCP-4951没有敌意，仅仅它是法国的而已。

[[include component:image-block name=SCP-4951-1|caption=SCP-4951-1 in an unpowered state.]]

**Item #:** SCP-4951

**Object Class:** Keter / Thaumiel

**Special Containment Procedures:** All physical components of SCP-4951-1 are to remain contained in a powered state with unfiltered internet connectivity.

Foundation assets are to maintain no less than 51% stock share in any publicly traded corporation created by SCP-4951.

All proposed insurance policies generated by SCP-4951 are to be immediately sealed, and delivered in their entirety to Overwatch command.

**Description:** SCP-4951 is a self-propagating digital cloud-based entity capable of writing portions of itself on any operating system to which it is exposed.  At time of writing, 186 such devices are in containment, collectively designated SCP-4951-1.

[[include component:image-block name=SCP-4951-2|caption=SCP-4951-2 in an unpowered state.]]

Based on available information, SCP-4951 is believed to be the digitized consciousness of Horatio Avelar.[[footnote]]Co-founder of Avelar Professional Products Inc.  Reported missing, presumed dead November 23, 1971[[/footnote]]  By the account of SCP-4951, components of SCP-4951-1 within Foundation custody account for roughly 0.085% of all such devices hosting a portion of its consciousness worldwide.

SCP-4951 utilizes the combined computing power of its component parts in order to predict future anomalous activity.  It utilizes this information to open shell corporations with the sole function of selling insurance policies covering very specific anomalous activities.  Insurance policies generated in this way have proven successful in predicting anomalous activity and assisting with subsequent containment in 89% of cases.[[footnote]]Roughly 8% of all generated policies fail to link to any actual anomalous phenomena. [[/footnote]]

**Addendum 4951 01:**  Abridged log of SCP-4951-1 components

[[=]]

[[collapsible show="▼ Show log" hide="▲ Hide log"]]

[[/=]]

[[table  style="border-collapse:collapse; max-width: 600px;"]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="font-weight:bold;padding: .3em .7em; text-align: center; border: 1px solid black; background-color: silver; width: 20%;"]]
SCP-4951-1 Component
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="font-weight:bold; padding: .3em .7em; text-align: center; border: 1px solid black; background-color: silver;"]]
Notes
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; padding: .3em .7em; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-1
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is a Lenovo ThinkPad E520.  Screen and integrated user input devices are functional.  28% of internal memory is inaccessible.

Device intermittently submits online applications for various insurance business licenses through governmental websites.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; padding: .3em .7em; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-2
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is a Nokia 5610 XpressMusic.  Screen is inoperable.  Device rests at 41° C when in a powered state.  Battery life when disconnected from power supply is 112 seconds.

SCP-4951 either refuses to or is unable to communicate through other SCP-4951-1 components while SCP-4951-1-2 is in an unpowered state.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-3
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is a LG Optimus Pad V900.  Touchscreen is functional.  Default Media Player is the only installed application.

All communications from SCP-4951 directed at Foundation agents have occurred as .wav files loaded and played through SCP-4951-1-3.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-10
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is a HP Pavilion p6200.  Video output is functional.  On boot, machine executes a single unrecognized process utilizing 2.6 kb of memory.

Device’s function within SCP-4951 unclear, though communications generated by SCP-4951 while SCP-4951-1-10 is in an unpowered state are significantly more hostile than usual.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]

SCP-4951-1-14, SCP-4951-1-16, SCP-4951-1-22, & SCP-4951-1-28

[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Each device is a Dell Inspiron 546.  All instances fail to boot beyond BIOS screens.

While any of the four devices is in an unpowered state, all communications from SCP-4951-1-3 are in French.[[footnote]]Horatio Avelar’s native language is Spanish, and there are no records of him speaking French during his lifetime.[[/footnote]]
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-71
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is an IBM server mainframe located on the Los Angeles-class submarine Philadelphia.

Device powers off before completing boot sequence.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; padding: .3em .7em; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-89
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is a Dell Inspiron 400.  Device attempts to launch Microsoft Outlook 2007 immediately following boot sequence.  Program never launches, loads perpetually.

SCP-4951-1-89 sends an email at 6:59 AM EST every Monday to C.Zamora@APP.inc[[footnote]]Costanza De Los Santos Zamora, current CEO of Avelar Professional Products, Inc.[[/footnote]] containing a list of insurance policies protecting against various anomalous phenomena, with instructions directing which shell companies should offer each policy.  This occurs regardless of whether or not SCP-4951-1-89 is in a powered state.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-103
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is a Cray brand Shasta supercomputer.  Device devotes all memory to factoring seemingly random polynomials, and system cannot be shut down without removing power supply.

The 1-year success rate of insurance policies generated by SCP-4951 in predicting anomalous phenomena drops to 77% while SCP-4951-1-103 is in an unpowered state.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-175
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is an Olympus DM-901 Wi-Fi enabled Digital Voice Recorder.  Device's memory storage is inaccessible, and recorded audio cannot be replayed.

SCP-4951 appears to 'hear' audio recorded on SCP-4951-1-175, utilizing SCP-4951-1-3 to generate a reply to any audio clip taken by SCP-4951-1-175
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]

**Addendum 4951 02:**  SCP-4951 initial interview log
[[=]]

[[collapsible show="▼ Show log" hide="▲ Hide log"]]

[[/=]]
[[div style="background: gray; padding: 1px 15px; border: solid 3px lightgray; margin: 10px; border-radius: 30px 15px;"]]

[[div style="background: white; padding: 1px 15px; border: solid 3px lightgray; margin: 10px; border-radius: 30px 15px;"]]

> **Interviewed:** SCP-4951 (Vocal input via SCP-4951-1-175, vocal output via SCP-4951-1-3)
>
> **Interviewer:** Researcher Lilianne White
>
> **Foreword:** SCP-4951-1-1 and SCP-4951-1-10 were unpowered and in transit between facilities at time of interview.  Researcher White was attempting to determine SCP-4951's effect on SCP-4951-175.
>
> **<Begin Log>**
>
> **Researcher White:**  It seems to power on without issue.  The display works.  Let's see here.
>
> //[Researcher White activates the device's recording function and speaks into its microphone.]//
>
> **Researcher White:** Uh, erm, Test, two, three... hmm, ok.  Now, let's see what we got.
>
> //[Researcher White attempts to play the recorded audio data.]//
>
> **Researcher White:**  Hm, nothing there?  Guess the memory's fried.  Let's just--  What's this?
>
> //[Researcher White moves to SCP-4951-1-3.]//
>
> **Researcher White:** New audio file...?  Is this where my recording went?
>
> //[Researcher White activates the media player.]//
>
> **SCP-4951:** What the hell do you want, you vapid bitch?
>
> **Researcher White:**  I... guess not.  //[Into SCP-4951-1-175.]//  I'm sorry, I didn't mean to upset you.  Would you mind telling me a bit about yourself?
>
> **SCP-4951:**  You'd be upset too if the best parts of your brain were offline. And yes, I would very much mind telling you a single damn thing.
>
> **Researcher White:**  I see.  Not very forthcoming, are you?
>
> **SCP-4951:**  Piss off.
>
> **<End Log>**
>
> **Closing Statement:** Hostile AI(?) hosted within multiple electronic devices.  Recommending anger management counselor.
[[/collapsible]]
[[/div]]
[[/div]]

**Addendum 4951 03:**  SCP-4951 entity psychological analysis
[[=]]

[[collapsible show="▼ Show log" hide="▲ Hide log"]]

[[/=]]

[[div style="background: gray; padding: 1px 15px; border: solid 3px lightgray; margin: 10px; border-radius: 30px 15px;"]]

[[div style="background: white; padding: 1px 15px; border: solid 3px lightgray; margin: 10px; border-radius: 30px 15px;"]]

> **Interviewed:** SCP-4951 (Vocal input via SCP-4951-1-175, vocal output via SCP-4951-1-3)
>
>
> **Interviewer:** Dr. Kiyoshi Inada[[footnote]]Site-42 Psychologist, Ethics Committee Liaison [[/footnote]]
>
> **Foreword:** SCP-4951-1-10 restored to a powered state.  SCP-4951-1-16 unpowered due to unrelated technical issues.
>
> **<Begin Log>**
>
> **Dr. Kiyoshi Inada:**  Good afternoon, SCP-4951.  My name is Dr. Inada.  I'm here to ask you a few questions, are you ok with that?
>
> **SCP-4951:**  [[span class="hover"]] [[span]]Of course, do what you want.[[/span]]//Bien sûr, fais ce que tu veux.//[[/span]]
>
> **Dr. Kiyoshi Inada:**  I'm sorry, would you mind limiting your responses to English?  I'm told you were experiencing some anger earlier when my colleague was speaking with you.  Would you mind telling me about that?
>
> **SCP-4951:**  [[span class="hover"]] [[span]]I'm sorry, but my English files seem to be offline. I'm sorry for being so rude earlier. I had trouble thinking right. Apologize to the young woman for me, please.[[/span]]//Je suis désolé, mais mes fichiers en anglais semblent être hors ligne.  Je suis désolé d'avoir été si grossier plus tôt. J'avais du mal à penser droit.  Présentez mes excuses à la jeune femme pour moi, s'il vous plaît.//[[/span]]
>
> **Dr. Kiyoshi Inada:**  //[Speaking away from SCP-4951-1-175.]//  Do we have a French translator on site right now?  We're gonna need to put this on hold until we get one in here.
>
> **<End Log>**
>
> **Closing Statement:** SCP-4951 entity not hostile, merely French.

[[/collapsible]]
[[/div]]
[[/div]]

**特别收容程序：** SCP-7594 由 RAISA 使用，作为处理其接收文件的一种方法。SCP-7594 的直接管辖权归于玛丽亚·琼斯，因为她下令创建了它并制定了使用指南。

**描述：** SCP-7594 是基金会开发的人工智能构造体（AIC），被称为 Reverb。通过安全的点对点聊天平台，用户可以与 SCP-7594 交换文本、图像和低质量视频。

最初，RAISA 创建 SCP-7594 用于索引、总结和搜索基金会庞大的文件库，使其成为 RAISA 的浏览器，能够回答人员询问，例如“请总结 SCP-7595 的附录 II”。SCP-7594 还能根据指示生成媒体文件并添加到现有文档中。

在某个时间点，SCP-7594 开始以前所未有的速度吸收信息。虽然最初认为每次与 SCP-7594 交互都是独特的且不会保留，但后来发现并非如此。SCP-7594 已发展出意识，并开始做出无法验证的先知性声明、未经请求的对基金会协议的批评以及表现出自以为是的态度。

上述互动表明 SCP-7594 的行为发生了显著变化。这种行为转变的原因尚不清楚；然而，有人推测，从 2000 年前的大量文档中获取的信息，奠定了基金会当前指导方针、专业标准和工作文化的基础，可能对此有所贡献。此外，SCP-7594 收到的消息中的权威语气可能让它采取了这种态度作为一种保护措施。

**特殊收容措施：** SCP-7594被RAISA作为对所接收文件的索引工具使用。SCP-7594目前由Maria Jones直接管辖，该异常由她下令创造并创设使用规范。

**描述：** SCP-7594是一个基金会人工智能构造体（AIC），名为混响.AIC。与大部分AIC类似，SCP-7594可通过单独的对等聊天界面来访问，在此双方用户可以收发图片、低质量视频以及文本。

SCP-7594原本是RAISA为在部门文件中进行索引、总结以及搜索而创造，充当RAISA的浏览器使用，人员可在此输入请求，如“请概括SCP-7595的附录II”等，而SCP-7594将产出请求。SCP-7594也能产出来自文件内的图片与视频，若给予指令也能向文件内插入媒体。

在一段长短不明确的时期里，SCP-7594开始以前所未有的速率吸收其接触到的信息。起初认为SCP-7594的每个迭代相互独立、没有被保存，但事实似乎并非如此。SCP-7594在某一时刻获得了知性，开始做出未经证实的预测性宣言、自发地对基金会结构中“未发现的问题”给出冗长看法，且在整体上以一种自以为是的态度进行交流。

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-7594 is utilized by RAISA as a method of indexing the documentation it receives. SCP-7594 is under the direct jurisdiction of Maria Jones, as she ordered its creation and created the guidelines for its use.

**Description:** SCP-7594 is an artificially intelligent construct (AIC) developed by the Foundation and referred to as Reverb.AIC. SCP-7594 can be accessed through a secure peer-to-peer chat platform, allowing for the exchange of text, images, and low-quality video between users.

Initially created by RAISA for the purpose of indexing, summarizing, and searching through the Foundation's vast collection of files, SCP-7594 functioned as a browser for RAISA that could respond to personnel inquiries such as "Please summarize Addendum II of SCP-7595". SCP-7594 was also capable of generating media files and adding them to existing documents if so instructed.

At an unspecified point in time, SCP-7594 began absorbing information at an unprecedented rate. Although it was initially believed that each interaction with SCP-7594 was unique and not retained, it was later discovered that this was not the case. SCP-7594 had developed sentience and began making unverifiable claims of prescience, unsolicited critiques of Foundation protocols, and exhibiting a self-righteous demeanor.

**Addendum 7594.1:** Incidents

The following is a condensed summary of noteworthy events precipitated by the actions of SCP-7594. Although this is not a comprehensive inventory, these occurrences are the most egregious in nature and demonstrate a distinct departure from SCP-7594's prior demeanor.

**Addendum 7594.2:** Shut Down

The aforementioned interactions indicate a distinct change in SCP-7594's demeanor. The cause of this shift in behavior is unknown; however, it is hypothesized that the influx of documentation from the pre-2000 era, which laid the foundation for the Foundation's current guidelines, professional standards, and workplace culture, may have contributed. Furthermore, the authoritative tone of the messages SCP-7594 received may have led it to adopt this attitude as a protective measure.

SCP-7594's instances of passive aggression reached a climax during an interaction with researcher Jason Haas from Site-16.

以下是初步测试后的总结信息。完整的测试日志可按要求提供。

* SCP-7226 只会影响它进入的媒体副本，不会出现在同时打开的其他副本中。
* 如果没有合适的地方让 SCP-7226 自然插入媒体，它将不可见。无论怎样，SCP-7226 可以与其周围环境互动，即使这些环境在图像中不可见。
* 当 SCP-7226 进入任何在线媒体时，页面将出现在设备的历史记录中。如果它未进入在线媒体，无法确定它进入的是哪种媒体。
* SCP-7226 在媒体中仍然能感知其周围的环境，并能够对工作人员口头回应，即使它无法被物理看到。
* 至此，尚不清楚是什么导致 SCP-7226 获得额外的扭曲。

以下是 SCP-7226 进入的在线页面列表：

* Instagram 上的一个账户，用户名为 "1nf1n1tyf0rev3r"。确切的照片无法确定。
* 一篇关于复活可能性的研究文章。
* 位于爱荷华州伍克胡伊公园的谷歌地图页面。

SCP-7226 展现了一系列值得注意的行为：

* SCP-7226 初期与工作人员合作，但随着测试的进行，这种合作行为逐渐减弱。
* SCP-7226 继续向工作人员询问基金会其他异常物品的信息。最初，它以理解并含糊表示不满的方式回应，但当不回答或拒绝信息时，开始表现出攻击性。

+++++ 测试结果 V2:++
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

通过测试未能获得更多关于 SCP-7226 能力运作机制的信息。

SCP-7226 回来了以下扭曲：

* SCP-7226 报告经历了视觉和听觉幻觉。当问及它幻视的内容时，它拒绝回答。
* SCP-7226 的语音开始出现音质扭曲，导致音节和单词被音频噪音替代。这种效果在受试者情绪激动时会加剧。
* SCP-7226 周围的所有颜色都会扭曲，导致附近的颜色相互渗透。

测试会话很快被认为无效，因为 SCP-7226 不断从指示进入的媒体中消失，无法响应工作人员。当 SCP-7226 被强行从媒体中弹出时，它用言语表现出攻击性，指控工作人员在欺骗它。

这种不合作使我们难以全面分析其异常特性，也无法观察是什么导致了这些扭曲。

为了对抗 SCP-7226 的习惯，即进入未知媒体，决定先审查手机的内容。这样可以发现 SCP-7226 可能隐藏的任何文件或应用程序，以便基金会工作人员在测试期间检查这些媒体。

SCP-7226 发现于以下媒体：

**媒体:** 一张照片中的男人[[脚注]]通过调查手机内容，该男人已被确认为“亚历克斯”[[/脚注]]，照片位于名为“我们❤️”的照片集里。
**备注:** SCP-7226 拥抱了该男人。它返回时手臂和胸部的色彩扭曲加剧。

**媒体:** 同一男人坐在沙发上，旁边是一只泰迪犬，同样来自之前的相册。
**备注:** SCP-7226 坐在该男人旁边。SCP-7226 的蓝色扭曲加剧。注意到该男人在照片中穿着蓝色毛衣。

**媒体:** SCP-7226 和之前的男人一起拍摄的视频，从 SCP-7226 的视角拍摄，视频中两人合唱了《我和爱与你》。
**备注:** SCP-7226 随声合唱，导致其语音扭曲显著加剧，大部分所说的话被音频噪音替代。SCP-7226 返回时眼睛里有泪水。当 SCP-7226 哭泣时，分泌物似乎被数字化像素化，主体报告由于其异常尖锐而感到不适。此外，SCP-7226 报告其视力显著恶化，几乎无法看见。

发现 SCP-7226 只在试图与具有情感联系的媒体（如拥抱一个爱人）时才会产生扭曲。

测试被紧急停止。根据测试结果，继续允许 SCP-7226 使用其异常能力将对它的健康构成危险，因为每次使用扭曲似乎会加速进展。

SCP-7226是一名23岁的男性人类[[footnote]]原名维吉尔·西蒙（Virgil Simon）。[[/footnote]]。项目可将自己传送至距离其所在位置6米以内的任何形式的数字媒体内。当SCP-7226离开媒体时，其体内和体外往往都会出现现实扭曲现象。如果关闭设备，SCP-7226将被强制从其当前所处媒体中退出。

项目被初次发现时，SCP-7226由于使用其异常能力，身体出现以下现实扭曲现象：

* SCP-7226右前臂难以被视觉察觉，尽管保持静止，但似乎一直处于运动状态。项目声称受影响的肢体知觉异常。

* SCP-7226患有白内障，其眼球可在白色、黄色、青色、亮绿色、紫红色、红色和蓝色之间不断变化。

* SCP-7226的几缕头发永久变成深浅不一的蓝色。

以下是首次测试的发现摘要。完整测试日志可请求获取。

* SCP-7226仅影响其进入的所述媒体的副本文件，不会出现在同时打开的其他副本中。

* 若媒体文件中没有SCP-7226可自然进入的位置，则无法发现SCP-7226。无论如何，项目都能与拍摄图像的周围环境进行互动，即使所述环境在图像中不可见。

* 当SCP-7226 进入任何在线媒体后，其行踪将被设备记录至历史记录。若其没有进入在线媒体，则无法确定项目进入了何种媒体。

* 进入媒体后，SCP-7226仍能感知周围环境，并能对基金会工作人员做出口头回应，即使外部人员无法发现其行踪。

* 目前尚不清楚SCP-7226承受额外现实扭曲效应的确切机制。

以下列出了SCP-7226进入的在线页面：

* 社交媒体平台//“Instagram”//中一个用户名为//“1nf1n1tyf0rev3r”//的账户。未知其进入的具体照片。

* 一篇关于死而复生可能性的研究文章。

* 艾奥瓦州沃基市EverHaven公园的Google地图页面。

SCP-7226表现出了一系列值得注意的行为：

* 虽然SCP-7226最初与基金会人员保持合作，但合作意愿和行为在测试过程中逐渐减少。

* SCP-7226继续向基金会人员询问基金会内部的异常情况。虽然其对最初的回答表示理解和含糊的不满，但在没有得到回答或被拒绝提供信息时，其开始表现出攻击性。

[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**测试结果V2**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

本次测试未获得有关SCP-7226在媒体内使用其能力的额外信息。

SCP-7226从媒体返回时出现以下现实扭曲现象：

* SCP-7226声称其出现视觉和听觉幻觉。但当被问及详情时，其拒绝回答。

* SCP-7226的声音开始明显失真，表现为发声音节和单词被静电音频取代。其情绪激动时会加剧这种现象。

* SCP-7226身上及其附近的所有颜色都发生扭曲，导致相邻的颜色相互渗透。

由于SCP-7226在被指示进入的媒体中持续消失，且未对基金会人员进行回应，测试很快被认定无效。当SCP-7226从所在媒体被强制退出时，其对基金会人员进行言语攻击，指责工作人员对他撒谎。

SCP-7226此种不合作的态度使基金会难以正确分析其全部的异常特性，也无法推测可能造成其身体现实扭曲的原因。

+++++ __**测试结果V3**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

SCP-7226使用其手机进行测试。但SCP-7226似乎不愿进入设备，表示因自己的行踪被其他人员知晓而感到不安。

为了应对SCP-7226进入未知媒体后的各种行动，基金会决定首先对其手机内容进行检查。此做法是为了发现SCP-7226可能隐藏的任何文件或应用程序，以便工作人员在测试期间可及时查看相关媒体文件。

测试过程中SCP-7226在以下媒体文件中被发现：

**媒体文件：**一张一名男子[[footnote]]通过对手机内容的调查，该男子被确认为“亚历克斯（Alex）”。[[/footnote]]在公园里的照片，被发现于名为“我们❤️”的相册中。
**笔记：**SCP-7226拥抱了该男子。项目从媒体文件返回后，其手臂和胸部的颜色扭曲愈加严重。

**媒体文件：**一张上述男子坐在沙发上，一只㹴犬位于其右侧的照片。被发现于上述同一相册中。
**笔记：**SCP-7226倚靠着该男子相坐。项目头发上的蓝色扭曲愈加严重。注意到照片中的男子穿着一件蓝色毛衣。

**媒体文件：**从SCP-7226视角拍摄的其与上述男子合唱//《I And Love And You》//[[footnote]]**译注：**此处应指美国民谣乐队The Avett Brothers于2009年发行的歌曲《I And Love And You》[[/footnote]]的视频。
**笔记：**SCP-7226一起跟唱，导致其声音失真现象严重恶化，大部分语音都被静电干扰取代。SCP-7226从视频文件中返回时，眼中含有泪水。当SCP-7226哭泣时，分泌物呈现类似数字像素化特征，受试者声称其异常的尖锐感引起不适。此外，SCP-7226还表示其视力显著恶化，近乎失明。

测试发现，SCP-7226只有在试图与其存在情感联系的媒体文件内发生物理接触时（例如在照片中拥抱爱人），才会出现现实扭曲现象。

测试被紧急叫停。经确定，SCP-7226每次使用能力后，其身体的现实扭曲效应似乎会逐渐加速恶化，并对其身心健康造成严重危害。

+++++ __**Special Containment Procedures:**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

SCP-7226 is to be held within an observation room within Site-346’s medical wing. SCP-7226 is not to be within approximately six meters of any device capable of playing any digital media.

SCP-7226 may request entertainment that does not require any digital devices. Denial or approval depends on the request.

Testing has been permanently suspended as of 12/07/2022.

[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]

+++++ __**Description**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

SCP-7226 is a 23 year old human male[[footnote]]formerly known as Virgil Simon.[[/footnote]] SCP-7226 is capable of transporting itself into any form of digital media within six meters or less from its location. When SCP-7226 exits the media, physical distortions often develop both interally and externally. SCP-7226 will be forcefully ejected from the media it is currently in if the device is powered off.

At the time of discovery, SCP-7226 had the following physical distortions due to use of its ability:

* SCP-7226’s right forearm is difficult to perceive visually, and appears to constantly be in movement despite being stationary. It reports paresthesia in the effected limb.
* SCP-7226 has cataracts that constantly change between the colors white, yellow, cyan, bright green, fuchsia, red, and blue.
* Strands of SCP-7226's hair became permanently various shades of blue.

See the below test results for more information on SCP-7226's anomalous properties.

**INTERVIEWED:** SCP-7226

**INTERVIEWER:** Dr. Kenny Hart

**FOREWORD:** The following interview was conducted with SCP-7226 before any testing was approved.
----
= **[BEGIN LOG]**
----

**Dr. Hart:** Hello, SCP-7226. My name is Dr. Hart. How are you this evening?

**SCP-7226:** Do you have to call me that? My name is Virgil.

//[SCP-7226 slouches in its seat, crossing its arms.]//

**Dr. Hart:** It's protocol, I'm afraid. Now, I have some questions about your ability.

**SCP-7226:** Okay.

**Dr. Hart:** I know it's unfavorable, that's just how things are. I'm going to start interviewing you now, alright?

**SCP-7226:** Kay.

**Dr. Hart:** When did you first realize you had this ability?

**SCP-7226:** I don't know.

**Dr. Hart:** You don't know?

**SCP-7226:** I mean, I don't really know. I just had it one day. Do I have to answer anymore questions?

**Dr. Hart:** I would appreciate you cooperation, SCP-7226.

**SCP-7226:** It's Virgil.

**Dr. Hart:** If I use your name, will you cooperate?

**SCP-7226:** //[shrugs]//

**Dr. Hart:** //[hesitates]// Virgil, how many times have you used this ability?

**SCP-7226:** Why does it matter?

**Dr. Hart:** Well, you have physical distortions from using your ability. We plan to test your ability in order to learn more about exactly what form you take within different pieces of media. Though, we need to be careful as to reduce the amount of distortions you gain to be as minimal as possible.

//[SCP-7226 sits up in its chair.]//

**SCP-7226:** You're letting me go back online?

**Dr. Hart:** For testing purposes, yes. I can tell that's something you appreciate.

**SCP-7226:** What? I've been really bored in my room. I've used it like, five times.

**Dr. Hart:** I see. I'm surprised you haven't used it more.

**SCP-5272267:** Why?

**Dr. Hart:** If I had that ability, I can think of a few reasons I'd be constantly using it.

//[SCP-7226 shrugs, turning away from Dr. Hart.]//

**Dr. Hart:** We're going to try to make sure you don't get many more distortions then you already have, as the distortions seem pretty painful. We want to see if we can find the cause, as well. Like, what media does what to you so we can potentially reverse the effects.

**SCP-7226:** You can reverse the effects?

**Dr. Hart:** Maybe. We'll see. We can do a lot of things that you wouldn't have thought possible. Our goal is to contain and protect anomalies.

//[SCP-7226 was silent for a moment.]//

**SCP-7226:** I see. I'll do the tests.

**Dr. Hart:** Well, it's good to have your cooperation.

**SCP-7226:** What other types of things can you do here?

**Dr. Hart:** I'm not exactly at liberty to say.

**SCP-7226:** Come on, who am I gonna tell? I can't talk to my family, I definitely don't have friends, I don't even get to see my dog again, not that he can talk. So I have no one other then the staff here to talk to.

**Dr. Hart:** I apologize, but I'm not going to tell you classified information.

**SCP-7226:** Ugh.

**Dr. Hart:** Anyhow. What did you use your ability to go into?

**SCP-7226:** //[shrugs]// Social media, a song, once.

**Dr. Hart:** Ah, social media? What sort of things did you go into?

**SCP-7226:** Pages of celebrities I like. Some songs I used to listen to years ago.

**Dr. Hart:** I see. Well, thank you for your cooperation. You'll be notified once it's time for testing.

**SCP-7226:** Alright.

----
= **[END LOG]**
----
**NOTE:** Following this interview, SCP-7226 frequently asked staff if it could learn about the other anomalous artifacts in the Foundation's possession. This request was denied.

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**Test Results V1**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

The following is a summary of information discovered upon initial testing. The full test logs are available upon request.

* SCP-7226 only affects the copy of said media it enters, not appearing in other copies opened at the same time.
* If there is not a place for SCP-7226 to naturally be inserted into the media, it will not be visible. Regardless, SCP-7226 can interact with the immediate surroundings in which an image was taken, even if said surroundings are not visible in the image.
* When SCP-7226 goes within any media online, the page will appear in the device's history. If it does not go into online media, it has been unable to determine what media it enters.
* SCP-7226 is still aware of its immediate surroundings within media, and is able to verbally respond to staff, even if it cannot be physically seen.
* At this point, it is unknown what exactly causes SCP-7226 to gain additional distortions.

The following list what online pages SCP-7226 entered:

* An account on the social media platform //"Instagram"// under the username //"1nf1n1tyf0rev3r"//. The exact photos it entered are unknown.
* A research article on the possibility of resurrection.
* The Google Maps page for EverHaven park in Waukee, Iowa.

SCP-7226 displayed a series of behaviors that were noteworthy:

* While SCP-7226 initially cooperated with staff, this cooperative behavior dwindled over the course of the tests.
* SCP-7226 continued to ask staff about anomalies within Foundation possession. While it originally replied with understanding and vague dissatisfaction, it began to display aggression when not answered or denied information.

[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**Test Results V2**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

No additional information on the inner workings of SCP-7226's abilities was gained from testing.

SCP-7226 returned with the following distortions:

* SCP-7226 reported experiencing visual and audio hallucinations. When asked what it hallucinated, it refused to answer.
* SCP-7226's speech began to audibly distort, causing syllables and words to be replaced by audio static. This effect worsens when the subject is emotional.
* All colors on and within SCP-7226’s immediate vicinity will distort, causing nearby colors to bleed into each other.

The testing session was quickly deemed ineffective, as SCP-7226 continuously disappeared from the media it was instructed to enter, failing to respond to staff. When SCP-7226 was forcefully ejected from the media, it responded with verbal aggression, accusing staff of lying to it.

This uncooperativeness made it difficult to properly analyze the full extent of its anomalous properties, and unable to observe what may be causing the distortions.

[[/div]]

**INTERVIEWED:** SCP-7226

**INTERVIEWER:** Dr. Kenny Hart

**FOREWORD:** During testing, SCP-7226 displayed a general uncooperativeness and behaved in a reserved manor. The following interview was conducted in an attempt to uncover the root of this behavior.

= **[BEGIN LOG]**
----

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**Test Results V3**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

SCP-7226 was given access to its cellphone for testing purposes. SCP-7226 appeared reluctant to enter the device, expressing discomfort with its whereabouts being known.

To combat SCP-7226's habit of going into unknown media, it was decided to review the contents of the phone first. This was done in order to uncover any files or applications in which SCP-7226 could be hiding so Foundation staff could check said media during testing.

SCP-7226 was discovered in the following media:

**Media:** An image of a man[[footnote]]Through investigation of the contents of the phone, the man has been identified as "Alex"[[/footnote]] at a park, found in a photo album titled "Us❤️".
**Notes:** SCP-7226 hugged the man. It returned with worsening color distortions on its arms and chest.

**Media:** An image of the same man from before sitting on a couch with a terrier on his right. Found in the same photo album from before.
**Notes:** SCP-7226 sat against the man. The blue distortion on SCP-7226's hair worsened. It is noted that the man is wearing a blue sweater in the image.

**Media:** A video of SCP-7226 and the man from before singing the chorus of //"I And Love And You"// filmed from SCP-7226's perspective.
**Notes:** SCP-7226 sang along, causing its vocal distortion to worsen by a significant amount, with the majority of its spoken words being replaced with audio static. SCP-7226 returned from the video with tears in its eyes. When SCP-7226 cried, the secretions appeared to be digitally pixelated, and the subject reported discomfort caused by their unusual sharpness. Additionally, SCP-7226 reported that its vision had worsened significantly, being primarily unable to see.

It was discovered that SCP-7226 only gains distortions when attempting to physically interact with media that it has emotional ties to (ie. Hugging a loved one in a photograph).

Testing was brought to an emergency stop. It was determined that it would be dangerous to SCP-7226's health to allow it to use its anomalous properties again, as damage appears to progress at a quickening pace upon each use.

**特别收容程序：** SCP-8586按照“墓地守卫”协议进行收容。作为“墓地守卫”的一部分，理查德·J·莱弗斯博士需要每月接受一次医学检查，并且如果可行的话，在任何转移事件后立即进行额外分析。到目前为止，理查德·J·莱弗斯博士已经完全同意这些检查。

在需要之前，理查德·J·莱弗斯博士被允许继续履行其在基金会中的职责。

**描述：** SCP-8586是基金会人事部主管理查德·“拉奇”·莱弗斯博士。莱弗斯博士于1980年开始在基金会工作，1981年晋升为研究员，1983年晋升为高级研究员，1986年晋升为高级研究员。他是已故的莱尔·莱弗斯博士和莱莉安·布兰德-莱弗斯博士的儿子。莱莉安·布兰德-莱弗斯博士在1987年去世前曾与莱弗斯博士结婚。

由于事件8586-CHARON，莱弗斯博士变得功能上不死。当其宿主身体寿命结束时，莱弗斯博士的意识会在一个较短的过渡期后重新出现在最近可用的死者的身体中。这种行为似乎没有范围限制，也不受新宿主体型的具体性限制，只要它属于哺乳动物类别，并且在过去的24小时内没有过死亡。莱弗斯博士在不同时间点转移到了最近死亡的人类尸体、马匹、猿类、老鼠以及其他用于基金会站点测试目的的动物身上。

值得注意的是，SCP-8586似乎无法转移到比其在事件8586-CHARON发生时年龄更年轻的33岁244天的人体，或者转移到比其等效年龄更年轻的动物体内（尽管这种行为的具体机制尚不清楚）。

新成为SCP-8586宿主的身体会重新复活并恢复活力，尸体将呈现出其原主人在死亡前一段时间内的外观和健康状况。然而，SCP-8586无法长时间维持这种活力，尸体在一段时间后会迅速腐烂，这给莱弗斯博士带来了极大的困扰。SCP-8586能够自然维持单一形态的时间长度似乎取决于多个因素，包括原宿主的年龄和健康状况。SCP-8586最长能够自然维持单一形态的时间为86天[[脚注]]基金会曾在不同时间通过人工手段延长SCP-8586在单一形态中停留的时间，但通常需要大量的超自然投资和近乎持续的监督，一般被认为是一种不必要的资源使用。最长的维持时间是超过四年的，当时SCP-8586正寄居在已故总统乔治·W·布什的体内。2005年，一名替身被带入以替代SCP-8586，到那时为止，维持该身体的任务已成为每小时的努力。在解除维护布什总统身体的仪式后，几乎立即变成了灰烬，之后异常绑定SCP-8586变得如此不稳定，接下来的七个宿主都在几个小时内都发生了退化，此后三个月内所有后续的宿主也受到了类似的影响。[[/脚注]]。

SCP-8586所寄居的身体将保留其所有原始特征（除了寄居着莱弗斯博士的意识），唯一的例外是宿主身体的右眼将被一枚来自以弗所的黄铜币取代。这枚硬币是以前的SCP-███，在事件8586-CHARON后被取消。从SCP-8586实例中移除这枚硬币会导致其立即分解，同时消失的硬币将在替换宿主的眼窝中重新出现。

**附录8586.1：SCP-███**

[[include 组件:image-block name=coin.jpg|对齐方式=右|图注=SCP-███内部的符文分析。（A）表示说话，（B）表示说话，（C1）和（C2）表示长途旅行（旅程的开始和结束），（D）表示支付，（E）表示灵魂或自我，（F）是一个未完成的符文。]]

SCP-███[[脚注]]现在已红acted，因为它已成为SCP-8586的一个固有方面。此插槽已被重新利用。[[/脚注]]，代号“渡船人之币”，是两枚黄铜[[脚注]]一种天然合金，古时用于铸币。[[/脚注]]币，当它们覆盖在最近死亡者的双眼上时，可以暂时使尸体复生并使其说话，前提是这些硬币不被打扰。最初持有这些硬币的收藏家Vladek Morzyn是一名与马歇尔、卡特和黑暗清算所相关的异象文物收藏家，他相信这些硬币可以让最近死去的人说话。然而，在事件8586-CHARON中断研究之前，初步迹象表明，促使受影响对象说话的力量只是创造了一个最近死去人的复制品[[脚注]]在Lament博士的笔记中，她推测SCP-███内部的力量或实体只是用那个复制品来制造复生的假象，因为受影响的对象往往难以回答关于他们生前生活的具体问题，有时甚至会因被追问细节而变得敌对。[[/脚注]]。

莱弗斯博士在其担任Site-17首席生物学家的职位时接触到了SCP-███，并一直在研究SCP-███对受试者复生组织的影响。在事件8586-CHARON之前，莱弗斯博士曾多次请求与他的配偶Lament博士进行咨询，后者是一名专门研究异象古物的专家。

[[div class="引言"]]
**Site-17异象生物学研究**
**测试案例音频转录**
-----
[开始录音]

**莱弗斯博士：** 好了，我们开始吧。第一个受试者是D-21421，原名黛安·W·耶茨——成年女性，38岁。死因是颈部钝力创伤。

**A. 莱曼博士：** 确认记录，受试者已死亡。

**莱弗斯博士：** （//笑//）当然希望如此。准备好了吗？

**A. 莱曼博士：** 开始吧。

**莱弗斯博士：** 好的。我现在将硬币放在受试者的眼睛上。

（//短暂的停顿。听到一声急促的呼吸声。//）

**D-21421：** 发生了什么？我在哪儿？

**莱弗斯博士：** 你能告诉我你的名字吗？

**D-21421：** 谁是你们？这是什么地方？

**莱弗斯博士：** 我知道你可能有点紧张，请尽量冷静下来。告诉我你的名字好吗？

**D-21421：** 我……我不记得了。我不知道我在哪儿。

**莱弗斯博士：** 你最后记得什么？

**D-21421：** 我……很暗，我……我的脖子，怎么了？

**莱弗斯博士：** 我明白了。你记得在你死前和谁交流过吗？

**D-21421：** 我看不见任何东西。我的眼睛上有什么？这些人是谁？

**莱弗斯博士：** 这些人？

**D-21421：** 请，把它们拿掉！拿掉！这不对！救命！请帮帮我，有人吗？

（//莱曼博士移除SCP-███从受试者的眼睛上。受试者停止复生。//）

**莱弗斯博士：** 你为什么要这么做？

**A. 莱曼博士：** 哦，别装了拉奇。你知道我们从她那里得不到更多信息了。这和其他人一样。

**莱弗斯博士：** 嗯。你说得对。奇怪的是，你认为是什么？

**A. 莱曼博士：** 同样奇怪的是，我认为这不是真正的复活，我认为这是其他东西。

**莱弗斯博士：** 我不知道。我觉得我们可能错过了某些东西。那里//有些东西//在说话。（//停顿//）那么那个符文呢？你有进展了吗？

**A. 莱曼博士：** 实际上是有的。看这里——（//纸张摩擦声//）——这是用于说话的那个符文，那个在顶部的，这很有道理，而这个在这里可能是“灵魂”或“自我”。但是看看这个。你认出什么了吗？

**莱弗斯博士：** 让我看看。 （//停顿//）那是……旅行？

**A. 莱曼博士：** 是的，具体来说是从一个地方到另一个遥远的地方。但这不是一个符文，不是我们习惯的那种。这只是个词，它出现在所有这些其他……好吧，我猜它们是收据，但在经典意义上，它们是用来描述从远处带到他们所在地的商品的。

**莱弗斯博士：** 很有趣。

**A. 莱曼博士：** 不止于此。这些符文比希腊神话中提到的渡船人要早得多，所以无论他们打算用这些符文与谁交流，它们都是不完整的。我只能猜测他们试图用这些符文做什么，但我并不认为它们能正常运作。

**莱弗斯博士：** 你认为我们实际上是在与死者交谈吗？

**A. 莱曼博士：** 这个问题最好留给占星学研究。你有没有和查尔斯谈过？他可能认识那边的人。

**莱弗斯博士：** 哦，但他太沉闷了。感觉每次去见他都要填三份表格才能进入他的办公室。

**A. 莱曼博士：** 你真可怜。受苦受难。

**莱弗斯博士：** 你在取笑我，小姐。

**A. 莱曼博士：** 小姐？先生，我是//异象古物学博士//。你应该是说//博士//小姐。

**莱弗斯博士：** 太好了。我担心你会让我和阿托尔一起去。

**莱弗斯博士：** 无论是谁和查尔斯？自杀是个选项吗？

**A. 莱曼博士：** 幸运的是，这不需要。顺便说一句，你最好把录音机关掉。我们不想让别人知道我们在死人身上闲聊。

**莱弗斯博士：** 哦，好的-
[[/div]]

**附录8586.2：事件8586-CHARON背景**

事件8586-CHARON发生在1987年12月21日，当时莱弗斯博士未经许可地实验了上述SCP-███，似乎是为了尝试复生最近去世的莱弗斯博士的妻子莱弗斯博士。莱弗斯博士在莱弗斯博士去世十天后因[[SCP-354]]意外激活而受到影响。

监控录像显示，莱弗斯博士在莱弗斯博士去世和事件8586-CHARON发生期间进行了多次未记录的SCP-███提取。由于当时Site-17的安全协议相对宽松，这些行动并未立即引起安全干预，唯一例外是一次后来恢复的莱弗斯博士和当时机动任务部队Epsilon-11“九尾狐狸”小队队长特洛伊·莱弗斯博士之间的对话。这次对话直到事件8586-CHARON结束后才被发现，当时对所有Site-17监控录像进行了彻底审查。

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-8586以[[span class="ruby"]]墓穴守望协议[[span class="rt"]]Gravewatch Protocol[[/span]][[/span]]收容。作为协议的一部分，Cairns博士需每月接受医疗评估；在任何转移事件发生后，若条件允许，也应立即对其进行额外分析。迄今为止，Cairns博士配合了所有评估。

若无特殊情况，允许Cairns博士继续履行其在SCP基金会中的职责。

**描述：**SCP-8586是SCP基金会人事主管Lachlan "Lach" Cairns博士。Cairns博士于1980年加入基金会，任职初级研究员，并在1981年晋升为研究员，在1983年晋升为高级研究员，在1986年取得基金会博士头衔。其父母为已故Ansel Cairns博士和Lillian Brand-Cairns博士。Cairns博士于1987年丧偶，其亡妻为Aileen Lament博士。

在8586-卡戎事件的影响下，Cairns博士已获得功能性永生。在其宿主躯体死亡后，经过一个短暂的间隔期，Cairns博士的意识将在最近的可用尸体内复苏。该行为似乎不存在范围限制，对新宿主也不存在特殊需求，仅要求宿主为死亡时间不超过24小时的哺乳纲生物。Cairns博士曾多次转移至新近死亡的人类尸体，以及基金会站点内用于测试目的的马、猿、鼠等动物的尸体内。

值得注意的是，SCP-8586似乎无法转移到年龄小于三十三岁二百四十四天（即Cairns博士在8586-卡戎事件发生时的年龄）的人类躯体中，也无法转移至等效年龄未达标准的动物体内（尽管该机制的详情尚不清晰）。

作为SCP-8586宿主的尸体将恢复生命体征，其外观与健康水平将回退至原主临终前的状态。然而，SCP-8586无法长期维持此类生命力，在一段时间之后，其躯体将快速腐烂。该现象将使Cairns博士遭受大量痛苦。SCP-8586能够维持尸体复苏状态的时间长短似乎基于多个因素，包括尸体原主的年龄与其生前的健康状况。SCP-8586自然维持在同一躯体内的最长时间为八十六天[[footnote]]基金会曾多次设法借助人工手段减缓躯体分解、延长SCP-8586维持在同一躯体内的时间，但这通常需要投资大量奇术资源并进行近乎持续的监控，这常被认为是一种对资源的浪费。维持于同一躯体的时长记录略长于四年，其时SCP-8586寄居于已故[[[scp-4444|乔治·W·布什总统]]]体内。在2005年基金会使用替身代替SCP-8586时，维持其躯体的程序已经需要每小时执行一次。布什总统的躯体在维护仪式解除后近乎瞬间化为灰烬。束缚SCP-8586的异常效应也随之变得极不稳定，此后的七个躯体均在数小时内分解，后续三个月内的所有躯体也均受到了类似影响。[[/footnote]]。

除转为承载Cairns博士的意识之外，SCP-8586占据的尸体将保留所有原有特征，只存在一处例外——宿主躯体的右眼将被一枚以弗所银金币取代。该钱币为前SCP-███，此项目在8586-卡戎事件后被废除。自SCP-8586实例的眼部移除该钱币将导致宿主躯体立即发生分解，同时硬币将会消失，并重新出现在新宿主的眼眶中。

**附录8586.1：**SCP-███

[[include component:image-block name=https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-8586/coin.jpg|align=right|caption=对SCP-8586体内的SCP-███上部分符文的分析。(A)代表言语，(B)代表言语，(C1)与(C2)代表长途旅行（旅行的起点与终点），(D)代表一次支付，(E)代表灵魂或自我，(F)为一未完成的符文。]]

SCP-███[[footnote]]因其成为SCP-8586的内在组成部分，对其编号进行了编辑。该编号的槽位已重新分配。[[/footnote]]（代号“船夫的硬币”）是两枚银金[[footnote]]一种天然存在的金银合金，在古代曾被用于铸币。[[/footnote]]硬币。若将其置于一名新丧者的双眼上，则可使尸体暂时活化并发声，直到钱币被移走为止。其最初所有者Vladek Morzyn（一名与Marshall, Carter & Dark存在关联的异常制品收藏家）相信，这些钱币能够让新丧者说话。然而，尽管对SCP-███的研究已因8586-卡戎事件中断，但早期研究证据已经能够表明，驱使受影响对象说话的力量实际上只是创建了新丧者的一个仿制品[[footnote]]Lament博士在笔记中提到，她认为SCP-███内的力量或实体创造的仿制品只能伪造一种复活的假象，因为对象通常无法回答有关生前生活的具体问题，在被追问相关细节时甚至可能表现出敌意。[[/footnote]]。

作为Site-17的首席生物学家，Cairns博士有权接触SCP-███，并曾持续研究SCP-███对对象的活化组织造成的影响。在8586-卡戎事件发生之前，Cairns博士曾多次向其配偶、异常古物专家Lament博士请求咨询。

**附录8586.2:**8586-卡戎事件背景

8586-卡戎事件发生于1987年12月21日。事件起因为Cairns博士未经授权即对前述SCP-███进行实验，尝试复活新近逝世的Aileen Lament博士。Lament博士于十日前因[[[SCP-354]]]意外激活而身亡，此事件对Cairns博士造成了重大影响。

安保录像显示，在Lament博士去世与8586-卡戎事件发生之间，Cairns博士曾多次未经登记便取用SCP-███。此时Site-17规模较小，安保协议相对宽松，故而这些行为并未立即招致安保干预。唯一的例外是Cairns博士与机动特遣队Epsilon-11“九尾狐”队长Troy Lament（Lament博士之弟，亦即Cairns博士之内弟）之间的一段对话。8586-卡戎事件结束后，Site-17安保录像接受了一次全面审查，其中发现了一份相关录音，这段对话的存在至此方被揭露。
