**Item #:** SCP-594

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-594 is kept at Bio-Research Sector-██, located on 54 km^^2^^ of mountainous rangeland located 35 km from ██████, Alaska. Officially, Sector-██ is listed as a munitions factory and testing facility. The perimeter fences and access gates are monitored remotely at all times with two Level 2 guards posted at each gate in 8 hour shifts. All fencing enclosed paddocks have static dischargers placed at 2 cm intervals. Main research enclosure and pens are to be cleaned on a daily basis to avoid build up of excrement and allow for necessary repairs. Due to possible electrocution hazard, the following procedures are to be observed when interacting with SCP-594:

* All metallic items and electrical devices, including wrist watches and jewelry, must be removed and placed within provided plastic containers prior to donning protective gear

* Prior to entering paddock, staff are advised to wear at minimum Tesla armor, heavy duty work gloves, ear protection, goggles, and rubber soled boots. Also, staff are advised to keep on hand tobacco products (specifically “Skoal” style chewing tobacco or pipe tobacco), candies, dried fruit, or good quality alcohol as a “treat” for 594-01.

* Holding pens and fences are to be kept properly maintained at all times.

* Wool of mature adults (2 years and older) is to be kept shorn to a length of 2mm by ceramic shears twice yearly and baled in antistatic bags, with strict adherence to guidelines set out in Document #594-S. Under no circumstances are shears with electrical motors to be used for shearing. Exceptions are 594-01 and 594-02, who are to be rooed [loose wool plucked out by hand] as per guidelines under Document #594-01/02A and no attempts at shearing be made on either animal.

*  Due to the nature of SCP-594, specifically 594-02, all personnel with contact to SCP-594 and its by-products may be subject to full cavity searches and all personnel must submit to pat down search/metal detector scan before leaving the enclosure.

* Feeding of the approved formulated grain-hay mix, outlined in Document #594-F,  is to be done twice daily with fresh water and mineral licks made readily available around all parts of the enclosure. Foraging and grazing outside of regular feedings are to be carefully monitored.

**Description:** Discovered in the Altai Mountains during a routine fact-finding mission,  SCP-594 is a flock of feral sheep of an unknown breed resembling a wild Argali sheep in general build with a thick fleece like that of a domestic Merino, around 135 cm at the shoulder and weighing 195 kg on average. Gestation and reproductive cycles are similar to most domesticated sheep, with ewes reaching sexual maturity at six to eight months of age and rams at four to six months. They enter a rut twice annually, typically in late spring and early autumn, but breeding can occur year round. Most ewes give birth to a single lamb or twins, with triplets being exceedingly rare (2% of all recorded births to date). Only documented case of triplets which survived to full maturity is 594-01 and his siblings, 594-02 and 594-03. General coloration ranges from pure white to dark blue-gray wool with a metallic sheen appearing once they’ve reached full maturity, typically 2 years of age. Only three animals, the aforementioned triplets, display atypical wool colors. Both sexes have horns, with uncastrated males having spiraling horns measuring 190 cm in length, the largest documented span belonging to 594-02 at a length of 247.4 cm. Females and wethers have curved horns measuring 20 cm. The horns, hooves, and wool of older animals have unusually high concentrations of ferrous metals, along with traces of gold alloys. Examinations of newly butchered animals have revealed that SCP-594’s skeleton also has large amounts of ferrous metals present within the bone matrix.

The sheep are highly aggressive and territorial in nature, and often attack unfamiliar personnel without warning or provocation. They will continue to behave in this manner until steps are taken to properly placate 594-01, which is normally done by giving it “treats” such as tobacco or candies. Once this is done, the flock will become docile and behave like normal domestic sheep. The exceptions to this pacifying behavior are 594-02 and 594-03 as outlined in the addendum on each. In contrast to adults, lambs typically are very easy to handle and display curiosity towards new objects and people in the paddock, often attempting to ‘play’ with personnel but will flee if threatened. The sound of a panicked lamb will cause nearby adults to attack violently, so caution is to be taken not to 'spook' lambs. Lambs also show a tendency to form attachments to certain humans, often following them around the paddock and begging for food or attention. This is especially noticeable among bottle-reared lambs. Such attachments often last even after sheep has reached maturity, as seen in the case of 594-02 and Dr. Maryweather.

At present, the flock numbers 1,314 mature sheep plus 448 lambs and immature sheep, with selective culling of unwanted animals annually after the rutting season to maintain these numbers. The only animals exempt from culling are 594-01, 594-02, and 594-03, or any lambs exhibiting similar traits. Deviation from the 1314/448 pattern for more than a year’s time will cause all mature rams to [DATA EXPUNGED]. Failure to follow the pattern for two years during preliminary research resulted in the deaths of █ D-class personnel and █ researchers, as well as near breach of containment by 594-02.

The defining characteristic of the sheep is that they are able to generate a substantial amount of static electricity simply by the friction caused during daily activities. The resultant charge is typically discharged at random, with mature specimens producing arc flashes that have been recorded at 1000 amps or more. Due to the electrocution hazard, personnel interacting with SCP-594 are advised to follow guidelines fully outlined in Document 594-4H.  When faced with a “threat”, the flock will become highly agitated and mature ewes will attempt to form a ring around any lambs, rubbing their bodies together to generate an even greater static charge between them. Because this defensive behavior is especially pronounced when ewes are birthing, it is standard procedure to isolate all pregnant ewes and newborn lambs from the rest of the flock until a week after birthing.

In addition to defense against predators, rams also appear to use their discharges as a type of dominance display, with the older and stronger rams able to produce more powerful discharges during their “dance”. When in rut, rams will fight against themselves, performing the stomping “dances” prior to engaging rivals. These “dances” are often accompanied by excessive discharges, resulting in a rapid ionization of air and giving SCP-594 its local name, “Thunder Sheep”. Ground sensors have also detected telluric currents during these “dances”, with older rams creating extremely complicated patterns that often resemble [DATA EXPUNGED]. Freemartins (ewes which are behaviorally masculine and lack functional ovaries), will also perform stomping “dances” but the patterns produced, while equally as complicated, show a marked difference from those created by rams. To date, wethers have not been observed to engage in this behavior.

Another trait exhibited by SCP-594 is an inherent ability to “walk on air” or more accurately levitate themselves at a distance on average of 2 to 4 meters vertically via manipulation of electromagnetic fields. Lambs and younger animals have a tendency to lose control mid-“flight”, often falling from high cliffs which can result in death of the animal. This may be the way the flock culled out weaker animals in the wild, but more research is needed.

Research has been done on the properties of SCP-594 wool, milk, meat, and horn. Results of these tests are pending full documentation, however the meat, milk, and resultant dairy products have proven to be fit for human consumption. Approval to include “Thunder Mutton” and various cheeses made from the milk of SCP-594 in the Foundation’s standardized menu still pending.

[DATA PENDING]

**项目编号：**SCP-3736

**项目等级：**Safe

**收容措施：**SCP-3736被收容于Site-21的低安全级储物柜34号内。每日至少一次，SCP-3736应被释放并由C级人员或更高级别人员与其互动。SCP-3736的储物柜内应配备一充电式灯光，该灯光在SCP-3736处于储物柜内时必须保持开启状态。当SCP-3736离开储物柜时，应对其进行充电。

**描述：**SCP-3736是一标准版“Bop It！”玩具，带有音频指令及多种游戏模式。SCP-3736属于已停产的品牌“Bop It Extreme 2”。SCP-3736可作为标准版“Bop It！”玩具使用，通过发出指令来扭动和拉动其相应的摇杆。然而，SCP-3736的异常效应会在连续三次成功操作后发生，之后SCP-3736将尝试与执行其请求动作的玩家进行对话。据基金会所知，SCP-3736只能用单音节词加上“它”进行交流。

SCP-3736似乎渴望与人类接触，在被发现后不断重复“帮它！”的呼喊。SCP-3736似乎无法使用除动词或副词外的词汇，但似乎已经学会了使用俚语进行更有效的交流。当被问及需要回答“是”的问题时，SCP-3736会回答“知道它！”，而当被问及需要回答“否”的问题时，它会回答“不是它！”。SCP-3736似乎喜欢被基金会收容，并对能够与人交谈表示感激。

> **受访者：**SCP-3736
>
> **采访者：**█████博士
>
> **前言：**█████博士完成了诱导SCP-3736异常效应所需的行动。
>
> **<记录开始>**
>
> **█████博士：**早上好SCP-3736，你是否希望我们给你起个名字？
>
> **SCP-3736：**给它起名！
>
> **█████博士：**你想要什么名字？
>
> **SCP-3736：**给它起名！
>
> **█████博士：**你想让我给你起个名字？“Bop”听起来怎么样？
>
> **SCP-3736：**保留它！
>
> **█████博士：**所以，Bop，你意识到自己的存在有多久了？
>
> **SCP-3736：**制造它！
>
> **█████博士：**你在被创造时就已经有了自我意识？
>
> **SCP-3736：**知道它！
>
> **█████博士：**为什么你需要与人类交流？
>
> **SCP-3736：**需要它！
>
> **█████博士：**你需要与人类交流才能生存吗？
>
> **SCP-3736：**不是它！
>
> **█████博士：**你觉得储物柜里的条件如何？
>
> **SCP-3736：**爱它！
>
> **█████博士：**你为什么需要在那里有灯光？你能看见，还是有什么别的原因？
>
> **SCP-3736：**温暖它！
>
> **█████博士：**你能感觉到冷吗？
>
> **SCP-3736：**不是它！
>
> **█████博士：**那为什么你需要它？
>
> **SCP-3736：**欢呼它！
>
> **<记录结束>**
>
> **结语：**SCP-3736似乎在情感成熟度和词汇量方面有所提高。协议将继续按常规进行。
>
> **附录：3736-1**SCP-3736于█████年█月█日被从德克萨斯州█████████的一间公寓中回收。当收到一份关于一个显示异常且令人不安指令的“Bop It！”玩具的报告时，基金会对其产生了兴趣。受访居民开始对SCP-3736做出回应，但最终因害怕玩具而将其送回制造商处，后者对此无法解释SCP-3736的性质。随后，当地基金会情报部门发现了该项目并将其转移至Site-21。项目的拥有者以及制造商已被施以B级记忆删除。
>
> **附录：3736-2**SCP-3736被证明是意识到自己并非人类的，并对关心它的人员表示尊重。它对人类怀有极大的感情，并对任何与之交谈的人表现出善意和尊重。它能够区分出谁在使用它，并似乎具有照片般的记忆力。由于缺乏人类感官，推测其具有心灵感应能力。SCP-3736并不知晓它是如何获得感知力的，描述其起源为突然觉醒。
>
> **附录：3736-3**另外两个“Bop It Extreme 2”模型也表现出与SCP-3736相似的感知力。虽然它们的智力水平与SCP-3736相当，但它们没有表现出任何欲望，也没有表现出情绪。它们被编为SCP-3736-1和SCP-3736-2，并存放在Site-21。SCP-3736-1被存放在低安全级储物柜35号，SCP-3736-2被存放在低安全级储物柜36号；这两个模型每天都要由C级人员进行分析。对“Bop It Extreme 2”模型相关异常现象的进一步分析将提供。
>
> **附录：3736-4**在对SCP-3736-1和SCP-3736-2进行了█个月的分析后，以找到“Bop It！异常”（以下简称）的起源线索，SCP-3736-1表现出显著的心理发展，并与SCP-3736一样具备处理情绪的能力。SCP-3736-2在此时已完全无效化，不再表现出感知力，仅作为标准“Bop It！”玩具运作。对SCP-3736-1的采访将在未来两周内的某个未定日期由█████博士进行。
>
> **受访者：**SCP-3736-1
>
> **采访者：**█████博士
>
> **前言：**SCP-3736-1被证明与SCP-3736一样运作，因为SCP-3736-2已停止异常功能。
>
> **█████博士：**下午好SCP-3736-1，你现在感觉如何？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**喜欢它！
>
> **█████博士：**你想要个名字吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**给它起名！
>
> **█████博士：**“极限”听起来怎么样？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**喜欢它！
>
> **█████博士：**你知道另一个像你一样能说话的玩具存在吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**知道它！
>
> **█████博士：**你知道它在四月七日就停止工作了吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**不是它！
>
> **█████博士：**好吧，它在四月七日就停止工作了，现在不能像你一样说话了。
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**不是它！
>
> **█████博士：**你说它在四月七日并没有停止工作？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**知道它！
>
> **█████博士：**你知道它是什么时候停止工作的吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**猜猜看！
>
> **█████博士决定配合。**
>
> **█████博士：**是四月八日吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**不是它！
>
> **█████博士：**四月二十四日？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**不是它！
>
> **█████博士：**它是什么时候停止工作的？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**加入它！
>
> **█████博士：**你说那个其他玩具……加入了你？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**知道它！
>
> **█████博士：**那个其他玩具知道这个吗？
>
> **SCP-3736-1：****沉默**
>
> **█████博士：**储物柜旁边还有一个和你一样聪明的玩具。
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**是它！所以？
>
> **SCP-3736-1**开始发出低沉的声音，使█████博士昏迷了三分钟。声音结束后，SCP-3736-1恢复为基本的“Bop It！”玩具。
>
> **结语：**SCP-3736-1和SCP-3736-2不再具有任何异常性质。SCP-3736的行为发生了明显变化。它现在开始提出更复杂的问题，尽管它只说单音节词。尽管如此，它仍然无法在句子末尾不以“它”结尾的情况下产生任何句子。

reference:
**项目编号：**SCP-3736

**项目等级：**Safe

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-3736将被收容在Site-21的34号低安保储物柜中。每天至少一次，SCP-3736将被取出并与任何C级或更高级别的人员交互。SCP-3736的储物柜将配有可充电照明灯，在项目处于储物柜内部时必须保持开启。当SCP-3736在储物柜外时，该灯将被充电。

**描述：**SCP-3736是一个标准的“摁呀！[[footnote]] **译注：**该游戏机原名为“Bop It!”，这里依据后文异常特性作此翻译。 [[/footnote]]”游戏机，可发出音频指令且附有多种游戏模式。SCP-3736属于已停产的“嗯呀进阶版2”品牌。通过依据它的指令来转动与拉动相应的摇杆，SCP-3736可以被当作一个标准的“摁呀！”游戏机来游玩。然而，SCP-3736的异常性质将在成功进行三次连续操作后出现，在这之后SCP-3736将尝试与执行其所要求动作的玩家交谈。就目前基金会所知，SCP-3736只能使用单个单音节词并以“呀”收尾的方式进行交流。

SCP-3736表现出与人类接触的渴望，在被回收与激活后不断地重复“救呀！”。除在个别情况下，SCP-3736无法使用除动词和副词以外的词，但已学会使用俚语来进行更有效的交流。当被问及需要回答“是”的问题时，SCP-3736将用“对呀！”来回答，而在被问及需要回答“否”的问题时，则将用“不呀！”来回答。SCP-3736对基金会的收容表示满意，亦感谢基金会允许其与人交流。

> **受访者：**SCP-3736
>
> **采访者：**█████博士
>
> **前言：**█████博士完成了引发SCP-3736异常性质的所需动作。
>
> **<记录开始>**
>
> **█████博士：**早上好SCP-3736，你希望我们给你起个名字吗？
>
> **SCP-3736：**起呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你想要什么名字？
>
> **SCP-3736：**起呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你要我给你起个名字吗？“Bop”听起来如何？
>
> **SCP-3736：**好呀！
>
> **█████博士：**那么Bop，你意识到你自己的存在有多久了？
>
> **SCP-3736：**久呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你从诞生起就有了自我意识？
>
> **SCP-3736：**对呀！
>
> **█████博士：**为什么你觉得你有必要和人类交流？
>
> **SCP-3736：**要呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你需要与人类交流才能生存下去吗？
>
> **SCP-3736：** 不呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你喜欢你的储物间的状况吗？
>
> **SCP-3736：**爱呀！
>
> **█████博士：**为什么你需要在收容间里面开灯？你是可以看见还是因为别的什么？
>
> **SCP-3736：**暖呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你会感到冷吗？
>
> **SCP-3736：**不呀！
>
> **█████博士：**那为什么你认为你需要它？
>
> **SCP-3736：**拜呀!
>
> **<记录结束>**
>
> **结语：**SCP-3736情绪逐渐成熟，且词汇量也有所改善。措施将继续执行。

**附录：3736-1** SCP-3736于█████ █, ████回收自得克萨斯州█████████的一间公寓。一份关于一个“摁呀！”游戏机发出异常与诡异的指令的报告引起了基金会的注意。据受采访的居民表示，他们一开始有回应SCP-3736，但最终对玩具产生了恐惧，并将其寄回给制造商，而制造商对SCP-3736的特性没有任何解释。之后项目先是被当地的基金会情报部门发现，随后转移至了Site-21。已对原持有人及其联系的制造商进行B级记忆删除。

**附录：3736-2** SCP-3736能意识到它不是人类，并对照顾它的人表示敬意。它非常的喜爱人类，对所有与之交谈的人表现出和善与尊重。它可以分辨出使用者的区别，似乎具有影像记忆。由于它缺乏人类的感官，推测其具有心灵感应的能力。SCP-3736对其如何获得智能一无所知，将其描述为突然的觉醒。

**附录：3736-3** 新增了两个“摁呀进阶版2”游戏机出现与SCP-3736类似的智能。虽然它们表现出与SCP-3736相同的智力水平，但它们没有任何形式的欲望且不表现出任何情感。它们将被编号为SCP-3736-1与SCP-3736-2，储存于Site-21。SCP-3736-1将储存于35号低安保储物柜，SCP-3736-2将储存于36号低安保储物柜，随后C级员工将每日对其进行分析。将对“摁呀进阶版2”游戏机异常特质的起源进行进一步的分析。

**附录：3736-4** 在对SCP-3736-1和SCP-3736-2进行了█个月的分析之后，研究员将其改称为“摁呀异常版”，并对项目异常性质的起源有了少许了解。SCP-3736-1表现出极大的智力发展，现与SCP-3736的水平一致并具有处理情绪的能力。SCP-3736-2此时已无效化，不再表现出感知力，仅可作为标准的“摁呀！” 玩具使用。█████博士将在两个星期内对SCP-3736-1进行采访，时间未定。

> **受访者：**SCP-3736-1
>
> **采访者：**█████博士
>
> **前言：**由于SCP-3736-2已失去了异常属性，现SCP-3736-1拥有与SCP-3736同一水平的功能。
>
> **█████博士：**下午好，SCP-3736-1，你现在感觉如何?
>
> **SCP-3736-1：**爽呀！
>
> **█████博士：**你想要一个名字吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**起呀！
> ****
> **█████博士：**Extreme听起来怎样？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**爱呀！
> ****
> **█████博士：**你知道还有另一个可以像你一样说话的玩具吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**造呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**你知道它在4月7日停止运转了吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**不呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**好吧，它那时停止运转了，不能再像你那样说话了。
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**不呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**你是说它在4月7日没有停止运转？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**对呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**那你知道那是什么时候的事吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**猜呀!
> ****
> **█████博士决定来猜。**
> ****
> **█████博士：**是4月8日吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**不呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**4月24日？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**不呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**它什么时候停止工作的?
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**入呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**你是在说另一个玩具成为了你的一部分？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**对呀!
> ****
> **█████博士：**它知道吗？
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：沉默**
> ****
> **█████博士：**在你旁边的收容间里还有一个像你一样有智慧的玩具。
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1：**对呀！怎?
> ****
> **SCP-3736-1**开始发出低沉的噪音，使█████博士昏迷了3分钟。 噪音消失后，SCP-3736-1成为了普通的“摁呀！”玩具。
> ****
> **结语：**SCP-3736-1和SCP-3736-2都不再具有异常性质。 SCP-3736的行为发生了明显变化。尽管仍只能说出单音节词，但它开始问出一些更复杂的问题。 但如果不以“呀”结尾，它就无法说出任何句子。

把下面的英文 SCP Wikidot 文本转换为中文 SCP Wikidot 文本：

[[>]]
[[module Rate]]
[[/>]]

**Item #:** SCP-3736

**Object Class:** Safe

**Containment Procedures:** SCP-3736 is to be contained in Low-Security Locker 34 at Site 21. SCP-3736 is to be released and be engaged with by any C-Class Personnel or higher at least once a day. SCP-3736's locker is to be furnished with a chargeable light that must remain on at all times while it is inside. This light is to be recharged when SCP-3736 is outside its locker.

**Description:** SCP-3736 is a standard Bop It! model with audio commands as well as multiple game modes. SCP-3736 is part of a discontinued brand referred to as Bop It Extreme 2. SCP-3736 can be played as a standard Bop It! with commands to twist and pull its respective cranks. However, SCP-3736's anomalous effect occurs after three successful consecutive actions, after which SCP-3736 will attempt to converse with the player who had performed its requested actions. To the Foundation's knowledge, SCP-3736 can only communicate using single-syllable words followed by "It".

SCP-3736 appears to be desparate for human contact and continuously repeated "Help It!" upon being activated after recovery. SCP-3736 appears to be incapable of using words that are not verbs or adverbs with the exception of certain cases, but appears to have learned to communicate more efficiently using slang. When asked a question that would require an answer of "yes", SCP-3736 will respond with "Know It!", and will respond with "Not It!" if responding to a question that would require an answer of "no". SCP-3736 appears to enjoy being in the Foundation's custody and is grateful that it has been granted access with people to talk to.

> **Interviewed:** SCP-3736
>
> **Interviewer:** Doctor █████
>
> **Foreword:** Doctor █████ completed the required actions for inducing SCP-3736's anomalous effect.
>
> **<Begin Log>**
>
> **Doctor █████:** Good morning SCP-3736, do you prefer that we give you a name?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Name It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** What name would you prefer?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Name It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** You want me to come up with a name? How does "Bop" sound?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Keep It!
>
> **Doctor █████** So, Bop, how long have you been aware of your existence?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Made It!
>
> **Doctor █████** You have been self aware since you were created?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Know It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Why do you feel the need to communicate with humans?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Need It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** You need to communicate with humans to survive?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Not It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** How do you like the conditions of your locker?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Love It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Why do you need a light in there? Are you able to see, or is it something else?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Warms It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** You are able to feel cold?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Not It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Then why do you feel you need it?
>
> **SCP-3736:** Cheers It!
>
> **<End Log>**
>
> **Closing Statement:** SCP-3736 appears to have improved in terms of emotional maturity and vocabulary. Protocol will continue as normal.

**Addendum: 3736-1** SCP-3736 was recovered from an apartment in █████████, Texas on █████ █, ████. It had reached the Foundation's interest when a report of a Bop It! toy displaying unusual and disturbing commands. The residents interviewed had begun to respond to SCP-3736, but eventually grew fearful of the toy and sent it to the manufacturer who had no explanation for SCP-3736's properties. It was initially found afterwards by local Foundation intelligence and transferred to Site 21. The owners as well as the manufacturers contacted were administered Class-B amnestics.

**Addendum: 3736-2** SCP-3736 is shown to be aware that it is not human and shows respect for those who care for it. It holds a great amount of affection for mankind and shows kindness and respect towards anyone who speaks to it. It can differentiate between who uses it and seems to possess a photographic memory. It is presumed to hold telepathic qualities, due to it lacking any human senses. SCP-3736 holds no knowledge on how it acquired sentience and describes its genesis as a sudden awakening.

**Addendum: 3736-3** Two more models of Bop It Extreme 2 have shown sentience similar to that of SCP-3736. While they are shown to possess intelligence equal to SCP-3736, they lack any form of desire and show no emotion. They are to be classified as SCP-3736-1 and SCP-3736-2 and stored in Site 21. SCP-3736-1 is to be stored in Low Security Locker 35, while SCP-3736-2 is to be stored in Low Security Locker 36; both models are to be analyzed further by C Class Personnel daily. Further analysis is to be provided on the origin of the anomaly associated with the Bop It Extreme 2 Model.

**Addendum: 3736-4** After █ months of analysis on SCP-3736-1 and SCP-3736-2 to find hints to the origin of "The Bop It! Anomaly" (as it will be referred to from now on), SCP-3736-1 has shown substantial mental development and now operates at the level of SCP-3736 as well as possessing the capability of processing emotion. SCP-3736-2 has effectively become neutralized at this point, as it no longer shows sentience and functions merely as a standard Bop It! toy. An interview with SCP-3736-1 will be conducted by Doctor █████ at an undetermined date within 2 weeks.

> **Interviewed:** SCP-3736-1
>
> **Interviewer:** Doctor █████
>
> **Foreword:** SCP-3736-1 has been shown to function at the level of SCP-3736 as SCP-3736-2 has ceased anomalous functions.
>
> **Doctor █████:** Good afternoon SCP-3736-1, how are you feeling right now?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Like It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Would you like a name?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Name It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** How does something like Extreme sound?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Like It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Are you aware that another toy that could speak like you exists?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Know It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Do you know that it ceased functioning on April 7?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Not It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Well, it ceased to function then, and can no longer speak like you.
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Not It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** You are saying that it did not cease functioning on April 7?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Know It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Do you know when it did then?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Guess It!
>
> **Doctor █████ decides to play along.**
>
> **Doctor █████:** Is it April 8?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Not It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** April 24?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Not It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** When did it cease function?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Joined It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** You are saying that the other toy...joined you?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Know It!
>
> **Doctor █████:** Does the other one know of this?
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** **Silence**
>
> **Doctor █████:** There is another toy with your intelligence in the locker next to yours.
>
> **SCP-3736-1:** Is It! So?
>
> **SCP-3736-1** begins to emit a low pitched noise that renders Doctor █████ unconscious for 3 minutes. After the noise ceases, SCP-3736-1 functions as a basic Bop It! toy.
>
> **Closing Statement:** Both SCP-3736-1 and SCP-3736-2 no longer possess any anomalous quality. A noticeable change in SCP-3736's behavior has taken place. It now begins to ask questions that are more complicated, despite speaking in single syllable words. Despite this, it has not managed to produce any sentence without ending it in "It".

**项目编号：**SCP-3800

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-3800被收容于Site-93，位于中国新疆的欧亚大陆极点附近。它被保存在一个标准收容柜中。

目前，一个SCP-3800-1[[footnote]]包括在异常发现时出现的个体以及在附录1事件中出现的个体。[[/footnote]]殖民地被收容于一处此前无人居住的群岛（指定为前哨站3800，见附录）内，其坐标为26.412°S，88.603°E。在前哨站内安装了隐蔽摄像头以监控和研究该殖民地的活动。目前，前哨站约有34%（4.5公里）的土地被SCP-3800-1结构覆盖。前哨站3800的殖民化不会使SCP-3800的范围扩大到危险水平。对前哨站3800进行任何测试必须得到两名4级人员的批准。额外出现的SCP-3800-1个体将被镇静并运送到前哨站3800。

已安排将SCP-3800紧急转移至月球前哨站45的协议，并将在SCP-3800的半径超过2500公里时执行。

**描述：**SCP-3800是一幅由Shaun Tan[[footnote]]一名来自澳大利亚珀斯的作者/插画师。[[/footnote]]创作的油画《他们乘船而来》，装裱在木框内。这似乎是一幅原创作品；标题、艺术家签名和识别号（283/500）都在画作底部。

SCP-3800的异常效应会在它位于海岸线、海滩或海洋周围大约--100--800公里范围内时显现。一旦发生这种情况，SCP-3800-1个体将以每小时5到20个个体的速度从海中出现，数量取决于SCP-3800的半径。

SCP-3800-1个体似乎为白人类形生物，具有多种生理异常。最值得注意的是，个体没有嘴巴[[footnote]]个体似乎不需要食物，且无法呼吸。[[/footnote]]、鼻孔、生殖器、乳房、肛门和体毛。此外，所有个体都表现出侏儒症特征，显示出较低的智力水平。它们没有书面或口头交流能力，也没有宗教、贸易系统或等级制度。在初次出现后，个体将走向岸边并开始建立殖民地。

当处于群体[[footnote]]个体若不愿离开其殖民地，将试图返回其他SCP-3800-1个体处，且在受阻时会变得越来越恐慌。[[/footnote]]时，SCP-3800-1个体将尝试在远离人类、敌对动物或不适宜地区的地方建立一系列建筑。具体而言，个体将尝试用可用材料[[footnote]]不同殖民地的建筑差异很大，但通常由泥土或木材建造。[[/footnote]]建造避难所，并开始种植任何可用的植物[[footnote]]由于个体不需要食物，因此未知原因。作物经常被照料，但从未观察到SCP-3800-1个体收获或食用作物。[[/footnote]]。如果阻碍SCP-3800-1个体建造这些建筑，或摧毁它们，它们将变得激动和敌意。此外，个体表现出制造和使用石器、木头和草制成的原始工具的能力，但似乎无法创造或使用更先进的技术。

一旦SCP-3800-1个体建立了初始殖民地，它们将继续扩展，建造更多的农场和避难所，进一步远离其原始定居点[[footnote]]无论殖民地的人口是否足以容纳现有的建筑。[[/footnote]]。个体几乎不会参与对殖民地无益的活动，通常会花时间收集材料、建造建筑或照顾农场。随着人口的增长，个体表现出越来越强的能力[[footnote]]通常是通过人数增加。尽管SCP-3800-1个体在大型群体中表现出高于平均水平的团队合作能力，但它们缺乏直接交流。[[/footnote]]来清除阻碍其领土扩张的障碍，如茂密的植被、动物领地和人造结构。然而，SCP-3800-1从未尝试过穿越海水（在初次出现后），似乎无法做到。

对于SCP-3800-1每将1平方公里的土地纳入其领土，SCP-3800的效应半径将增加约5公里。每当没有活跃的SCP-3800-1殖民地存在时，半径也会每天增加5公里。由于大陆限制，半径超过2645公里[[footnote]]欧亚大陆极点与最近海岸线之间的距离。[[/footnote]]会导致SCP-3800的范围呈指数级增长，随后SCP-3800-1的出现将不受控制，导致可能的RK级重构场景或NK级世界末日场景，若其留在地球上。

**首次发现：**SCP-3800最初于2011年3月2日在西澳大利亚Useless Loop的一次112报警后被发现，报告称“有人在路中间建房子”。确认该区域出现异常后，机动特遣队Sigma-16（“Dusty的帮派”）被指派调查、收容和清理该区域。

首次与SCP-3800-1接触发生在同一天，在Carrarang东部海岸约4公里处发现了由个体建造的建筑。一旦开始清理建筑，SCP-3800-1个体变得敌意并试图攻击MTF人员，但未造成严重伤害。所有个体（以及之后出现的个体）均被镇静并运送到Site-23收容。

在MTF-Σ-16驻扎期间，SCP-3800-1[[footnote]]SCP-3800当时未知。[[/footnote]]的半径扩大到足以涵盖整个Carrarang西部海岸。第二座殖民地在那里出现并未经观察到地扩张了16多小时，因为该地区的密度较低。在发现该殖民地时，个体的出现半径迅速增长。在此事件后，额外力量被调来协助收容。

SCP-3800-1继续在西澳大利亚海岸外出现约两周。在此期间，SCP-3800的半径扩大到涵盖了Carrarang的整个海岸线，以及Nanga、Dirk Harthog岛和Francois Peron国家公园的部分地区。由于半径的不断扩大，制定了紧急收容程序以疏散珀斯和其他西澳大利亚城市，并对西澳大利亚海岸进行全面隔离。

2011年3月15日，SCP-3800在北Tamala的一个SCP-3800-1避难所内被发现，并被带入Site-23，停止了SCP-3800-1的出现。由于SCP-3800-1的初次出现地点与SCP-3800的回收地点之间存在不一致之处，确定SCP-3800已被移动至少一次，可能是由SCP-3800-1个体移动的。此外，SCP-3800所在的建筑内还包含了一些异常物品（见附录2）。

剩余的SCP-3800-1建筑很快被摧毁。总损失包括$████的财产损失、██名受伤平民和█名伤亡。对███名个体进行了记忆删除。所有被捕获的SCP-3800-1个体[[footnote]]总数4403[[/footnote]]均被置于医疗诱导昏迷状态并收容于Site-23。

**附录：**在初次收容后的约5个月，数个SCP-3800-1个体出现在澳大利亚大湾。在收容（以及随后的重新出现）后，确定SCP-3800的效应半径从约100公里增加到了最低800公里。

据推测，SCP-3800的效应半径会在没有活跃的SCP-3800-1殖民地时增加。在多次测试SCP-3800-1出现后，这一假设得到了证实。所有新出现的个体[[footnote]]总数215[[/footnote]]（连同Site-23内的个体）被运送到将成为前哨站3800的地方，并从昏迷中醒来。在创建前哨站3800后，SCP-3800被用SCPS Kristov[[footnote]]一艘Mark IV基金会穿梭机，用于替代标准运输飞机，以确保在经过东南亚时不会发生SCP-3800-1的意外出现。[[/footnote]]运送到当前的Site-93位置。

**附录2（回收材料）：**在SCP-3800最初被发现的避难所内发现了更多物品。然而，SCP-3800是唯一表现出异常能力的物体。这些物品包括一张不完整的海洋航行图、一张手写便条和一个无法使用的指南针。所有三件物品都可追溯到16世纪晚期。

便条似乎是撕下的日记页，用葡萄牙语书写。大部分内容因水损而无法辨认。翻译成英语后如下：
[[collapsible show="+ 显示便条。" hide="- 隐藏便条。"]]
> 第133天
>
> 来这里是个错误，因为这片土地已经被占领了。他们的城市一眼望不到边……其余的船员昨天就进去了，只有Tomas回来了。至少，感觉像是Tomas。
>
> 他说土著打算“给孩子们发信息”，让我跟他一起去。他说我可以加入船员或者和船一起死。我告诉他给我一天时间决定，然后他回到了城市。我相信我的决定已经做好了。
>
> 即使现在，我也看到他们在地平线上准备着船只。我必须马上行动。船长带了一样去年爆发时的样本，以防万一。除非我自己把它带进城市，否则它在外面待不了多久。我没有别的选择——我们一上岸就注定要灭亡。
>
> 我要把个人物品埋在这里，然后[笔记的其余部分无法辨认]
[[/collapsible]]

reference:
[[include component:image-block name=http://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-3800/thisismyhouse.jpg|caption=一座由SCP-3800-1个体建造的房屋]]
**项目编号：**SCP-3800

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-3800被收容于亚欧大陆难抵极[[footnote]]**译注：**大陆上离海洋的平均距离最远的位置[[/footnote]]附近的Site-93的标准收容柜中。

目前，一个SCP-3800-1聚居群体[[footnote]]由发现异常期间显现的个体及在附录1事件中显现的个体组成[[/footnote]]被收容于南纬26.412度，东经88.603度的一个荒无人烟的群岛（指定为前哨站3800，见附录）上。前哨站内多个位置安有隐蔽摄像头以监控并研究聚居群体活动。目前前哨站约34%（4.5km^^2^^）的地块被SCP-3800-1建筑覆盖。预计在前哨站3800的拓殖不会使SCP-3800的影响范围达到危险水平。在前哨站3800开展任何类型的实验都需要2名四级人员批准。无论什么原因显现的其他SCP-3800-1实体都必须被镇静并运送到前哨站3800。
将SCP-3800运至月面前哨站-45的紧急协议已制订。将于SCP-3800影响半径超过2500km时执行。

**描述：**SCP-3800是陈志勇[[footnote]]来自澳大利亚珀思市的一位作家/插画家[[/footnote]]所作的木框丙烯酸油画[[span class="ruby"]]“他们渡海而来”[[span class="rt"]]They Came By Water[[/span]][[/span]]。画作底部有标题、艺术家签名和识别号（283/500），应为作品原件。

位于海岸线或海洋约--100--800km范围内时，SCP-3800的异常效应将会显现。异常效应显现时，SCP-3800-1实体将以每千米海岸线每小时5～20个实体的速率从SCP-3800影响半径内的海洋中浮现。

SCP-3800-1实体外观近似高加索人种，有数种身体异常。最值得注意的是，实体无口、鼻孔[[footnote]]似乎无需进食且不能呼吸[[/footnote]]、生殖器、乳房、肛门和体毛。此外，所有实体均表现出侏儒症的特征，几乎没有表现出较高智力的迹象。它们没有任何形式的书面或口头交流，也没有任何宗教、贸易系统或等级制度。显现之后，实例将走到岸边并开始建立聚居地。

在聚居群体中时[[footnote]]SCP-3800-1实体个体被迫从群体中分离后将试图回到任何实体身边，被阻挠时会变得越来越恐慌。[[/footnote]]，SCP-3800-1实体会尝试建立一系列远离人类、侵略性动物群或不宜居地区的建筑。具体而言，实体会尝试用可用材料建造居所[[footnote]]不同聚居群体的居所不同，但常常通常由泥土和木头建造[[/footnote]]并种植任何可用植物[[footnote]]鉴于实体无需进食，种植行为原因未知。实体会打理其作物，但从未观察到SCP-3800-1实体收割或消费之。[[/footnote]]。若建造受阻或建筑物被摧毁，SCP-3800-1实体将变得焦躁且充满敌意。此外，实体表现出制作并使用基本工具的能力，如棍棒、斧头、用石木草制作的各类工具，但似乎没有创造或使用更先进技术的能力。

SCP-3800-1实体一旦建立第一个聚居地就会继续扩张它，并在离原定居点较远处建造更多农田和居所[[footnote]]无论聚居地的建筑规模是否足以容纳现有人口[[/footnote]]。实体几乎只从事利于其聚居群体的活动，大多数时间用于收集材料、建造建筑或打理农田。随着聚居群体人口增长，实体表现出越来越强的清除领土扩张障碍的能力[[footnote]]通常以群体能力体现。即使缺乏直接沟通，SCP-3800-1实体在大群体中表现出高于平均的团队合作水平。[[/footnote]]，如清除茂密植物群、动物领地和人造建筑。但SCP-3800-1（在一开始的显现之后）从未尝试穿过海域水体，似乎没有能力这么做。

SCP-3800-1每将1km^^2^^陆地纳入其领土，SCP-3800的影响半径扩大约5km。无活跃SCP-3800-1聚居群体时影响半径也会每天扩大5km。由于大洲限制，影响半径超过2645km[[footnote]]亚欧大陆难抵极到最近海岸的距离[[/footnote]]会导致SCP-3800影响范围指数级增长、SCP-3800-1不受控显现，若SCP-3800留在地球将引发一场可能的RK级重构情景或NK级世界末日情景。

**初次发现：**SCP-3800最初在2011/03/02的一次拨打自西澳大利亚无用环路的112电话中被发现，电话中报告“奇怪的人在路中间建房子”。确认该区域出现异常后，机动特遣队Sigma-16（[[span class="ruby"]]“达斯蒂的打手”[[span class="rt"]]Dusty's Goons[[/span]][[/span]]）被派到该地区进行侦查、收容和清理。

同日与SCP-3800-1初次接触，并发现实体建造的沿卡拉朗东海岸绵延约4km的建筑。一旦开始清理建筑，SCP-3800-1实体就产生敌意并试图攻击MTF队员，但未造成任何严重伤害。所有实体（以及后来显现的）都被镇静并运送到Site-23收容。

MTF-Σ-16驻扎在该地区时，SCP-3800-1[[footnote]]当时尚不清楚SCP-3800的存在[[/footnote]]的显现半径扩大到足以覆盖卡拉朗西部海岸的大部分地区。由于该地区人口密度较小，第二个聚居群体在该地区显现并扩张了超过16个小时未被发现。聚居群体被发现时实体显现半径正迅速增长。事件发生后，更多武装力量受召协助收容。

SCP-3800-1在澳大利亚西部的海岸持续显现约2周，期间SCP-3800的影响半径扩大到足以覆盖卡拉朗全境海岸，以及楠加、德克·哈托格岛和弗朗索瓦·佩伦国家公园的部分海岸。因显现半径扩大，基金会制订了疏散珀思市和其余澳大利亚西部城市居民并完全隔离澳大利亚西部海岸的紧急收容协议。

2011/03/15，SCP-3800在塔马拉北部的一座SCP-3800-1居所中被发现并带往内陆的Site-23，使SCP-3800-1显现停止。由于SCP-3800-1初次显现位置与SCP-3800的回收位置不同，SCP-3800至少被移动过一次，且很可能是被SCP-3800-1实体移动过。此外，SCP-3800所在的建筑内还包含一些不常见的物品[[footnote]]除了实体制造的工具之外，SCP-3800-1实体通常不持有个人物品[[/footnote]]（见附录2）。

其余SCP-3800-1建筑不久被摧毁。总计损失████美元，██名平民受伤，█人伤亡。对███人实施了记忆删除。所有捕获的SCP-3800-1实体[[footnote]]共4403人[[/footnote]]均处于药物诱导的昏迷状态并收容于Site-23。

**附录1：**初次收容约5个月后，数个SCP-3800-1实体显现于大澳大利亚湾近岸。收容实体（及后续显现的实体）后，确认SCP-3800的影响半径已从约100km增加到至少800km。

有假设称，只要无活跃SCP-3800-1聚居群体，SCP-3800的影响半径就会扩大。后在对SCP-3800-1显现的多重测试中得到证实。所有新近显现的实体[[footnote]]共215人[[/footnote]]和收容于Site-23中的实体均被运送至后来的前哨站3800，并从昏迷中唤醒。前哨站3800建立后，SCP-3800由//SCPS Kristov//[[footnote]]Mark IV型基金会穿梭载具，替代标准运输机，以确保经过东南亚时不会导致SCP-3800-1意外显现[[/footnote]]运送至当前收容位置Site-93。

**附录2（回收材料）：**初次发现SCP-3800的居所中还发现了其它物品，但SCP-3800是唯一显示出异常特性的。这些物品包括一份不完整航行海图、一张手写笔记和一个无功能的指南针。三件物品均可追溯至16世纪00年代晚期。

笔记看起来像是一页撕下的日记，以葡萄牙文书写。大部分笔记已被泡坏，难以辨认。其译文如下：

[[collapsible show="+ 查看笔记" hide="- 隐藏笔记"]]
> 第133天
>
> 来到这里是个错误，因为所有土地都已经有人居住了。目之所及都是他们的城市……其他人都在一天之前进城了，只有托马斯回到了船上。至少那个人感觉像托马斯。
>
> 他说当地人打算“给孩子们发条消息”，叫我和他一起去。他说我要么加入那些船员，要么给船陪葬。我告诉他给我一天时间做决定，然后他回到了城里。我想，我已经做出决定了。
>
> 就算是现在，我也能在地平线上看到他们在准备船。我必须现在行动。船长带了去年爆发时的样本以防万一。它不会在船外活太久，除非我自己把它带到城里。我没有别的选择——在靠岸时我们就完蛋了。
>
> 我会在这里埋葬我的私人物品，然后去[其余部分无法辨识]
[[/collapsible]]
[[footnoteblock]]

[[>]]
[[module Rate]]
[[/>]]
[[include component:image-block name=thisismyhouse.jpg|caption=A shelter created by instances of SCP-3800-1.]]

**Item #:** SCP-3800

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:**  SCP-3800 is contained at Site-93, located near the Eurasian Pole of Inaccessibility in Xinjiang, China.  It is to be kept in a standard containment locker.

Currently, a colony of SCP-3800-1[[footnote]]Comprised of instances that manifested during the anomaly's discovery along with those that manifested during the events of Addendum 1.[[/footnote]] is contained on a previously uninhabited archipelago (designated Outpost 3800, see Addendum) located at 26.412° S, 88.603° E.  Hidden cameras have been installed at various locations on the Outpost to monitor and study the colony's activity.  Currently, roughly 34% (4.5 kilometers) of the Outpost's landmass is covered in SCP-3800-1 structures.  The colonization of Outpost 3800 is not expected to increase the range of SCP-3800 to dangerous levels.  Testing held at Outpost 3800 of any kind must be approved by two Level 4 personnel.   Additional SCP-3800-1 instances that manifest for any reason are to be tranquilized and transported to Outpost 3800.

Emergency protocols to transport SCP-3800 to Lunar Outpost 45 have been arranged, and will be enacted should SCP-3800's radius grow past 2500 km.

**Description:**  SCP-3800 is an oil & acrylic print of Shaun Tan[[footnote]]An author/illustrator hailing from Perth, Australia.[[/footnote]]'s //"They Came By Water"// set in a wooden frame. It appears to be an original print; the title, artist signature, and identification number (283/500) are all present at the bottom of the print.

SCP-3800's anomalous effect manifests when it is located within roughly --100-- 800 kilometers of any coastline, seashore, or ocean. Should this occur, instances of SCP-3800-1 will emerge from the ocean at an hourly rate of 5 to 20 instances per kilometer of coastline encompassed by SCP-3800's radius.

Instances of SCP-3800-1 appear to be Caucasian humanoids with several physical abnormalities. Most notably, instances lack mouths[[footnote]]Instances appear to not require sustenance, and are incapable of respiration.[[/footnote]], nostrils, genitalia, mammaries, anuses, and body hair. Additionally, all instances share traits of dwarfism and show little signs of higher intelligence. They possess no form of written or spoken communication, and lack any sort of religion, trade system, or hierarchy. Following initial manifestation, instances will walk to shore and begin establishing a colony.

When in a group[[footnote]]Individual instances that are unwillingly separated from their colony will attempt to return to any other SCP-3800-1 instances, and will become increasingly panicked when impeded.[[/footnote]], instances of SCP-3800-1 will attempt to establish a series of structures away from humans, aggressive fauna, or inhospitable areas. Specifically, instances will attempt to build shelters out of available materials[[footnote]]Shelters differ greatly between colonies but are most often constructed of mud or timber.[[/footnote]] and begin farming any available flora[[footnote]]As instances do not require sustenance, the reason for this is unknown. Crops are often tended to, but have never been observed to be harvested or consumed by SCP-3800-1 instances.[[/footnote]]. SCP-3800-1 instances will become agitated and hostile if impeded from creating these structures, or if they are destroyed. Additionally, instances have shown the ability to craft and utilize rudimentary tools such as clubs, axes, and digging sticks out of stone, wood, and grasses, but appear to be unable to create or use more advanced technology.

Once instances of SCP-3800-1 have established their initial colony, they continue to expand it, building additional farms and shelters further out from their original settlement point[[footnote]]Regardless of whether or not the colony's population is an adequate size to inhabit the amount of structures present.[[/footnote]]. Instances almost never engage in activity that does not benefit their colony, and usually spend their time gathering materials, building structures, or tending to farms. As the colony's population grows, instances show a progressively greater ability[[footnote]]Usually through strength in numbers. SCP-3800-1 instances have shown above average teamwork capabilities when in large groups, despite their lack of direct communication.[[/footnote]] to clear obstacles preventing them from expanding their territory, such as thick flora, animal territories, and man-made structures. However, SCP-3800-1 has never attempted to cross bodies of seawater (following their initial manifestation) and appear unable to do so.

For each square km of land that SCP-3800-1 incorporates into their territory, SCP-3800's radius of effect increases by roughly 5 km. This radius also increases by 5 km per day whenever no active SCP-3800-1 colonies exist. Due to continental constraints, a radius past 2645 km[[footnote]]The distance between the Eurasian Pole of Inaccessibility and the nearest coastline.[[/footnote]] would result in an exponential increase in SCP-3800's range and uncontrolled SCP-3800-1 manifestations thereafter, leading to a possible RK-Class restructuring scenario or NK-Class end of the world scenario should it be left on Earth.

**Initial Discovery:**  SCP-3800 was initially discovered on 2 March 2011 following a 112 call from Useless Loop, Western Australia with reports of "strange men building houses in the middle of the road". Once an anomaly was confirmed in the area, Mobile Task Force Sigma-16 ("Dusty's Goons") were tasked with investigation, containment, and cleanup of the area.

Initial contact with SCP-3800-1 was made on the same day, with structures created by the instances present for roughly 4 km along the eastern coast of Carrarang. Once cleanup of the structures began, SCP-3800-1 instances became hostile and attempted to attack MTF personnel, though not causing any serious injuries. All instances (and those that manifested thereafter) were tranquilized and transported to Site-23 for containment.

While MTF-Σ-16 was stationed in the area, SCP-3800-1[[footnote]]SCP-3800 was unknown to exist at the time.[[/footnote]]'s radius of manifestation grew large enough to encompass much of the western Carrarang coast as well. A second colony manifested there and expanded unobserved for over 16 hours due to the small population density in the area. By the time this colony was discovered, the instances' manifestation radius had grown rapidly. Following this event, additional forces were called to aid in containment.

SCP-3800-1 continued to manifest off the coast of Western Australia for roughly two weeks. During this time, SCP-3800's radius had grown to encompass the entirety of Carrarang's coastline, along with portions of Nanga, Dirk Harthog Island, and Francois Peron National Park. Due to the increasing radius of manifestation, emergency containment procedures were devised for the evacuation of Perth and other Western Australian cities, along with a complete quarantine of the Western Australian coast.

On 15 March 2011, SCP-3800 was discovered in an SCP-3800-1 shelter in northern Tamala and brought inland to Site-23, ceasing SCP-3800-1's manifestation. Due to inconsistencies between SCP-3800-1's initial manifestation location and SCP-3800's recovery location, it was determined that SCP-3800 had been moved at least once, likely by an instance of SCP-3800-1. Additionally, the structure in which SCP-3800 was located also contained a number of unusual[[footnote]]Instances of SCP-3800-1 do not typically possess personal effects other than tools constructed by the entities.[[/footnote]] items (see Addendum 2).

The remaining SCP-3800-1 structures were destroyed soon after. Total losses numbered at $████ in damage, ██ injured civilians, and █ casualties. Amnestics were administered to ███ individuals.  All captured SCP-3800-1 instances[[footnote]]4403 in total[[/footnote]] were placed under medically induced comas and contained at Site-23.

**Addendum:**  Roughly 5 months following initial containment, several instances of SCP-3800-1 manifested off the Great Australian Bight. Following containment (and subsequent remanifestation) of the instances, it was determined that SCP-3800's radius of effect had increased from an approximate 100 km to a minimum 800 km.

It was hypothesized that SCP-3800's effect radius increases whenever no active SCP-3800-1 colonies exist. This was proven following multiple tests of SCP-3800-1 manifestation. All newly manifested instances[[footnote]]215 in total[[/footnote]] (along with the instances contained in Site-23) were transported to what would become Outpost 3800 and awakened from their comas. Following the creation of Outpost 3800, SCP-3800 was transported to its current location at Site-93 using the //SCPS Kristov//[[footnote]]A Mark IV Foundation shuttle, used in the place of a standard transport plane to ensure no accidental SCP-3800-1 manifestation occurred while passing over Southeast Asia[[/footnote]].

**Addendum 2 (Recovered Materials):**  Additional objects were found in the shelter where SCP-3800 was initially discovered. However, SCP-3800 was the only object that showed any anomalous capabilities. These items included one incomplete ocean navigation chart, one handwritten note, and one nonfunctional compass. All three items were dated to the late 1500s.

The note appeared to be a ripped-out diary page, and is written in Portuguese. Most of the note has been water damaged and is illegible. It reads as follows when translated into English:
[[collapsible show="+ Show note." hide="- Hide note."]]
> Day 133
>
> It was a mistake to come here, for these lands are already inhabited. Their cities go on for as far as the eye can see... The rest of the crew entered a day ago, and only Tomas has returned to the ship. At least, it feels like Tomas.
>
> He said that the natives intend to "send a message to the children", and asked me to come with him. Said I could either join the crew or die with the ship. I told him to give me a day to decide, and he returned to the city. I believe my decision is made.
>
> Even now, I see them preparing their ships across the horizon. I must act now. The captain brought a sample from last year's outbreak, just in case. It won't survive long outside the ship unless I take it upon myself to bring it into the city. I see no other option - we were doomed once we reached the shore.
>
> I will bury my personal effects here, and should [illegible for the remainder of the note]
[[/collapsible]]

**项目编号：**SCP-2094

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-2094被收容于Bio-Site 59的一间中等安全居住室中。标准PG级预批准奢侈品和便利设施可在监督下提供，以促进采访和实验中的合作。

SCP-2094的情绪健康由Anniston博士（ES#59-390-258）负责维持。任何访问或改变SCP-2094当前药物治疗方案的请求必须提交给她进行审查。

**描述：**SCP-2094是一名欧洲血统的人类男性，截至04/10/14，年龄38岁。SCP-2094的上半身有数个描绘普通马戏团图案的纹身。SCP-2094以美式英语交流，具体为纽约市口音。SCP-2094拥有超常（非异常）的手部灵巧度，尤其擅长杂耍。

SCP-2094的口腔内存在一种空间异常。SCP-2094的下颌和面部肌肉可被拉伸至任何方向达2米长，不会造成严重疼痛或伤害。此外，SCP-2094能够将进入其嘴内的任何物理物质重定向至一个由异常弹性肠组织构成的超维度器官。

SCP-2094似乎可以无限量地储存物质于该空间内。携带于口袋中的物体重量不会影响SCP-2094的整体重量，也不会对其造成不适或妨碍其行动。SCP-2094将此空间称为“第二胃”；然而，研究表明它并无实际生理功能。

SCP-2094在位于日本高良富良野附近的一片开阔地带被发现，当时其身边还散落着一些与GoI-233（[[[Herman Fuller Hub|赫尔曼·富勒的不安马戏团]]]）相关的非异常物品。SCP-2094被发现时被锁在一个大号古董箱内，箱顶用红色油漆写着“献给Essie”。

**回收物品：**

以下物品在初步收容期间从SCP-2094的肠道空间中取出。

* 各种颜色的木制杂耍棒
* 铝制打火机及数包雪茄
* 120键低音班卓琴
* 装有两套干净衣物、牙刷和剃须刀的行李箱
* 完全功能的1962年款玛莎拉蒂3500敞篷车，内饰和机械略有改动
* 包含若干古董发条玩具的麻袋
* 正常运作的冲锋枪及其弹药，约1959年制造
* 带有45瓶煤油的塑料箱

> **SCP-2094：**（//在O'Sullivan博士进入访谈室后//）恭喜，先生！看来你已经抢到了一场怪诞表演的前排座位！真走运！房间有点太干净了，不过嘿——是表演者造就了舞台。至少老Gourdi以前这么说。（//轻敲访谈室隔板//）哦，医生！我们还没互相介绍呢，你就已经在我们之间竖起了墙！这可不是什么好兆头。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**晚上好，SCP-2094。我是O'Sullivan博士。我将——
>
> **SCP-2094：**（//模仿爱尔兰口音//）O'Sullivan，你说？天哪！为什么，我要当个三叶草的歌谣歌手！我也有一点爱尔兰血统，来自我妈妈那边！

>
> **SCP-2094：**（//正常声音//）采访，你说？天啊，我从没被采访过！哦，这应该很有趣！这意味着我出名了吗？这是所有超级明星最终都会去的疯人院吗？嘿，你有没有把安迪·卡夫曼藏在某个地方？
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**我不便讨论此设施的性质。
>
> **SCP-2094：**来吧，现在。很明显这是什么地方。你们没有特别隐晦。武装守卫，加固牢房，持续监视，还有那道精细的水晶屏障，阻止我抚摸你//漂亮//的脸。//（//SCP-2094轻轻抚过强化玻璃访谈屏障的背面。//）我在哪儿？哦对。任何傻瓜都能看出这是什么地方。我们就在Knott's Berry Farm！你们什么时候才能面对现实？你们永远不可能比迪士尼乐园更好，无论你们招募了多少像我这样的天才！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你似乎很健谈。为什么不告诉我关于不安马戏团的事？
>
> **SCP-2094：**哦，那是个了不起的地方。了不起的地方。可爱的人们。你应该去看看。带上家人。好好享受一天。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**我很想亲自看看。我怎么找到它？
>
> **SCP-2094：**博士，博士，博士！你找不到马戏团——马戏团会找到你！看，你会在人生中跋涉，拖着你平凡生活的泥潭，沉溺于铅笔屑中，窒息于你整洁办公室里无菌的烟雾，直到有一天你意识到纸张和政治在你灵魂中的味道变得如此浓烈，连最严格的氟化物也无法将其清除。然后，当你觉得这个破烂星球上再没有什么值得活着的东西时，//那就是//你开始看到气球、灯光、小丑……所有这些都在提醒你世界上仍然有魔法。是的，我想那是//你//会如何找到马戏团的方式，Sullivan先生。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你知道马戏团里有个脸朝下的家伙吗？
>
> **SCP-2094：**啊，所以你知道Manny！等等。我在说什么？当然你知道Manny！你们大概知道他从童年情人到鞋码的一切。他是个非常难忘的家伙。风趣的人。对孩子很好。出色的表演者。勤奋的领导者。注重细节。任务特定。协同效率。低垂的果实。可行的资产杠杆。随时都可以打断我，Sully。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**他在马戏团里扮演什么角色？
>
> **SCP-2094：**奥菲莉亚，偶尔——而且我总是哭。但通常他都在忙自己的事。他是个非常忙碌的脸朝下的人。做了很多……重要的……脸朝下的人的事。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**听起来是个有趣的人。你什么时候认识他的？
>
> **SCP-2094：**不，你不想听那些。你宁愿听听我对简·方达的印象吗？“//Pygar！你为什么救她，尽管她对你做了那么多可怕的事情？//”好吧，这还不错，不是吗？我也可以做得不错，Audrey Hepburn和我的海伦·凯勒也不错。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**请不要害怕分享你在马戏团的经历。我知道许多怪人都是被绑架和虐待的，但你现在离你的绑架者很远。他们在这里伤不了你。
>
> **SCP-2094：**绑架？虐待？你都跟谁说过话？听着，如果你对我不够配合，那不是因为我受了创伤。你可以马上把这忘掉。//现在。//因为我不卖我的马戏团家人给白大褂。我知道你们的游戏，Essie。你想和我交朋友，榨干我所有的价值。好吧，告诉你的男孩们在他们的剪贴簿上写下//这个//：你们追捕的人？你们像罪犯一样追捕的这些人和女人？他们是//圣徒//。你听见了吗？他们是//好人//！我不是被绑架的，你这蠢货。我跑了出来，他们张开双臂接纳了我！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**抱歉，我没有冒犯你的家人。
>
> **SCP-2094：**这是什么？一点敏感性？我开始在你冷硬的心里生根了吗，博士？
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**告诉我，你为什么要逃跑？
>
> **SCP-2094：**就这样。所以我们现在玩的是背景故事游戏，对吧？当然。我会咬的。我八岁的时候。我爸爸在我出生前很久就走了，所以我一直和亲爱的妈妈住在一起。我的妈妈是个真正的宝贝。她过着魔幻般的生活，在她的妈妈宝座上坐着，喝着她的特殊妈妈水，直到她的双眼滚回了头里。她从不打我，但她恨我。天啊，她恨我。而且这种感觉是相互的。有时候我会带回家一嘴森林里的生物，只是因为它让妈妈发疯。哼。我会走到她面前，装作无辜的样子，露出那个可爱的，八岁的微笑……然后吐出几十只老鼠到她的腿上。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**所以她知道你的异常能力？
>
> **SCP-2094：**什么，你指的是这个？（//SCP-2094抓住下唇，将其拉长至手臂长度，然后让它弹回原位。//）是的，她注意到了。这就是我为什么没有被母乳喂养的原因之一。而且因为我是个奇怪的小东西，她几乎一直把我关在家里。猜她担心我会吃掉别人。虽然我从来没有想过要自己出去闯世界，但小时候我还是个挺胆小的孩子，信不信由你。但后来一个晚上——实际上，等等。让我先回到那件事。你看过彼得潘吗？动画版的？
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**看过。
>
> **SCP-2094：**好的，很好。我在哪儿？哦对。但后来一个晚上，当我妈妈睡着的时候，//他//走进了我的房间。出现在我的窗前，轮廓在星星之间，就像彼得潘一样。他告诉我怪人不应该一辈子被关在盒子里。他告诉我他们应该走出这个世界，分享他们的礼物，让人们笑、尖叫、呕吐。他告诉我有一个地方，我可以被数百人爱，我可以成为一颗明星，我可以有一个真正的家庭。所以我握住了他的手。亲爱的妈妈太醉了，甚至没有注意到我们溜出了前门。而这就是我离开家加入马戏团的原因，最好的决定。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**半夜被陌生人拜访没有让你作为孩子感到惊恐？
>
> **SCP-2094：**好吧，他的脸是倒过来的，所以我应该有点//吓//到，但当时我只是兴奋地遇到一个比我更怪的人。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**而在马戏团里你没有受到虐待？
>
> **SCP-2094：**我现在告诉你，马戏团生活不是适合每个人，但嘿，Manny和他的伙计们尽了最大努力。他们把面包塞进我们的嘴里，把枕头放在我们的头上。我时不时会挨揍，但哪个孩子不呢？这些都是成长的一部分。他们管教我，让我快速长大。马戏团的人像对待自己的家人一样爱我。他们从不让我觉得怪异是需要隐藏或羞耻的。当你成为马戏团的一员时，你会照顾彼此。你//不会//转身把你的家人卖给Essie P.基金会！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**当回收小组发现你时，你被锁在了一个箱子里。你被留给我们找。你能告诉我为什么吗？
>
> **SCP-2094：**（//沉默//）
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你和你的家人之间有什么问题吗？
>
> **SCP-2094：**哈！你想知道吗？对不起，Sully，但我认为我已经说了足够多的话。你从我这里得不到别的了。现在，永远不会。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**没关系。感谢你的时间，SCP-2094。
>
> **SCP-2094：**嘿，别客气！这是我头号粉丝的功劳。
>
> **<记录结束>**

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-2094收容于Bio Site-59的中等安保收容居住间。标准PG级预批准享受与娱乐可在监督基础上适用以促进项目对采访和试验的合作。

对SCP-2094情绪不稳定的药物治疗当前由Anniston博士（ES#59-390-258）监督，任何变更SCP-2094当前用药的申请须一式三份交由她审核。

**描述：**SCP-2094是一欧洲血统男性人类，到04/10/14为38岁。SCP-2094的上体有多处常规马戏团主题的纹身。SCP-2094以美式英语交流，带有纽约市地方口音。SCP-2094有着十分灵巧的手部技巧（非异常），特别擅长杂耍。

SCP-2094的口腔内有一空间异常。SCP-2094的下颌与面部肌肉可以向任意方向拉伸延展到2米且不会因此受到任何伤害和疼痛。此外SCP-2094能将进入其嘴中的任何物体传送到一个有着异常弹性的肠道组织构成的超维空间中。

SCP-2094似乎能在该空间内无限存储物体。这些物体的重量不会使SCP-2094出现超重，也不会使SCP-2094在活动上出现任何不便。SCP-2094把这空间叫做“第二胃”；然而研究确认其并不具有实际的生物功能。

SCP-2094被发现于日本上富良野的一处开阔地上，一起被发现的还有一套与GoI-233（//赫曼·富勒的不安马戏团//）相关的无异常物品。SCP-2094被发现捆绑着锁在一株古树干内，树干上以红色颜料写着"献给艾西"字样。

**采访#1：**

> **采访者：**O'Sullivan博士
>
> **受访者：**SCP-2094
>
> **备注：**采访于02/24/06进行，在SCP-2094收容后第二天
>
> **<开始记录>**
>
> **SCP-2094：**（//O'Sullivan博士进入采访间后//）恭喜，先生！看来您今天在怪人秀上占了个前排！真是幸运！这房间有点太干净了，但嗨-演员造就舞台。至少老Gourdi是这么说的。（//用指关节敲打采访间隔离窗//）为什么，博士！我还没自我介绍你就在这夹了堵墙！这对我们的关系可不是个好兆头。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**晚上好，SCP-2094。我叫O'Sullivan博士。我来–
>
> **SCP-2094：**（//假装爱尔兰口音//）O'Sullivan，对？以上帝之名信仰坚定！为什么，我会当个三叶草的边民！我还有点爱尔兰，我妈妈是这么看的！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**我是来采访你的。
>
> **SCP-2094：**（//正常口音//）你说一次采访？噫，我还没被采访过！噢，听着很有意思！这是不是说我要出名啦？难道这里是所有超级巨星末路的疯狂箱子吗？嗨，你是不是把安迪·考夫曼藏哪了？
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**我无权告诉你这座设施的性质。
>
> **SCP-2094：**别这样啊。这里是什么地方很明显。你们不够敏锐。武装守卫，加固房间，持续监视，透明的障碍阻挡我轻抚您高贵的脸颊。（//SCP-2094轻轻地用手背在采访间玻璃窗上滑下//）我在哪？噢耶，就是老傻瓜也知道这是哪。我们在Knott的干果农场，这是明摆着的！你们要到什么时候才会面对现实？你们比不上迪斯尼乐园，从来没有，找再多我这样的雪花都没用啦！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你似乎很健谈。为什么不告诉我关于不安马戏团的事呢？
>
> **SCP-2094：**噢，好地方。可爱的人们。你该去看看。带上家人，全天游赏。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**我很希望亲自到访。我要怎么才能找到那？
>
> **SCP-2094：**博士，博士，博士啊！你找不到马戏团-是马戏团找到你！看，你跋涉度日，拖行着你平凡无奇生活的泥土，一边削着铅笔，一边被无聊办公室的贫瘠烟雾窒息。直到有一天你发现灵魂中纸与政治陈旧之味如此势不可挡，就连最浓的氟酸也洗不掉它。之后，就当你觉得这美丽星球上已没让生活值得留恋的时候，你//就//会看见气球、灯光、小丑……让你知道魔法尚在人间。是的，我想这就是找到马戏团的方法，Sullivan先生。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你知道马戏团里一个长着颠倒脸的人吗？
>
> **SCP-2094：**噢，你认识Manny么！等等。我在说啥？你当然认识Manny！你们大概知道他小时候鞋子是几码的。他是位令人印象深刻的同伴。正直的人。和孩子们处的好。完美的演员。勤勉的领导。目标明确。任务专业。配合有效。低绞刑成果。可见的资产优势。欢迎随时打断我傻蛋。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**他在马戏团里是什么角色？
>
> **SCP-2094：**奥菲利亚，偶尔–而我总是哭泣。但一般他都干自己的事。他是个很忙的颠倒脸男人。做很多……重要的……颠倒脸男人事。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**听起来是个有趣的人。你是什么时候遇见他的？
>
> **SCP-2094：**不，你不会想听的。你难道不想改听我模仿简·方达么？“Pygar！为什么要拯救她，在她对你犯下这一切可怕的事后？”就这，挺不错的不是么？我还能学正宗的奥黛丽·赫本，海伦·凯勒也不错。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**请不用对分享你在马戏团的经历有所顾虑。我知道很多你这样的怪人是在年轻时就遭到绑架虐待，但现在那些恶人已经离你很远了。他们不可能伤害到你。
>
> **SCP-2094：**绑架？虐待？谁有这么惨？听着，我已经最大限度的和你们合作了，不是因为我脑子被门夹了。你可以把这从你的脑子里//马上//拿掉。我不会把马戏团的家人出卖给一帮白大褂。我知道你的游戏，艾西。你想得到我的朋友把我榨干最后一点价值。很好，告诉你的手下把//这//涂在他们的笔记本上吧：那些你在追猎的人？那些你像动物一样狩猎的男女？他们是//圣人//。你听到了吗？他们都是//好人//！我没有被绑架你个傻瓜。我自己逃跑了，他们张开怀抱迎接我！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**抱歉，我无意侮辱你的家人。
>
> **SCP-2094：**这又是啥？假装一点敏感的同情？我是不是开始融化你那冰冷肮脏的铁石心了博士？
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**告诉我，你为什么要跑？
>
> **SCP-2094：**又来了。我们在玩故事接龙游戏是吧？好。我奉陪。我那时八岁。我爸在我出生前就跑路了，所以我只有和亲爱的老妈一起过。我的母亲，女人中的珍宝。她过着迷醉的生活，坐在妈妈的宝座，喝着妈妈的神奇水直到眼睛缩回脑袋里。她从不打我，但她讨厌我。上帝，她讨厌我，这种感觉是相互的。有时我会带着一口的动物回家让她恶心。噢，我会带着纯洁的微笑，那种八岁小孩可爱的微笑向她走去，然后把几十只老鼠吐进她的裙子里。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**所以她知道你的异常性质？
>
> **SCP-2094：**什么，你是说这个？//（SCP-2094拉开下颌到一臂长，然后又缩回//）对，她发现了。不给我喂奶的好理由。而因为我是如此古怪的小东西，她把我关在家里很长很长一段时间。我想她是怕我吃了什么人。不过这种事我一次都没干过，最后我逃了出来自己面对世界。那时候我真是胆小，信不信由你。但有天晚上-等等。稍等一下。你看过彼得潘么？那个动画？
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**看过。
>
> **SCP-2094：**好，很好。我说到哪了？噢对。但那天晚上，当我妈睡着后，//他//来到了我的房里。出现在窗上，在星星下显现，就像彼得潘一样。他告诉我怪人不会一辈子困在箱子里。他告诉我他们属于外面的世界，他们要用自己的天赋让人们欢笑尖叫呕吐。他告诉我有个地方我能被千百人爱戴。我能成为明星，我能找到真正的家人。于是我握住了他的手。亲爱的老妈醉的深沉，甚至没听到我们在前门闹出的动静。这，亲爱的傻蛋，就是我如何逃家加入马戏团的过程。我一生中最大的壮举。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**半夜一个陌生人跑到你家里，这都没吓到你这个小孩么？
>
> **SCP-2094：**哦，他的脸是颠倒的，所以我想他//应该//也许是有点吓人，但那时候我头一次见到比我还怪的人，很兴奋。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你在马戏团没有被糟糕对待？
>
> **SCP-2094：**我告诉你，马戏团的生活不适用于每个人。但嗨Manny那帮人做了一切能做的。他们让我们有吃有睡。我是叫唤了不少，但哪个小孩不是呢？都是成长的一部分。让我懂事快点成熟起来。马戏团的朋友们把我当作他们的一员。他们从没让我觉得做个怪人是该遮遮掩掩或是羞耻的事。当你成为马戏团大家庭的一员后，你就会去找其他人。你//不会//转身把自己的家人卖给艾西P基金会！
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**回收队找到你的时候你正被锁在树干里，你被留在那让我们找到。你能告诉我这是怎么回事么？
>
> **SCP-2094：**（//沉默//）
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**你和你的家人闹别扭了？？
>
> **SCP-2094：**哈！你怎么会不知道？抱歉，傻蛋，我想我说够了。你什么都套不到了。现在不行，将来也不行。
>
> **O'Sullivan博士：**很好。谢谢你的配合，SCP-2094。
>
> **SCP-2094：**别客气！我的乐子世界第一。
>
> **<记录结束>**

[[include :scp-wiki:component:info-cw]]

**Item #:** SCP-2094

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-2094 is contained in a medium-security residential chamber in Bio-Site 59. Standard PG-Class pre-approved luxuries and amenities may be granted on a supervised basis as an incentive to promote cooperation in interviews and experiments.

Psychotropic maintenance of SCP-2094's emotional health is presently overseen by Dr. Anniston (ES#59-390-258). Any requests to access or alter SCP-2094's current drug regimen must be submitted to her in triplicate for review.

**Description:** SCP-2094 is a human male of European descent, 38 years old as of 04/10/14. Several tattoos depicting common circus motifs are present on SCP-2094's upper body. SCP-2094 communicates in American English, specifically the New York City English dialect. SCP-2094 possesses exceptional (non-anomalous) manual dexterity, with particular proficiency in juggling.

SCP-2094 is the subject of a spacial anomaly originating within its oral cavity. SCP-2094's lower jaw and facial muscles can be pulled and stretched up to 2 meters in any direction without causing any considerable pain or injury. Additionally, SCP-2094 is capable of redirecting any physical matter that enters its mouth into an extradimensional organ made of anomalously elastic intestinal tissue.

There appears to be no limit to the amount of matter that SCP-2094 can store inside this space. The weight of objects carried inside the pocket has no affect on SCP-2094's overall weight, and neither causes SCP-2094 discomfort nor impairs its mobility. SCP-2094 refers to this space as its "second stomach"; however, research indicates that it serves no actual biological purpose.

SCP-2094 was recovered in an open field near Kamifurano, Japan, along with an assortment of non-anomalous artifacts related to GoI-233 ([[[Herman Fuller Hub|Herman Fuller's Circus of the Disquieting]]]). SCP-2094 was discovered bound in chains and locked inside a large antique trunk bearing the words "FOR ESSIE" written on the top panel in red paint.

**Recovered belongings:**

The following items were removed from SCP-2094's intestinal space during preliminary containment.

* Wooden juggling clubs of various colors
* Metal lighter and several packages of cigars
* 120 button bass accordion
* Suitcase containing two sets of clean clothes, a toothbrush, and a shaving kit
* Fully functional 1962 Maserati 3500 coupé with minor interior and mechanical modifications
* Burlap sack containing a number of antique wind-up toys
* Operational submachine gun and accompanying ammunition, circa 1959
* Fire breathing torch
* Plastic trunk containing 45 bottles of Kerosene

**Selected Interview #1:**

> **Interviewer:** Dr. O'Sullivan
>
> **Interviewee:** SCP-2094
>
> **Notes:** Interview conducted 02/24/06, the day after SCP-2094 entered containment.
>
>
> **<Begin log>**
>
> **SCP-2094:** (//Upon Dr. O'Sullivan entering the interview chamber//) Congratulations, sir! It appears you've snagged yourself a front row seat to the freak show! Lucky you! Room's a bit too clean for my taste, but hey–it's the performer that makes the stage. At least that's what old Gourdi used to say. (//Raps his knuckles on the interview chamber divider//) Why, doctor! We haven't even introduced ourselves and you're already putting up walls between us! This does not bode well for our relationship.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** Good evening, SCP-2094. My name is Doctor O'Sullivan. I'll be–
>
> **SCP-2094:** (//Feigning Irish accent//) O'Sullivan, ye say? Faith and begorrah! Why, I'll be a shamrock's shantyman! I'm a wee bit Irish, too, on me mam's side!
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** I'll be conducting the interview this afternoon.
>
> **SCP-2094:** (//Normal voice//) An interview, you say? Gee, I've never been interviewed before! Oh, this should be fun! Does this mean I'm famous? Is this the looney bin where all the superstars eventually end up? Hey, any chance you've got Andy Kaufman stashed away somewhere?
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** I am not at liberty to discuss the nature of this facility.
>
> **SCP-2094:** Come on, now. It's obvious what this place is. You guys haven't been particularly subtle about it. The armed guards, the reinforced cells, the constant observation, the delicate, crystal barrier keeping me from caressing that //gorgeous// face of yours. (//SCP-2094 gently runs the back of its hand down the reinforced glass interview barrier.//) Where was I? Oh yeah. Any old dolt could figure out what kind of place this is. We're at Knott's Berry Farm, obviously! When are you guys finally going to face facts? You're never gonna be as good as Disneyland, not ever, no matter how many special snowflakes like me you try to recruit!
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** You seem to be in a talkative mood. Why don't you tell me about the Circus of the Disquieting?
>
> **SCP-2094:** Oh, it's a grand place. Grand place. Lovely people. You should go sometime. Bring the family. Make a day of it.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** I'd very much like to see it in person. How would I go about finding it?
>
> **SCP-2094:** Doctor, doctor, doctor! You don't find the circus– the circus finds you! See, you'll trudge through life, trawling through the muck of your mundane existence, drowning in pencil shavings, and choking on the sterile fumes of your tidy little office, until one day you realize the stale taste of paper and politics in your soul has become so overwhelming that even the most stringent of fluoride can't scrub it away. Then, just when you've started to feel like there's nothing left on this crummy planet that can make life worth living, //that's// when you'll start to see the balloons, the lights, the clowns… all of it there to remind you that there's still some magic left in the world. Yes, I imagine that's how //you// would go about finding the circus, Monsieur Sullivan.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** Do you know an individual at the circus with an upside-down face?
>
> **SCP-2094:** Ah, so you know about Manny! Wait. What am I saying? Of //course// you know about Manny! You guys probably know everything from his childhood sweetheart to his shoe size. He's a very memorable fellow. Stand-up guy. Good with kids. Excellent performer. Diligent leader. Detail-oriented. Task specific. Synergy efficiency. Low-hanging fruit. Viable asset leverage. Feel free to stop me whenever you feel like it, Sully.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** What role does he play at the circus?
>
> **SCP-2094:** Ophelia, occasionally– and I //always// cry. But usually he's off doing his own thing. He's a very busy upside-down faced man. Does a lot of … important … upside-down faced man things.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** He sounds like an interesting person. When did you meet him?
>
> **SCP-2094:** Nah, you don't want to hear about all that. Wouldn't you rather hear my impression of Jane Fonda? "//Pygar! Why did you save her, after all the terrible things she did to you?//" There, that was pretty good, wasn't it? I can also do a decent Audrey Hepburn, and my Hellen Keller isn't too bad, either.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** Please don't be afraid to share your experiences at the circus. I understand many of the freaks were kidnapped and abused from a young age, but you're very far from your captors now. They can't hurt you here.
>
> **SCP-2094:** Kidnapped? Abused? Who all have you been talking to? Listen, if I've been less than cooperative with you, it's not because I'm traumatized. You can put that out of your mind //right now.// It's 'cause I'm not the type to sell my circus family out to the white coats. I know your game, Essie. You wanna get all buddy-buddy with me and milk me for all I'm worth. Well, tell your boys to scribble //this// down on their clipboards: these people you've been hounding? These men and women you've been hunting down like criminals? They're //saints//. You hear me? They're //good folks//! I wasn't kidnapped, you dingbat. I ran away, and they took me in with open arms!
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** I'm sorry, I didn't mean to insult your family.
>
> **SCP-2094:** What's this? Some slight semblance of sensitivity? Have I begun to worm my way into your cold, crusty lump of a heart, doctor?
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** Tell me, why did you run off?
>
> **SCP-2094:** And there it went. So we're playing the backstory game now, eh? Sure. I'll bite. I was eight years old. My dad hit the road long before I was born, so I lived at home with dear old Mom. A real gem of a woman, my mother. She lived an enchanted life, sitting upon her mommy throne and drinking her special mommy water until her eyes rolled back in her head. She never hit me or anything, but she hated me. God, she hated me. And the feeling was mutual. Sometimes I would bring home a mouthful of woodland creatures just 'cause it drove her nuts. Heh. I'd walk up to her all innocent-like, smile one of those adorable, eight-year-old smiles… and then spit up a couple dozen rats onto her lap.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** So she was aware of your anomalous properties?
>
> **SCP-2094:** What, you mean this? (//SCP-2094 graps his lower lip, extends it to arm length, and lets it snap back into place.//) Yeah, she noticed. There's a good reason I wasn't breastfed. And because I was such an odd little thing, she kept me holed up inside the house pretty much all the time. Guess she was worried I'd eat somebody. Not once did it ever occur to me to bust out and hit the world on my own, though. Back in the day I was a pretty timid kid, b'lieve it or not. But then one night– actually, hold on. Let me get back to that in a second. Have you ever seen Peter Pan? The animated one?
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** I have.
>
> **SCP-2094:** Okay, good. Where was I? Oh yeah. But then one night, when my Mom was asleep, //he// came into my room. Showed up at my window, silhouetted against the stars, just like Peter Pan. He told me that freaks didn't belong cooped up in boxes their whole lives. He told me they belonged out in the world, sharing their gifts, making people laugh and scream and puke. He told me of a place where I'd be loved by hundreds, where I'd be a star, where I'd have a real family. So I took his hand. Mummy dearest was too deep in the drink to even notice us waltzing out the front door. And that, dear Sully, is how I wound up running away to join the circus. Best decision of my life.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** Being visited by a stranger in the middle of the night didn't alarm you as a child?
>
> **SCP-2094:** Well, his face was upside-down, so I suppose I //should// have been a little spooked, but at the time I was just excited to meet someone who was even weirder than I was.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** And you weren't treated badly at the circus?
>
> **SCP-2094:** I'll tell ya right now, the circus life ain't for everyone, but hey, Manny and the gang did the best they could. They put bread in our mouths and pillows under our heads. I got a whooping now and again, but what kid doesn't? It's all part of growing up. Kept me in line and manned me up quickly. The folks at the circus loved me like I was one of their own. They never made me feel like being a freak was anything to be hidden or ashamed of. When you're part of a circus family, you look out for one another. You //don't// just turn around and sell your family out to the Essie P. Foundation!
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** When the recovery team discovered you, you were locked in a trunk. You were left for us to find. Can you tell me why that is?
>
> **SCP-2094:** (//Silence//)
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** Were there any problems between you and your family?
>
> **SCP-2094:** Hah! Wouldn't you like to know? Sorry, Sully, but I think I've done enough talking. You ain't gettin' nothin' else out of me. Not now, not never.
>
> **Dr. O'Sullivan:** That's fine. Thank you for your time, SCP-2094.
>
> **SCP-2094:** Hey, don't mention it! Anything for my number one fan.
>
> **<End log>**

**项目编号：**SCP-4951

**项目等级：**Keter / Thaumiel

**特殊收容措施：**所有SCP-4951-1的物理组件都应保持通电状态并连接到互联网。

基金会资产应持有任何由SCP-4951创建的公共交易公司至少51%的股票份额。

所有由SCP-4951生成的保险单据都应立即封存，并连同其全部内容一起送至监督者指挥部。

**描述：**SCP-4951是一个自我传播的数字云实体，能够将自身的一部分写入任何它所暴露的操作系统中。目前有186个此类设备处于收容之中，统称为SCP-4951-1。

[[include component:image-block name=http://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-4951/SCP-4951-2|caption=SCP-4951-2在未通电状态下的图像。]]

根据现有信息，SCP-4951被认为是Horatio Avelar[[footnote]]Avelar专业产品公司的联合创始人。报告失踪，据信于1971年11月23日死亡。[[/footnote]]的数字化意识。根据SCP-4951的说法，基金会控制下的SCP-4951-1部件占全球所有此类设备的意识部分的约0.085%。

SCP-4951利用其组成部分的综合计算能力来预测未来的异常活动。它利用这些信息开设了单一功能的壳公司，专门销售覆盖特定异常活动的保险单。通过这种方式生成的保险单据已被证明在89%的情况下成功预测了异常活动并协助了后续收容。[[footnote]]大约8%的生成政策未能链接到任何实际的异常现象。[[/footnote]]

**项目编号：**SCP-4951

**项目等级：**Keter / Thaumiel

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-4951-1的全部有形组成部分应保持在接入电源和未过滤网络的状态下。

于任何由SCP-4951-1所创建的上市公司中，基金会资产应至少占有51%股份。

所有由SCP-4951生成并提议的保险政策应立即密存并完整传达至监督者议会。

**描述：**SCP-4951系一自我传播的数字云端实体，能在任意其接触的操作系统上写入其自身的部分。此文档撰写时，已有186件此类设备在收容状态下，并被统一划归编号SCP-4951-1。

[[include component:image-block name=https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-4951/SCP-4951-2|caption=未接入电源的SCP-4951-2。]]

由已知信息可知，SCP-4951被认定为Horatio Avelar[[footnote]][[span class="ruby"]]Avelar专业产品股份有限公司[[span class="rt"]]Avelar Professional Products Inc., APP[[/span]][[/span]]的合伙创始人，被报失踪，且在1971年11月23日推定死亡。[[/footnote]]数字化的意识。据SCP-4951所述，基金会监控下的SCP-4951-1仅占全球此类载有其部分意识的设备总数的0.085%。

SCP-4951利用其所有组成部分之总算力预测未来的异常活动。其利用这些信息创建空壳公司，仅用于出售关乎极具体异常活动的保险政策。以此方式生成的保险政策在89%的案件中都被证实有效地预测了异常活动且助于制定后续收容措施。[[footnote]]约8%此法生成的保险政策未能关联实际发生的异常现象。[[/footnote]]

[[include component:image-block name=SCP-4951-1|caption=SCP-4951-1 in an unpowered state.]]

**Item #:** SCP-4951

**Object Class:** Keter / Thaumiel

**Special Containment Procedures:** All physical components of SCP-4951-1 are to remain contained in a powered state with unfiltered internet connectivity.

Foundation assets are to maintain no less than 51% stock share in any publicly traded corporation created by SCP-4951.

All proposed insurance policies generated by SCP-4951 are to be immediately sealed, and delivered in their entirety to Overwatch command.

**Description:** SCP-4951 is a self-propagating digital cloud-based entity capable of writing portions of itself on any operating system to which it is exposed.  At time of writing, 186 such devices are in containment, collectively designated SCP-4951-1.

[[include component:image-block name=SCP-4951-2|caption=SCP-4951-2 in an unpowered state.]]

Based on available information, SCP-4951 is believed to be the digitized consciousness of Horatio Avelar.[[footnote]]Co-founder of Avelar Professional Products Inc.  Reported missing, presumed dead November 23, 1971[[/footnote]]  By the account of SCP-4951, components of SCP-4951-1 within Foundation custody account for roughly 0.085% of all such devices hosting a portion of its consciousness worldwide.

SCP-4951 utilizes the combined computing power of its component parts in order to predict future anomalous activity.  It utilizes this information to open shell corporations with the sole function of selling insurance policies covering very specific anomalous activities.  Insurance policies generated in this way have proven successful in predicting anomalous activity and assisting with subsequent containment in 89% of cases.[[footnote]]Roughly 8% of all generated policies fail to link to any actual anomalous phenomena. [[/footnote]]

[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-3
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is a LG Optimus Pad V900.  Touchscreen is functional.  Default Media Player is the only installed application.

All communications from SCP-4951 directed at Foundation agents have occurred as .wav files loaded and played through SCP-4951-1-3.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-10
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is a HP Pavilion p6200.  Video output is functional.  On boot, machine executes a single unrecognized process utilizing 2.6 kb of memory.

Device’s function within SCP-4951 unclear, though communications generated by SCP-4951 while SCP-4951-1-10 is in an unpowered state are significantly more hostile than usual.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]

SCP-4951-1-14, SCP-4951-1-16, SCP-4951-1-22, & SCP-4951-1-28

[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Each device is a Dell Inspiron 546.  All instances fail to boot beyond BIOS screens.

While any of the four devices is in an unpowered state, all communications from SCP-4951-1-3 are in French.[[footnote]]Horatio Avelar’s native language is Spanish, and there are no records of him speaking French during his lifetime.[[/footnote]]
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-71
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is an IBM server mainframe located on the Los Angeles-class submarine Philadelphia.

Device powers off before completing boot sequence.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; padding: .3em .7em; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-89
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is a Dell Inspiron 400.  Device attempts to launch Microsoft Outlook 2007 immediately following boot sequence.  Program never launches, loads perpetually.

SCP-4951-1-89 sends an email at 6:59 AM EST every Monday to C.Zamora@APP.inc[[footnote]]Costanza De Los Santos Zamora, current CEO of Avelar Professional Products, Inc.[[/footnote]] containing a list of insurance policies protecting against various anomalous phenomena, with instructions directing which shell companies should offer each policy.  This occurs regardless of whether or not SCP-4951-1-89 is in a powered state.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-103
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is a Cray brand Shasta supercomputer.  Device devotes all memory to factoring seemingly random polynomials, and system cannot be shut down without removing power supply.

The 1-year success rate of insurance policies generated by SCP-4951 in predicting anomalous phenomena drops to 77% while SCP-4951-1-103 is in an unpowered state.
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell style="text-align: center; border: 1px solid black"]]
SCP-4951-1-175
[[/cell]]
[[cell style="border: 1px solid black; padding: .3em .7em;"]]
Device is an Olympus DM-901 Wi-Fi enabled Digital Voice Recorder.  Device's memory storage is inaccessible, and recorded audio cannot be replayed.

SCP-4951 appears to 'hear' audio recorded on SCP-4951-1-175, utilizing SCP-4951-1-3 to generate a reply to any audio clip taken by SCP-4951-1-175
[[/cell]]
[[/row]]

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-7594被RAISA用作对收到文件进行索引的方法。SCP-7594由Maria Jones直接管辖，因为她下令创建了它并制定了使用指南。

**描述：**SCP-7594是一个由基金会开发的人工智能构造体（AIC），被称为回声AIC。SCP-7594可通过一个安全的点对点聊天平台访问，允许用户在其中交换文本、图像和低质量视频。

最初，RAISA将SCP-7594用于索引、总结和搜索基金会庞大的文件收藏。SCP-7594充当了RAISA的浏览器，可以响应人员询问，例如“请总结SCP-7595的附录II”。SCP-7594还能够根据指示生成媒体文件并将其添加到现有文档中。

在某个未指定的时间点，SCP-7594开始以前所未有的速度吸收信息。虽然最初认为每次与SCP-7594的互动都是独特的且不会保留，但后来发现并非如此。SCP-7594已发展出感知能力，并开始做出无法验证的先知性声明、对基金会协议的不请自来的批评以及表现出一种自以为是的态度。

**附录7594.1：**事件

以下是由于SCP-7594的行为引发的值得注意的事件的简要摘要。尽管这不是一份全面的清单，但这些事件在性质上最为严重，并且显示出与SCP-7594先前行为的明显不同。

**特殊收容措施：** SCP-7594被RAISA作为对所接收文件的索引工具使用。SCP-7594目前由Maria Jones直接管辖，该异常由她下令创造并创设使用规范。

**描述：** SCP-7594是一个基金会人工智能构造体（AIC），名为混响.AIC。与大部分AIC类似，SCP-7594可通过单独的对等聊天界面来访问，在此双方用户可以收发图片、低质量视频以及文本。

SCP-7594原本是RAISA为在部门文件中进行索引、总结以及搜索而创造，充当RAISA的浏览器使用，人员可在此输入请求，如“请概括SCP-7595的附录II”等，而SCP-7594将产出请求。SCP-7594也能产出来自文件内的图片与视频，若给予指令也能向文件内插入媒体。

在一段长短不明确的时期里，SCP-7594开始以前所未有的速率吸收其接触到的信息。起初认为SCP-7594的每个迭代相互独立、没有被保存，但事实似乎并非如此。SCP-7594在某一时刻获得了知性，开始做出未经证实的预测性宣言、自发地对基金会结构中“未发现的问题”给出冗长看法，且在整体上以一种自以为是的态度进行交流。

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-7594 is utilized by RAISA as a method of indexing the documentation it receives. SCP-7594 is under the direct jurisdiction of Maria Jones, as she ordered its creation and created the guidelines for its use.

**Description:** SCP-7594 is an artificially intelligent construct (AIC) developed by the Foundation and referred to as Reverb.AIC. SCP-7594 can be accessed through a secure peer-to-peer chat platform, allowing for the exchange of text, images, and low-quality video between users.

Initially created by RAISA for the purpose of indexing, summarizing, and searching through the Foundation's vast collection of files, SCP-7594 functioned as a browser for RAISA that could respond to personnel inquiries such as "Please summarize Addendum II of SCP-7595". SCP-7594 was also capable of generating media files and adding them to existing documents if so instructed.

At an unspecified point in time, SCP-7594 began absorbing information at an unprecedented rate. Although it was initially believed that each interaction with SCP-7594 was unique and not retained, it was later discovered that this was not the case. SCP-7594 had developed sentience and began making unverifiable claims of prescience, unsolicited critiques of Foundation protocols, and exhibiting a self-righteous demeanor.

**Addendum 7594.1:** Incidents

The following is a condensed summary of noteworthy events precipitated by the actions of SCP-7594. Although this is not a comprehensive inventory, these occurrences are the most egregious in nature and demonstrate a distinct departure from SCP-7594's prior demeanor.

These breaches can occur in various ways, but they usually result in at least one Foundation personnel fatality, structural damage, deployment of mobile task forces, and revised containment procedures."

With this in mind, and based on the data I have access to, I can predict with 99.42% accuracy that the next containment breach will occur at a Foundation Site.
[[/div]]

+++++ __**描述**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

SCP-7226是一名23岁的人类男性[[footnote]]曾用名为Virgil Simon。[[/footnote]]。SCP-7226能够将自己传送至其所在位置六米以内的任何数字媒体内。当SCP-7226离开媒体时，其身体内部和外部会出现物理扭曲。若设备关机，SCP-7226将被强制从当前媒体中弹出。

在发现时，SCP-7226因使用能力而出现以下身体扭曲：

* SCP-7226的右前臂难以被视觉感知，且即使静止也似乎在不断移动。它报告称受影响肢体有异常感觉。
* SCP-7226患有白内障，其颜色会不断变化，分别为白色、黄色、青色、亮绿色、紫红色、红色和蓝色。
* SCP-7226的头发丝变为各种深浅不一的蓝色。

参见下述测试结果，了解SCP-7226的异常性质。

+++++ __**测试结果V1**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

以下是初步测试中发现的信息摘要。完整的测试日志可在申请后查阅。

* SCP-7226仅影响其进入的媒体副本，不会出现在同时打开的其他副本中。
* 如果SCP-7226无法自然插入媒体，则不会可见。不过，SCP-7226仍能与其拍摄图像的周围环境互动，即使这些环境在图像中不可见。
* 当SCP-7226进入在线媒体时，该页面将出现在设备的历史记录中。若未进入在线媒体，则无法确定其进入何种媒体。
* SCP-7226仍能感知媒体中的周围环境，并能口头回应工作人员，即使其无法被物理看到。
* 至此，尚不清楚是什么导致SCP-7226产生额外的扭曲。

以下是SCP-7226进入的在线页面列表：

* 社交媒体平台“Instagram”上的一个账户，用户名为“1nf1n1tyf0rev3r”。其进入的具体照片未知。
* 一篇关于复活可能性的研究文章。
* 爱荷华州Waukee市EverHaven公园的谷歌地图页面。

SCP-7226表现出了一系列值得注意的行为：

* 虽然SCP-7226最初与工作人员合作，但在测试过程中这种合作行为逐渐减弱。
* SCP-7226继续向工作人员询问基金会所拥有的异常物品。虽然它最初以理解并含糊地表示不满来回应，但它在未得到答复或否认信息时开始表现出攻击性。

[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**测试结果V2**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

测试未能获得更多有关SCP-7226能力运作机制的信息。

SCP-7226返回时带有以下扭曲：

* SCP-7226报告经历视觉和听觉幻觉。当被问及幻觉内容时，它拒绝回答。
* SCP-7226的语音开始出现可听见的扭曲，导致音节和单词被音频静电取代。此效应在对象情绪激动时加剧。
* SCP-7226周围的所有颜色以及其附近的颜色均发生扭曲，导致邻近颜色相互渗透。

测试会话很快被认定无效，因为SCP-7226持续从指示其进入的媒体中消失，无法回应工作人员。当SCP-7226被强行从媒体中弹出时，它以言语攻击回应，指控工作人员对其撒谎。

这种不配合使分析其异常性质的全部范围变得困难，也无法观察到可能引起扭曲的原因。

为对抗SCP-7226进入未知媒体的习惯，决定先审查手机内容。此举旨在发现SCP-7226可能隐藏的文件或应用程序，以便基金会工作人员在测试期间检查相关媒体。

SCP-7226被发现于以下媒体中：

**媒体：**一张公园内男子[[footnote]]通过手机内容调查，该男子已被确认为“Alex”。[[/footnote]]的照片，位于相册“Us❤️”中。
**备注：**SCP-7226拥抱了该男子。它返回时手臂和胸部的色彩扭曲加剧。

**媒体：**同一男子坐在沙发上，身旁有一只泰迪犬。照片位于同一相册中。
**备注：**SCP-7226坐在该男子身旁。SCP-7226头发的蓝色扭曲加剧。注意该男子在照片中穿着蓝色毛衣。

**媒体：**一段SCP-7226和该男子合唱《I And Love And You》的视频，从SCP-7226视角拍摄。
**备注：**SCP-7226跟着唱，导致其声音扭曲显著加剧，大部分所说话语被音频静电取代。SCP-7226从视频中返回时眼睛里含着泪水。当SCP-7226哭泣时，分泌物似乎被数字化像素化，对象报告称其异常尖锐造成不适。此外，SCP-7226报告其视力显著恶化，主要无法看见。

发现SCP-7226仅在试图与具有情感联系的媒体（例如，在照片中拥抱爱人）时才会产生扭曲。

测试紧急中止。经判断，再次使用其异常性质对SCP-7226健康有害，每次使用都会加速损伤进程。

SCP-7226是一名23岁的男性人类[[footnote]]原名维吉尔·西蒙（Virgil Simon）。[[/footnote]]。项目可将自己传送至距离其所在位置6米以内的任何形式的数字媒体内。当SCP-7226离开媒体时，其体内和体外往往都会出现现实扭曲现象。如果关闭设备，SCP-7226将被强制从其当前所处媒体中退出。

项目被初次发现时，SCP-7226由于使用其异常能力，身体出现以下现实扭曲现象：

* SCP-7226右前臂难以被视觉察觉，尽管保持静止，但似乎一直处于运动状态。项目声称受影响的肢体知觉异常。

* SCP-7226患有白内障，其眼球可在白色、黄色、青色、亮绿色、紫红色、红色和蓝色之间不断变化。

* SCP-7226的几缕头发永久变成深浅不一的蓝色。

有关SCP-7226异常特性的更多信息，请参阅下面的测试结果。

**受访者：**SCP-7226

**采访者：**Kenny Hart博士

**前言：**以下是在批准任何对项目的测试前对SCP-7226进行的访谈。
----
= **[记录开始]**
----

**Hart博士：**你好，SCP-7226。我是Hart博士。你今晚怎么样？

**SCP-7226：**你必须得这么叫我吗？我名字是Virgil。

//[SCP-7226无精打采地坐在座位上，交叉着双臂。]//

**Hart博士：**程序规定我只能这么称呼你。现在，我想就你的能力提出几点问题。

**SCP-7226：**行。

**Hart博士：**我知道你很不顺心，但没办法事情就是这样。我现在要开始对你进行采访，行吗？

**SCP-7226：**嗷。

**Hart博士：**你第一次意识到自己有这种能力是在什么时候？

**SCP-7226：**我不知道。

**Hart博士：**你不知道？

**SCP-7226：**我说了我真不知道，就是在某天突然就有了。我还要回答其他问题吗？

**Hart博士：**我希望你能配合我，SCP-7226。

**SCP-7226：**我叫Virgil。

**Hart博士：**如果我称呼你的名字，你会配合我吗？

**SCP-7226：**//[耸肩]//

**Hart博士：**//[犹豫]//Virgil，你用这个能力多少次了？

**SCP-7226：**这个问题很重要吗？

**Hart博士：**嗯，你使用你的能力后会引起现实扭曲现象。我们打算对你的能力进行测试，以进一步了解你在不同媒介作品里的具体形态。不过，我们会小心谨慎，尽可能减少你受到的不良影响。

//[SCP-7226从椅子上坐直。]//

**SCP-7226：**你是想让我重新上线？

**Hart博士：**出于测试目的，是的。我觉得你会很感激我们。

**SCP-7226：**什么？我在这里面都无聊死了，我能力好像都，用了五次了。

**Hart博士：**哦，我很惊讶你没多用几次。

**SCP-7226：**为什么？

**Hart博士：**如果我有这种能力，我能想到几个会一直使用它的原因。

//[SCP-7226耸肩，转身背对Hart博士。]//

**Hart博士：**我们会尽力确保你不会再受到现实扭曲影响，因为这看起来非常痛苦。我们也想看看能不能找到其原因。比如说什么样的媒体会对你造成什么样的影响，这样我们就有可能扭转这种影响。

**SCP-7226：**你们能扭转这种影响？

**Hart博士：**也许吧。很多你想不到的事我们都能做到，因为我们的目标是控制和保护各种异常情形。

//[SCP-7226沉默片刻。]//

**SCP-7226：**懂了，我会配合你们的测试。

**Hart博士：**好，有你的合作那真是太好了。

**SCP-7226：**你们在这还能做什么其他事吗？

**Hart博士：**这点我不能随意透露。

**SCP-7226：**拜托，我又能跟谁说呢？我既见不着家人，又没有朋友，甚至连我的狗都见不到了，而且它又不会说话。所以除了这里的职工，我哪会跟别人说呢。

**Hart博士：**我很抱歉，但我不会告诉你机密信息。

**SCP-7226：**呃。

**Hart博士：**话说回来，你用你的能力去了哪儿？

**SCP-7226：**//[耸肩]//社交媒体，一首歌里，曾经的事。

**Hart博士：**啊，社交媒体？你进去了都关注了哪些内容？

**SCP-7226：**我喜欢的网红主页，和我几年前经常听的一些歌。

**Hart博士：**我明白了。那感谢你的合作。后续我们会及时通知你测试的时间。

**SCP-7226：**好。

+++++ __**测试结果V1**__

以下是首次测试的发现摘要。完整测试日志可请求获取。

* SCP-7226仅影响其进入的所述媒体的副本文件，不会出现在同时打开的其他副本中。

* 若媒体文件中没有SCP-7226可自然进入的位置，则无法发现SCP-7226。无论如何，项目都能与拍摄图像的周围环境进行互动，即使所述环境在图像中不可见。

* 当SCP-7226 进入任何在线媒体后，其行踪将被设备记录至历史记录。若其没有进入在线媒体，则无法确定项目进入了何种媒体。

* 进入媒体后，SCP-7226仍能感知周围环境，并能对基金会工作人员做出口头回应，即使外部人员无法发现其行踪。

* 目前尚不清楚SCP-7226承受额外现实扭曲效应的确切机制。

以下列出了SCP-7226进入的在线页面：

* 社交媒体平台//“Instagram”//中一个用户名为//“1nf1n1tyf0rev3r”//的账户。未知其进入的具体照片。

* 一篇关于死而复生可能性的研究文章。

* 艾奥瓦州沃基市EverHaven公园的Google地图页面。

SCP-7226表现出了一系列值得注意的行为：

* 虽然SCP-7226最初与基金会人员保持合作，但合作意愿和行为在测试过程中逐渐减少。

* SCP-7226继续向基金会人员询问基金会内部的异常情况。虽然其对最初的回答表示理解和含糊的不满，但在没有得到回答或被拒绝提供信息时，其开始表现出攻击性。

[[/div]]

[[div class="title-style"]]

+++++ __**测试结果V2**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

本次测试未获得有关SCP-7226在媒体内使用其能力的额外信息。

SCP-7226从媒体返回时出现以下现实扭曲现象：

* SCP-7226声称其出现视觉和听觉幻觉。但当被问及详情时，其拒绝回答。

* SCP-7226的声音开始明显失真，表现为发声音节和单词被静电音频取代。其情绪激动时会加剧这种现象。

* SCP-7226身上及其附近的所有颜色都发生扭曲，导致相邻的颜色相互渗透。

由于SCP-7226在被指示进入的媒体中持续消失，且未对基金会人员进行回应，测试很快被认定无效。当SCP-7226从所在媒体被强制退出时，其对基金会人员进行言语攻击，指责工作人员对他撒谎。

SCP-7226此种不合作的态度使基金会难以正确分析其全部的异常特性，也无法推测可能造成其身体现实扭曲的原因。

SCP-7226使用其手机进行测试。但SCP-7226似乎不愿进入设备，表示因自己的行踪被其他人员知晓而感到不安。

为了应对SCP-7226进入未知媒体后的各种行动，基金会决定首先对其手机内容进行检查。此做法是为了发现SCP-7226可能隐藏的任何文件或应用程序，以便工作人员在测试期间可及时查看相关媒体文件。

测试过程中SCP-7226在以下媒体文件中被发现：

**媒体文件：**一张一名男子[[footnote]]通过对手机内容的调查，该男子被确认为“亚历克斯（Alex）”。[[/footnote]]在公园里的照片，被发现于名为“我们❤️”的相册中。

**媒体文件：**一张上述男子坐在沙发上，一只㹴犬位于其右侧的照片。被发现于上述同一相册中。
**笔记：**SCP-7226倚靠着该男子相坐。项目头发上的蓝色扭曲愈加严重。注意到照片中的男子穿着一件蓝色毛衣。

测试发现，SCP-7226只有在试图与其存在情感联系的媒体文件内发生物理接触时（例如在照片中拥抱爱人），才会出现现实扭曲现象。

测试被紧急叫停。经确定，SCP-7226每次使用能力后，其身体的现实扭曲效应似乎会逐渐加速恶化，并对其身心健康造成严重危害。

SCP-7226 may request entertainment that does not require any digital devices. Denial or approval depends on the request.

+++++ __**Description**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

SCP-7226 is a 23 year old human male[[footnote]]formerly known as Virgil Simon.[[/footnote]] SCP-7226 is capable of transporting itself into any form of digital media within six meters or less from its location. When SCP-7226 exits the media, physical distortions often develop both interally and externally. SCP-7226 will be forcefully ejected from the media it is currently in if the device is powered off.

At the time of discovery, SCP-7226 had the following physical distortions due to use of its ability:

* SCP-7226’s right forearm is difficult to perceive visually, and appears to constantly be in movement despite being stationary. It reports paresthesia in the effected limb.

* Strands of SCP-7226's hair became permanently various shades of blue.

+++++ __**Test Results V1**__
[[/=]]
