The following is a summary of information discovered upon initial testing. The full test logs are available upon request.

* SCP-7226 only affects the copy of said media it enters, not appearing in other copies opened at the same time.
* If there is not a place for SCP-7226 to naturally be inserted into the media, it will not be visible. Regardless, SCP-7226 can interact with the immediate surroundings in which an image was taken, even if said surroundings are not visible in the image.
* When SCP-7226 goes within any media online, the page will appear in the device's history. If it does not go into online media, it has been unable to determine what media it enters.
* SCP-7226 is still aware of its immediate surroundings within media, and is able to verbally respond to staff, even if it cannot be physically seen.
* At this point, it is unknown what exactly causes SCP-7226 to gain additional distortions.

The following list what online pages SCP-7226 entered:

* An account on the social media platform //"Instagram"// under the username //"1nf1n1tyf0rev3r"//. The exact photos it entered are unknown.
* A research article on the possibility of resurrection.
* The Google Maps page for EverHaven park in Waukee, Iowa.

SCP-7226 displayed a series of behaviors that were noteworthy:

* While SCP-7226 initially cooperated with staff, this cooperative behavior dwindled over the course of the tests.
* SCP-7226 continued to ask staff about anomalies within Foundation possession. While it originally replied with understanding and vague dissatisfaction, it began to display aggression when not answered or denied information.

[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**Test Results V2**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

No additional information on the inner workings of SCP-7226's abilities was gained from testing.

SCP-7226 returned with the following distortions:

* SCP-7226 reported experiencing visual and audio hallucinations. When asked what it hallucinated, it refused to answer.
* SCP-7226's speech began to audibly distort, causing syllables and words to be replaced by audio static. This effect worsens when the subject is emotional.
* All colors on and within SCP-7226’s immediate vicinity will distort, causing nearby colors to bleed into each other.

The testing session was quickly deemed ineffective, as SCP-7226 continuously disappeared from the media it was instructed to enter, failing to respond to staff. When SCP-7226 was forcefully ejected from the media, it responded with verbal aggression, accusing staff of lying to it.

This uncooperativeness made it difficult to properly analyze the full extent of its anomalous properties, and unable to observe what may be causing the distortions.

+++++ __**Test Results V3**__

SCP-7226 was given access to its cellphone for testing purposes. SCP-7226 appeared reluctant to enter the device, expressing discomfort with its whereabouts being known.

To combat SCP-7226's habit of going into unknown media, it was decided to review the contents of the phone first. This was done in order to uncover any files or applications in which SCP-7226 could be hiding so Foundation staff could check said media during testing.

SCP-7226 was discovered in the following media:

**Media:** An image of a man[[footnote]]Through investigation of the contents of the phone, the man has been identified as "Alex"[[/footnote]] at a park, found in a photo album titled "Us❤️".
**Notes:** SCP-7226 hugged the man. It returned with worsening color distortions on its arms and chest.

**Media:** An image of the same man from before sitting on a couch with a terrier on his right. Found in the same photo album from before.
**Notes:** SCP-7226 sat against the man. The blue distortion on SCP-7226's hair worsened. It is noted that the man is wearing a blue sweater in the image.

**Media:** A video of SCP-7226 and the man from before singing the chorus of //"I And Love And You"// filmed from SCP-7226's perspective.
**Notes:** SCP-7226 sang along, causing its vocal distortion to worsen by a significant amount, with the majority of its spoken words being replaced with audio static. SCP-7226 returned from the video with tears in its eyes. When SCP-7226 cried, the secretions appeared to be digitally pixelated, and the subject reported discomfort caused by their unusual sharpness. Additionally, SCP-7226 reported that its vision had worsened significantly, being primarily unable to see.

It was discovered that SCP-7226 only gains distortions when attempting to physically interact with media that it has emotional ties to (ie. Hugging a loved one in a photograph).

Testing was brought to an emergency stop. It was determined that it would be dangerous to SCP-7226's health to allow it to use its anomalous properties again, as damage appears to progress at a quickening pace upon each use.

[[include component:image-block name=cairn.jpg|align=right|caption=Dr. Lachlan Cairns在1987年，8586-CHARON事件发生前不久。]]

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-8586被收容于Gravewatch协议下。作为Gravewatch的一部分，Dr. Cairns每月接受一次医疗评估，并且在任何转移事件后立即进行额外分析。到目前为止，Dr. Cairns对这些评估完全配合。

在需要时，允许Dr. Cairns继续履行其在SCP基金会内的职务。

**描述：**SCP-8586是SCP基金会人事主管Dr. Lachlan “Lach” Cairns。Dr. Cairns于1980年以初级研究员身份加入基金会，并于1981年晋升为职员研究员，1983年晋升为高级研究员，1986年晋升为职员博士。他是已故Dr. Ansel Cairns和Dr. Lillian Brand-Cairns的儿子。在他妻子Aileen Lament于1987年去世之前，他与她结了婚。

由于8586-CHARON事件，Dr. Cairns已功能上不朽。在其宿主身体过期后，Dr. Cairns的意识将在短暂的间歇期后重新觉醒在最近可用的尸体中。这种行为似乎没有范围限制，也没有特定的新宿主，只要它属于哺乳动物类群，且未过期超过24小时。Dr. Cairns曾在不同时间转移到过人类尸体、马匹、猿类、老鼠等动物尸体中。

值得注意的是，SCP-8586似乎无法转移到年龄小于33岁244天的人体中——即Dr. Cairns在8586-CHARON事件当天的年龄——或转移到年龄小于其等效年龄的动物体内（尽管这种行为的具体细节尚不清楚）。

新宿主将被SCP-8586重新激活并恢复活力，尸体将呈现出其原主人在死亡前不久的外观和健康状况。然而，SCP-8586无法长时间维持这种活力，且在一段时间后尸体将开始迅速腐烂，这使Dr. Cairns感到极大的痛苦。SCP-8586能够维持重新激活的尸体的时间长度似乎取决于多个因素，包括原宿主的年龄和死亡前的健康状况。SCP-8586最长自然维持单一形态的时间为86天[[footnote]]基金会曾多次通过人工手段延长SCP-8586在单一形态下维持的时间，但通常需要投入大量奇术投资和近乎持续的监督，一般被认为是一种不必要的资源使用。最长的维持时间仅为4年多一点，当时SCP-8586居住在已故的[[[SCP-4444|乔治·W·布什总统]]]的身体内。2005年，一名替身被带入以替换SCP-8586，此时维持该身体的任务已成为每小时的努力。在解除总统布什身体的维护仪式后，它几乎立即变成了灰烬，之后SCP-8586的异常绑定变得不稳定，接下来的七种形态都在数小时内退化，此后所有形态在三个月内都受到了类似影响。[[/footnote]]。

SCP-8586所居住的尸体将保留其所有原始特征（除了承载Dr. Cairns的意识），唯一例外是宿主右眼将被一枚来自以弗所的金铜币取代。这枚硬币是前SCP-███，在8586-CHARON事件后被废弃。从SCP-8586的眼中移除这枚硬币会导致其立即分解，而硬币则会消失，然后重新出现在替代宿主的眼窝中。

**附录8586.1：**SCP-███

[[include component:image-block name=coin.jpg|align=right|caption=对SCP-███中部分SCP-8586的符文进行分析。（A）表示说话，（B）表示说话，（C1）和（C2）表示长途旅行（旅程的开始和结束），（D）表示支付，（E）表示灵魂或自我，（F）是一个未完成的符文。]]

SCP-███[[footnote]]因成为SCP-8586的固有属性，其ID号已被删除。此位置已重新分配。[[/footnote]]，代号“渡船人之币”，是两枚金铜合金[[footnote]]一种天然存在的黄金和白银合金，在古代用于铸币。[[/footnote]]硬币，当放置在最近死亡者的双眼上时，可暂时使尸体复活并使其说话，只要硬币不受干扰。这些硬币的最初持有者是Marshall、Carter & Dark清算所的一名异常文物收藏家Vladek Morzyn，他相信它们可以让最近死去的人说话。然而，在研究SCP-███的过程中，8586-CHARON事件中断了研究，早期迹象表明，促使受影响对象说话的力量只是创造了一个最近死去的人的复制品[[footnote]]在Dr. Lament的笔记中，她认为SCP-███中的力量或实体只是用这个复制品来制造复活的假象，因为对象经常难以回答他们死前生活中的具体问题，有时甚至会在被追问细节时变得敌意。[[/footnote]]。

Dr. Cairns在担任Site-17首席生物学家期间接触到了SCP-███，并一直在研究SCP-███对受试者复活组织的影响。在8586-CHARON事件之前，Dr. Cairns曾多次向Dr. Lament及其配偶、一位异常古董专家咨询。

**A. LAMENT：**小姐？先生，我是//异常古董学博士//。这是//博士//小姐给你的称呼。

**CAIRNS：**我怎么会忘记。

**A. LAMENT：**这样吧。下周我要去加拿大帮助Aleksy评估他们在湖边挖出的一些遗迹。回来后，我们会安排一起去和Charles聊聊。

**CAIRNS：**谢天谢地。我担心你会让我和Alto一起去。

**A. LAMENT：**你喜欢哪个，还是我哥哥？

**CAIRNS：**他们俩和Charles？自杀是个选项吗？

**A. LAMENT：**幸运的是，这不需要。顺便说一句，你应该关掉录音机。我们最不想的就是人们知道我们在尸体上无所事事地聊天。

**CAIRNS：**啊，好——

[记录结束]
[[/div]]

**附录8586.2：**8586-CHARON背景

8586-CHARON事件发生在1987年12月21日，当时Dr. Cairns未经批准地实验了上述SCP-███，似乎是为了复活最近去世的Dr. Aileen Lament。Dr. Lament在十天前死于一次意外激活的[[[SCP-354]]]事件，该事件严重影响了Dr. Cairns。

安保录像显示，Dr. Cairns在Dr. Lament去世至8586-CHARON事件期间进行了多次未记录的SCP-███取款。当时Site-17的安保协议相对宽松，这意味着这些行动并未立即引起安保干预，唯一的例外是后来回收的一次记录交换，其中Dr. Cairns与当时的机动特遣队Epsilon-11“九尾狐”小队队长Troy Lament进行了交流，后者是Dr. Lament的兄弟，也是Dr. Cairns的妹夫。这次交流直到8586-CHARON事件结束后才被发现，当时对Site-17的所有安保录像进行了彻底审查。

**Site-17安保终端**
**回收视频记录转录**
-----
[记录开始]

**T. LAMENT：**——告诉过你不要待在这儿。这对你不好。

**CAIRNS：**你能别烦我吗？我只是在工作。

**T. LAMENT：**别跟我扯淡，Lach。我知道你没记录这个，我知道这个东西的作用。

**CAIRNS：**你真的因为我不填文件单子就生气吗？这真的是你最好的时间利用方式吗？

**T. LAMENT：**来吧，兄弟。别假装我不知道这是什么。

**CAIRNS：**这是什么？这是我们的//工作//，Troy。这是我们做的工作。我见过这个东西做了些我……需要跟进的事情。这就是工作，不是吗？

**T. LAMENT：**在一个受控环境中，有严格的监督，是的，但你在这里不是想这么做的。

**CAIRNS：**我不需要向你们解释自己——

**T. LAMENT：**如果你不——你//必须//向管理员解释自己——

**CAIRNS：**（突然激动）她//跟我说话//了，Troy。她说我的//名字//。没有其他人能做到。你明白吗？这里有些不同，如果有什么改变了，//我就想知道为什么//。我是科学家他妈的，我不会——

**T. LAMENT：**（//打断//）你不应该——

**CAIRNS：**（//继续//）——坐在这里等着她烂在地下，直到这个组织的机制决定——

**T. LAMENT：**Lach。

**CAIRNS：**（//继续//）——决定我们是否可以回收我们//最好的//之一。

**T. LAMENT：**她已经走了。

**CAIRNS：**她//没有走//，Troy。如果我说得没错，//没有人走//。你懂吗？如果我说得没错，我们就再也不会失去任何人了。这个地方一直拿走拿走拿走，直到现在我们//确定//它永远不会把他们任何一个还给我们。好吧，现在我不这么确定了。

**T. LAMENT：**这不是我们的工作。

**CAIRNS：**那我们的工作是什么？在黑暗中死去？如果我们不用死，那为什么我们要？难道继续我们正在做的事情不是更好吗？难道让她……让她……让她不……

**T. LAMENT：**Lach。

[[include component:image-block name=https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-8586/cairn.jpg|align=right|caption=1987年的Lachlan Cairns博士，摄于8586-卡戎事件发生前不久。]]

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-8586以[[span class="ruby"]]墓穴守望协议[[span class="rt"]]Gravewatch Protocol[[/span]][[/span]]收容。作为协议的一部分，Cairns博士需每月接受医疗评估；在任何转移事件发生后，若条件允许，也应立即对其进行额外分析。迄今为止，Cairns博士配合了所有评估。

若无特殊情况，允许Cairns博士继续履行其在SCP基金会中的职责。

**描述：**SCP-8586是SCP基金会人事主管Lachlan "Lach" Cairns博士。Cairns博士于1980年加入基金会，任职初级研究员，并在1981年晋升为研究员，在1983年晋升为高级研究员，在1986年取得基金会博士头衔。其父母为已故Ansel Cairns博士和Lillian Brand-Cairns博士。Cairns博士于1987年丧偶，其亡妻为Aileen Lament博士。

在8586-卡戎事件的影响下，Cairns博士已获得功能性永生。在其宿主躯体死亡后，经过一个短暂的间隔期，Cairns博士的意识将在最近的可用尸体内复苏。该行为似乎不存在范围限制，对新宿主也不存在特殊需求，仅要求宿主为死亡时间不超过24小时的哺乳纲生物。Cairns博士曾多次转移至新近死亡的人类尸体，以及基金会站点内用于测试目的的马、猿、鼠等动物的尸体内。

值得注意的是，SCP-8586似乎无法转移到年龄小于三十三岁二百四十四天（即Cairns博士在8586-卡戎事件发生时的年龄）的人类躯体中，也无法转移至等效年龄未达标准的动物体内（尽管该机制的详情尚不清晰）。

作为SCP-8586宿主的尸体将恢复生命体征，其外观与健康水平将回退至原主临终前的状态。然而，SCP-8586无法长期维持此类生命力，在一段时间之后，其躯体将快速腐烂。该现象将使Cairns博士遭受大量痛苦。SCP-8586能够维持尸体复苏状态的时间长短似乎基于多个因素，包括尸体原主的年龄与其生前的健康状况。SCP-8586自然维持在同一躯体内的最长时间为八十六天[[footnote]]基金会曾多次设法借助人工手段减缓躯体分解、延长SCP-8586维持在同一躯体内的时间，但这通常需要投资大量奇术资源并进行近乎持续的监控，这常被认为是一种对资源的浪费。维持于同一躯体的时长记录略长于四年，其时SCP-8586寄居于已故[[[scp-4444|乔治·W·布什总统]]]体内。在2005年基金会使用替身代替SCP-8586时，维持其躯体的程序已经需要每小时执行一次。布什总统的躯体在维护仪式解除后近乎瞬间化为灰烬。束缚SCP-8586的异常效应也随之变得极不稳定，此后的七个躯体均在数小时内分解，后续三个月内的所有躯体也均受到了类似影响。[[/footnote]]。

除转为承载Cairns博士的意识之外，SCP-8586占据的尸体将保留所有原有特征，只存在一处例外——宿主躯体的右眼将被一枚以弗所银金币取代。该钱币为前SCP-███，此项目在8586-卡戎事件后被废除。自SCP-8586实例的眼部移除该钱币将导致宿主躯体立即发生分解，同时硬币将会消失，并重新出现在新宿主的眼眶中。

**附录8586.1：**SCP-███

[[include component:image-block name=https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-8586/coin.jpg|align=right|caption=对SCP-8586体内的SCP-███上部分符文的分析。(A)代表言语，(B)代表言语，(C1)与(C2)代表长途旅行（旅行的起点与终点），(D)代表一次支付，(E)代表灵魂或自我，(F)为一未完成的符文。]]

SCP-███[[footnote]]因其成为SCP-8586的内在组成部分，对其编号进行了编辑。该编号的槽位已重新分配。[[/footnote]]（代号“船夫的硬币”）是两枚银金[[footnote]]一种天然存在的金银合金，在古代曾被用于铸币。[[/footnote]]硬币。若将其置于一名新丧者的双眼上，则可使尸体暂时活化并发声，直到钱币被移走为止。其最初所有者Vladek Morzyn（一名与Marshall, Carter & Dark存在关联的异常制品收藏家）相信，这些钱币能够让新丧者说话。然而，尽管对SCP-███的研究已因8586-卡戎事件中断，但早期研究证据已经能够表明，驱使受影响对象说话的力量实际上只是创建了新丧者的一个仿制品[[footnote]]Lament博士在笔记中提到，她认为SCP-███内的力量或实体创造的仿制品只能伪造一种复活的假象，因为对象通常无法回答有关生前生活的具体问题，在被追问相关细节时甚至可能表现出敌意。[[/footnote]]。

作为Site-17的首席生物学家，Cairns博士有权接触SCP-███，并曾持续研究SCP-███对对象的活化组织造成的影响。在8586-卡戎事件发生之前，Cairns博士曾多次向其配偶、异常古物专家Lament博士请求咨询。

[[div class="blockquote"]]
**Site-17异常生物学研究室**
**测试案例音频转录**
-----

[记录开始]

**CAIRNS：**来吧。第一个受试者是D-21421，原名Diane W. Yates——成年女性，38岁。死因是颈部遭受钝器创伤。

**A. LAMENT：**正式确认受试者已死亡。

**CAIRNS：**（//大笑//）老天啊，希望如此。准备好了吗？

**A. LAMENT：**开始吧。

**CAIRNS：**好。现在我将把硬币放到受试者的眼睛上。

（//短暂停顿。记录到一声急促的吸气声。//）

**D-21421：**怎么回事？我在哪？

**CAIRNS：**可以告诉我们你的名字吗？

**D-21421：**你是谁？这是什么情况？

**CAIRNS：**我理解你可能有些忧虑，但请尽量冷静。请告诉我们你的名字。

**D-21421：**我……我不记得了。我不知道我在哪里。

**CAIRNS：**你记得的最后一件事是什么？

**D-21421：**我当时……周围当时很黑，然后我……我的脖子，我的脖子怎么了？

**CAIRNS：**明白了。你还记得死亡之前可能在和什么人会面吗？

**D-21421：**我什么都看不见。我眼睛上是什么？这些人都是谁？

**CAIRNS：**这些人？

**D-21421：**求求你，拿掉它！拿掉它！这不对劲！救救我！求你们了，谁能救救我！

（//Lament博士将SCP-███从受试者眼部移除。受试者停止活动。//）

**CAIRNS：**为什么要拿走？

**A. LAMENT：**啊，得了吧Lach。你清楚我们问不出更多东西了。跟别的案例一模一样。

**CAIRNS：**嗯……你说得对。但有点奇怪。你怎么想？

**A. LAMENT：**和其他个体一样。除了那些触手可及的东西，以及自己身体上一些明摆着的状态，无法回答任何具体问题。我不认为这是复活，这是别的什么现象。

**CAIRNS：**我想不出来。我们可能漏掉了什么东西。有什么//东西//在借她说话。（//停顿//）你之前研究的那个符文怎么样了？有什么新发现吗？

**A. LAMENT：**确实有。你看——（//纸张翻动声//）顶部的那个符文，被他们用来表示“言语”，很合理。这一个要么代表“灵魂”，要么代表“自我”。但再看看这个。能认出什么吗？

**CAIRNS：**让我看看。（//停顿//）这是……“旅行”吗？

**A. LAMENT：**准确地说，是“远距离旅行”。但它不算是一个真正的符文，至少不是我们熟知的那种。它只是个词语，跟其它这些一同出现……嗯，我想这是一份，很典型的收据，但它只会用来描述从远方运送到当地的货物。

**CAIRNS：**有意思。

**A. LAMENT：**还不止如此。它们的时期甚至早于希腊的船夫神话，所以能把它们用作“通行费”的……一定是个特别的地方，我猜。

**CAIRNS：**也可能是个特别的人。

**A. LAMENT：**嗯。也可能是个特别的人。

**CAIRNS：**那最后一个符文呢？

**A. LAMENT：**那一个……我也跟你一样没头绪。其它符文显然是精心制作而成，但那一个却没有完成。很有趣——他们似乎是在给自己预留空间，看到没？硬币其它部分的材料都被挖空了，只有这里留下了再刻一个符号的空间，他们就这样留下了一个半成品。

**CAIRNS：**很有意思。

**A. LAMENT：**我原以为这是一个复苏符文，像另一枚硬币上的这个一样，但它只有前半部分，很不合理。这里的工具痕迹暗示他们开始了雕刻，但却没能完成。（//停顿//）想听听专业意见吗，Cairns博士？

**CAIRNS：**你在这儿可不能光侃侃大山，Lament博士。

**A. LAMENT：**聪明孩子。嗯。从我的//专业//视角看，这是个未完成的仪式。无论这些东西是做什么的，无论它们原本的功能是和谁进行沟通，它们都绝非成品。我只能闭着眼睛猜测它们本应实现的功能，但我觉得它们并没有正常运作。

**CAIRNS：**所以你认为我们对话的并不是真正的死者。

**A. LAMENT：**这问题更适合留给神秘学研究。和Charles谈过了吗？他可能认识相关的专家。

**CAIRNS：**啊，但见他也太烦了。感觉想进他的办公室都得填张一式三份表格。

**A. LAMENT：**可怜的小家伙。委屈你了。

**CAIRNS：**女士，你在嘲笑我。

**A. LAMENT：**女士？先生，我是一位//异常古物学博士。//请称呼我//博士//女士。

**CAIRNS：**岂敢忘怀。

**A. LAMENT：**这样吧。下周我要去加拿大帮Aleksy评估他们从湖边挖出的圣物。等我回来，我们定个时间一起去见Charles。

**CAIRNS：**谢天谢地了。我还以为你要让我跟Alto一起去。

**A. LAMENT：**你更喜欢让他陪？还是换我弟弟来？

**CAIRNS：**他们俩挑一个，再加上Charles？我能选择自杀吗？

**A. LAMENT：**算你走运，不必如此。对了，该关录音了。可不能让人知道我们对着尸体闲聊。

**CAIRNS：**啊，好——

[记录结束]
[[/div]]

**附录8586.2:**8586-卡戎事件背景

8586-卡戎事件发生于1987年12月21日。事件起因为Cairns博士未经授权即对前述SCP-███进行实验，尝试复活新近逝世的Aileen Lament博士。Lament博士于十日前因[[[SCP-354]]]意外激活而身亡，此事件对Cairns博士造成了重大影响。

安保录像显示，在Lament博士去世与8586-卡戎事件发生之间，Cairns博士曾多次未经登记便取用SCP-███。此时Site-17规模较小，安保协议相对宽松，故而这些行为并未立即招致安保干预。唯一的例外是Cairns博士与机动特遣队Epsilon-11“九尾狐”队长Troy Lament（Lament博士之弟，亦即Cairns博士之内弟）之间的一段对话。8586-卡戎事件结束后，Site-17安保录像接受了一次全面审查，其中发现了一份相关录音，这段对话的存在至此方被揭露。

[[div class="blockquote"]]
**Site-17安保终端**
**寻获视频记录的转录**
-----
[记录开始]

**T. LAMENT：**——早说过让你不要来这儿。这样没好处。

**CAIRNS：**你能别拦我吗？我只是在工作。

**T. LAMENT：**别糊弄我，Lach。我知道你没做记录，我也知道这东西是干什么的。

**CAIRNS：**你就因为一点文书工作来找我茬？你没别的事好干吗？

**T. LAMENT：**得了吧，兄弟。别跟我装蒜了。

**CAIRNS：**装蒜？我在履行//职责//，Troy。这是我们的工作。我见识过这东西的能力，这些事我——这些事必须有人跟进。这不就是我们的职责吗？

**T. LAMENT：**在受严格监管的可控环境下确实如此，但现在你可不是这么干的。

**CAIRNS：**我不需要向你解——

**T. LAMENT：**如果你一意孤行，那你//就要//和管理层解释——

**CAIRNS：**（突然激动）她在对我//说话//，Troy。她喊了我的//名字//。其它**所有**个体都做不到这点。你明白吗？发生变化了，既然有变化那//我就要知道原因。//我是个天杀的科学家，我不能就这么——

**T. LAMENT：**（//打断//）你本不该——

**CAIRNS：**（//无视//）干坐着看她烂成灰等到组织的老爷们愿意行行好——

**T. LAMENT：**Lach。

**CAIRNS：**（//无视//）施舍给我们做决定要不要救回我们//最优秀//同僚的那点最基本的尊严！

**T. LAMENT：**她已经走了。

**CAIRNS：**她还//没走//，Troy。如果我是对的，//那他们全都没走//。你还不懂吗？如果我是对的，我们再也不用失去任何人了。世界不停地索取索取索取让我们全都//深信不疑//它绝不会把任何人还给我们。但，现在我不那么确定了。

**T. LAMENT：**那不是我们的职责。

**CAIRNS：**那我们的职责是什么？死在黑暗里？如果不必死，那为什么要死？这样难道不是更好，如果我们能继续自己熟知的工作？难道不是吗，如果她……她……如果她没有……

**T. LAMENT：**Lach。

[[include component:image-block name=cairn.jpg|align=right|caption=Dr. Lachlan Cairns in 1987, shortly before the 8586-CHARON event.]]

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-8586 is contained under the Gravewatch Protocol. As a function of Gravewatch, Dr. Cairns is subject to monthly medical evaluations and, if feasible, additional analysis immediately following any transference events. To date, Dr. Cairns has been fully amenable to these evaluations.

Until such a time as need demands it, Dr. Cairns is permitted to continue to fulfill the functions of their position within the SCP Foundation.

**Description:** SCP-8586 is SCP Foundation Director of Personnel Dr. Lachlan "Lach" Cairns. Dr. Cairns began working for the Foundation as a Junior Researcher in 1980 and was promoted to Staff Researcher in 1981, Senior Researcher in 1983, and Doctor of Staff in 1986. He is the son of the late Dr. Ansel Cairns and Dr. Lillian Brand-Cairns. Prior to her death in 1987, he was married to Dr. Aileen Lament.

As a result of the 8586-CHARON event, Dr. Cairns has become functionally immortal. Upon the expiry of its host body, Dr. Cairns' consciousness will, after a short interstitial period, reawaken in the nearest available dead body. There does not seem to be a limit to the range of this behaviour, nor to the specificity of the new host, so long as it is within class Mammalia, and has not been expired for more than 24 hours. Dr. Cairns has, at different times, transferred into the bodies of recently deceased human corpses, as well as those of horses, apes, mice, and other animals used for testing purposes within Foundation sites.

Notably, SCP-8586 is also seemingly incapable of transferring into human bodies younger than thirty-three years, two-hundred and forty-four days - the age Dr. Cairns was on the date of the 8586-CHARON event - or transferring into the bodies of animals younger than their equivalent age (though the specifics of this behaviour are poorly understood).

New bodies that become hosts for SCP-8586 will become both reanimated and reinvigorated, with corpses taking on the appearance and well-being of their originator as they were in the time shortly before their death. However, SCP-8586 is incapable of maintaining this vitality for extended periods of time, and after some duration the bodies will began to decay rapidly, a phenomenon that causes Dr. Cairns considerable distress. The length of time that SCP-8586 is able to sustain the reinvigorated bodies seemingly depends on several factors, including the original body's age and health prior to their death. The longest period of time SCP-8586 has been able to naturally maintain a single form has been eighty-six days[[footnote]]The Foundation has, at different times, been able to artificially extend the duration with which SCP-8586 is able to stay in a single form before it degrades, though this often involves significant thaumatological investment and near-constant oversight, and has generally been considered an unnecessary use of resources. The longest time a form has been maintained was just over four years, when SCP-8586 was inhabiting the body of the late [[[SCP-4444|President George W. Bush]]]. A body-double was brought in to replace SCP-8586 in 2005, by which point the task of maintaining the body in question had become an hourly effort. Upon lifting the rituals maintaining the body of President Bush it almost immediately turned to ash, after which the anomaly binding SCP-8586 became so unstable that the next seven forms all degraded within the space of several hours, and all those afterwards for a period of three months were similarly affected.[[/footnote]].

Bodies inhabited by SCP-8586 will retain all of their original characteristics (aside from hosting Dr. Cairns' consciousness) with a single exception - the right eye of the host body will be replaced with a single electrum coin of Ephesian origin. This coin is the former SCP-███, which was decommissioned following 8586-CHARON. Removing this coin from the eye of the SCP-8586 instance will result in both its immediate decomposition, and the disappearance of the coin, which will then reappear in the eye socket of the replacement host.

**Addendum 8586.1:** SCP-███

[[include component:image-block name=coin.jpg|align=right|caption=Analysis of the runes present on the part of SCP-███ within SCP-8586. (A) indicates speech, (B) indicates speech, (C1) and (C2) indicate travel over great distance (the beginning and end of a journey), (D) indicates a payment, (E) indicates the soul or self, and (F) is an unfinished rune.]]

SCP-███[[footnote]]ID number now redacted due to it becoming an inherent aspect of SCP-8586. This slot has since been repurposed.[[/footnote]], codename "Ferryman's Coins" were two electrum[[footnote]]A naturally occurring alloy of gold and silver, used in antiquity for coinage.[[/footnote]] coins that, when placed over the eyes of the recently deceased, could temporarily animate the corpse and allow it to speak, so long as the coins were not disturbed. The original holder of these coins, a collector of anomalous artifacts affiliated with the Marshall, Carter & Dark clearinghouse named Vladek Morzyn, believed they were capable of permitting the recently dead to speak. However, while research into SCP-███ was interrupted by the 8586-CHARON event, early indications were that the force compelling the affected subjects to speech was only creating a facsimile of the recently deceased[[footnote]]In Dr. Lament's notes, she posited that the force or entity within SCP-███ was only using that facsimile to give the appearance of reanimation, as the subjects often had difficulty answering specific questions about their lives prior to their deaths, and would sometimes become hostile when pressed on those details.[[/footnote]].

Dr. Cairns had access to SCP-███ in his position as Chief Biologist at Site-17, and had been studying the effects of SCP-███ on subjects' reanimated tissues. Prior to 8586-CHARON, Dr. Cairns had, on several occasions, requested consults from Dr. Lament, his spouse and a specialist in anomalous antiquities.

[[div class="blockquote"]]
**Site-17 Anomalous Biological Studies**
**Test Case Audio Transcription**
-----

[BEGIN LOG]

**CAIRNS:** Let's get started. First subject is D-21421, formerly Diane W. Yates - adult female, age 38. Cause of death was blunt force trauma to the neck.

**A. LAMENT:** Confirming for the record that the subject is deceased.

**CAIRNS:** (//Laughs//) Good god I would hope so. Ready to begin?

**A. LAMENT:** Let's do it.

**CAIRNS:** Alright. I'm placing the coins on the subject's eyes now.

(//Brief pause. A sharp intake of breath is heard.//)

**D-21421:** What happened? Where am I?

**CAIRNS:** Can you tell me your name?

**D-21421:** Who are you? What is this?

**CAIRNS:** I understand you may be experiencing a bit of distress, but please try to calm down. Just tell me your name, please.

**D-21421:** I... I don't remember. I don't know where I am.

**CAIRNS:** What is the last thing you remember?

**D-21421:** I was... it was dark, and I... my neck, what's wrong with my neck?

**CAIRNS:** I see. Do you remember anyone else you may have been in communication with prior to your death?

**D-21421:** I can't see anything. What's on my eyes? Who are all these people?

**CAIRNS:** These people?

**D-21421:** Please, take it off! Take it off! This isn't right! Help! Help me, please, somebody!

(//Dr. Lament removes SCP-███ from the subject's eyes. The subject deanimates.//)

**CAIRNS:** What did you do that for?

**A. LAMENT:** Ah, come off it Lach. You know we weren't getting anything else out of her. It was just like the others.

**CAIRNS:** Mmmmmm. I suppose you're right. Strange, though. What did you make of it?

**A. LAMENT:** Same as the others. Wasn't able to answer anything specific except what was immediately available around her, and what was obvious about the state of her body. I don't think this is resurrection, I think it's something else.

**CAIRNS:** I don't know. I feel like we're missing something here. There's //something// in there doing the talking. (//Pauses//) What about that rune you were looking at? Have you made any more progress with it?

**A. LAMENT:** I have, actually. Look here - (//sound of shuffling papers//) - this is the rune they used for speech, that one on the top, which makes sense, and this one here is either "soul" or "self". But then look at this one. Recognize anything about it?

**CAIRNS:** Let me see. (//Pauses//) Is that... travel?

**A. LAMENT:** It is, specifically, from one place to another far away. But it's not a rune really, not in the way we're used to. It's just a word, it shows up on all these other... well, I suppose they're receipts, in the classic sense, but it was used when describing goods brought to their locality from somewhere far away.

**CAIRNS:** Curious.

**A. LAMENT:** More than just that, too. These predate the Greek myths about the boatman, so whatever "toll" they were intended for has got to be... something different, I imagine.

**CAIRNS:** Or someone.

**A. LAMENT:** Aye. Or someone.

**CAIRNS:** So what about that last one then?

**A. LAMENT:** That one... your guess is as good as mine. These were very clearly meticulously crafted, but that one is unfinished. It's funny - it's like they left themselves room to work, see here? It's not like the rest of the coin where the material has been bored out, there's room there for another symbol, they've just left it unfinished.

**CAIRNS:** Very curious.

**A. LAMENT:** I thought it might be the rejuvenation rune, like this one on the other coin, but it's really only the first half of it, which doesn't make any sense. The tool mark here makes me think they started on it but never completed it. (//Pauses//) Would you like my //professional// opinion, Dr. Cairns.

**CAIRNS:** You're not just here for your engaging discourse, Dr. Lament.

**A. LAMENT:** Clever boy. Well. In my //professional// opinion, this is an incomplete ritual. What these things do, whoever they were intended to commune with, they are unfinished. I certainly could only hazard a guess at what they were attempting to do with them, but I don't believe they are functioning correctly.

**CAIRNS:** And you don't think it's actually the dead we're speaking with.

**A. LAMENT:** That is a question better left to occult studies. Have you spoken to Charles? He may know someone over there.

**CAIRNS:** Ah, but he's such a bore. Feel like I need to fill out forms in triplicate just to get into his office.

**A. LAMENT:** You poor thing. So put upon.

**CAIRNS:** You mock me, miss.

**A. LAMENT:** Miss? Sir, I am a //doctor of anomalous antiquities.// That's //Doctor// Miss to you.

**CAIRNS:** How could I forget.

**A. LAMENT:** How about this. Next week I'm traveling to Canada to help Aleksy assess some relics they dug up near the lake. Once I get back, we'll schedule a trip to go chat with Charles together.

**CAIRNS:** Thank god. I was worried you were going to tell me to go with Alto.

**A. LAMENT:** Would you prefer that, or my brother?

**CAIRNS:** Either of them and Charles? Is suicide an option?

**A. LAMENT:** Lucky for you, that won't be necessary. By the way, you should turn that recorder off. Last thing we need is people knowing we have idle chit chat over dead bodies.

**CAIRNS:** Ah, good-

[END LOG]
[[/div]]

**Addendum 8586.2:** 8586-CHARON Background

8586-CHARON was an event that transpired on the 21st of December 1987 after Dr. Cairns' unsanctioned experimentation with the aforementioned SCP-███, seemingly in an attempt to reanimate the recently deceased Dr. Aileen Lament. Dr. Lament had died ten days prior during an unexpected activation of [[[SCP-354]]], an event that significantly affected Dr. Cairns.

Security footage indicates that Dr. Cairns made several unlogged withdrawals of SCP-███ in the period between Dr. Lament's death and the 8586-CHARON event. The relatively lax security protocols, common at the time for the smaller Site-17, meant these actions did not immediately prompt security intervention, with the single exception being one recorded exchange later recovered between Dr. Cairns and then Mobile Task Force Epsilon-11 "Nine-Tailed Fox" team lead Troy Lament, Dr. Lament's brother and Dr. Cairns' brother-in-law. This exchange was not revealed until after 8586-CHARON had concluded, when a thorough review of all Site-17 security footage was conducted.

[[div class="blockquote"]]
**Site-17 Security Terminal**
**Recovered Video Log Transcription**
-----
[BEGIN LOG]

**T. LAMENT:** -told you that you shouldn't be down here. It's not healthy.

**CAIRNS:** Can you get off my case? I'm just working.

**T. LAMENT:** Don't bullshit me, Lach. I know you're not logging this, and I know what this thing does.

**CAIRNS:** Are you seriously getting on me for not filing paperwork? Is this really the best use of your time?

**T. LAMENT:** Come on, brother. Don't pretend I don't know what this is.

**CAIRNS:** What this is? This is our //job//, Troy. This is the work we do. I've seen this thing do things that I... that need to be followed up on. That's the job, isn't it?

**T. LAMENT:** In a controlled environment with rigorous oversight, yes, but that's not what you're trying to do here.

**CAIRNS:** I don't need to explain myself to-

**T. LAMENT:** You //will// need to explain yourself to admin if you don't-

**CAIRNS:** (suddenly agitated) She //spoke// to me, Troy. She said my //name//. NONE of the others were able to do that. Do you get it? Something is different here, and if something has changed then //I want to know why.// I'm a scientist goddammit, I'm not just going to-

**T. LAMENT:** (//interrupting//) You shouldn't have been-

**CAIRNS:** (//continuing//) -sit by and wait for her to rot in the ground before the mechanisms of this organization deign to do us the-

**T. LAMENT:** Lach.

**CAIRNS:** (//continuing//) -basic dignity of deciding whether or not we can recover one of our //best!//

**T. LAMENT:** She's gone.

**CAIRNS:** She is //not gone//, Troy. If I'm right, //none of them are gone//. Don't you get it? If I'm right, then we never have to lose anyone else ever again. This place takes and takes and takes and up until now we were //sure// that it would never give any of them back. Well, now I'm not so sure.

**T. LAMENT:** That's not what our job is.

**CAIRNS:** What is our job then? Die in the dark? If we don't have to die, then why should we? Is it not better for us to continue the work we're doing? Is it not better that she... that... that she doesn't...

**T. LAMENT:** Lach.

**Item #:** SCP-043

**Object Class:** Safe

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-043 requires no special containment, although it is recommended that SCP-043 not be used for purposes other than testing. A turntable is to be maintained in the same room for testing.

**Description:** SCP-043 appears to be a vinyl copy of "The White Album" by the Beatles; however, upon closer inspection, the record has no grooves. In spite of this, the record will play from start to finish regardless of the starting position of the needle.

When the twenty-ninth track is reached, instead of playing "Revolution 9", the disc stops spinning and faint breathing can be heard. Occasionally the entity responsible for the breathing will speak in a male voice. The entity will respond to questions and shows a profound encyclopedic knowledge of the music industry, [[[SCP-1668|musical theory]]], and obscure trivia about many bands and artists. However, the entity refuses to answer [[[bigger-than-jesus|questions regarding The Beatles]]] or its own personal details.

Inside the jacket, a small handwritten note was found, reading:

> //Limited Edition: 1/1//
>
> //Thanks, John!//
>
> //xxx//

* SCP-9805产生了明显的声响。

**Item #:** SCP-9805

**Object Class:** [*https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-9336 Euclid]

**Special Containment Procedures:** Photos of the SCP-9805 event are held in a small plastic bag within the [[[SCP-173 |Site-19]]] containment lockers.

**Description:** SCP-9805 was an entity which briefly manifested during an unrelated scientific project. No other materializations of SCP-9805 have been recorded.

The [*https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-9607 photo reel] containing evidence of the apparition was first located by the US Military following abnormal reporting emerging from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. A subsequent investigative raid revealed a constructed anechoic chamber, used to conduct the experiments which first discovered SCP-9805.

[[<]]
[[include :scp-wiki:component:image-block name= http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/local--files/scp-9805/Fullteeth.jpg|caption=Collected photo-reel.|width=###px]]
[[/<]]

According to the research team, an individual was placed within the chamber and ordered to take a series of 12 photos over the course of approximately 3 minutes, each within an evenly spaced duration. Reportedly, no abnormal events occurred until the photos were developed, at which point the figure was first noticed.  Despite this, all participating in the event reported a loss of notable retrospective coherency, rendering them unable to properly recall logical transpirations during the period.

Further interviews with the involved staff would confirm the following details:[[footnote]] Paraphrased directly from witness accounts, minimizing outside interpretation or intervention. [[/footnote]]

* SCP-9805 had a physical presence.
* SCP-9805 had no noticeable smell.
* SCP-9805 had no noticeable taste.
* SCP-9805 did not attempt physical interaction.
* SCP-9805 produced noticeable sound.
* SCP-9805 produced the faint sound of chattering teeth.

All evidence would be seized, including the [*https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-9853 chamber used] in the original study. Later attempts at replication would fail to reproduce the event.

The photographs themselves display no identifiable paranormal properties. Many viewers report the pictures bring them a strong sense of calm.

**项目编号：**SCP-037

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-037被磁性地收容在Site-22地下设施中。其尺寸、光谱特征和温度将由Site-98远程监控。

主收容室衬有导热、抗辐射NANOPEEK GFV聚合物瓷砖，并抽空了任何大气。项目的热量将辐射到周围的岩石中。若收容完整性受损，紧急系统将生成低功率氩气等离子体屏蔽。预计这将为现场工程师提供至少4小时的时间，在项目突破收容前完成必要的维修。

若恒星演化超出预期，新星事件即将发生，或收容失败不可避免，则剩余的项目人员将被授权启动Pituaq协议。

**描述：**SCP-037似乎是一颗直径约5厘米（2英寸）的恒星，其亮度约为太阳的1*10^^-12^^倍，表面温度约为5000K（通过UBVRI分析确定）。SCP-037的起源未知，但分析表明它与典型的主序星有许多共同特性，除了其异常小的尺寸。理论上，它通过北极进入地球的磁层。

该物体于19██年在北磁极附近的白令海上方被发现。加拿大部队站（CFS）警报报告了强烈的电磁干扰，随后一个极其明亮的物体从天空下降到海洋。SCPS//守护者//响应并发现该物体在水面上方约200米处摇摆不定。一旦制定出收容程序，它就被运送到Site-32进行研究。

SCP-037的收容和运输是通过使用强大的电磁铁实现的，该装置根据自身的磁场对准。迄今为止，收容的主要挑战是其强大的电磁发射，强度足以在高地球轨道上用肉眼看到。它的当前收容位置位于地下深处，以防止检测并促进向周围基岩的辐射冷却。实际上，整个设施和地球地壳周围的体积充当了一个巨大的散热器。

附录A：在过去██年的研究中，这颗恒星的电磁辐射发生了变化，表明它正在以惊人的速度进行恒星演化。如果标准恒星模型成立，这将很快导致半径增加100至300倍，并伴随辐射能量的增加。正在研究紧急收容措施以应对这一情况。恒星生命的进一步发展很可能会以新星结束，估计其产量为███████████。外推预测这将在███████████发生。目前正在研究一种方法来阻止这种发展，或者在发生之前将SCP-037安全地运离行星。
[[collapsible show="Pituaq协议" hide="发送于1977年8月5日"]]
> **致：**O5议会
> **自：**Innis博士
> **主题：**SCP-037紧急无效化研究
>
> **正文：**先生们女士们，
>
> 植入美国国防部的特工设法改变了NASA轨道器计划的要求。现在，该航天器将被设计成有足够的空间容纳SCP-037和一个临时收容装置，以便于将其运离行星。然而，我仍然保留意见。
>
> 现代火箭技术对于这个项目的需要来说并不可靠。一个错误可能导致发射失败和随后的收容损失，可能造成灾难性的后果。即使成功发射，也必须完美无缺，否则结果可能会被世界各地的天文台和仪器，甚至裸眼所见。
>
> 基金会收容了许多文物，可能允许我们安全有效地将SCP-037运送到相邻的维度、宇宙或神秘领域。特别是SCP-███可能特别方便，考虑到最近探索它的结果，以及无效化SCP-037的难度，这也可以作为减少或消除该异常带来的威胁的附加目的。
>
> 我恳求您重新考虑Pituaq提案，这是基于这些担忧提出的。
> **信息结束**

**项目编号：**SCP-037

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-037以磁场收容于被称作Site-22的复合地下室。物体的大小、光谱特征和温度被即时于现场和从Site-98进行远程监控。

SCP-037的主收容室内衬覆盖以导热、耐辐射的纳米颗粒GFV聚合物瓦，并抽出所有气体。来自收容物的热量被辐射到周围的岩石中。如果收容室完整性受损，应急系统将产生一个低功率的氩等离子体屏蔽罩。 预计这将为现场工程师提供至少4个小时的时间，以便在异常收容失效之前进行必要的维修。

如果发生恒星演化超乎预期或者新星爆发事件迫在眉睫或者无法避免收容措施失效的情况，任何剩余的项目人员均被授权发动:“Pituaq协议”。

**描述：**SCP-037似乎是一颗直径约5厘米（2英寸）的恒星。具有太阳表面1*10^^-12^^倍的亮度，表面温度为5000K（通过UBVRI分析测定）。SCP-037的起源不明，然而，分析表明，除了其异常小的尺寸之外，它与典型的主序星有许多共同的属性。它理论上是通过地球的磁北极进入地球磁层的。

该物体发现于19██年的波佛特海的地磁北极附近。加拿大军事站点（CFS）在警报中报告有强烈的电磁干扰，随后一个极其明亮的物体从天空降向大海。驱逐舰SCPS//监护者//号予以响应，并且发现对象在水面上以循不稳定的轨道不定地摇摆。收容措施规划完毕后，对象立即被送至Site-32进行研究。

SCP-037的收容及运输可以通过强力电磁铁来完成，设备的工件会通过自身的磁场自行排列整合。目前为止收容的主要挑战一直是其強烈的电磁辐射，其强到可以在地球高空轨道上以肉眼观测。它当前的圍阻體位于地下深处以防止被目击和促使辐射逸散到周围的基岩里。事实上，整个设施及其周围的岩层就是一个巨大的散热器。

附录A：在过去██年的研究過程中，该恒星已經歷一次电磁辐射型態的变动，表明其正經歷大幅加速的恒星演化過程。如果参照标准恒星模型，这将很快導致其半径膨大100-300倍，並伴隨著辐射能量的增加。对于该可能性，正在研究紧急突发事件的控制。恒星生命周期进一步发展的结果很可能是一次新星爆炸，之後預計將生成███████████。外推法估計這可能在███████████之後发生。在此之前阻止该过程或将SCP-037运输到地球的安全距离外的研究已在進行中。

[[collapsible show="Pituaq 协议"  hide="寄于1977年8月5日"]]

> **收件人：**O5 议会
> **发件人：**Dr. Innis
> **邮件主题：**SCP-037 应急无效化研究
>
> **正文：**女士们先生们,
>
> 派往美国国防部的探员已经设法改变了NASA轨道飞行器项目的项目要求。飞行器现在的设计将有足够的空间容纳SCP-037和一个临时安全运输装置，以便把项目于运输出行星。然而，对此我仍然持保留意见。
>
> 我认为目前的火箭技术是非常不可靠的，它不能满足运输这个项目的需求。一个简单的错误就可能导致发射失败，随后使项目失去控制，其后果可能是灾难性的。即使是一次成功的发射也必须进行的非常完美，以免结果被全世界的天文台和仪器，甚至是肉眼看到。
>
> 基金会中包含了大量的收容物，这些收容物可能允许我们将SCP-037安全且经济有效地运输到邻近的维度、宇宙或着其他未知的领域。 考虑到近来对SCP-███的各种探索成果，以及对SCP-037进行无效化的困难，无效化SCP-037可能还可以用于减少或消除SCP-███带来的威胁
>
> 恳请您重新考虑到因为这些担忧而提出的Pituaq提案

**Item #:** SCP-037

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedure:** SCP-037 is magnetically contained in a subterranean complex known as Site-22. Object size, spectral signature, and temperature are constantly monitored both onsite and remotely from Site-98.

The primary containment chamber is lined with heat conducting, radiation-resistant NANOPEEK GFV polymer tiles and evacuated of any atmosphere. Heat from the object is radiated into the surrounding rock. Should enclosure integrity become compromised, the emergency system will generate a low power argon plasma shield. This is projected to provide a minimum of 4 hours for onsite engineers to effect necessary repairs before the object breaches containment.

In the contingency that stellar evolution proceeds ahead of projections and a nova event appears imminent, or if containment failure is otherwise unavoidable, any remaining project staff are authorized to initiate the Pituaq Protocol.

**Description:** SCP-037 appears to be a star approximately 5 cm (2 in) in diameter, with a luminosity of about 1*10^^-12^^ times that of our sun and a surface temperature of about 5000 K (determined by UBVRI analysis). The origin of SCP-037 is unknown, however, analysis suggests that it shares many properties in common with a typical main sequence star, other than its anomalously small size. It is theorized to have entered the Earth's magnetosphere via the North Magnetic Pole.

The object was discovered in 19██ above the Beaufort Sea at approximately the North Magnetic Pole. Intense electromagnetic interference was reported by Canadian Forces Station (CFS) Alert, followed by an extremely bright object descending toward the ocean from the sky. The SCPS //Guardian// responded and discovered the object wavering in an erratic trajectory about 200 m above the surface of the water. Once containment procedures were devised it was transported to Site-32 for study.

Containment and transport of SCP-037 have been achieved by the use of powerful electromagnets, to which the artifact aligns itself according to its own magnetic field. The primary challenge to containment thus far has been its powerful electromagnetic emissions, which are intense enough to be easily seen by the naked eye from high Earth orbit. Its current enclosure is located deep underground to prevent detection and to facilitate radiative cooling into the surrounding bedrock. In effect, the entire facility and the surrounding volume of the Earth's crust act as a massive heat sink.

Addendum A: Over the past ██ years of study, the star has undergone a shift in emitted EM radiation, suggesting that it is undergoing stellar evolution at a vastly accelerated rate. If standard stellar models hold up, this will soon result in an increase in radius by a factor of 100 to 300 times, and a concomitant increase in radiated energy. Emergency containment contingencies are being studied for that eventuality. Further progression of the star's life cycle will likely terminate in a stellar nova, which is estimated to have a yield of ███████████. Extrapolations predict this to occur in ███████████. Research is underway for a method to arrest this development or to transport SCP-037 a safe distance from the planet before it occurs.

* 一个昏暗的房间，中央地板上固定着一把椅子。电线从椅子延伸到相邻的墙壁，墙上安装有几个损坏的设备和粗糙的机械仪器。[[footnote]]这些工具的目的尚不清楚，但它们覆盖着一种未知的干燥物质和头发。[[/footnote]]墙壁上覆盖着剥落的油漆，房间角落里可见微弱的灰烬痕迹。椅子后面是一台投影仪。[[footnote]]大部分影片无法辨认，只有一段女性跳舞的片段。[[/footnote]]

**Special Containment Procedures:** The entrance to SCP-8790 has been locked and all potential entrances boarded up. A single armed guard is to be constantly patrolling SCP-8790. All access is forbidden.

**Description:** SCP-8790 is an abandoned facility located in ████████, Alabama, constructed sometime within the late 19th century. The building spans approximately 3,800 square meters and contains dormitories, administrative offices, communal areas, and other rooms with unclear purposes. Inside one of the offices, a metal placard is affixed to the wall, which reads:

[[=]]
[[div style="background: url("https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/the-great-hippo/scp_trans.png") center no-repeat; float: center; border: solid 2px #000; padding: 1px 15px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.2);"]]
++ DEPARTMENT OF ABNORMALITIES

+++ FOR THE BETTERMENT OF ALL
[[/div]]
[[/=]]
No department of this name exists within Foundation archives.

The original purpose of the facility remains unknown, as most documents and identifying materials are completely absent. Some examples of rooms within SCP-8790 include:

* A large, bare room with two rows of metal chairs facing a faded emblem on the wall. The room shows signs of extensive use, with visible scuff marks on the floor and remnants of a long-destroyed filing cabinet. Two rusted observation windows are located at either end of the room. Recovered artifacts include a rusted ledger containing lists of names alongside the notations "H2," "H3," and "Corrected."

* A room nearly filled with burnt documents and broken filing cabinets. While most papers are heavily redacted or entirely destroyed, a few intact files reference "Postwar advancements in psycho-██████ anomalies" and "Candidate irrecoverable. Decommissioned per final resolution protocol."

* A dimly lit room with a single chair bolted to the center of the floor. Wires run from the chair to an adjacent wall, where several broken devices and crude mechanical instruments are mounted.[[footnote]] The purpose of the tools are unknown, but they are covered in an unknown dried substance and hair. [[/footnote]] The walls are covered in peeling paint, and faint traces of ash are visible in the corners of the room. Behind the chair is a projector.[[footnote]] Most of the film is indecipherable, save for a clip of women dancing. [[/footnote]]

* A small, circular room featuring a cracked but functional full-length mirror. The walls are draped in thick, faded red curtains that block out most light. Small remnants of cloth and hair are lodged in the cracks of the mirror.

* A rectangular room featuring faded murals resembling winged figures. On the left side of the room is a podium with a crucifix etched onto the base. Behind it are several paddles, whips, and clamps, all highly damaged. The center of the room has stains of blood within the carpeting. The room is always lit despite the lack of windows.

* A hallway of 12 small cells, each containing a cot, a non-functional surveillance camera, and a feeding hatch built into the door. Scratch marks on the walls and ceilings spell out various words and phrases, although most are illegible.

Personnel exposed to the interior of SCP-8790 for extended periods report difficulty forming or maintaining personal relationships. This effect is often permanent among individuals attracted to the same sex.

**项目编号：**SCP-230

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-230被保存在Site-██的一个安全房间内。该房间必须配备一个受控通风系统，以确保从房间中排出的空气在重新进入建筑群的常规通风系统之前能够得到适当的过滤。SCP-230将被给予他所要求的一切，只要这些要求不违反SCP收容标准程序。门在每次关闭时都会自动上锁，并且只能从房间外部打开。进入SCP-230房间的人员必须穿着带有自身氧气供应的全套危险品防护服。暴露于SCP-230房间内的空气或与SCP-230或任何SCP-230体液发生物理接触的人员必须被收容并观察至少一个月。在一个月后仍然表现出SCP-230症状的人员将被处决。如果人员在一个月后被现场工作人员清除，他们将被转移并禁止与SCP-230接触。

由于最近发生的事件，已经暴露并被工作人员清除的对象需要接受定期的心理检查。如果在检查中人员表现出文件230-4436b中列出的任何特征，该人员将被处决。

**笔记：**对象利用暴露于SCP-230的人员进行了几次逃跑尝试。这代表了一种低威胁，因为暴露人员通常会受到损害；然而，人员会变得暴力，以便留在SCP-230的面前。

**描述：**SCP-230是一名高瘦的白人男性。SCP-230身高185厘米（6英尺1英寸），体重68.04公斤（150磅），年龄约为三十岁。他穿着鲜艳的衣服，喜欢粉色和黄色。SCP-230是一个非常乐观的人，似乎无法产生负面情绪。

SCP-230从他的毛孔中分泌出一种化学物质，其成分类似于海洛因。这种化学物质被称为化合物-███。一旦从他的毛孔中分泌出来，它就会立即蒸发并污染SCP-230周围的空气。化合物-███似乎在气体形式下有效，浓度仅为百万分之三十。当吸入时，化合物-███会导致对象极度欣快。对受SCP-230影响的D级人员的分析表明，他们的多巴胺水平高于性高潮期间预期的五倍。对象表现出与海洛因相似的损害。对象愿意遵守SCP-230提出的任何要求，只要这些要求不涉及离开SCP-230的视线。

化合物-███存在于SCP-230的所有体液中。即使通过接触SCP-230的皮肤也可能导致暴露。暴露于化合物将导致立即成瘾。戒断症状极为严重，死亡率高达百分之三十。症状包括：食欲不振、颤抖、恐慌、呕吐、腹泻、易怒、痴呆、疯狂、失明和出血，尽管症状因对象而异。症状通常持续约两周才会消退。症状似乎是根据对象暴露于化合物-███的程度来确定的。摄入SCP-230的任何体液（如唾液、血液等）的对象的戒断死亡率为百分之百。

SCP-230在一个有二十个人充当仆人的公寓里被发现█████████。SCP-230似乎正在积极地试图限制他暴露的人数。在场地上发现了几具暴露人员的尸体。当被问及此事时，SCP-230回答说：“事情变得很拥挤，所以我不得不让他们停止呼吸。”

SCP-230似乎处于化合物-███的影响之下，但似乎没有以任何方式受到它的损害。改变SCP-230情绪的尝试已被证明是无效的。使用各种已知会引起抑郁的药物只会导致SCP-230产生更多的化合物-███，因此是无效的。

SCP-230是一个非常友好的人，并且会坦诚地与任何人员交谈。SCP-230不知道他是如何或何时开始分泌化合物-███的。当被问及他的过去时，SCP-230回答说，他一直都在分泌化合物-███，直到他能记得为止。

SCP-230更喜欢谈论他认为“好”或“快乐”的事物。SCP-230对“快乐”这个词有一些心理依恋。当被要求描述自己时，SCP-230用了六次“快乐”，四次“欢乐”，一次“最快乐”来描述自己是“活着最快乐的男人”。

**██████博士的笔记：**//SCP-230对“快乐”这个词的痴迷与性取向无关。SCP-230似乎没有性取向，因为他完全缺乏对性的兴趣。这很有道理，因为SCP-230在进行任何给定活动时都体验到相同的乐趣，使性行为变得没有必要。//

**附录230-1：**二级人员研究员██████ ███在研究过程中意外暴露于化合物-███。██████ ███被拘留并送往治疗，直至戒断症状消失。一个月后，██████ ███在医疗人员的批准下被释放。两个月后，██████ ███被发现试图闯入SCP-230的收容区域。██████ ███反应激烈，在她被拘留前伤了几个人。██████ ███在检查后被处决，并采取了预防措施以防止进一步发生；参见文件230-4436b。

reference:
**项目编号：**SCP-230

**项目等级：**Euclid

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-230被收容于██号站点的一个看守严密的房间内。房间须设有可控的通风设施，以确保从中排出的空气在重新进入站点的常规通风系统前能够被适当地过滤。在不违背SCP收容标准程序的情况下，应满足SCP-230的任何需求。门被设置为在每次关闭后自动上锁，且只能从房间外开启。进入房间的人员必须完整装备独立供氧的防护套装。暴露在SCP-230房间的空气中或与SCP-230及其体液存在身体接触的人员将被收容并受到不少于一个月的观察。一个月后仍表现出SCP-230相关症状的人员将被处决。若一个月后人员被现场员工证明无异常，则应将其调走并禁止其接触SCP-230。

鉴于近期的事件，通过观察的对象须定期接受心理检查。在检查中表现出任何文件230-4436b所述特征的人员将被处决。

**注意：**对象已利用接触SCP-230的人员数次尝试逃跑。由于人员通常都受到了损伤，这些尝试没有造成太大的威胁；然而，人员会为了留在SCP-230身边而变得暴力。

**描述：**SCP-230是一个体格精壮、面容瘦峭的男性白人。SCP-230身高185厘米（6英尺1英寸），体重68.04千克（150磅），外表为30岁出头。他衣着鲜艳，喜欢粉色和黄色。SCP-230性格非常开朗，似乎从来不会表现出负面情绪。

SCP-230的毛孔中会分泌出一种化学成分与海洛因类似的物质。这种物质被命名为化合物-███。从毛孔中被分泌出来后，它会立即蒸发，污染SCP-230周围的空气。化合物-███在气体中所占体积达到百万分之三十时即可起效。化合物-███被吸入后会引起极度的兴奋。对处于SCP-230影响下的D级人员的分析表明，此时血液中的多巴胺含量比性高潮时多巴胺预期含量的五倍还高。受试者表现出类似海洛因引发的损伤。他们将会满足SCP-230的任何要求，只要不离开SCP-230身边。

化合物-███在SCP-230的所有体液中都存在，甚至连与SCP-230进行皮肤接触都有感染的可能。接触这种化合物将立即导致成瘾，戒断症状非常激烈且有30％的致死率。症状包括：食欲减退、颤抖、心慌、呕吐、腹泻、烦躁、痴呆、精神失常、失明和严重内出血等，但个体症状有所差异。症状通常持续约两周后消退。症状似乎是由接触的化合物-███剂量多少所决定的。如果受试者摄入了SCP-230的任何体液（如唾液、血液等），戒断致死率将达到100％。

SCP-230在位于█████████的一座公寓里被发现，当时有二十人充当他的仆人。SCP-230似乎主动试图为被影响者的数量设限。现场发现了几具受影响者的尸体。当被问到时，SCP-230回答说：“越来越挤了，所以我只能叫几个人停止呼吸。”

SCP-230似乎也处于化合物-███的作用之下，但看上去他没有受到任何损害。转换其情绪的尝试均告失败。使用到的数种可引发抑郁症的药物都只能导致SCP-230分泌更多的化合物-███，因此被证明无效。

SCP-230是一个非常友好的人，愿意与任何人员坦率地交谈。SCP-230不清楚自己是怎样开始或从何时开始分泌化合物-███的。当被问及他的过去时，SCP-230回答说记忆里自己一直在分泌化合物-███。

SCP-230喜欢谈论那些他认为“好的”或“愉悦的”事物。SCP-230对“愉悦”这个词语有心理依附。当被要求对自己进行描述时，SCP-230使用了六次“愉悦的”，四次“愉悦[[footnote]] **译注：**名词[[/footnote]]”，以及在当他自称“世界上最愉悦的人”的时候使用了一次“最愉悦的”。

**██████博士注：**//SCP-230专注的“愉悦”和性取向无关。SCP-230似乎并没有什么性取向，因为他对性爱完全没有兴趣。这很容易理解，因为SCP-230无论做什么都能感受到同等的欢愉，性爱是毫无必要的。//

**附录230-1：**2级研究员██████ ███在研究时意外接触了化合物-███。██████ ███被拘押并在戒断症状持续期中接受治疗。一个月后，医务人员确认██████ ███的症状已经消除，██████ ███被释放。两个月后，██████ ███在试图闯入SCP-230的收容区域时被发现。██████ ███暴力地反抗，在被拘禁前使多名人员受伤。经检测后，██████ ███被处决。已制定预防措施以避免发生更多事故，详见文档230-4436b。

**Item #**: SCP-230

**Object Class**: Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures**: SCP-230 is kept in a secure room in Site-██. The room must have a controlled ventilation system so that air exiting the room can be properly filtered before it reenters the regular ventilation system of the complex. SCP-230 is to be given anything he requests that does not violate standard procedures for SCP containment. The door is set to automatically lock every time it closes and can only be opened from outside the room. Personnel entering SCP-230's room must wear a full HAZMAT suit with its own oxygen supply. Personnel exposed to the air in SCP-230's cell or who come in physical contact with SCP-230 or any of SCP-230's bodily fluids must be contained and held for observation for no less than one month. Personnel still exhibiting symptoms from SCP-230 after one month are to be terminated. If personnel are cleared by on-site staff after a month, they are then to be transferred and forbidden contact with SCP-230.

Due to recent events, subjects that have been exposed and cleared by staff are required to undergo regular psychological exams. If upon exam the personnel exhibits any of the traits shown in document 230-4436b, the personnel is to be terminated.

**NOTE**: Subject has made several escape attempts utilizing personnel exposed to SCP-230. This represents a low threat due to the fact that exposed personnel are usually impaired; however, personnel will become violent in order to stay in SCP-230's presence.

**Description**: SCP-230 is a male Caucasian with a lean build and gaunt appearance. SCP-230 is 185 cm (6 ft 1 in) tall, 68.04 kg (150 lbs), and appears to be in his early thirties. He wears bright clothing and prefers the colors pink and yellow. SCP-230 is a very cheerful individual who appears to be incapable of negative emotions.

SCP-230 secretes a chemical similar in composition to heroin from his pores. The chemical has been named Compound-███. Once secreted from his pores, it evaporates immediately and contaminates the air around SCP-230. Compound-███ seems to be effective in as little as thirty parts per million in gaseous form. When inhaled, Compound-███ causes extreme euphoria in subjects. Analysis on Class-D personnel under the effects of SCP-230 indicated they had dopamine levels greater than five times of what is expected during sexual climax. Subjects express impairment similar to the effects of heroin. Subjects become willing to comply with any request SCP-230 makes provided it does not involve leaving SCP-230's presence.

Compound-███ is present in all of SCP-230's bodily fluids. Exposure is possible even by contact with SCP-230's skin. Exposure to the compound will result in immediate addiction. Withdrawal symptoms are extreme and have a thirty percent mortality rate. Symptoms include: loss of appetite, tremors, panic, vomiting, diarrhea, irritability, dementia, insanity, blindness, and hemorrhaging, though symptoms vary from subject to subject. Symptoms typically last for around two weeks before subsiding. The symptoms appear to be determined by how much of Compound-███ the subject is exposed to. Subjects that ingest any of SCP-230's bodily fluid (i.e. saliva, blood, etc) have a mortality rate from withdrawal of 100%.

SCP-230 was found in an apartment in █████████ with twenty people acting as his servants. SCP-230 seemed to be actively attempting to limit the number of people he exposed. Several bodies of exposed persons were found on the premises. When questioned about them, SCP-230 replied, "Things were getting crowded, so I had to ask a few of them to stop breathing."

SCP-230 appears to be under the effects of Compound-███, but doesn't seem to be impaired by it in any way. Attempts to alter SCP-230's mood have proven ineffective. Use of various drugs known to cause depression only resulted in SCP-230 producing more of Compound-███ and thus were ineffective.

SCP-230 is a very friendly individual and will candidly engage in conversation with any personnel. SCP-230 is unaware of how or when he began secreting Compound-███. When questioned about his past, SCP-230 replied that he has been secreting Compound-███ as long as he can remember.

SCP-230 prefers to talk about things he considers "good" or "gay". SCP-230 has some psychological attachment to the word "gay". When asked to describe himself, SCP-230 used the word "gay" six times, "gaiety" four times, and the word "gayest" once when SCP-230 referred to himself as "the gayest man alive."

**Note by Dr. ██████:** //SCP-230's preoccupation with the word "gay" has nothing to do with sexual orientation. SCP-230 doesn't appear to have a sexual orientation due to a lack of interest in sex entirely. This makes sense, seeing as SCP-230 experiences the same amount of pleasure doing any given activity, making sex unnecessary.//

**Addendum 230-1:** Class 2 personnel researcher ██████ ███ was accidentally exposed to Compound-███ during research. ██████ ███ was detained and sent to treatment for the duration of withdrawal symptoms. After one month, ██████ ███ was released after being cleared by medical staff. Two months later, ██████ ███ was found trying to break into SCP-230's containment area. ██████ ███ reacted violently and injured several personnel before she was detained. ██████ ███ was terminated after examination, and precautions have been made to prevent further occurrence; see document 230-4436b.

**Document 230-4436b:** [DATA EXPUNGED]

hypothesis:
**CAIRNS：**不。这还不至于需要我们再安排//更多//次预约。我觉得我最近心里有太多事了，开始影响到我了。

**MANN：**确实。都快二十年了，不是吗？

**CAIRNS：**是的。

//沉默。//

**MANN：**我能感觉到你很困扰。

**CAIRNS：**哈！好吧，这应该很明显。

**MANN：**你知道我的意思。

**CAIRNS：**我知道，我很抱歉。只是让你受累了。（//停顿//）前几天我和Sophia聊过，她打电话过来想谈谈，而我只是……你知道的，有点好笑。我已经习惯了醒来照镜子看到一个完全不同的自己。我经历了那么多//我//的不同版本，有时候我会开始怀疑自己在这里还剩下多少。我记得，当我还是……嗯，当我第一次成为我自己时，我会注意到一些小变化，因为其他部分的我保持不变，但你看一个痘痘或者一根杂毛就会显得格外突出。现在我唯一和自己共有的东西就是这个（//轻敲右眼//），所以这让我一直在思考。那个东西真的是我吗？

**MANN：**那枚硬币感觉像是你的中心吗？

**CAIRNS：**你知道，其实并不完全是。我还是觉得我在这里的某个地方……在我的脑子里。即使手臂感觉更重了，或者脚稍微小了一点，或者其他任何事情，我还是感觉……我感觉我还是在这里。

**MANN：**这至少能让人感到些许安慰吧。

**CAIRNS：**Sophia这么说的。她说如果我现在只是一个硬币，那会很疯狂。

**MANN：**而且还是个寄生硬币。

**CAIRNS：**我们见过更奇怪的东西。

**MANN：**我们当然见过。（//停顿//）好吧，我觉得我们已经触及了重要的事情。就这样吧。

**CAIRNS：**好的。我希望稍后能和Troy一起吃晚饭，我想我们打算在电影下映前去看场《变形金刚》电影。

**MANN：**有点对牛弹琴，不是吗？

**CAIRNS：**哈哈。有趣的人。

**MANN：**我尽力了。你确定不想让我申请一次医学评估来调整你的睡眠辅助药物吗？

**CAIRNS：**是的，没关系。没那么糟糕了。

**MANN：**还有那些噩梦，它们减轻了吗？

**CAIRNS：**（//停顿//）没有，真的没有，只是……它们安静了一些。

**MANN：**你的意思是？

**CAIRNS：**梦境，它们……我还能听到它们的声音，你知道吗？当我睡着的时候。我能看见它们，就像我现在和你说话一样。并不是每次都这样，而且药物肯定有帮助，但有时候我只是……出现在它们所在的地方。一开始它们很愤怒，声音很大，而且……而且有时候我不知道这是不是梦，还是别的什么。它们从不说话，从来不说，但我还是能……我能分辨出来。有时候它们仍然很愤怒。我能看到所有他们的脸，所有我曾经的样子，而它们……它们想要答案，而我无法给出。

**MANN：**什么样的答案？

**CAIRNS：**我不知道。为什么会发生这样的事。为什么它们还在这里。甚至它们是否真的在这里。

**MANN：**还有Aileen呢？

**CAIRNS：**（//停顿//）是的。她也在里面。

**MANN：**她看起来……愤怒吗？

**CAIRNS：**不，不是愤怒。她//从来没有//愤怒过。一开始她……我想她是为我难过。她会用那种眼神看着我，就像……看到它会让你心碎。但已经快二十年了。在这所有人中，她可能是最……//乐于取笑//的。我感觉她觉得这很有趣。

**MANN：**我明白了。

**CAIRNS：**但这一切都是不可量化的，你知道吗。就我所知，我看到的所有这些面孔，只是我的潜意识在耍我。

**MANN：**你知道有多少吗？

**CAIRNS：**多少什么？

**MANN：**你变成过多少种不同的人？

**CAIRNS：**（//停顿//）四百七十一。

**MANN：**你确定？

**CAIRNS：**是的。四百十八人——包括一位[[[SCP-4444|美国总统]]]，我会提醒你——二十六只猿猴，十二只狗，八只猫，两只豚鼠，两匹马和一匹骡子。Troy觉得最后一个很有趣。Aileen也这么认为。

**MANN：**有点有趣。

**CAIRNS：**（//大笑//）非常有趣。（//停顿//）实际上，我知道他们所有的名字。不只是Aileen——他们每一个人，甚至是我不认识的那些人。那个滑雪板运动员是Lynn Simon——偶然在一张度假照片的背景中瞥见了096。那个记者是Park Seo-yeon——一开始他们真的很生气。很多人是D级人员。很多人是我的同事。他们都在那里。我认识他们每一个人的脸。（//停顿//）他们都是我，我想。我是他们所有人。

[记录结束]

**MANN：**你觉得硬币是你的核心吗？

**CAIRNS：**说实话，不像。我还是觉得，我仍然……存在于更深的某处。在我自己的脑袋里。就算手臂变沉、脚掌变小，诸如此类，我还是觉得……我在更深的某处。

**MANN：**这倒是让人安心。

**CAIRNS：**Sophia也是这么说的。她说，要是我变成一枚硬币，那可太奇怪了。

**MANN：**还是枚寄生硬币。

**CAIRNS：**更怪的我们也见过吧。

**MANN：**确实。（//停顿//）好的，我想重点都谈到了。今天就到这里吧。

**CAIRNS：**好。我还想晚点找Troy吃个便饭，试试能不能在《变形金刚》下映之前找到个时间去看。

**MANN：**这对你来说真不是什么赤裸裸的比喻吗？

**CAIRNS：**哈，哈。幽默大师。

**MANN：**尽力而为啦。确定不需要我申请一个医疗评估来调整你的助眠药物？

**CAIRNS：**嗯，不用了。已经不像以前那么糟了。

**MANN：**那噩梦呢，平息了吗？

**CAIRNS：**（//停顿//）不，没有。只是……安静些了。

**MANN：**什么意思？

**CAIRNS：**那些梦，他们……我仍然能听见他们所有的声音，你明白吗？当我睡着的时候，我能看到他们，就像我们现在面对面这么清晰。不是每次都会，药物确实有帮助，但有时我就会……出现在他们所在的什么地方。起初他们充满愤怒，声音高亢，而且……而且有时候我会分不清是否身处梦境。他们不说话，从来不说，但我还是能……我能感知到。有时他们依然愤怒。我能看见所有面孔，所有我曾成为的人，而我……我给不了他们想要的答案。

**MANN：**什么样的答案？

**CAIRNS：**我不知道。为什么会发生这些。为什么他们还存在在这里。我甚至不确定它们到底存不存在。

**MANN：**Aileen呢？

**CAIRNS：**（//停顿//）嗯。她也在那儿。

**MANN：**她看起来……愤怒吗？

**CAIRNS：**不，不愤怒。她//从未//愤怒过。最初她……我觉得她在为我难过。她看我的眼神……真的让人心碎。但已经过了二十年了。在所有人之中，她可能是最……//欢快//的那一个。我感觉，她可能觉得这很有趣。

**MANN：**我明白了。

**CAIRNS：**但这些都无法量化，对吧。说不定那些面孔都只是我的潜意识在耍我。

**MANN：**你知道具体数量吗？

**CAIRNS：**什么数量？

**MANN：**你成为过多少个不同的人？

**CAIRNS：**（//停顿//）四百七十一个。

**MANN：**你确定？

**CAIRNS：**嗯。四百一十八个人类——提醒你，包括一位[[[scp-4444|时任美国总统]]]——二十六只猿类，十二条狗，八只猫，两只豚鼠和两只小鼠，两匹马，还有一头骡子。Troy觉得最后这个太好笑了。Aileen也是。

**MANN：**是有点好笑。

**CAIRNS：**（//大笑//）特别好笑（//停顿//）其实我记得他们每个人的名字。不仅是[[span class="ruby"]]Aileen[[span class="rt"]]艾 琳[[/span]][[/span]]——是每一个，包括那些我原本不认识的。滑雪玩家是[[span class="ruby"]]Lynn Simon[[span class="rt"]]林 恩 · 西 蒙[[/span]][[/span]]——意外瞥到了度假照片背景里的096。记者叫[[span class="ruby"]]Park Seo-yeon[[span class="rt"]]朴 书 妍[[/span]][[/span]]——他们一开始//非常//生气。很多是D级人员。也有很多是同事。他们都在那里。我认得每一张脸。（//停顿//）我想，他们都是我。我也是他们所有人。

[记录结束]
[[/div]]

source:
把下面的英文 SCP Wikidot 文本转换为中文 SCP Wikidot 文本：

**CAIRNS:** Nah. It's not so bad that we need to set up //more// appointments. I think I just had a lot on my mind recently, was starting to get to me.

**MANN:** Indeed. It's almost been twenty years, hasn't it?

**CAIRNS:** It has.

//Silence.//

**MANN:** I sense you're troubled.

**CAIRNS:** Hah! Well, that much should be obvious.

**MANN:** You know what I mean.

**CAIRNS:** I know, I'm sorry. Just giving you a hard time. (//Pauses//) I was talking to Sophia the other day, she had called to talk, and I just... it's kind of funny, you know. I've gotten used to waking up and looking in the mirror and seeing someone different. I've gone through so many iterations of //me// that sometimes I start wondering how much of me is still left in here. I remember how, when I was... well, back when I was the first me, and I would notice little changes because the rest of me would stay the same, but you see a pimple or a stray hair and it stands out. Now the only thing I've got in common with myself is this thing (//taps right eye//), so it just had me wondering. Is that thing me?

**MANN:** Does the coin feel like your center?

**CAIRNS:** You know, it doesn't really. I still feel like I'm just... in here somewhere. Inside my own head. Even if the arms feel heavier or my feet are a little smaller or any of it, I still feel... I feel like I'm still in here.

**MANN:** That has to be somewhat reassuring.

**CAIRNS:** That's what Sophia said. She said it would be wild if I was just a coin now.

**MANN:** A parasitic coin, at that.

**CAIRNS:** We've seen stranger.

**MANN:** We certainly have. (//Pauses//) Alright, I think we've touched on the important things. That should do it.

**CAIRNS:** Good. I was hoping to grab dinner with Troy later, I think we're going to try and catch a showing of that Transformers movie before it leaves theaters.

**MANN:** Little on the nose, isn't it?

**CAIRNS:** Har har. Funny guy.

**MANN:** I do what I can. You're sure you don't want me to put in for a medical evaluation to adjust your sleeping aids?

**CAIRNS:** Yeah, it's alright. It's not as bad as it used to be.

**MANN:** And the nightmares, have those subsided?

**CAIRNS:** (//Pauses//) No, not really, just... they're quieter.

**MANN:** What do you mean?

**CAIRNS:** The dreams, they're... I can still hear them all, you know? When I'm asleep. I can see them, same as I'm talking to you now. Not always, and the meds definitely help, but sometimes I just sort of... appear wherever they are. In the beginning they were angry, and loud, and... and sometimes I didn't know if it was a dream, or something else. They don't speak, they never speak, but I can still just... I can tell. Sometimes they're still angry. I can see all their faces, all the ones I've been, and they... they want answers I can't give them.

**MANN:** What kind of answers?

**CAIRNS:** I don't know. Why this happened. Why they're still here. If they're even here at all.

**MANN:** And Aileen?

**CAIRNS:** (//Pauses//) Yeah. She's in there too.

**MANN:** Does she seem... angry?

**CAIRNS:** No, not angry. She was //never// angry. At the beginning she was... I think she was sad for me. She would give me this look that, like... it would break your heart to see it. But it's been almost twenty years. Of all of them, she's maybe the most... //amused//. I get the feeling she thinks it's funny.

**MANN:** I see.

**CAIRNS:** But there's nothing quantifiable about it, you know. For all I know, all those faces I see, they're just my subconscious fucking with me.

**MANN:** Do you know how many?

**CAIRNS:** How many what?

**MANN:** How many different people you've been?

**CAIRNS:** (//Pauses//) Four hundred and seventy-one.

**MANN:** You're sure?

**CAIRNS:** Yeah. Four hundred and eighteen people - including a [[[SCP-4444|sitting US President]]], I'll remind you - twenty-six apes, twelve dogs, eight cats, two each of guinea pigs and lab mice, two horses and a mule. Troy thought the last one was funny. Aileen did too.

**MANN:** It's a little funny.

**CAIRNS:** (//Laughs//) It's a lot funny. (//Pauses//) I know all of their names, actually. Not just Aileen - every single one of them, even the ones I didn't know beforehand. The snowboarder was Lynn Simon - accidentally caught a glimpse of 096 in the background of a vacation photo. The journalist was Park Seo-yeon - they were //really// angry at first. A lot of them were D-Class. A lot of them were colleagues. They're all in there. I've known every single one of their faces. (//Pauses//) They were all me, I guess. I'm all of them.

[END LOG]

hypothesis:
**项目编号：**SCP-5518

**项目等级：**Thaumiel

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-5518应被存放在Site-19的六个安全储物柜中。根据伦理委员会的命令，目前不允许直接接触SCP-5518。

**描述：**SCP-5518是一套六块方形石质板，每块长0.5米，宽0.5米，厚1.5厘米。这些板子被设计成可以组装成一个盒子，并且每个板子上都刻有相同的文字，但用不同的语言书写[[footnote]]这些语言包括英语、普通话、西班牙语、印地语、ASCII二进制码以及一种未知的文字，这种文字与任何已知的语言或书写风格（过去和现在）都没有相似之处。[[/footnote]]，详见附录-5518。这段文字提供了激活SCP-5518主要异常功能的说明。

SCP-5518的主要功能是实施一次瞬时YK级现实重构事件，在此过程中，基准现实将被消耗以生成一个完全相同的镜像现实。SCP-5518及其内容不受该事件影响，并在确定的时间和地点重新出现在镜像现实中。因此，可以在激活前将物体和信息存储在组装好的SCP-5518盒子里，从而在基准现实和镜像现实之间进行转移。

**发现：**SCP-5518是在Site-19的一个空库房内自发显现的，当时它已经完全组装成一个盒子。SCP-5518的出现立即被现场监控系统标记，基金会特工被派去评估任何可能的威胁。当SCP-5518随后被拆解成其板状部件时，里面发现了大量的打印文件，包括以下内容：

• 证明SCP-5518是由基金会一名正式授权成员发送的安全凭证。
• [http://www.scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-231 SCP-231]、[http://www.scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-2845 SCP-2845]和[http://www.scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-3600 SCP-3600]的地点和特殊收容措施[[footnote]]当时这些SCP尚未被发现。[[/footnote]]。
• 建造[http://www.scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-711 SCP-711]并防止[http://www.scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-2000 SCP-2000]崩溃的建筑计划。
• [http://www.scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/wmdd-s-proposal 防线计划]的操作数据。
• [已编辑]

**附录-5518-A：**SCP-5518上每个板子所刻文字的转录：
[[div class="blockquote"]]
这不是救赎。这个盒子代表了我们最大的失败，我们只把它作为最后的手段来使用，以警告那些我们太晚才能克服的威胁。这些威胁会及时到来。我们无法生存下来，我们牺牲了我们剩下的所有东西来传达我们的警告。不要让我们的死亡白费。

这个盒子的设计是为了通过重置现实来传递它的内容。这些功能可以通过[伦理委员会下令删除的指示]激活。

你现在是基准现实。你是我们从未拥有的第二次机会，如果你不能阻止黑暗，盒子就会等着你。传递你的警告，接受你的谴责，就像我们一样，新的世界将继续尝试。
[[/div]]

[[collapsible show="+进一步访问仅限5级权限" hide="-欢迎监督者"]]

**文件-5518：**以下文件是关于先前迭代中使用SCP-5518情况的简要汇编。

||~ 编号 ||~ 描述 ||~ 后果 ||
||XA-1 ||已知最早使用SCP-5518的现实迭代。社会的发展总体上呈积极趋势，经济趋势、环境因素和社会动荡均超过当前社会约1.5个标准差。这一趋势持续到2089年，当时异常首次被公众发现。基金会成立，试图收容这一威胁，但最终证明无效，导致社会秩序迅速崩溃。到2098年，异常现象使地球不再适合人类长期居住。 ||SCP-5518提供了第一个正式的特殊收容程序开发指南，以及发现[https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-001 SCP-001]的坐标。 ||
||XA-2 ||基金会成立于1824年，大约比异常现象被发现早两年。随后的调查使基金会与各种利益相关团体发生冲突，包括破碎之神教会、蛇之手和Marshall、Carter和Dark有限公司。这些冲突的升级导致公众了解异常现象，随后引发了武器化异常的国际军备竞赛。最终，在1970年，罗伯特·肯尼迪总统发起了一场冲突，导致所有已知的利益相关团体之间的冲突，最终导致人类文明的崩溃。 ||SCP-5518提供了[https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-3000 SCP-3000]的完整文档和记忆删除的发展。迭代XB-1进一步指示了刺杀罗伯特·肯尼迪的精确时间和方法。 ||
||XB-3 ||为应对异常现象的兴起，基金会利用SCP-5518获得的知识对所有主要国家进行了秘密渗透。任何已知的利益相关团体都被迅速镇压，到1998年，一个影子政府在全球社会建立起来。此后，异常活动显著减少。然而，公民自由权实际上已被从普通民众中消除，多次叛乱企图篡夺基金会统治。其中最大的一次叛乱最终在2043年成功刺杀了O5议会，导致社会随后崩溃，SCP-5518被不明势力窃取。 ||从这一迭代开始，SCP-5518的内容未知，因为该项目被非基金会人员使用。SCP-5518在最终被基金会回收之前被使用了未知次数。 ||
||XC-4 ||基金会成立于1778年，当时SCP-5518自发出现在安娜·斯特龙[[footnote]]**译注：**安娜·斯特龙（Anna Strong），美国独立战争时期间谍，参与了“康普顿环”（Culper Ring）间谍组织。[[/footnote]]的监管下。基金会几乎不干扰公众社会就完成了其使命，并在1921年前成功收容了近4000个SCP。然而，此后现实似乎出现了自发的完整性丧失。症状始于物理场所的消失，最终发展为各种物理定律的消失。SCP-5518在2012年被使用，就在时间线完全崩溃之前。 ||SCP-5518提供了当前SCP数据库的大约80%。尽管进行了大量研究，但现实崩溃的确切原因仍未确定，调查仍在迭代XC-5继续进行。 ||
||XC-5 ||最近的先前迭代。基金会成立于1843年，并立即继续调查迭代XC-4的崩溃。一个工作理论提出，SCP-5518可能参与了之前的现实崩溃。这导致决定限制所有对SCP-5518及其内容的访问。然而，此后异常现象迅速增加，到1901年，地球变得不适合人类长期居住。 ||SCP-5518提供了一个修订后的标准，用于建立基金会的有效伦理委员会。 ||

**伦理附录：**以下声明由基金会伦理委员会发布给O5议会。

[[div class="blockquote"]]
SCP-5518代表了基金会的一个独特机会。重置现实的能力同时意味着选择现实结果的能力，是的，我们可以利用这一点来警告K级情景或传达更好的未来指令。然而，在任何情况下使用SCP-5518都是不可接受的。

首先，异常是不可预测的，我们不能把整个现实托付给一个连基本测试都无法进行的对象。也许这对我们的前辈有效，但我们怎么能确定它还会起作用？我们怎么能确定它不会带来不希望的副作用？这些问题我们永远无法给出明确的答案。

更重要的是，基金会的唯一职责是保护我们的基准现实。任何镜像现实的改进都是无关紧要的，因为这些现实都不是我们的。我们的前辈可能放弃了他们的责任，但无论好坏，这是我们的世界，我们会坚守到最后。因此，禁止SCP-5518的所有未来使用。

拆开盒子，锁好板子；控制，收容，保护。其他什么都不重要。
[[/div]]

[[/collapsible]]

reference:
**项目编号：**SCP-5518

**项目等级：**Thaumiel

**特殊收容措施：**SCP-5518被分别储存于Site-19的6个异常收容储物柜中。根据伦理道德委员会的命令，不允许直接使用SCP-5518。

**描述：**SCP-5518是一组6个由未知石料构成的石板，经测量其长0.5m，宽0.5m，厚1.5cm。这些石板被设计成可以组装为一个“魔盒”，同时都分别刻有不同语言相同含义的文本[[footnote]]这些语言包括英语、汉语普通话、西班牙语、印地语、ASCII二进制码以及一未知的字体，该未知字体不像过去或现在的任何已知语言或写作风格。[[/footnote]]，详情请查阅附录-5518。该文本介绍了如何激活SCP-5518的异常效应。

SCP-5518的异常效应表现为产生一个瞬时的YK级现实重构情景，其中基本现实将被消耗，以生成一个相同的镜像现实。此K级情景不会影响SCP-5518及其异常内容，并会在激活过程决定的时间和地点重新出现在镜像现实中。因此，通过在激活前将对象和信息存储在SCP-5518的“魔盒”中，可以在基本现实和镜像现实之间传输对象和信息。

**发现：**SCP-5518被发现时，其在Site-19的一个空地下室内自发地组装成了“魔盒”。SCP-5518的出现立即被现场的监控系统标记，基金会特工被派遣以评估任何可能的威胁。当随后将SCP-5518拆分成石板组件时，在其中发现大量印刷文件，包括以下内容：

• 证明SCP-5518是由基金会正式员工所传送的安保凭证。
• [https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-231 SCP-231]、[https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-2845 SCP-2845]及[https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-3600 SCP-3600][[footnote]]所有这些SCP项目在当时都未被发现。[[/footnote]]的位置及特殊收容措施。
• 建设[https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-711 SCP-711]以及防止[https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-2000 SCP-2000]崩溃的计划。
• [https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/wmdd-s-proposal 围栏计划]的操作数据。
• [已编辑]

**附录-5518：**SCP-5518每块石板上文字的抄本如下：
[[div class="blockquote"]]
这不是救赎。这个魔盒代表了我们最大的失败，我们只把它作为最后的手段，对那些我们来不及克服的威胁发出警告。这些威胁迟早会降临到你们身上。他们使我们无法生存，为了发出警告，我们牺牲了一切。不要让我们白白牺牲。这个盒子被设计用来通过重置现实来传送里面的东西。这些功能将由[根据伦理道德委员会的命令删除]激活。

你们现在是基本现实。你们是我们从未有过的第二次机会，如果你们不能控制住黑暗，魔盒就在等着你们。
[[/div]]

[[collapsible show="+进一步访问需要5级权限" hide="-欢迎，监督者"]]
**伦理道德委员会备注：**以下声明由基金会伦理道德委员会向O5议会发布。

[[div class="blockquote"]]
SCP-5518是基金会的一个独特的机会。能重置现实的能力同时也是选择现实如何结果的能力。同时，是的，我们可以用它来预警K级情景，或者为了一个更加安定和平的未来而传达命令。然而，在任何情况下使用SCP-5518都是不可接受的。

首先，异常是无法被预测的，同时我们不能把整个现实托付给一个甚至不能被进行适当测试的项目。也许它对我们的前辈们奏效了，但我们怎么能确定它会再次奏效呢？我们怎么能确定它不会带来不必要的副作用呢？这些问题我们永远没有明确的答案。

尽管如此，更重要的是，基金会只负责于我们的基本现实。任何对镜像现实的改动都是完全不必要的，因为这些现实不是我们自己的。我们的前辈可能已经放弃了他们的责任，但不管是好是坏，现在这是我们的世界，我们会坚持到最后。因此，今后禁止使用SCP-5518。

拆开那个“魔盒”，单独锁存每块石板；控制，收容，保护。没有什么比这更重要。

把下面的英文 SCP Wikidot 文本转换为中文 SCP Wikidot 文本：

[[>]]
[[module Rate]]
[[/>]]

**Item #:** SCP-5518

**Object Class:** Thaumiel

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-5518 is to be stored at Site-19 in six secure storage lockers. By order of the Ethics Committee, no direct access to SCP-5518 is currently permitted.

**Description:** SCP-5518 is a set of six square plates of an unknown stone material, measuring 0.5 meters in length, 0.5 meters in width, and 1.5 cm in depth. These plates are designed to be assembled into a box and are each inscribed with the same text in a different language[[footnote]] These languages include English, Mandarin, Spanish, Hindi, ASCII binary code, and an unknown script, bearing no resemblance to any known language or writing style, past or present. [[/footnote]], as noted in Addendum-5518. This text provides the instructions for activating the primary anomalous function of SCP-5518.

The primary function of SCP-5518 is to implement an instantaneous YK-Class Reality Restructuring Event, wherein the baseline reality would be consumed in order to generate an identical mirror reality. SCP-5518 and its contents are not affected by this event, and reappear in the mirror reality at a time and location that is determined by the activation procedure. Objects and information may thus be transferred between the baseline and mirror reality by storing them in the assembled box form of SCP-5518 prior to activation.

**Discovery:** SCP-5518 was discovered when it spontaneously materialized in an empty vault in Site-19 as a fully assembled box. The appearance of SCP-5518 was immediately flagged by the on-site surveillance system, and Foundation agents were dispatched to assess any possible threats. When SCP-5518 was subsequently disassembled into its plate components, a large number of printed files were found inside, including the following:

•	Security credentials to establish that SCP-5518 was sent by a duly authorized member of the Foundation.
•	The locations and special containment procedures for [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-231 SCP-231], [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-2845 SCP-2845], and [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-3600 SCP-3600] [[footnote]] None of these SCPs had been discovered at this time. [[/footnote]].
•	The construction plans for building [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-711 SCP-711] and preventing the breakdown of [http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-2000 SCP-2000].
•	The operational data for [http://www.scpwiki.com/wmdd-s-proposal Project Palisade].
•	[REDACTED]

**Addendum-5518-A:** A transcription of the text inscribed on each plate of SCP-5518:
[[div class="blockquote"]]
This is not salvation. This box represents our greatest failure, and we have used it only as our last resort, to deliver a warning for the threats we were too late to overcome. These threats will come to you in time. We could not survive them, and we sacrifice all that we have left to deliver our warning. Do not let our deaths be in vain.

This box is designed to deliver its contents through a reset of reality. These functions may be activated by [INSTRUCTIONS EXPUNGED BY ORDER OF THE ETHICS COMMITTEE].

You are now the baseline reality. You are the second chance we never had, and should you fail to hold the darkness at bay, the box awaits. Pass on your warnings, accept your condemnation as we have, and the new world will continue to try again.
[[/div]]

[[collapsible show="+FURTHER ACCESS RESTRICTED TO LEVEL 5 CREDENTIALS" hide="-WELCOME OVERSEER"]]

**Document-5518:** The following document is an abridged compilation of the circumstances that preceded the use of SCP-5518 in prior iterations of reality.

||~ Designation ||~ Description ||~ Aftermath ||
||XA-1 ||The earliest known iteration of reality that included the use of SCP-5518. Society develops along an overall positive trend regarding economic trends, environmental factors, and social upheaval, surpassing present society by approximately 1.5 standard deviations. This trend continues until 2089, when anomalies are first discovered by the general public. The Foundation is established in an attempt to contain this threat, but ultimately proves ineffective, resulting in the rapid collapse of social order. By the year 2098, anomalous phenomena have rendered the planet unsuitable for sustained human life. ||SCP-5518 provides the first formal instructions for developing special containment procedures, and the coordinates to discover [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-001 SCP-001.] ||
||XA-2 || The Foundation is established in the year 1824, approximately two years prior to the discovery of anomalous phenomena. Subsequent investigations bring the Foundation into conflict with various groups of interest, including the Church of the Broken God, the Serpent’s Hand, and Marshall, Carter, and Dark, Ltd. The escalation of these conflicts leads to the public gaining knowledge of anomalous phenomena, and subsequently, an international arms race for weaponized anomalies. Finally, in the year 1970, President Robert Kennedy initiates a conflict between all known groups of interest that would result in the collapse of human civilization. ||SCP-5518 provides the full documentation of [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-3000 SCP-3000] and the development of amnestics. Iteration XB-1 is further instructed with the precise time and method for assassinating Robert Kennedy. ||
||XB-3 || In an attempt to proactively combat the rise of anomalous phenomena, the Foundation uses knowledge gained by SCP-5518 to conduct covert infiltrations of all major nations. Any known groups of interest are rapidly suppressed, and a shadow government is established across global society by the year 1998. Minimal anomalous activity is noted after this point. However, civil liberties are effectively eliminated from the general population, and multiple rebellions are attempted to usurp Foundation rule. The largest of these rebellions eventually manages to assassinate the O5 council in the year 2043, leading to the subsequent collapse of society and the theft of SCP-5518 by parties unknown ||The contents of SCP-5518 from this iteration are unknown, at the item was utilized by non-Foundation personnel. SCP-5518 was utilized an unknown number of times before it is finally reclaimed by the Foundation in iteration XC-4. ||
||XC-4 || The Foundation is established in the year 1778, when SCP-5518 spontaneously materializes in the custody of Anna Strong, a Culper Ring spy. Foundation carries out its mission with minimal interference with public society, and nearly 4000 SCPs are successfully contained by the year 1921. After this point however, reality appears to undergo a spontaneous loss of integrity. Symptoms begin with the disappearance of physical locales and culminate in the disappearance of various laws of physics. SCP-5518 is utilized in the year 2012, just prior to the complete disintegration of the timeline. ||SCP-5518 provides approximately 80% of the current SCP database. Despite extensive research, no definitive cause is identified for the collapse of reality and investigations continue in iteration XC-5. ||
||XC-5 || The most recent prior iteration of reality. The Foundation is established in the year 1843 and immediately continues investigating the collapse of iteration XC-4. A working theory proposes that SCP-5518 may have been involved in the prior collapse of reality. This leads to the decision to restrict all access to SCP-5518 and its contents. After this point however, anomalous phenomena undergo a rapid increase and renders the planet unsuitable for sustained human life by the year 1901. ||SCP-5518 provides a revised standard for establishing an effective Ethics Committee for the Foundation. ||

**Ethics Addendum:** The following statement was issued by the Foundation Ethics Committee to the O5 Council.

[[div class="blockquote"]]
SCP-5518 represents a unique opportunity for the Foundation. The power to reset reality is simultaneously the power to choose the outcomes of reality, and yes, we could use this to warn against K-Class scenarios or convey instructions for a better future. However, the use of SCP-5518 is not acceptable under any circumstances.

First, anomalies are unpredictable, and we cannot entrust the whole of reality to an object that cannot even be properly tested. Perhaps it worked for our predecessors, but how can we be sure that it will work again? How can we be sure that it won’t come with unwanted side effects? These are questions we will never definitively answer.

More importantly however, the Foundation owes its sole duty to our baseline reality. The improvement of any mirror reality is entirely irrelevant, as these realities would not be our own. Our predecessors may have surrendered their responsibility, but for better or for worse, this is our world now, and we will make our stand until the end. SCP-5518 is therefore prohibited from all future use.

Disassemble the box and lock away the plates; secure, contain, protect. Nothing else matters.
[[/div]]

**Maddie：**他们需要9到12年的时间才能到这。以我们的视角。

**Turnpike：**我走不掉了，对吧？

**Maddie：**我……我不知道，我们保证我们正在努力。但是……

**Turnpike：**没……没事的，Maddie。我觉得……我觉得我注定逃不过的。

**Maddie：**你可以！你//可以的//！求你了，相信我。

**Turnpike：**没关系，真的。她说过了……“永恒时光”。就像那女士说的，这个地方……就是我的永恒之地。

**Maddie：**不——我们还能帮你，我们还有希望。

//Turnpike停顿。//

**Turnpike：**我知道还有希望。//Turnpike叹了口气//但我真的好想再见到她[[footnote]]**译注：**希望（hope）与Turnpike的妻子Hope同形同音。[[/footnote]]。

//Turnpike慢慢放下相机，然后又站了起来。//

**Turnpike：**请告诉……告诉Hope我爱她。然后告诉其他人……Celeste，Sage，Levi，还有那些已经失踪或逝去的人们……告诉他们我也爱他们。我很抱歉。

**Maddie：**你可以自己亲自告诉他们的。

**Turnpike：**我……

//Turnpike深吸了一口气。//

**Turnpike：**我只想离开这里，对不起，Maddie。我要切断供给，然后用他们给我的止痛药试着结束这一切，永远离开。我不想……我不想永远待在这里，我现在必须这么做，在我改变主意之前。

**Maddie低声说：**求你不要。

//Turnpike举起一只靴子，用力跺碎了摄像机。视频信号中断。//

//研究员Simes啜泣。//

[记录结束]
