SCP-7226是一名23岁的人类男性[[footnote]]曾名为Virgil Simon。[[/footnote]]。SCP-7226能够将自身传送至其所在位置六米范围内的任何数字媒体内。当SCP-7226离开媒体时，其内部和外部通常会出现物理扭曲。若设备断电，SCP-7226将被强行从当前所处媒体中弹出。

在被发现时，由于使用其能力，SCP-7226出现了以下物理扭曲：

* SCP-7226的右前臂难以被视觉感知，且即使静止也似乎持续运动。它报告称受影响肢体出现感觉异常。
* SCP-7226患有白内障，颜色不断变化，分别为白色、黄色、青色、亮绿色、紫红色、红色和蓝色。
* SCP-7226的头发丝永久性地变为各种蓝色。

更多信息请参阅以下测试结果，以了解SCP-7226的异常性质。

[[/div]]

[[<]]
**受访者：**SCP-7226

**采访者：**Kenny Hart博士

**前言：**以下采访在任何测试获得批准之前进行。
----
= **[开始记录]**
----

**Hart博士：**你好，SCP-7226。我是Hart博士。你今晚怎么样？

**SCP-7226：**你非得这么叫我吗？我的名字是Virgil。

//[SCP-7226在座位上懒散地坐着，交叉双臂。]//

**Hart博士：**恐怕这是规定。现在，我有一些关于你能力的问题要问。

**SCP-7226：**好。

**Hart博士：**我知道这对你不利，但事情就是如此。我现在要开始采访你了，好吗？

**SCP-7226：**好。

**Hart博士：**你第一次意识到自己有这种能力是什么时候？

**SCP-7226：**我不知道。

**Hart博士：**你不知道？

**SCP-7226：**我是说，我真的不知道。我只是有一天突然有了这种能力。我还要回答更多的问题吗？

**Hart博士：**我很感激你的配合，SCP-7226。

**SCP-7226：**我是Virgil。

**Hart博士：**如果我用你的名字，你会配合吗？

**SCP-7226：**//[耸肩]//

**Hart博士：**//[犹豫]// Virgil，你用过这种能力多少次了？

**SCP-7226：**这有什么关系吗？

**Hart博士：**嗯，你因为使用你的能力而出现了身体扭曲。我们计划测试你的能力，以便更详细地了解你在不同媒体中的具体形态。不过，我们需要小心，尽量减少你获得的扭曲程度，使其尽可能小。

//[SCP-7226坐在椅子上。]//

**SCP-7226：**你们让我重新上线了吗？

**Hart博士：**为了测试目的，是的。我能看出这是你所欣赏的。

**SCP-7226：**什么？我在房间里真的很无聊。我用过它，大概五次。

**Hart博士：**我明白了。我很惊讶你没有用得更多。

**SCP-5272267：**为什么？

**Hart博士：**如果我有那种能力，我可以想到几个我会一直使用的理由。

//[SCP-7226耸肩，背对着Hart博士。]//

**Hart博士：**我们将尝试确保你不会得到比你已经有的更多的扭曲，因为这些扭曲看起来很痛苦。我们也想看看是否能找到原因，以便我们有可能逆转效果。比如，哪些媒体会对你产生什么影响，这样我们就可以潜在地逆转效果。

**SCP-7226：**你能逆转效果吗？

**Hart博士：**也许吧。我们会看看的。我们可以做很多你以前认为不可能的事情。我们的目标是收容和保护异常。

//[SCP-7226沉默了一会儿。]//

以下是初步测试中发现的信息摘要。完整的测试日志可根据要求提供。

* SCP-7226仅影响其进入的媒体副本，不会出现在同时打开的其他副本中。
* 如果SCP-7226无法自然插入媒体，则不会可见。然而，SCP-7226仍能与拍摄图像的即时周围环境互动，即使所述环境在图像中不可见。
* 当SCP-7226进入任何在线媒体时，该页面将出现在设备的历史记录中。如果它没有进入在线媒体，就无法确定它进入了哪种媒体。
* SCP-7226仍然能够意识到媒体中的即时周围环境，并能够口头回应工作人员，即使它无法被物理看到。
* 至此，尚不清楚是什么导致SCP-7226获得额外的扭曲。

以下列表列出了SCP-7226进入的在线页面：

* 社交媒体平台“Instagram”上的一个账户，用户名为“1nf1n1tyf0rev3r”。它进入的确切照片未知。
* 一篇关于复活可能性的研究文章。
* 爱荷华州Waukee市EverHaven公园的谷歌地图页面。

SCP-7226表现出一系列值得注意的行为：

* 虽然SCP-7226最初与工作人员合作，但在测试过程中，这种合作行为逐渐减弱。
* SCP-7226继续向工作人员询问基金会拥有的异常物品。起初，它对理解表示理解和模糊的不满，但当没有回答或否认信息时，它开始表现出攻击性。

+++++ __**测试结果V2**__

SCP-7226返回时带有以下扭曲：

* SCP-7226报告经历视觉和听觉幻觉。当被问及它幻觉的内容时，它拒绝回答。
* SCP-7226的言语开始出现明显的失真，导致音节和单词被音频静电取代。当对象情绪激动时，这种影响会加剧。
* SCP-7226周围的所有颜色以及SCP-7226附近的颜色都会失真，导致附近的颜色相互渗透。

由于SCP-7226不断从指示其进入的媒体中消失，且无法回应工作人员，测试会话很快被认为无效。当SCP-7226被强行从媒体中弹出时，它以言语攻击回应，指控工作人员对其撒谎。

这种不配合使得难以正确分析其异常性质的全部程度，并无法观察可能导致扭曲的原因。

SCP-7226因其测试目的而被允许使用其手机。SCP-7226似乎不愿进入设备，表达了对其位置被知晓的不适感。

为对抗SCP-7226进入未知媒体的习惯，决定先审查手机的内容。这是为了发现SCP-7226可能隐藏的任何文件或应用程序，以便基金会工作人员在测试期间检查所述媒体。

SCP-7226在以下媒体中被发现：

**媒体：**一张男人[[footnote]]通过调查手机的内容，该男子已被确认为“Alex”。[[/footnote]]在公园的照片，来自名为“我们❤️”的相册。
**笔记：**SCP-7226拥抱了男人。它回来时手臂和胸部的色彩扭曲恶化。

**媒体：**同一男人坐在沙发上，右侧有一只泰迪犬的照片。来自之前的同一相册。
**笔记：**SCP-7226坐在男人身边。SCP-7226头发上的蓝色扭曲恶化。值得注意的是，图片中男人穿着蓝色毛衣。

**媒体：**一段视频，SCP-7226和之前的男人一起唱《我和爱和你》的合唱部分，从SCP-7226的角度拍摄。
**笔记：**SCP-7226跟着唱，导致其声音扭曲显著恶化，大部分所说的话被音频静电取代。SCP-7226从视频中回来时眼睛里含着泪水。当SCP-7226哭泣时，分泌物似乎被数字化像素化，对象报告称由于其异常尖锐而感到不适。此外，SCP-7226报告称视力显著恶化，主要无法看见。

发现SCP-7226仅在试图与与其有情感联系的媒体（例如，在照片中拥抱所爱之人）进行物理互动时才会获得扭曲。

测试被紧急停止。经确定，再次允许SCP-7226使用其异常性质对它的健康构成危险，因为每次使用时损伤似乎都在加速。

SCP-7226是一名23岁的男性人类[[footnote]]原名维吉尔·西蒙（Virgil Simon）。[[/footnote]]。项目可将自己传送至距离其所在位置6米以内的任何形式的数字媒体内。当SCP-7226离开媒体时，其体内和体外往往都会出现现实扭曲现象。如果关闭设备，SCP-7226将被强制从其当前所处媒体中退出。

项目被初次发现时，SCP-7226由于使用其异常能力，身体出现以下现实扭曲现象：

* SCP-7226右前臂难以被视觉察觉，尽管保持静止，但似乎一直处于运动状态。项目声称受影响的肢体知觉异常。

* SCP-7226患有白内障，其眼球可在白色、黄色、青色、亮绿色、紫红色、红色和蓝色之间不断变化。

* SCP-7226的几缕头发永久变成深浅不一的蓝色。

有关SCP-7226异常特性的更多信息，请参阅下面的测试结果。

* SCP-7226身上及其附近的所有颜色都发生扭曲，导致相邻的颜色相互渗透。

由于SCP-7226在被指示进入的媒体中持续消失，且未对基金会人员进行回应，测试很快被认定无效。当SCP-7226从所在媒体被强制退出时，其对基金会人员进行言语攻击，指责工作人员对他撒谎。

SCP-7226此种不合作的态度使基金会难以正确分析其全部的异常特性，也无法推测可能造成其身体现实扭曲的原因。

[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**附录2**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]
[[collapsible hideLocation="both" show="▼ 访问采访记录 ▼" hide="▲ 关闭采访记录 ▲"]]
[[div class="quote-block"]]
[[=]]
+++ 采访记录
[[/=]]
----
[[<]]
**受访者：**SCP-7226

**采访者：**Kenny Hart博士

**前言：**测试过程中，SCP-7226在预留设施普遍表现出不合作的态度和行为。因此进行以下访谈，以试图确定项目出现此现象的原因。
----
= **[记录开始]**
----

**Hart博士：**下午好，Virgil。

**SCP-7226：**你还记得我的名字。//[咳嗽]//

**Hart博士：**是的，我还记得。

**SCP-7226：**谢……谢谢。

**Hart博士：**别客气，现在，我想和你讨论一下你在测试期间的行为是怎么回事。

**SCP-7226：**什么，我是——[静电干扰]……//[咳嗽]//遇到麻烦了吗？这是小学，还是别的什么地方？我更想回到那里，这样就容易多了。

**Hart博士：**不，你没遇到什么麻烦。但你的行为确实给我们造成了很多问题。

**SCP-7226：**问题？

**Hart博士：**对，你总是不停地去其他没有指示你进入的页面。

**SCP-7226：**嗯，你们也没办法——[静电干扰]//[咳嗽]//阻止我。

**Hart博士：**如果你能告诉我原因，我将不胜感激。你第一次就挺配合的。

**SCP-7226：**你们不就是——[静电干扰]创造奇迹的人吗？

**Hart博士：**是谁让你这么想的呢？

**SCP-7226：**//[耸肩]//因为你说你们能帮忙。当我第一次被你们带走时，我还以为自己惹上了官司。但是，接我的人——[静电干扰]向我保证我会受到很好的照顾。//[耸肩]//我也不知道，但我还抱有希望，希望能……//[摇头]//但你们没能帮我，事情变得更糟了，你们也把我搞得更糟。

**Hart博士：**我们正努力帮助你。但如果我们无法观察你与媒体之间的互动，我们就无法帮助你。

**SCP-7226：**反正我也从没真关心过发生在我身上的事。

**Hart博士：**连你受到的伤害也无所谓吗？

**SCP-7226：**嗯。发生在我身上的这些确实并不重要。我只是想......[静电干扰]可以不那么痛苦。但我真的很蠢。

**Hart博士：**那些不是真实的。

//[SCP-7226保持沉默。]//

**Hart博士：**Virgil，我是名心理学家。如果你有过情感受伤经历，我可以帮你。

**SCP-7226：**//[停顿]//你们还要做其他测试吗？

**Hart博士：**是的，几天后，我们会把你的手机还给你以进行测试。

**SCP-7226：**你们要看我的手机吗？

**Hart博士：**嗯，是的，我们需要提前知道你可能会进入哪些内容。

//[SCP-7226表现出明显痛苦。]//

**SCP-7226：**为什么？你们又不需要知道那些。

**Hart博士：**不，为了解那些内容会对你造成何种影响，我们应该知道。我们不确定到底是什么相互作用导致了发生在你身上的现实扭曲，所以我们需要看看是否能找出原因，是否有什么办法可以缓解你的痛苦。

**SCP-7226：**真是太蠢了。很明显你什么也——[静电干扰]帮不了我。

**Hart博士：**你需要让我们试试。起码让我试试。

**SCP-7226：**让我上线。

**Hart博士：**我们会对其进行测试。

**SCP-7226：**测试后的结果呢？

**Hart博士：**我们仅用于测试。我说过鉴于你的情况，我们必须谨慎小心。

//[SCP-7226保持沉默。]//

**Hart博士：**好吧，Virgil，测试后再见。

**SCP-7226：**//[咳嗽]//

----
= **[记录结束]**
----
**笔记：**//我请求在测试后对SCP-7226进行全面彻底的心理评估。——Hart博士//
[[/<]]
[[/div]]
[[/collapsible]]
[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**测试结果V3**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

SCP-7226使用其手机进行测试。但SCP-7226似乎不愿进入设备，表示因自己的行踪被其他人员知晓而感到不安。

为了应对SCP-7226进入未知媒体后的各种行动，基金会决定首先对其手机内容进行检查。此做法是为了发现SCP-7226可能隐藏的任何文件或应用程序，以便工作人员在测试期间可及时查看相关媒体文件。

测试过程中SCP-7226在以下媒体文件中被发现：

**媒体文件：**一张一名男子[[footnote]]通过对手机内容的调查，该男子被确认为“亚历克斯（Alex）”。[[/footnote]]在公园里的照片，被发现于名为“我们❤️”的相册中。
**笔记：**SCP-7226拥抱了该男子。项目从媒体文件返回后，其手臂和胸部的颜色扭曲愈加严重。

**媒体文件：**一张上述男子坐在沙发上，一只㹴犬位于其右侧的照片。被发现于上述同一相册中。
**笔记：**SCP-7226倚靠着该男子相坐。项目头发上的蓝色扭曲愈加严重。注意到照片中的男子穿着一件蓝色毛衣。

**媒体文件：**从SCP-7226视角拍摄的其与上述男子合唱//《I And Love And You》//[[footnote]]**译注：**此处应指美国民谣乐队The Avett Brothers于2009年发行的歌曲《I And Love And You》[[/footnote]]的视频。
**笔记：**SCP-7226一起跟唱，导致其声音失真现象严重恶化，大部分语音都被静电干扰取代。SCP-7226从视频文件中返回时，眼中含有泪水。当SCP-7226哭泣时，分泌物呈现类似数字像素化特征，受试者声称其异常的尖锐感引起不适。此外，SCP-7226还表示其视力显著恶化，近乎失明。

测试发现，SCP-7226只有在试图与其存在情感联系的媒体文件内发生物理接触时（例如在照片中拥抱爱人），才会出现现实扭曲现象。

测试被紧急叫停。经确定，SCP-7226每次使用能力后，其身体的现实扭曲效应似乎会逐渐加速恶化，并对其身心健康造成严重危害。

[[=]]
+++++ __**Special Containment Procedures:**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

SCP-7226 is to be held within an observation room within Site-346’s medical wing. SCP-7226 is not to be within approximately six meters of any device capable of playing any digital media.

SCP-7226 may request entertainment that does not require any digital devices. Denial or approval depends on the request.

Testing has been permanently suspended as of 12/07/2022.

[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**Description**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

SCP-7226 is a 23 year old human male[[footnote]]formerly known as Virgil Simon.[[/footnote]] SCP-7226 is capable of transporting itself into any form of digital media within six meters or less from its location. When SCP-7226 exits the media, physical distortions often develop both interally and externally. SCP-7226 will be forcefully ejected from the media it is currently in if the device is powered off.

At the time of discovery, SCP-7226 had the following physical distortions due to use of its ability:

* SCP-7226’s right forearm is difficult to perceive visually, and appears to constantly be in movement despite being stationary. It reports paresthesia in the effected limb.
* SCP-7226 has cataracts that constantly change between the colors white, yellow, cyan, bright green, fuchsia, red, and blue.
* Strands of SCP-7226's hair became permanently various shades of blue.

See the below test results for more information on SCP-7226's anomalous properties.

[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**Addendum 1**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]
[[collapsible hideLocation="both" show="▼ Open Interview ▼" hide="▲ Close Interview ▲"]]
[[div class="quote-block"]]
[[=]]
+++ Interview Log
[[/=]]
----
[[<]]
**INTERVIEWED:** SCP-7226

**INTERVIEWER:** Dr. Kenny Hart

**FOREWORD:** The following interview was conducted with SCP-7226 before any testing was approved.
----
= **[BEGIN LOG]**
----

**Dr. Hart:** Hello, SCP-7226. My name is Dr. Hart. How are you this evening?

**SCP-7226:** Do you have to call me that? My name is Virgil.

//[SCP-7226 slouches in its seat, crossing its arms.]//

**Dr. Hart:** It's protocol, I'm afraid. Now, I have some questions about your ability.

**SCP-7226:** Okay.

**Dr. Hart:** I know it's unfavorable, that's just how things are. I'm going to start interviewing you now, alright?

**SCP-7226:** Kay.

**Dr. Hart:** When did you first realize you had this ability?

**SCP-7226:** I don't know.

**Dr. Hart:** You don't know?

**SCP-7226:** I mean, I don't really know. I just had it one day. Do I have to answer anymore questions?

**Dr. Hart:** I would appreciate you cooperation, SCP-7226.

**SCP-7226:** It's Virgil.

**Dr. Hart:** If I use your name, will you cooperate?

**SCP-7226:** //[shrugs]//

**Dr. Hart:** //[hesitates]// Virgil, how many times have you used this ability?

**SCP-7226:** Why does it matter?

**Dr. Hart:** Well, you have physical distortions from using your ability. We plan to test your ability in order to learn more about exactly what form you take within different pieces of media. Though, we need to be careful as to reduce the amount of distortions you gain to be as minimal as possible.

//[SCP-7226 sits up in its chair.]//

**SCP-7226:** You're letting me go back online?

**Dr. Hart:** For testing purposes, yes. I can tell that's something you appreciate.

**SCP-7226:** What? I've been really bored in my room. I've used it like, five times.

**Dr. Hart:** I see. I'm surprised you haven't used it more.

**SCP-5272267:** Why?

**Dr. Hart:** If I had that ability, I can think of a few reasons I'd be constantly using it.

//[SCP-7226 shrugs, turning away from Dr. Hart.]//

**Dr. Hart:** We're going to try to make sure you don't get many more distortions then you already have, as the distortions seem pretty painful. We want to see if we can find the cause, as well. Like, what media does what to you so we can potentially reverse the effects.

**SCP-7226:** You can reverse the effects?

**Dr. Hart:** Maybe. We'll see. We can do a lot of things that you wouldn't have thought possible. Our goal is to contain and protect anomalies.

//[SCP-7226 was silent for a moment.]//

**SCP-7226:** I see. I'll do the tests.

**Dr. Hart:** Well, it's good to have your cooperation.

**SCP-7226:** What other types of things can you do here?

**Dr. Hart:** I'm not exactly at liberty to say.

**SCP-7226:** Come on, who am I gonna tell? I can't talk to my family, I definitely don't have friends, I don't even get to see my dog again, not that he can talk. So I have no one other then the staff here to talk to.

**Dr. Hart:** I apologize, but I'm not going to tell you classified information.

**SCP-7226:** Ugh.

**Dr. Hart:** Anyhow. What did you use your ability to go into?

**SCP-7226:** //[shrugs]// Social media, a song, once.

**Dr. Hart:** Ah, social media? What sort of things did you go into?

**SCP-7226:** Pages of celebrities I like. Some songs I used to listen to years ago.

**Dr. Hart:** I see. Well, thank you for your cooperation. You'll be notified once it's time for testing.

**SCP-7226:** Alright.

----
= **[END LOG]**
----
**NOTE:** Following this interview, SCP-7226 frequently asked staff if it could learn about the other anomalous artifacts in the Foundation's possession. This request was denied.
[[/<]]
[[/div]]
[[/collapsible]]
[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**Test Results V1**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

The following is a summary of information discovered upon initial testing. The full test logs are available upon request.

* SCP-7226 only affects the copy of said media it enters, not appearing in other copies opened at the same time.
* If there is not a place for SCP-7226 to naturally be inserted into the media, it will not be visible. Regardless, SCP-7226 can interact with the immediate surroundings in which an image was taken, even if said surroundings are not visible in the image.
* When SCP-7226 goes within any media online, the page will appear in the device's history. If it does not go into online media, it has been unable to determine what media it enters.
* SCP-7226 is still aware of its immediate surroundings within media, and is able to verbally respond to staff, even if it cannot be physically seen.
* At this point, it is unknown what exactly causes SCP-7226 to gain additional distortions.

The following list what online pages SCP-7226 entered:

* An account on the social media platform //"Instagram"// under the username //"1nf1n1tyf0rev3r"//. The exact photos it entered are unknown.
* A research article on the possibility of resurrection.
* The Google Maps page for EverHaven park in Waukee, Iowa.

SCP-7226 displayed a series of behaviors that were noteworthy:

* While SCP-7226 initially cooperated with staff, this cooperative behavior dwindled over the course of the tests.
* SCP-7226 continued to ask staff about anomalies within Foundation possession. While it originally replied with understanding and vague dissatisfaction, it began to display aggression when not answered or denied information.

[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**Test Results V2**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

No additional information on the inner workings of SCP-7226's abilities was gained from testing.

SCP-7226 returned with the following distortions:

* SCP-7226 reported experiencing visual and audio hallucinations. When asked what it hallucinated, it refused to answer.
* SCP-7226's speech began to audibly distort, causing syllables and words to be replaced by audio static. This effect worsens when the subject is emotional.
* All colors on and within SCP-7226’s immediate vicinity will distort, causing nearby colors to bleed into each other.

The testing session was quickly deemed ineffective, as SCP-7226 continuously disappeared from the media it was instructed to enter, failing to respond to staff. When SCP-7226 was forcefully ejected from the media, it responded with verbal aggression, accusing staff of lying to it.

This uncooperativeness made it difficult to properly analyze the full extent of its anomalous properties, and unable to observe what may be causing the distortions.

[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**Addendum 2**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]
[[collapsible hideLocation="both" show="▼ Open Interview ▼" hide="▲ Close Interview ▲"]]
[[div class="quote-block"]]
[[=]]
+++ Interview Log
[[/=]]
----
[[<]]
**INTERVIEWED:** SCP-7226

**INTERVIEWER:** Dr. Kenny Hart

**FOREWORD:** During testing, SCP-7226 displayed a general uncooperativeness and behaved in a reserved manor. The following interview was conducted in an attempt to uncover the root of this behavior.
----
= **[BEGIN LOG]**
----

**Dr. Hart:** Afternoon, Virgil.

**SCP-7226:** You remembered to call me my name. //[coughs]//

**Dr. Hart:** Yes. I did.

**SCP-7226:** Th-thanks.

**Dr. Hart:** You're welcome. Now, I would like to discuss your behavior during testing.

**SCP-7226:** What, am I-[STATIC].. //[coughs]// in trouble? Is this grade school, or something? I'd actually prefer to be back there. Things were easier.

**Dr. Hart:** No, you're not in trouble. But your behavior did leave us with many questions.

**SCP-7226:** Questions?

**Dr. Hart:** Yes. You continuously went to other pages that you were not instructed to go into.

**SCP-7226:** Yeah, there wasn't really much you could do to-- [STATIC]. //[coughs]// Do to stop me.

**Dr. Hart:** I would appreciate if you could enlighten me on why. You were rather cooperative the first time.

**SCP-7226:** Aren't you guys supposed to be-[STATIC] miracle workers?

**Dr. Hart:** Who gave you that impression?

**SCP-7226:** //[shrugs]// Because you said you could help. When I first got picked by you guys I thought I was in legal trouble. But, the people who escorted me-[STATIC] assured I was in good hands. [shrugs] I don't know. I had hope. That something could... //[shakes head]// But you didn't help me. Things just got worse. You all made me worse.

**Dr. Hart:** We're trying to help you. But if we can't observe your interactions with the media, we can't help you.

**SCP-7226:** I never actually cared about what happened to me, anyway.

**Dr. Hart:** You don't care about getting hurt?

**SCP-7226:** No. It doesn't really matter what happens to me. I just thought... [STATIC] I could be less miserable. But I was stupid.

**Dr. Hart:** That's not true.

//[SCP-7226 remains silent.]//

**Dr. Hart:** Virgil, I'm a psychologist. If you're hurting emotionally, I can help you.

**SCP-7226:** //[Pause]// Are you gonna do more testing?

**Dr. Hart:** Yes. In a few days, we're going to give you your phone for testing purposes.

**SCP-7226:** Are you going to look through my phone?

**Dr. Hart:** Well, yes. We need to know what content you might go into.

//[SCP-7226 appears visibly distressed.]//

**SCP-7226:** Why? You don't need to know that.

**Dr. Hart:** Yes, we do. In order to see how the content affects you. We're not sure exactly what interactions are causing these distortions. So we need to see if uncover the cause, if there's anything we can do to ease your symptoms.

**SCP-7226:** That's stupid. There's clearly nothing you can do to- [STATIC] help me.

**Dr. Hart:** You need to let us try. To let me try.

**SCP-7226:** Just let me back online.

**Dr. Hart:** We will for testing.

**SCP-7226:** And after testing?

**Dr. Hart:** Only for testing. I've said we have to be careful due to your condition.

//[SCP-7226 remains silent.]//

**Dr. Hart:** Well, Virgil, I'll see you again, after testing.

**SCP-7226:** //[coughs]//

----
= **[END LOG]**
----
**NOTE:** //I request that SCP-7226 be given a thorough physiological evaluation after testing. - Dr. Hart//
[[/<]]
[[/div]]
[[/collapsible]]
[[/div]]

[[div class="material-box"]]
[[div class="title-style"]]
[[=]]
+++++ __**Test Results V3**__
[[/=]]
[[/div]]

SCP-7226 was given access to its cellphone for testing purposes. SCP-7226 appeared reluctant to enter the device, expressing discomfort with its whereabouts being known.

To combat SCP-7226's habit of going into unknown media, it was decided to review the contents of the phone first. This was done in order to uncover any files or applications in which SCP-7226 could be hiding so Foundation staff could check said media during testing.

SCP-7226 was discovered in the following media:

**Media:** An image of a man[[footnote]]Through investigation of the contents of the phone, the man has been identified as "Alex"[[/footnote]] at a park, found in a photo album titled "Us❤️".
**Notes:** SCP-7226 hugged the man. It returned with worsening color distortions on its arms and chest.

**Media:** An image of the same man from before sitting on a couch with a terrier on his right. Found in the same photo album from before.
**Notes:** SCP-7226 sat against the man. The blue distortion on SCP-7226's hair worsened. It is noted that the man is wearing a blue sweater in the image.

**Media:** A video of SCP-7226 and the man from before singing the chorus of //"I And Love And You"// filmed from SCP-7226's perspective.
**Notes:** SCP-7226 sang along, causing its vocal distortion to worsen by a significant amount, with the majority of its spoken words being replaced with audio static. SCP-7226 returned from the video with tears in its eyes. When SCP-7226 cried, the secretions appeared to be digitally pixelated, and the subject reported discomfort caused by their unusual sharpness. Additionally, SCP-7226 reported that its vision had worsened significantly, being primarily unable to see.

It was discovered that SCP-7226 only gains distortions when attempting to physically interact with media that it has emotional ties to (ie. Hugging a loved one in a photograph).

Testing was brought to an emergency stop. It was determined that it would be dangerous to SCP-7226's health to allow it to use its anomalous properties again, as damage appears to progress at a quickening pace upon each use.

**描述：**SCP-8586是SCP基金会人事主管Dr. Lachlan “Lach” Cairns。Dr. Cairns于1980年以初级研究员身份加入基金会，并于1981年晋升为职员研究员，1983年晋升为高级研究员，1986年成为职员博士。他是已故Dr. Ansel Cairns和Dr. Lillian Brand-Cairns的儿子。在她于1987年去世前，他与Dr. Aileen Lament结婚。

由于8586-CHARON事件，Dr. Cairns的功能性不朽。在其宿主身体过期后，Dr. Cairns的意识将在短暂的间隙期后，在最近可用的尸体中重新苏醒。这种行为的范围似乎没有限制，新宿主的特定性也如此，只要它属于哺乳动物类，且未过期超过24小时。Dr. Cairns曾在不同时间转移到近期死亡的人类尸体、马、猿、鼠及其他用于基金会站点测试的动物尸体中。

值得注意的是，SCP-8586似乎无法转移到年龄小于三十三岁二百四十四天（即Dr. Cairns在8586-CHARON事件当天的年龄）的人体，或转移到年龄小于其等效年龄的动物体内（尽管这种行为的具体细节尚不清楚）。

新成为SCP-8586宿主的尸体将重新复活并恢复活力，尸体将呈现出其原主人在死亡前不久的外观和健康状况。然而，SCP-8586无法长时间维持这种活力，一段时间后尸体将开始迅速腐烂，这使Dr. Cairns感到相当痛苦。SCP-8586能够维持复活状态的时间长度似乎取决于多个因素，包括原始尸体在死亡前的年龄和健康状况。SCP-8586能够自然维持单一形态的最长时期为八十六天[[footnote]]基金会曾多次在不同时间通过人工手段延长SCP-8586在单一形态下停留的时间，尽管这通常需要大量奇术投资和近乎持续的监督，但一般被认为是一种不必要的资源使用。最长的形态维持时间为四年多一点，当时SCP-8586居住在已故的[[[SCP-4444|乔治·W·布什总统]]]的尸体中。2005年，一名替身被带入以替换SCP-8586，此时维持该尸体的任务已成为每小时的努力。在解除维持布什总统尸体的仪式后，它几乎立即变成灰烬，随后将SCP-8586绑定的异常变得不稳定，接下来的七个形态都在数小时内退化，此后三个月内所有形态都受到了类似影响。[[/footnote]]。

由SCP-8586占据的尸体将保留其所有原始特征（除了承载Dr. Cairns的意识外），唯一例外是宿主身体的右眼将被一块来自以弗所的金铜币取代。这枚硬币是前SCP-███，在8586-CHARON之后被废除。从SCP-8586实例的眼中移除这枚硬币会导致其立即分解，硬币也会消失，然后重新出现在替代宿主的眼窝中。

**附录8586.1：**SCP-███

SCP-███[[footnote]]由于它已成为SCP-8586的一个固有方面，ID号现已删除。此位置已被重新利用。[[/footnote]]，代号“渡船人硬币”，是两枚金铜币[[footnote]]一种天然合金，由黄金和白银组成，古代用于铸币。[[/footnote]]，当放置在最近死亡者的双眼上时，可以暂时使尸体复活并使其说话，只要硬币不受干扰。这些硬币的最初持有者是一位名为Vladek Morzyn的异常文物收藏家，隶属于Marshall、Carter & Dark清算所，他相信它们可以让最近死去的人说话。然而，在研究SCP-███的过程中，8586-CHARON事件中断了研究，早期迹象表明，迫使受影响对象说话的力量只是创造了一个最近死去的人的复制品[[footnote]]在Dr. Lament的笔记中，她认为SCP-███内的力量或实体只是使用这个复制品来制造复活的假象，因为对象往往难以回答关于他们死前生活的具体问题，有时在被要求提供这些细节时会变得敌对。[[/footnote]]。

Dr. Cairns在Site-17担任首席生物学家期间接触到了SCP-███，并一直在研究SCP-███对受试者复活组织的影响。在8586-CHARON之前，Dr. Cairns曾多次向他的配偶、一位异常古董专家Dr. Lament咨询。

**附录8586.2：**8586-CHARON背景

8586-CHARON是一起发生在1987年12月21日的事件，当时Dr. Cairns未经批准对上述SCP-███进行了实验，似乎是试图复活最近去世的Dr. Aileen Lament。Dr. Lament在十天前死于[[[SCP-354]]]的意外激活，这一事件显著影响了Dr. Cairns。

安保录像显示，Dr. Cairns在Dr. Lament死亡至8586-CHARON事件期间进行了几次未记录的SCP-███提款。由于当时Site-17较小，安全协议相对宽松，这些行动并未立即引起安保干预，唯一的例外是后来回收的一次记录在案的交流，其中Dr. Cairns与当时的机动特遣队Epsilon-11“九尾狐”小队队长Troy Lament进行了交流，Dr. Lament的弟弟和Dr. Cairns的妹夫。直到8586-CHARON结束后，才在对Site-17所有安保录像进行全面审查时发现这次交流。

SCP-███[[footnote]]因其成为SCP-8586的内在组成部分，对其编号进行了编辑。该编号的槽位已重新分配。[[/footnote]]（代号“船夫的硬币”）是两枚银金[[footnote]]一种天然存在的金银合金，在古代曾被用于铸币。[[/footnote]]硬币。若将其置于一名新丧者的双眼上，则可使尸体暂时活化并发声，直到钱币被移走为止。其最初所有者Vladek Morzyn（一名与Marshall, Carter & Dark存在关联的异常制品收藏家）相信，这些钱币能够让新丧者说话。然而，尽管对SCP-███的研究已因8586-卡戎事件中断，但早期研究证据已经能够表明，驱使受影响对象说话的力量实际上只是创建了新丧者的一个仿制品[[footnote]]Lament博士在笔记中提到，她认为SCP-███内的力量或实体创造的仿制品只能伪造一种复活的假象，因为对象通常无法回答有关生前生活的具体问题，在被追问相关细节时甚至可能表现出敌意。[[/footnote]]。

作为Site-17的首席生物学家，Cairns博士有权接触SCP-███，并曾持续研究SCP-███对对象的活化组织造成的影响。在8586-卡戎事件发生之前，Cairns博士曾多次向其配偶、异常古物专家Lament博士请求咨询。

**附录8586.2:**8586-卡戎事件背景

8586-卡戎事件发生于1987年12月21日。事件起因为Cairns博士未经授权即对前述SCP-███进行实验，尝试复活新近逝世的Aileen Lament博士。Lament博士于十日前因[[[SCP-354]]]意外激活而身亡，此事件对Cairns博士造成了重大影响。

安保录像显示，在Lament博士去世与8586-卡戎事件发生之间，Cairns博士曾多次未经登记便取用SCP-███。此时Site-17规模较小，安保协议相对宽松，故而这些行为并未立即招致安保干预。唯一的例外是Cairns博士与机动特遣队Epsilon-11“九尾狐”队长Troy Lament（Lament博士之弟，亦即Cairns博士之内弟）之间的一段对话。8586-卡戎事件结束后，Site-17安保录像接受了一次全面审查，其中发现了一份相关录音，这段对话的存在至此方被揭露。

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-8586 is contained under the Gravewatch Protocol. As a function of Gravewatch, Dr. Cairns is subject to monthly medical evaluations and, if feasible, additional analysis immediately following any transference events. To date, Dr. Cairns has been fully amenable to these evaluations.

Until such a time as need demands it, Dr. Cairns is permitted to continue to fulfill the functions of their position within the SCP Foundation.

**Description:** SCP-8586 is SCP Foundation Director of Personnel Dr. Lachlan "Lach" Cairns. Dr. Cairns began working for the Foundation as a Junior Researcher in 1980 and was promoted to Staff Researcher in 1981, Senior Researcher in 1983, and Doctor of Staff in 1986. He is the son of the late Dr. Ansel Cairns and Dr. Lillian Brand-Cairns. Prior to her death in 1987, he was married to Dr. Aileen Lament.

As a result of the 8586-CHARON event, Dr. Cairns has become functionally immortal. Upon the expiry of its host body, Dr. Cairns' consciousness will, after a short interstitial period, reawaken in the nearest available dead body. There does not seem to be a limit to the range of this behaviour, nor to the specificity of the new host, so long as it is within class Mammalia, and has not been expired for more than 24 hours. Dr. Cairns has, at different times, transferred into the bodies of recently deceased human corpses, as well as those of horses, apes, mice, and other animals used for testing purposes within Foundation sites.

Notably, SCP-8586 is also seemingly incapable of transferring into human bodies younger than thirty-three years, two-hundred and forty-four days - the age Dr. Cairns was on the date of the 8586-CHARON event - or transferring into the bodies of animals younger than their equivalent age (though the specifics of this behaviour are poorly understood).

New bodies that become hosts for SCP-8586 will become both reanimated and reinvigorated, with corpses taking on the appearance and well-being of their originator as they were in the time shortly before their death. However, SCP-8586 is incapable of maintaining this vitality for extended periods of time, and after some duration the bodies will began to decay rapidly, a phenomenon that causes Dr. Cairns considerable distress. The length of time that SCP-8586 is able to sustain the reinvigorated bodies seemingly depends on several factors, including the original body's age and health prior to their death. The longest period of time SCP-8586 has been able to naturally maintain a single form has been eighty-six days[[footnote]]The Foundation has, at different times, been able to artificially extend the duration with which SCP-8586 is able to stay in a single form before it degrades, though this often involves significant thaumatological investment and near-constant oversight, and has generally been considered an unnecessary use of resources. The longest time a form has been maintained was just over four years, when SCP-8586 was inhabiting the body of the late [[[SCP-4444|President George W. Bush]]]. A body-double was brought in to replace SCP-8586 in 2005, by which point the task of maintaining the body in question had become an hourly effort. Upon lifting the rituals maintaining the body of President Bush it almost immediately turned to ash, after which the anomaly binding SCP-8586 became so unstable that the next seven forms all degraded within the space of several hours, and all those afterwards for a period of three months were similarly affected.[[/footnote]].

Bodies inhabited by SCP-8586 will retain all of their original characteristics (aside from hosting Dr. Cairns' consciousness) with a single exception - the right eye of the host body will be replaced with a single electrum coin of Ephesian origin. This coin is the former SCP-███, which was decommissioned following 8586-CHARON. Removing this coin from the eye of the SCP-8586 instance will result in both its immediate decomposition, and the disappearance of the coin, which will then reappear in the eye socket of the replacement host.

**Addendum 8586.1:** SCP-███

[[include component:image-block name=coin.jpg|align=right|caption=Analysis of the runes present on the part of SCP-███ within SCP-8586. (A) indicates speech, (B) indicates speech, (C1) and (C2) indicate travel over great distance (the beginning and end of a journey), (D) indicates a payment, (E) indicates the soul or self, and (F) is an unfinished rune.]]

SCP-███[[footnote]]ID number now redacted due to it becoming an inherent aspect of SCP-8586. This slot has since been repurposed.[[/footnote]], codename "Ferryman's Coins" were two electrum[[footnote]]A naturally occurring alloy of gold and silver, used in antiquity for coinage.[[/footnote]] coins that, when placed over the eyes of the recently deceased, could temporarily animate the corpse and allow it to speak, so long as the coins were not disturbed. The original holder of these coins, a collector of anomalous artifacts affiliated with the Marshall, Carter & Dark clearinghouse named Vladek Morzyn, believed they were capable of permitting the recently dead to speak. However, while research into SCP-███ was interrupted by the 8586-CHARON event, early indications were that the force compelling the affected subjects to speech was only creating a facsimile of the recently deceased[[footnote]]In Dr. Lament's notes, she posited that the force or entity within SCP-███ was only using that facsimile to give the appearance of reanimation, as the subjects often had difficulty answering specific questions about their lives prior to their deaths, and would sometimes become hostile when pressed on those details.[[/footnote]].

Dr. Cairns had access to SCP-███ in his position as Chief Biologist at Site-17, and had been studying the effects of SCP-███ on subjects' reanimated tissues. Prior to 8586-CHARON, Dr. Cairns had, on several occasions, requested consults from Dr. Lament, his spouse and a specialist in anomalous antiquities.

**Site-17 Anomalous Biological Studies**

**CAIRNS:** Let's get started. First subject is D-21421, formerly Diane W. Yates - adult female, age 38. Cause of death was blunt force trauma to the neck.

**A. LAMENT:** Confirming for the record that the subject is deceased.

**CAIRNS:** (//Laughs//) Good god I would hope so. Ready to begin?

**A. LAMENT:** Let's do it.

**CAIRNS:** Alright. I'm placing the coins on the subject's eyes now.

(//Brief pause. A sharp intake of breath is heard.//)

**D-21421:** What happened? Where am I?

**CAIRNS:** Can you tell me your name?

**D-21421:** Who are you? What is this?

**CAIRNS:** I understand you may be experiencing a bit of distress, but please try to calm down. Just tell me your name, please.

**D-21421:** I... I don't remember. I don't know where I am.

**CAIRNS:** What is the last thing you remember?

**D-21421:** I was... it was dark, and I... my neck, what's wrong with my neck?

**CAIRNS:** I see. Do you remember anyone else you may have been in communication with prior to your death?

**D-21421:** I can't see anything. What's on my eyes? Who are all these people?

**CAIRNS:** These people?

**D-21421:** Please, take it off! Take it off! This isn't right! Help! Help me, please, somebody!

(//Dr. Lament removes SCP-███ from the subject's eyes. The subject deanimates.//)

**CAIRNS:** What did you do that for?

**A. LAMENT:** Ah, come off it Lach. You know we weren't getting anything else out of her. It was just like the others.

**CAIRNS:** Mmmmmm. I suppose you're right. Strange, though. What did you make of it?

**A. LAMENT:** Same as the others. Wasn't able to answer anything specific except what was immediately available around her, and what was obvious about the state of her body. I don't think this is resurrection, I think it's something else.

**CAIRNS:** I don't know. I feel like we're missing something here. There's //something// in there doing the talking. (//Pauses//) What about that rune you were looking at? Have you made any more progress with it?

**A. LAMENT:** I have, actually. Look here - (//sound of shuffling papers//) - this is the rune they used for speech, that one on the top, which makes sense, and this one here is either "soul" or "self". But then look at this one. Recognize anything about it?

**CAIRNS:** Let me see. (//Pauses//) Is that... travel?

**A. LAMENT:** It is, specifically, from one place to another far away. But it's not a rune really, not in the way we're used to. It's just a word, it shows up on all these other... well, I suppose they're receipts, in the classic sense, but it was used when describing goods brought to their locality from somewhere far away.

**CAIRNS:** Curious.

**A. LAMENT:** More than just that, too. These predate the Greek myths about the boatman, so whatever "toll" they were intended for has got to be... something different, I imagine.

**CAIRNS:** Or someone.

**A. LAMENT:** Aye. Or someone.

**CAIRNS:** So what about that last one then?

**A. LAMENT:** That one... your guess is as good as mine. These were very clearly meticulously crafted, but that one is unfinished. It's funny - it's like they left themselves room to work, see here? It's not like the rest of the coin where the material has been bored out, there's room there for another symbol, they've just left it unfinished.

**CAIRNS:** Very curious.

**A. LAMENT:** I thought it might be the rejuvenation rune, like this one on the other coin, but it's really only the first half of it, which doesn't make any sense. The tool mark here makes me think they started on it but never completed it. (//Pauses//) Would you like my //professional// opinion, Dr. Cairns.

**CAIRNS:** You're not just here for your engaging discourse, Dr. Lament.

**A. LAMENT:** Clever boy. Well. In my //professional// opinion, this is an incomplete ritual. What these things do, whoever they were intended to commune with, they are unfinished. I certainly could only hazard a guess at what they were attempting to do with them, but I don't believe they are functioning correctly.

**CAIRNS:** And you don't think it's actually the dead we're speaking with.

**A. LAMENT:** That is a question better left to occult studies. Have you spoken to Charles? He may know someone over there.

**CAIRNS:** Ah, but he's such a bore. Feel like I need to fill out forms in triplicate just to get into his office.

**A. LAMENT:** You poor thing. So put upon.

**CAIRNS:** You mock me, miss.

**A. LAMENT:** Miss? Sir, I am a //doctor of anomalous antiquities.// That's //Doctor// Miss to you.

**CAIRNS:** How could I forget.

**A. LAMENT:** How about this. Next week I'm traveling to Canada to help Aleksy assess some relics they dug up near the lake. Once I get back, we'll schedule a trip to go chat with Charles together.

**CAIRNS:** Thank god. I was worried you were going to tell me to go with Alto.

**A. LAMENT:** Would you prefer that, or my brother?

**CAIRNS:** Either of them and Charles? Is suicide an option?

**A. LAMENT:** Lucky for you, that won't be necessary. By the way, you should turn that recorder off. Last thing we need is people knowing we have idle chit chat over dead bodies.

**CAIRNS:** Ah, good-

**Addendum 8586.2:** 8586-CHARON Background

8586-CHARON was an event that transpired on the 21st of December 1987 after Dr. Cairns' unsanctioned experimentation with the aforementioned SCP-███, seemingly in an attempt to reanimate the recently deceased Dr. Aileen Lament. Dr. Lament had died ten days prior during an unexpected activation of [[[SCP-354]]], an event that significantly affected Dr. Cairns.

Security footage indicates that Dr. Cairns made several unlogged withdrawals of SCP-███ in the period between Dr. Lament's death and the 8586-CHARON event. The relatively lax security protocols, common at the time for the smaller Site-17, meant these actions did not immediately prompt security intervention, with the single exception being one recorded exchange later recovered between Dr. Cairns and then Mobile Task Force Epsilon-11 "Nine-Tailed Fox" team lead Troy Lament, Dr. Lament's brother and Dr. Cairns' brother-in-law. This exchange was not revealed until after 8586-CHARON had concluded, when a thorough review of all Site-17 security footage was conducted.

[BEGIN LOG]

**T. LAMENT:** -told you that you shouldn't be down here. It's not healthy.

**CAIRNS:** Can you get off my case? I'm just working.

**T. LAMENT:** Don't bullshit me, Lach. I know you're not logging this, and I know what this thing does.

**CAIRNS:** Are you seriously getting on me for not filing paperwork? Is this really the best use of your time?

**T. LAMENT:** Come on, brother. Don't pretend I don't know what this is.

**CAIRNS:** What this is? This is our //job//, Troy. This is the work we do. I've seen this thing do things that I... that need to be followed up on. That's the job, isn't it?

**T. LAMENT:** In a controlled environment with rigorous oversight, yes, but that's not what you're trying to do here.

**CAIRNS:** I don't need to explain myself to-

**T. LAMENT:** You //will// need to explain yourself to admin if you don't-

**CAIRNS:** (suddenly agitated) She //spoke// to me, Troy. She said my //name//. NONE of the others were able to do that. Do you get it? Something is different here, and if something has changed then //I want to know why.// I'm a scientist goddammit, I'm not just going to-

**T. LAMENT:** (//interrupting//) You shouldn't have been-

**CAIRNS:** (//continuing//) -sit by and wait for her to rot in the ground before the mechanisms of this organization deign to do us the-

**T. LAMENT:** Lach.

**CAIRNS:** (//continuing//) -basic dignity of deciding whether or not we can recover one of our //best!//

**T. LAMENT:** She's gone.

**CAIRNS:** She is //not gone//, Troy. If I'm right, //none of them are gone//. Don't you get it? If I'm right, then we never have to lose anyone else ever again. This place takes and takes and takes and up until now we were //sure// that it would never give any of them back. Well, now I'm not so sure.

**T. LAMENT:** That's not what our job is.

**CAIRNS:** What is our job then? Die in the dark? If we don't have to die, then why should we? Is it not better for us to continue the work we're doing? Is it not better that she... that... that she doesn't...

**T. LAMENT:** Lach.
